atm9.modpack.title.original: All the Mods 9 - To the Sky
atm9.modpack.title.translation: All the Mods 9 翱翔天際

atm9.quest.SG.SG.original: Silent Gear Weapons, Tools, and Armor
atm9.quest.SG.SG.translation: 寂靜裝備的武器、工具和盔甲

atm9.quest.SG.desc.SG.original:
Silent Gear is a tool and armor mod that makes crafting gear easy.

Each gear piece is customizable, allowing you to upgrade it with special traits or repair it on the go!

You can also convert vanilla tools like an Iron Pickaxe to a Silent Gear pickaxe by putting it into a Crafting Table!
atm9.quest.SG.desc.SG.translation:
寂靜裝備是個有關工具和裝備的模組，能夠為製作套裝增添樂趣。

工具和裝備的每個部件都是能夠客製化的，不僅能夠重複修復，還能透過升級添加各種特性。

你可以將原版工具放進「合成台」裡，將其轉換成寂靜裝備的工具！

atm9.quest.SG.desc.SGTool.original:
To make your first tool, take your Pickaxe Head part and put it into the crafting table.

To create a full pickaxe, you can either add a stick to the crafting table, or create your own custom handle using a &9Tool Rod Template&r instead of using a stick.

*Note: You can always search up the templates and then press U on it, then navigate to the 'Gear Crafting' tab. This will show you how to make gear parts.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.SGTool.translation:
要製作第一件工具，請將十字鎬頭部件放入製作台。

要製作一把完整的鎬，您可以在合成台上添加一根木棒，或者使用 &9工具桿模板&r 創建自己的自定義手柄，而不是使用木棒。

*注：您可以隨時搜索模板，然後按 U 鍵，進入「裝備打造」的頁籤。這將告訴你如何製作工具部件。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.alloyer.original: This is used to create custom alloys.\n\nIt is also the only way to get Tyrian Steel!
atm9.quest.SG.desc.alloyer.translation: 用於製造自訂合金。\n\n這也是獲得提爾鋼錠的唯一方法！

atm9.quest.SG.desc.blueprint.original: You can't use template boards forever!!!\n\nBlueprint paper is used to make blueprints, which are reusable, unlike template boards.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.blueprint.translation: 你不能永遠都在用模具！！！\n\n空白藍圖用於製作藍圖，與模具不同，藍圖可以重複使用。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.coating.original: Coats an item or tool.\n\nNetherite makes a great coating material.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.coating.translation: 對物品或工具進行覆層。\n\n獄髓是一種很好的覆層材料。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.dagger.original: Low damage, very high attack speed. Reduces the invincibility time of the target.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.dagger.translation: 傷害低，攻擊速度極快。減少目標的無敵時間。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.katana.original: Slightly faster than a sword, but lower damage.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.katana.translation: 速度略快於劍，但傷害較低。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.knife.original: Higher Durability than a dagger, but lower damage and speed.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.knife.translation: 耐久度比匕首高，但傷害和速度較低。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.machete.original: More damage than a sword, but slower.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.machete.translation: 傷害比劍高，但速度較慢。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.material_grader.original:
Placing an ingot in this with a Grader Catalyst will give the material a grade.

The better the grade, the better the stats are on the material.

The best grade is MAX.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.material_grader.translation:
將錠與分級催化劑一起放入其中，就能給材料分級。

等級越高，材料的屬性越好。

最好的等級是 MAX。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.repairkit.original:
Silent Gear items can be repaired using a &9Repair Kit&r.

To repair an item, place the Repair Kit into a crafting table, then place the materials needed to repair the tool inside the table with it. This will 'fill' the Repair Kit.

To repair the tool, combine the filled Repair Kit with the tool you'd like to repair in a crafting grid.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.repairkit.translation:
寂靜裝備物品可以使用&9修復套件&r進行修復。

要修理物品，先將修理包放入合成台，然後將修理工具所需的材料一起放入合成台。這將材料「填入」修理套件中。

要修復工具，請將裝有材料的修復套件和要修復的工具放入合成欄位中。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.spear.original: Less damage than a sword, but longer reach.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.spear.translation: 傷害比劍低，但範圍更遠。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.starlight_charger.original:
The Starlight Charger can 'enchant' materials with the 'Star Charged' enchantment.

A structure must be built with the Starlight Charger in the middle in view of the night sky. It only gains Starlight Power during the night.

The Charger must be placed in the middle of a 7x7 structure, with a Pillar in each corner. Each pillar must have a 'Starlight Charger Cap'.

It also requires a charger catalyst per material.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.starlight_charger.translation:
星光充能儀可以用「星光充能」對材料進行「附魔」。

建造建築時，必須將星光充能儀置於夜空之中。它只能在夜間獲得星光能量。

充能儀必須放在一個 7x7 建築的中間，每個角落都有一個支柱。每個支柱頂部都必須有一個 「星光充能柱帽」。

每個材料還需要一個充能催化劑。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.sword.original: Everyone loves the sword.\n\nWith this blueprint, you can make the basic sword! Reliable damage, reliable speed.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.sword.translation: 每個人都喜歡劍。\n\n有了這個藍圖，你就可以製作基本的劍！可靠的傷害，可靠的速度。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.template.original:
To get started with gear crafting in the early game, we'll need to make some &9Template Boards&r to create our first &eTemplate&r.

Templates are single-use 'blueprints' for creating tool parts. Using the basic boards, craft yourself a &aPickaxe Template&r.

If you combine the Pickaxe Template with 3 of most materials*, you can create a Pickaxe Head part.

*Note: Material must have a Silent Gear Material tooltip with the Main type.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.template.translation:
要在遊戲前期做出寂靜裝備的工具，我們會需要做一些&9模具基板&r來製作&e模具&r。

模具是一次性使用的「藍圖」，用來製作工具部件。試著用基板來製作一個&a鎬模具&r。

再拿鎬模具和三個材料合成，就能夠做出鎬頭部件。

註：材料必須為寂靜裝備材料中的主要材料（在物品提示查看）

atm9.quest.SG.desc.tier1SGCPC.original: This is a Tier 1 Pillar Cap for the Starlight Charger structure.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.tier1SGCPC.translation: 這是星光充電器結構的一級柱帽。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.tier2SGCPC.original: This is a Tier 2 Pillar Cap for the Starlight Charger structure.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.tier2SGCPC.translation: 這是星光充電器結構的二級柱帽。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.tier3SGCPC.original: This is a Tier 3 Pillar Cap for the Starlight Charger structure.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.tier3SGCPC.translation: 這是星光充電器結構的三級柱帽。

atm9.quest.SG.desc.tip.original: The tip upgrade is used to increase the mining level of the tool.\n\nFor example: If you have an Iron Pickaxe with 1 Diamond, you can make a Diamond Tip Upgrade, and place it on your Pickaxe. This will allow it to mine Obsidian, as well as give it a stat boost.
atm9.quest.SG.desc.tip.translation: 頂端升級用於提高工具的挖掘等級。\n\n舉例來說： 如果你有一把鐵鎬和一顆鑽石，你可以製作鑽石頂端升級，並將其安裝在鐵鎬上。這樣它就能開採黑曜石，同時還能提升數值。

atm9.quest.SG.subt.SGTool.original: Or At Least How To Make It

atm9.quest.SG.subt.salvager.original: Breaks down items into their components.
atm9.quest.SG.subt.salvager.translation: 將物品分解為各個組成部分。

atm9.quest.SG.subt.tip.original: For when you didn't find 3 Diamonds.
atm9.quest.SG.subt.tip.translation: 用於當你找不到 3 顆鑽石時。

atm9.quest.SG.tier1SGC.translation: 一階星光充能儀催化劑

atm9.quest.SG.tier2SGC.translation: 二階星光充能儀催化劑

atm9.quest.SG.tier3SGC.translation: 三階星光充能儀催化劑

atm9.quest.ae2.1k.translation: 製作你第一個儲存單元

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.16k.original: The third tier of storage component, providing &e16384&f bytes of storage.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.16k.translation: 第三層儲存元件，提供 &e16384&f 位元組的儲存空間。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.16m.original: The third MEGA tier of storage component, providing &e16777216&f (16384k) bytes of storage.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.16m.translation: 第三層 MEGA 儲存元件，提供 &e16777216&f (16384k) 位元組的儲存。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.1k.original: Each individual cell has a certain capacity dictated by the &ecomponent&f that the cell has been crafted with\n\nThe first of the components is the &b1k ME Storage Component&f, providing &e1024&f 'bytes' of storage for a given cell. More on that later.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.1k.translation: 每個獨立的單元都會擁有一定的容量，由製作單元所用的元件決定。\n\n第一個元件是 &b1k ME 儲存元件&f，為單元提供 &e1024&f 「位元組」儲存空間。稍後會詳細介紹。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.1m.original: There comes a point in any playthrough of a large modpack where even the highest standard tier of storage cell doesn't cut it for the amount of items and resources that you may be accumulating.\n\nThis is where the &dMEGA Cells&f add-on comes in, extending the available tiers of storage into the megabyte territory. The first of these new tiers is given by the &b1M MEGA Storage Component&f, providing 1024 &okilo&rbytes, or &e1048576&f bytes, of storage.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.1m.translation: 在遊玩大型模組包時，總會碰到某些情況，像是最高標準級別的儲存單元，已無法負荷你所累積的大量物品與資源。\n\n這就是 &dMEGA 單元&f的用武之地，將可用的儲存級別擴展到百萬位元組領域。其中第一個新級別是 &b1M MEGA 儲存元件&f，能提供 1024KB，又或者說是 &e1048576&f 位元的儲存空間。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.256.original: The fifth and final MEGA tier of storage component, providing &e268435456&f (262144k) bytes of storage.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.256.translation: 第五層也是最後一層 MEGA 儲存元件，提供 &e268435456&f (262144k) 位元組儲存。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.256k.original: The fifth and final AE2-standard tier of storage component, providing &e262144&f bytes of storage.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.256k.translation: 第五層也是最後一層 AE2 標準儲存元件，提供 &e262144&f 位元組的儲存。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.4k.original: The second tier of storage component, providing &e4096&f bytes of storage.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.4k.translation: 第二層儲存元件，提供 &e4096&f 位元組的儲存空間。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.4m.original: The second MEGA tier of storage component, providing &e4194304&f (4096k) bytes of storage.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.4m.translation: 第二層 MEGA 儲存元件，提供 &e4194304&f (4096k) 位元組的儲存空間。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.64k.original: The fourth tier of storage component, providing &e65536&f bytes of storage.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.64k.translation: 第四層儲存元件，提供 &e65536&f 位元組的儲存。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.64m.original: The fourth MEGA tier of storage component, providing &e67108864&f (65536k) bytes of storage.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.64m.translation: 第四層 MEGA 儲存元件，提供 &e67108864&f (65536k) 位元組的儲存空間。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.AE2.original:
&lWelcome to &bApplied Energistics 2&f!

Applied Energistics 2 (or &oAE2&r for short) is an incredibly versatile &bdigital storage&f mod, allowing for extremely efficient storage and all sorts of automation capabilities to greatly augment your modded Minecraft experience from as early as you want to the very endgame.

To get started with AE2, you will need to sieve for an important resource for the mod known as &bCertus Quartz&f.

For more information on AE2 beyond this chapter, consult the wiki over at
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.AE2.translation:
&l歡迎來到&b應用能源 2&f！

應用能源 2（或簡稱&oAE2&r），是個難以置信全能的&b數位儲存&f模組，使你能極度有效的儲存與執行各種自動化的工作，大幅改進麥塊模組的遊戲體驗，從遊戲初期至遊戲大後期都是。

開始發展 AE2 前，你必須篩出該模組的一個重要資源，叫做&b賽特斯石英&f。

關於這章沒提到的更多 AE2 資訊，請參閱

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.IO.original:
To make life that much easier, AE2 provides a whole suite of devices for the manipulation of ME data, i.e. moving stored items around the world.

The &bME Interface&f is one of these devices. As an input device, the Interface allows any item/fluid/etc to be piped externally through it, which is then automatically stored in the ME Network that the interface is connected to.

As an output device, the Interface can be configured to keep a certain available amount of a stored item in stock, from the ME network to its own internal inventory. This allows items to then be received by some external source like another player or some pipe.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.IO.translation:
為了讓生活變得更加輕鬆，AE2 提供了一整套用於操作 ME 資料的設備，即在世界各地移動時能儲存物品。

&bME 介面&f就是這些設備之一。作為輸入設備，介面允許任何物品/流體/等透過它進行外部管道傳輸，然後自動儲存在介面所連接的 ME 網路中。

作為輸出設備，介面可以設定為庫存保留一定可用數量的儲存物品，從 ME 網路到自己的內部庫存。這使得物品可以被一些外部來源（例如另一個玩家或某些管道）接收。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.MEIOPort.original: The &bME IO Port&f allows for the contents of an ME network's storage to be quickly rearranged between different storage media such as ME cells and external containers connected to storage buses.\n\nWhen a cell is inserted in an input slot on the left, the IO Port can be toggled to either empty the cell out into other ME storages or fill the (ideally, partitioned) cell with certain items spread out across other storages.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.MEIOPort.translation: &bME IO 埠&f允許 ME 網路儲存的內容在不同儲存媒介（例如 ME 單元和連接到儲存匯流排的外部容器）之間快速重新分配。\n\n當左側的輸入插槽插入一個儲存單元時，IO 端口可以切換，將儲存單元的物品取出並存入其他 ME 儲存裝置，或者將特定物品從其他儲存裝置中分散填入該（理想情況下，已分區的）儲存單元內。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.ME_controller.original:
The last piece of the puzzle for any large ME network is the &bME Controller&f.

A controller supplies an ME Network with a far larger number of channels than the standard 8 channels for ad-hoc networks, providing 32 channels out of each face of the block for a total of 216 channels.

That's only for a single-block controller, however, since the ME Controller is in fact a multi-block structure. The controller can be up to 7x7x7 blocks in size and can come in any freeform arrangement within that maximum size. Each individual block can then provide its own separate set of channels, so long as no single controller block is surrounded by 4 other blocks along the same plane.

An ME Network may only contain one multiblock controller at any given time. Attempting to connect more than one controller on separate parts of the network will cause a conflict, shutting down the whole network.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.ME_controller.translation:
對於任何大型 ME 網路而言，最後的關鍵是 &bME 控制器&f。

控制器為ME網路提供的頻道數遠超過臨時網路的標準8個頻道，每個控制器方塊的每個面提供 32 個頻道，總共提供 192 個頻道。

然而，這只適用於單方塊的控制器，因為 ME 控制器實際上是一種多方塊結構。控制器可以達到 7x7x7 塊的大小，並且可以在這個最大尺寸範圍內以任何形式排列。每個控制器方塊都可以提供自己的頻道，只要沒有一個控制器區塊在同一平面上被 4 個其他控制器方塊包住。

ME 網路在任何時候只能包含一個多方塊控制器。嘗試在網路的不同部分連接多個控制器會導致衝突，從而使整個網路停機。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.MElevel.original: The &bME Level Emitter&f, when configured with a specific item and quantity of it to respond to, will emit a Redstone signal depending on whether that item stored in the network either falls below, goes above or equals the given quantity.\n\nThis can be used, for example, to automatically switch certain machines on with Redstone to auto-craft a resource when it falls below a given minimum amount.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.MElevel.translation: 位準發射器當 &bME 位準發射器&f設定了特定的物品和數量後，會根據網路中該物品的儲量是否低於、高於，或等於設定的數量來發出紅石訊號。\n\n例如，這可以用來在資源低於設定的最低數量時，自動啟動某些機器進行自動合成。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.P2P.original:
&bP2P&f (peer-to-peer) is a powerful system within AE2, allowing for the transfer of items, fluids and even more without the need for any intermediary ME storage.

Right-clicking on a P2P tunnel with certain items will &eattune&f the tunnel into one capable of transferring something else, such as items through pipes, energy through cables, redstone signals and (by default) even ME connections themselves.

P2P tunnels must be linked to one another with the use of a &eMemory Card&f, detailed in the next quest.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.P2P.translation:
&bP2P&f（點對點）是 AE2 中的一個強大系統，允許在不需要任何中介 ME 儲存的情況下傳輸物品、液體等。

右鍵點擊 P2P 通道時，使用特定物品可以調整通道，使其能夠傳輸其他類型的內容，例如通過管道的物品、通過電纜的能量、紅石信號，以及（默認情況下）甚至 ME 連接。

P2P 通道必須使用&e記憶卡&f相互連接，詳細內容在下一個任務中說明。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.SSC.original:
&bSpatial Storage Cells&f are used to hold one defined volume each, and come in three different capacities allowing for a maximum of 2x2x2, 16x16x16 and 128x128x128 blocks' worth of space.

Upon encoding, a cell is allocated a section of space within the spatial storage &edimension&f, along with a unique ID corresponding to the region allocated to the cell. An encoded cell can still be used within the Spatial IO Port to retrieve any stored blocks and entities.

From then on, any blocks contained either within the cell's region of space or in an SCS with the same size as the one used for the initial encoding can be moved back into the overworld or into the spatial dimension respectively. If there are blocks both within the spatial region and within the SCS, these will simply swap places accordingly.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.SSC.translation:
&b空間儲存單元&f用於儲存特定體積的物品，有三種不同容量，最大可儲存 2x2x2、16x16x16 和 128x128x128 方塊的空間。

編碼後，儲存單元會在空間儲存維度中分配一個空間區域，並獲得對應於該區域的唯一 ID。編碼後的儲存單元仍然可以在空間 IO 埠中使用，以檢索任何已儲存的方塊和實體。

從那時起，任何位於儲存單元區域內的方塊或與最初編碼時使用的儲存單元同尺寸的空間塔中的方塊，都可以分別移回主世界或空間維度。如果空間區域和空間塔中同時存在方塊，這些方塊將會相應地交換位置。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.Sanchor.original: The &bSpatial Anchor&f is a companion device from the Spatial IO lineage that simply functions as a chunk loader. When connected to an ME network, the Anchor will force-load all the chunks occupied by the ME network across all cables and devices, excluding subnetworks, as long as the network remains powered.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.Sanchor.translation: &b空間錨&f是空間 IO 系列的配套設備，其功能類似於區塊載入器。當連接到 ME 網路時，錨會強制載入 ME 網路中除了子網路，所有線纜和設備所在的區塊，只要確保有持續向網路供電。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.acceleration.original: The &bAcceleration Card&f, depending on the device being upgraded with it, will either increase the speed at which the device operates or allow the device to carry out more operations in one go.\n\nIn the case of the &eMolecular Assembler&f, a full set of 5 cards reduces the time taken for the MA to fulfil a craft from one second (with no cards) to one &otick&r.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.acceleration.translation: 加速卡根據所升級的設備不同，將會增加設備的運行速度或允許設備一次執行更多操作。\n\n在&e分子組裝機&f的情況下，裝滿5張加速卡會將完成一次合成所需的時間從一秒（無升級卡時）減少到&o一刻&r。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.advanced_cabling.original: The &bME Smart Cable&f and &bDense Smart Cable&f function identically to the covered cables in terms of channel distribution, but will also visibly display the amount of channels they are using as colored lines along themselves.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.advanced_cabling.translation: &bME 智慧線纜&f和&b緻密智慧線纜&f在分配頻道的功能上與包覆線纜相同，但會利用彩色線條來顯示正在使用的頻道數。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.anchor.original:
The &bQuartz Cutting Knife&f, like the wrench, comes in both nether and Certus Quartz flavours and is a useful crafting tool to have on hand.

Cables can also be separated without needing to be colored by attaching a &bCable Anchor&f between them, crafted using this knife and craftable up to 50 times with the same knife before it breaks.

Cable Anchors can also be used to craft &bCable Facades&f, allowing you to disguise cables within walls by covering them with the face of an arbitrary block. While facade recipes are hidden in JEI, you can still craft them by taking any regular block and surrounding it with 4 cable anchors in the crafting grid.

Aside from crafting anchors, the Cutting Knife also has another use: right-clicking with the knife will open a small GUI that allows you to craft &bInscriber Name Presses&f. When given a name, these presses can be used inside of an Inscriber to rename any input item with the name of the press. Two of these presses can be concatenated in the inscriber to rename the item to the name of the top press, followed by the bottom one.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.anchor.translation:
&b石英切割刀&f和扳手一樣，有地獄石英和賽特斯石英兩種版本，是一個非常有用的合成工具。

&b線纜錨&f可以將線纜分離，而無需將線纜染色，這個錨是使用切割刀來製作的，同一把刀最多可以製作50個錨，之後刀子會損壞。

&b線纜錨&f還可以用來製作&b線纜偽裝板&f，讓你用任意方塊的表面來隱藏線纜。雖然偽裝板的配方在JEI中是隱藏的，但你依然可以將任意方塊放置在合成方格中，並用4個線纜錨包圍它來製作偽裝板。

除了製作線纜錨，這把切割刀還有另一個用途：右鍵刀子會打開一個小型介面，允許你製作&b命名壓印模板&f。給予名稱後，這些模板可以在壓印機內使用，將輸入的物品重新命名為模板的名稱。兩個這些模板可以在壓印機中連接起來，將物品重新命名為頂部模板的名稱，並接著底部模板的名稱。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.annhilation_plane.original:
The &bME Annihilation Plane&f can be used to automatically break any blocks in front of it and return anything dropped by the block directly to the ME network.

As an added bonus, the Annihilation Plane can be enchanted in the same way as a regular digging tool, affecting block drops in the same way as that enchanted tool would. This makes it ideal for processing ore blocks when enchanted with Fortune, for example.
Any added enchantments significantly increase the amount of energy used by the plane every time a block is broken. Enchanting the plane with &eEfficiency&f will decrease the overall energy use incurred by all other enchantments, while the &eUnbreaking&f enchantment gives the plane the chance to only use any energy sometimes, similarly to Unbreaking on regular tools.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.annhilation_plane.translation:
&bME 破壞面板&f可以用來自動破壞前方的任何方塊，並將該方塊掉落的所有物品直接回收到 ME 網路中。

額外的好處是，破壞面板可以像普通挖掘工具一樣進行附魔，並以相同方式影響方塊掉落物。例如，當附魔幸運時，它非常適合用於處理礦物方塊。
每次破壞方塊時，任何額外的附魔都會明顯增加破壞面板的能量消耗。附魔效率將減少所有其他附魔帶來的總能量消耗，而耐久附魔則使破壞面板有時候不會消耗能量，類似於普通工具上的耐久附魔。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.antimatter.original: When using a 64k storage component or higher, the Matter Condenser becomes able to condense significantly more to produce a &bSingularity&f. A single singularity requires 256000 items to be voided. That's exactly &o4000 stacks&r!\n\nSee what happens when you throw this singularity on the ground with a piece of &eender dust&f. You'll have to deal some damage to the surroundings while you're at it, but thankfully AE2 offers its own &bTiny TNT&f to minimise that.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.antimatter.translation: 當使用 64k 或更高容量的儲存元件時，物質聚合器能夠聚合更多的物品以生成&b奇點&f。生成一個奇點需要 256,000 個物品被銷毀。這正好是 &o4000 組物品&r！\n\n當你將這個奇點和一塊終界粉一起丟在地上時，你會看到周圍發生的事情。在此過程中，你可能會對周圍造成一些損害，但幸運的是 AE2 提供了自己的&b迷你 TNT&f 來最小化這些損害。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.assembler.original:
The &bMolecular Assembler&f is AE2's equivalent of an automatic crafting table, required to fulfil any and all &ecrafting&f pattern jobs.

Molecular Assemblers are capable of transferring power and channels to other ME devices connected to it, but will not themselves take up a channel. Up to 6 MAs can be connected to a single Pattern Provider (if employed) to allow for more crafts to be done in parallel.

MAs also each have their own dedicated slot for a single crafting pattern, allowing them to function standalone when powered. When operated in this way, any matching items inserted into the MA will be automatically crafted into the result of the pattern.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.assembler.translation:
&b分子組裝機&f是 AE2 中相當於自動工作台的設備，用於完成所有&e合成&f樣板的工作。

分子組裝機能夠向連接的其他ME設備傳輸能量和頻道，但它們本身不會占用頻道。最多可以將 6 個分子組裝機連接到單個樣板供應器（如果有使用），以允許更多合成作業一起進行。

每個分子組裝機還各自擁有一個專用槽位，用於存放一個合成樣板，使它們在供電時能夠獨立運作。以這種方式操作時，任何放入分子組裝機的符合模式的物品都會自動製作成樣板的結果。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.autocrafting.original:
Storage is nice and all that, but what good is a storage system if it's clogged up with raw materials needing to be crafted and processed into something and you're still stuck with having to do so manually?

AE2's &eauto-crafting&f system begins with the &bME Pattern Provider&f. The Pattern Provider holds certain items called &bPatterns&f (covered in the next quest) which are programmed to hold some recipe that turns input items into a certain output. Up to 9 patterns can fit in one provider.

You'll often be making use of multiple pattern providers scattered all throughout your base, which is why it's useful to have a &bPattern Access Terminal&f to remotely access the contents of any and all providers on your wider ME network.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.autocrafting.translation:
儲存系統雖然方便，但如果需要一直去製作和處理成其他物品的原料，而且你還是需要手動處理這些物品，這樣的儲存系統有什麼用處呢？

AE2 的&e自動合成&f系統始於 ME &b樣板供應器&f。樣板供應器儲存著稱為&b樣板&f的特定物品（在下一個任務中介紹），這些樣板被編程設計來儲存輸入物品轉換為特定輸出的配方。每個樣板供應器最多可以容納 9 個樣板。

通常你會在整個基地中使用多個分佈的樣板供應器，這就是為什麼擁有一個&b樣板存取終端機&f非常有用，可以遠程訪問你 ME 網路中所有供應器的內容。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.cables.original:
To connect the vast majority of your ME network together, you will need some cable. &eME Glass Cable&f is the first and most basic kind of cable, and you'll be making this all throughout as the first step towards crafting the other kinds of cable.

Both glass cables and their &ecovered&f counterpart can carry up to 8 channels along a single section of cabling. Unlike glass cables, covered cables can subsequently be crafted into &edense&f covered cables, capable of carrying up to 32 channels. However, most 'multipart' devices such as buses and terminals cannot be directly attached to dense cables, requiring normal-width cables to form a connection instead.

All cables can also be crafted with dye to color them. Uncolored ('Fluix') cables can connect to any other color of cable, but otherwise differently-colored cables will never connect to one another.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.cables.translation:
要把你的 ME 網路連接起來時，會需要一些線纜。&eME玻璃線纜&f是最基本的一種線纜，並且要使用它來合成其他種類的線纜。

玻璃線纜及其&e包覆&f的版本每段線纜可以擁有多達 8 個頻道。不同於玻璃線纜，包覆線纜可以進一步合成成&e緻密&f包覆線纜，能夠擁有多達 32 個頻道。然而，大多數的設備，如匯流排和終端機，無法直接放在緻密線纜上，而是需要使用普通寬度的線纜來連接。

所有線纜也可以用染料進行染色。未染色的（「福魯伊克斯」）線纜會與任何其他顏色的線纜連接，但不同顏色的線纜則不會互相連接。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.capacity.original: The &bCapacity Card&f allows a bus upgraded with it to carry a larger filter. Import and Export buses upgraded with capacity cards can go from supporting only one filtered item each to their maximum nine-slot filter, while Storage buses will go from 18 slots to a maximum of 63.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.capacity.translation: &b容量卡&f允許升級的匯流排攜帶更大的過濾器。使用容量卡升級的輸入和輸出匯流排，可以從原本只支援篩選一個物品，擴展到最多 9 個欄位，而儲存匯流排則可以從 18 個欄位擴展到最多 63 個欄位。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.cards.original: The &bFuzzy Card&f allows a filtered item to be matched regardless of any (NBT) metadata such as damage or enchantments, while the &bInverter Card&f toggles the filter on such buses from being a whitelist to being a blacklist.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.cards.translation: &b模糊卡&f能讓篩選的物品，在不考慮任何（NBT）後設資料（如耐久度或附魔）的情況下進行比對，而&b反相卡&f則是將這些匯流排上的篩選器，從白名單切換成黑名單。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.channels.original:
In Applied Energistics 2, every ME network has a certain number of &echannels&f available, which simply means how many networked devices can fit on the whole network.

As a rule of thumb, any device that more or less handles ME data directly (items stored within the network) and carries out some form of I/O will take up a channel. Usually components that are only concerned with the internal power storage of the network, like &eEnergy Cells&f and &eInscribers&f, do &onot&r take up channels.

Networks without an &bME Controller&f are known as 'ad-hoc' networks and only support a maximum of 8 channels.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.channels.translation:
在應用能源 2 裡，每個 ME 網路都有一定數量的可用&e頻道&f，簡單來說就是整個網路上可以容納多少個連網裝置。

根據經驗，所有多少會直接處理 ME 資料（儲存在網路內的項目）並執行某種形式「輸入/輸出」功能的裝置都將佔用一個頻道。通常來說，只和網路內部電力儲存的元件，比如 &e能量電池&f 和 &e印壓機&f &o不會&r 占用頻道。

沒有&b ME 控制器&f 的網路被稱為「特設臨時」網路，並且最多只能支援八個頻道。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.coloring.original: The &bColor Applicator&f is a chargeable tool that allows for in-world dyeing of cables. It functions more or less as a specialised &estorage cell&f to be loaded up with either vanilla dyes or &epaint balls&f for specific colors, along with &esnowballs&f to wash colors off and turn cables back to their Fluix variant.\n\nApplying color to a cable uses 100AE of energy from its internal battery, for a total of 3400 cable segments in a single charge.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.coloring.translation: 染色器是一個需要電的工具，可直接在世界中對線纜進行染色。它的功能多少算是一個裝載特定顏色的原版染料或染色球的專門儲存容器，或伴隨雪球來洗去顏色，將線纜恢復回福魯伊克斯系列物品。\n\n為線纜著色需要使用內部電池 100AE 的能量，一次充電總共可為 3400 個線纜段染色。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.crafting.original: When applied as an upgrade to any supported device such as an Interface or Export Bus, the &bCrafting Card&f allows the device in question to automatically send out its own crafting requests for a required (filtered) item. Crafting CPUs can be set to respond only to these requests to prevent taking up CPUs meant for player-requested crafts.\n\nWhen the &eLevel Emitter&f is upgraded with the Crafting Card, it can be configured to emit Redstone in order to directly facilitate in crafting, by emitting a signal either &owhile&r a crafting job for its given item is detected or specifically &oto&r craft the item. The latter would apply for cases where the only thing needed to make a given item is a Redstone signal, without even requiring a crafting pattern.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.crafting.translation: 當作為升級套用在支援的設備（如介面或輸出匯流排）時，&b合成卡&f允許該設備自動發送合成請求，以獲得所需（篩選）的物品。可以將合成 CPU 設為只回應這類請求，來避免佔用到玩家用來請求合成的 CPU。\n\n當&e位準發射器&f安裝合成卡時，可被設定來發射紅石訊號，用於直接觸發合成。它可以在檢測到指定物品的合成作業時發射訊號，或是主動發射訊號來觸發合成。後者適用於只需要紅石訊號，即可合成指定物品的情況，該模式下甚至不需要合成樣板。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.crafting_coprocessor.original: The &bCrafting Co-Processing Unit&f helps speed up crafting jobs by allowing pattern providers to either send items out to their connected devices faster or to work concurrently to make multiple required ingredients.\n\nThe base AE2 co-processor provides one co-processor 'thread' to assist this, while the co-processing unit from &dMEGA Cells&f provides 4 threads in a single such block.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.crafting_coprocessor.translation: &b協同處理合成單元&f能讓樣板供應器，更快地將物品發送到其連接的裝置，或進行平行處理來同時合成多個所需的材料，藉此加速合成作業。\n\n基礎的 AE2 協同處理合成單元，能提供 1 個協同處理「執行緒」來進行合成作業，至於《&dMEGA 單元&f》版本的協同處理合成單元，其每個方塊都能提供 4 個執行緒。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.crafting_monitor.original: The &bCrafting Monitor&f displays the overall item being crafted, along with the remaining quantity of that item still being crafted.\n\nBoth the base AE2 monitor and the MEGA monitor function identically, but are provided for aesthetic purposes.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.crafting_monitor.translation: &b合成監控器&f會顯示正在合成的物品，以及距離完成合成請求的的剩餘數量。\n\n AE2 原生監控器的功能與 MEGA 版本相同，但提供美觀效果。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.crafting_storage.original: Before you can carry out an auto-crafting job, you need a device to actually store the request itself along with any interim items for multi-step crafts. This device is known as a &ecrafting CPU&f.\n\nA crafting CPU is a multiblock structure requiring at least one &bCrafting Storage&f block, optionally along with any other Crafting Unit. The multiblock can be made in any size, but must be a solid cuboid in order to form and function accordingly.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.crafting_storage.translation: 你能進行自動合成作業之前，你需要有個裝置來實際儲存合成請求本身，以及任何多步驟合成的中間物品。這個裝置被稱為&e合成 CPU&f。\n\n合成 CPU 是一種多方塊結構，其結構至少需要一個&b合成儲存器&f方塊，並選擇性地搭配其他任何合成單元。多方塊結構可以搭建成任意大小，但必須是實心的長方體才能正常成型與運作。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.energy_acceptor.original: While the Inscriber and Charger will natively accept RF/FE, the vast majority of an ME network uses its own dedicated power system called AE.\n\nRF/FE can be converted into the native AE at a ratio of 2:1 RF:AE, either directly through an ME Controller, or through the &bEnergy Acceptor&f, which can instead be connected to any part of the network.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.energy_acceptor.translation: 雖然壓印機和充能器可以直接接受 RF/FE 電力，但大多數 ME 網路使用的是它自己的專用電力系統，稱為 AE。\n\nRF/FE 可以以 2：1 的比例轉換為 AE，AE 可以直接通過 ME 控制器進行轉換，或者利用&b能量接受器&f，後者可以連接在網路的任何部分。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.energy_card.original: The &bEnergy Card&f can be applied to most chargeable devices like Portable Cells and Wireless Terminals (covered later) to also increase &otheir&r energy buffer.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.energy_card.translation: &b能量卡&f可以用在大多數可充電的設備上，如之後會介紹的攜帶式單元和無線終端機，以增加它們的儲能量。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.energy_cell.original: By default, an ME network on its own only has an internal buffer of 800AE without an ME Controller, with the controller adding an extra 8kAE per block. For large enough networks, this can be insufficient and may cause a network to power off intermittently when trying to recoup power for any connected devices.\n\nThe &bEnergy Cell&f allows for an ME network to hold significantly more energy, adding another 200kAE per regular Energy Cell and 1.6MAE per &bDense&f Energy Cell. These can also be placed anywhere in the network to provide the increased energy buffer.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.energy_cell.translation: 預設情況下，沒有 ME 控制器的 ME 網路，其內部儲能量僅有 800 AE，而每個控制器方塊會額外增加 8000 AE。對較大的網路來說，這可能會不太夠，並且在嘗試為任何連接的機器恢復供能時，可能會導致網路斷電。\n\n&b能量電池&f可以讓 ME 網路儲存更多的能量，一顆普通的能量電池能儲存 20 萬 AE，而一顆&b緻密能量電池&f能儲存 160 萬 AE。這些電池也可以放置在網路中的任何位置，以增加網路的儲能量。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.equal_card.original: The &bEqual Distribution Card&f is an upgrade for storage cells that pre-allocates a certain amount of items that can be taken up by any individual type.\n\nThis behaviour is comparable to something like a Functional Storage drawer, wherein each compartment holds a set number of stacks as opposed to allowing items from one compartment to leak into the others and crowd other kinds of items out.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.equal_card.translation: &b平均分配卡&f是一種儲存單元的升級，它可以預先分配一定數量的物品給任何單一類型占用。\n\n這種行為類似於功能性儲存抽屜，在這之中，每個隔間可以容納一定數量的堆疊，而不是允許物品從一個隔間洩漏到其他隔間，並將其他類型的物品從中擠出。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.export_bus.original: The &bME Export Bus&f periodically spits items in its whitelist filter out to whatever external storage the bus is facing. Unlike the Import Bus, the Export Bus cannot work without being filtered.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.export_bus.translation: &bME 輸出匯流排&f會定期將其白名單篩選器中的物品，存進匯流排面向的任何外部儲存容器中。與輸入匯流排不同，輸出匯流排必須先寫入篩選器才會運作。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.fiber.original:
An important concept within AE2 is a technique known as '&esubnetting&f', wherein an extra separate ME network (a &esubnetwork&f) acts in conjunction with the main network to perform some specialised function or process.

What separates a subnetwork from a completely detached separate network is usually the use of the &bQuartz Fiber&f as a cable part. When placed between two otherwise unconnected lengths of cable, the Quartz Fiber transfers no data or channels between the two whatsoever, instead only transmitting power.

Thus, a subnetwork on the other side of the Fiber can be powered wholly by the main network's power source, without requiring any extra dedicated powergen.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.fiber.translation:
AE2 中的一個重要概念是稱為「&e子網路&f」的技術，其中一個額外的獨立 ME 網路（&e子網路&f），與主網路配合以執行某些特定功能或過程。

要將子網路與完全獨立的網路區分開來，通常會使用&b石英纖維&f作為線纜部件。當石英纖維放置在兩段原本不相連的線纜之間，石英纖維不會在兩者之間傳輸任何資料或提供頻道，而是只傳輸能量。

因此，石英纖維另一端的子網路可以完全由主網路的能源供能，而不需要使用任何額外的發電裝置。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.first.original:
Two of the very first things you will need to get started in AE2 are the &bCharger&f and the &bInscriber&f.

The &bCharger&f, when supplied with power, will take &eCertus Quartz Crystals&r and charge them. These &eCharged Certus Crystals&r can then be used in the production of &eFluix&f, another important resource in the mod. It can also be used to charge any item that stores power.

The &bInscriber&f can be used to turn the various quartz crystals in AE2 into their dust form, but more importantly is used to fabricate special &ePrinted Circuits&f and &eProcessors&f, as will become clearer in the next quest.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.first.translation:
要開始發展 AE2，你首先要取得的兩樣物品是&b充能器&f和&b壓印機&f。

當你給&b充能器&f供應電力時，它可以將&e賽特斯石英水晶&r充能。這些&e充能賽特斯石英水晶&r可以用來製造&e福魯伊克斯&f，這是模組中的另一種重要資源。&b充能器&f還可以給任何能儲存電力的物品充電。

&b壓印機&f可以將 AE2 中的各種石英水晶變為粉末形態，但更重要的是，它可以製造特殊的&e印刷電路板&f和&e處理器&f，這將在下一個任務中詳細介紹。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.fluid.original:
Items are not the only things that can be stored in ME cells. &bME Fluid Storage Cells&f can store liquids such as water, lava and any variety of modded oils and fuels, just to give a few examples.

Note that all storage cells, regardless of what they're designed to store, only differ in terms of their housing; both item and fluid cells use the same kind of storage component to make.

For fluids, 1 byte equals 8 buckets (8000mb).
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.fluid.translation:
ME 單元不只可以用來儲存物品，&bME 流體儲存單元&f可以用來儲存像是水、熔岩以及任何模組內的油和燃料之類的液體。

請注意，不管儲存單元的最終用途為何，它們之間的差別只在外殼：物品和流體元件都使用一樣的儲存元件來合成。

流體儲存單元的 1 個位元組可以容納 8 桶（8000mb）流體。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.fluix.original: Arguably the most important resource you will need next is &eFluix&f, used throughout the vast majority of AE2 devices and serving as a base for crafting all of the cabling within an ME network.\n\nYou'll typically want to mass produce these, and the way to do so is to make a &bFluix Crystal&f by throwing &eNether Quartz&f, &e&oCharged&r&e Certus Quartz&r and &eRedstone&f together in a pool of water. This will give you a &eFluix Crystal&r which you can turn to dust in an Inscriber.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.fluix.translation: 接下來，你可能最需要的資源是&e福魯伊克斯&f，它在合成絕大多數 AE2 裝置時都會用到，並作為合成 ME 網路內所有線纜的基礎。\n\n通常你會想要大規模生產福魯伊克斯，製作方法是將&e地獄石英&f、&e&o充能&r&e賽特斯石英&r和&e紅石&f一起丟入水池中。這樣就會得到一顆&e福魯伊克斯水晶&f，然後你可以用壓印機把它壓成粉。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.formation_plane.original: The &bME Formation Plane&f acts similarly to the Storage Bus, but treats the world itself as its storage medium. In other words, it will place down any block in its filter directly in front of itself.\n\nThis can be useful for situations where a block can be processed simply by placing it and breaking it with a certain tool.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.formation_plane.translation: &bME 成形面板&f其運作方式與儲存匯流排類似，但會將世界視作為儲存媒介。換句話說，它會將篩選器中的任何方塊放置在其正前方。\n\n這在某些情況下非常有用，例如當一個方塊可以透過放置，並用特定工具破壞來進行處理時。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.growth.original: Naturally, AE2 provides its own way to dramatically speed up crystal growth.\n\nPlace these around your Budding Crystals, give them some power, and watch your crystals grow!
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.growth.translation: 當然，AE2 本身就提供了能夠用來大幅提高水晶生長速度的方法。\n\n將它們通電並放在你的石英種子周圍，接下來就可以看著你的水晶長大了！

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.import_bus.original: The &bME Import Bus&f periodically sucks items in from whatever external storage the bus is facing. It can optionally be filtered to only take in certain items from said inventory.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.import_bus.translation: &bME 輸入匯流排&f會定期從其面向的外部儲存容器中抽取物品。它還可以選擇性地寫入篩選器，好從儲存容器中抽取特定物品。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.item_storage.original:
With the 1k Storage Component, you can now craft yourself a 1k ME Item Storage Cell to start your digital item storage system. You'll most likely want the majority of your storage to be for items, so you'll probably want to make a few &bME Item Storage Cells&f.

ME Item Storage Cells can each hold up to 63 different types of items. Each new type of item added to a cell will take up a certain fraction of the storage cell's total capacity in bytes. For each type already present, 1 'byte' counts for 8 items of that same type.

As an example, a 1k Item Storage Cell containing only cobblestone can hold up to 8128 cobblestone (8*1024b - 8b/type * 1 type).

If a cell is empty, it can be repurposed by disassembling it into its respective component and housing. This is done by sneaking and right-clicking in the air with the cell in your hand.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.item_storage.translation:
你現在可以利用 1k 儲存元件來合成一個 1k ME 物品儲存單元以作為你的數位物品儲存系統的開端。你大概會希望你的儲存系統主要用於存取物品，所以你可以先做幾個&bME 物品儲存單元&f。

ME 物品儲存單元可以容納63種不同種類的物品。單元中的每種物品都會分別佔用儲存單元的一部分總容量（以位元組為單位）。每個位元組可以放入8個同種物品。

舉例來說：一個只放入了鵝卵石的 1k 物品儲存單元最多可以放入 8128 個鵝卵石（8 * (1024b - 8b/種 * 1種)）。

如果單元是空的，玩家可以透過將其拆卸成對應的元件和外殼來重新利用它。可以透過將它拿在手中並對空氣潛行右鍵來完成這點。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.matter.original:
As for wirelessly expanding the ME Network itself, the first step is admittedly somewhat unorthodox.

The &bMatter Condenser&f is AE2's take on a trash can, voiding any items inserted into it. When fitted with a &eStorage Component&f, however, the condenser can harness some left-over energy from the item being voided and store it to make two special crafting items out of enough concentrated energy.

The first of these two items is the &bMatter Ball&f, requiring at least a 1k storage component and 256 items' worth of voided material.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.matter.translation:
要以無線擴展 ME 網路本身，第一步說實話有點不尋常。

&b物質聚合器&f是 AE2 的垃圾桶，用於銷毀任何輸入其中的物品。然而，當搭配&e儲存元件&f使用時，聚合器可以利用物品被銷毀後，殘存的一些能量並將其儲存起來，當匯集足夠能量後，能製作出兩種特殊物品中的其中一種。

這兩種物品中的第一種是&b物質球&f，需要至少一個 1k 儲存元件並銷毀 256 個物品。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.memory.original: The &bMemory Card&f is a tool with two different functions. The simplest of the two is to save various devices' configurations (such as whitelist filters) to be copied over to another device of the same kind.\n\nThe second function of a memory card is to link &eP2P tunnels&f together. When doing so, the P2P tunnel being linked will be assigned a unique ID, which is stored on the memory card for further linking.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.memory.translation: &b記憶卡&f是具有兩種不同功能的工具。最簡單的功能是儲存各種裝置的設定（如白名單篩選器），以便將其複製到另一個相同類型的裝置上。\n\n記憶卡的第二個功能是連接 &eP2P 通道&f。用來這麼做時，被連接的 P2P 通道會被分配一個唯一的 ID，該 ID 會儲存在記憶卡上以便進行進一步的連接。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.meteorite.original:
Since we're missing the floor, finding where meteorites land is gonna be a little too hard so instead we've replaced them!

Instead of finding Inscriber Press you can now craft them with an Inscriber. You'll need skystone dust for crafting them which we can get from sieving Dust.

Don't worry they are still used the same as if ATM9 had floor.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.meteorite.translation:
因為我們現在在天際中，想要找到隕石會變得非常困難，所以我們改用其他方式來代替！

你現在不需要尋找壓印模板，而是要利用壓印機來製作。你需要用到隕石粉來製作這些壓印模板，這些隕石粉可以通過篩塵土來取得。

別擔心，這些壓印模板的使用方式和 ATM9 在地表時是一樣的。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.more_items.original:
Aside from DISKs, you can also use netherite to craft what is effectively the complete opposite of the DISK.

&dMEGA Cells&f offers the bespoke &bBulk Item Storage Cell&f, which is limited to no more than &oone&r type of item storeable per cell but can store a practically &o&lINFINITE&r* number of that item type. Before it can accept an item type, it must be filtered in advance using a Cell Workbench.

*&oTechnically 'max long'. If you know then you know.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.more_items.translation:
除了磁碟，你還可以使用獄髓合成與磁碟完全相反的物品。

《&dMEGA 單元&f》提供了量身訂做的&b極巨物品儲存單元&f，每個單元最多只能儲存「&o一種&r」類型的物品，卻能夠儲存「&o&l無限量&r*」的該類型物品。在將某物品存入單元以前，必須先使用單元工作台將物品寫入單元的篩選器中。

*&o技術上來說是「max long」。如果你懂的話，你就懂。&r

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.network.original: The &bNetwork Tool&f is an important tool throughout AE2, which is used to display various details of a network on-screen such as overall power consumption and storage.\n\nAs an added bonus, it also provides its own small inventory used to hold &eupgrade cards&f, which can be accessed when looking at any upgradeable device's screen for easy replacement. However, it cannot rotate blocks attached to the ME network like a regular wrench, only dismantle them when sneaking.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.network.translation: &b網路工具&f是 AE2 裡的重要工具，用於在畫面上顯示 ME 網路的各種詳細資訊，如總體電力消耗量和儲能量。\n\n額外的好處是，它還提供一個小型的物品欄，用於存放&e升級卡&f，在查看任何可升級機器的介面時可以方便地替換升級卡。然而，它無法像普通扳手一樣旋轉連接到 ME 網路的方塊，只能用於蹲下拆解。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.overflow_card.original: This behaviour is comparable to something like a Functional Storage drawer, wherein each compartment holds a set number of stacks as opposed to allowing items from one compartment to leak into the others and crowd other kinds of items out.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.overflow_card.translation: 這種行為類似於功能性儲存抽屜，在這之中，每個隔間可以容納一定數量的堆疊，而不是允許物品從一個隔間洩漏到其他隔間，並將其他類型的物品從中擠出。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.patterns.original: &bPatterns&f are what hold an encoded recipe to be fulfilled by a Pattern Provider. To encode a recipe onto a Pattern, the &bME Pattern Encoding Terminal&f must be used.\n\nPatterns can be set to hold either a regular &ecrafting&f recipe, which will require the use of a &eMolecular Assembler&f on the face of its Provider, or a more general '&eprocessing&f' recipe, wherein any input items can be sent out by the provider into some other machine block or specialised processing plant.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.patterns.translation: &b樣板&f是保存樣板供應器完成編碼的配方。為了在樣板上執行編碼，必須使用&b ME 樣板編碼終端機&f。\n\n樣板可以設定普通的&e合成&f配方，這需要在其來源的一個面上連接分子組裝機使用；或是使用更通用的「&e處理&f」配方，任何輸入其中的物品可以輸出到其他的機器方塊或專門的處理計畫。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.portable.original: &bPortable Cells&f function identically to regular cells in that they can be inserted into a chest or drive and filled accordingly.\n\nHowever, unlike regular cells, their contents can also be accessed standalone via the cell item itself, a bit like a digital ME-flavoured backpack.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.portable.translation: &b攜帶式單元&f的功能與一般的單元相同，它也可以正常放入 ME 儲物箱或 ME 驅動器中。\n\n但是，與其他一般單元不同的是，玩家可以直接透過該單元本身來存取它的內容物，有點像是一個數位的 ME 風格背包。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.processors.original: Once you have obtained a full set of the required &eInscriber Presses&r, it's time to start making some &eProcessors&f. These are an important crafting ingredient used to make the large majority of ME-connected devices.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.processors.translation: 一旦你獲得了需要的一整組&e壓印模板&r，就可以開始製作一些&e處理器&f了。這些處理器是製作大多數 ME 網路設備的重要材料。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.pylon.original:
The Spatial Containment Structure (SCS) consists of a cage of &bSpatial Pylons&f covering the volume you wish to enclose in a Spatial IO cell. At the absolute minimum, an SCS requires three lines of spatial pylon blocks, one for each dimension of the space being contained (length, width, height).

However, Spatial IO is an extremely power-hungry feature, especially when trying to capture much larger spaces (up to 128x128x128). Having more spatial pylons included in the SCS around the desired volume will increase its overall &eefficiency&f, allowing it to use less energy to capture.

Also, be mindful that each individual pylon (regardless of its length) takes up one channel. For particularly large spaces, you may wish to build a dedicated network with a controller to fit all the required pylons.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.pylon.translation:
空間容納結構 (SCS) 由&b空間塔&f構成，使用空間塔將你希望包含在空間 IO 單元中的建築結構包圍起來。一個 SCS 需要至少三條由空間塔構成的柱子，分別對應被包含空間的各個尺寸（長度、寬度、高度）。

然而，空間 IO 是一個極其耗能的功能，特別是在試圖捕捉較大的空間（最大可達 128x128x128）時。在 SCS 周圍增加更多的空間塔，可以提高整體&e效率&f，使其在捕捉時消耗較少的能量。

此外，請注意，每個空間塔（無論其長度）都會占用一個頻道。對於特別大的空間，你可能需要搭建一個專用網路，並配備控制器來供應所有空間塔所需的頻道。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.quantum.original: If you did that last quest correctly, you should have turned that singularity into a pair of &bQuantum Entangled Singularities&f. These new singularities are used to link together a ring-shaped device known as a &eQuantum Network Bridge&f.\n\nWhen two of these individual rings have been linked using the Quantum Entangled Singularities and jumpstarted with some AE power (e.g. an energy cell), an ME network can be expanded wirelessly on the other side of the bridge, across either long distances or even dimensions.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.quantum.translation: 如果你正確完成了上一個任務，你應該已經把那個奇點變成了一對&b量子纏結奇點&f。這些新的奇點用於連接一個稱為&e量子網路橋&f的環形裝置。\n\n當這些單獨的環，使用兩個量子纏結奇點進行連接，並用一點 AE 能源（例如能量電池）啟動時，可以在橋的另一側無線擴展 ME 網路，無論是長距離還是跨維度都可以。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.quantumbridge.original: To get infinite range with your wireless terminal, you need a quantum bridge card. First build a quantum ring, then add the quantum bridge card to your wireless terminal, and a singularity to both the quantum ring and your wireless terminal.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.quantumbridge.translation: 想讓你的無線終端機有無限的網路收訊範圍，你會需要一張量子橋卡。首先你需要搭建一個量子環，並將量子橋卡安裝在你的無線終端機中，最後將兩顆奇點分別放入量子環以及你的無線終端機中。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.redstoneME.original: Individual ME devices can also be configured to respond to Redstone signals. When upgraded with a &bRedstone Card&f, a device can be configured to do work only when powered with Redstone or otherwise as needed.\n\nThis behavior can also apply to entire &osections&r of an ME network by using an &bME Toggle Bus&f. This allows a section of the network on the other side of the bus to come online only when the bus is powered by Redstone, or to go offline if using an &einverted&f toggle bus.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.redstoneME.translation: 每個 ME 裝置都可以單獨為其設定紅石工作狀態。當安裝了&b紅石卡&f，裝置可以設定成僅在接收到紅石訊號時運作。\n\n這種情境也可以透過 &bME 開關匯流排&f，套用在整個 ME 網路&o區段&r。這讓匯流排另一側的網路區段，僅在接收到紅石時上線，或使用&e反相&f開關匯流排時下線。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.spatial.original:
Aside from the storage of items and fluids, AE2 also provides a native way of storing entire &estructures&f inside of storage cells, not too dissimilarly to the Compact Machines mod.

The &bSpatial IO Port&f allows structures contained within a &bSpatial Containment Structure&f to be captured within a specially-designed storage cell, activated via a redstone signal.

If a mob or player happens to stand inside of the SCS while the space is being captured, they too will be transported to where the rest of the space goes, i.e. in a dedicated dimension. Just make sure you have a way to get back out and in if you're the one being captured.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.spatial.translation:
除了儲存物品和流體外，AE2 還提供了一種儲存整個&e結構空間&f的方法，類似於《壓縮機械》模組。

&b空間 IO 埠&f允許將包含在&b空間容納結構（SCS）&f中的建築結構，捕捉進專門設計的儲存單元中，需要使用紅石訊號啟動。

如果有生物或玩家恰巧站在 SCS 內部，當整個結構空間被捕捉時，他們也會跟著被傳送到該結構空間的去處，那裡是一個專屬的維度。要確保在被捕捉後，你有能夠進出該世界的辦法。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.storage.original:
Arguably the most important aspect of Applied Energistics 2 is its storage system, making use of digital &eStorage Cells&f. These cells are accessible through either an &eME Chest&r for single cells, or an &eME Drive&r for multiple cells.

The &bME Chest&f holds a single Cell at a time, which can then be read from and written to from any other terminal on the same network. The ME Chest itself also provides its own terminal screen on the top with specific access only to the cell it contains.

The &bME Drive&f can hold up to 10 assorted Storage Cells in the space of a single block and a single ME channel. However, it does not provide its own terminal screen, requiring some external terminal elsewhere on the network for storage access.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.storage.translation:
可以說，應用能源 2 最重要的特色就是它利用數位&e儲存單元&f的儲存系統。這些單元可以透過一個單元的 &eME 儲物箱&r或多個單元的 &eME 驅動器&r。

&bME 儲物箱&f一次儲存一個單元，然後就可以在同一個網路的任何其它終端機存取或寫入這個單元。ME 儲物箱還在自身頂面提供一個專屬自己的終端螢幕，它只提供箱子內部擁有單元的存取權限。

 &bME 驅動器e&f可以在一格及一個 ME 頻道的空間中容納十種不同的儲存單元。但是它並不提供自己的終端螢幕，需要在網路的其他地方提供外部的儲存存取終端機。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.storage_bus.original: The &bME Storage Bus&f, when facing some external storage container, will allow the container to be used as though it were part of the ME network, allowing items to be taken out from the container or inserted into it purely via ME.\n\nStorage buses can be filtered and given specific priorities such that specific items will try to go to the attached storage first, however it will not retroactively move any filtered items from anywhere else in the network to its attached storage.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.storage_bus.translation: &bME 儲存匯流排&f面向某些外部儲存容器時，能將容器視作 ME 網路的一部分使用，物品可以透過 ME 網路從容器中取出，或存入容器。\n\n儲存匯流排可以設定篩選器和指定優先權，以便將特定物品優先存入連接的儲存容器中。然而，它不會將網路中其他地方的已篩選物品，回溯性地移動到其連接的儲存容器中。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.terminals.original: &eTerminals&f provide access to any of the contents of an ME network. The standard &eME Terminal&f simply lists everything in the network as one large grid to pull from and insert into, akin to a single inventory.\n\nThe &eME Crafting Terminal&f is an extension of the ME Terminal which also provides a built-in crafting grid, allowing for convenient crafting using any item contained in the network and visible through the terminal screen.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.terminals.translation: &e終端機&f提供存取 ME 網路中任何內容的功能。標準的&eME 終端機&f會將網路中的所有物品以大型網格的形式列出，方便放入和取出，就像一個物品欄。\n\n&eME 合成終端機&f是 ME 終端機的延伸，它還提供內建的合成介面，可以方便地使用網路中任何可見的物品進行合成。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.weapons.original:
These last three items are more or less some extra toys provided by AE2 and don't necessarily fit under any of these quest trees.

The &bCharged Staff&f is just a simple powered staff which deals 3 hearts of damage and consumes 300AE per hit. It also uses pre-1.9 combat mechanics, meaning that you can spam-click with this like in the good old days.

The &bEntropy Manipulator&f, when &oused&r on certain blocks in the world, will smelt them in-place, such as sand to glass and metal ores to metal ingots. If not, it will simply light a fire on the block.

Finally, the &bMatter Cannon&f functions similarly to the Color Applicator as a dedicated cell for holding 'ammo' items such as Matter Balls and Iron/Gold Nuggets, which can then be fired out to deal damage to mobs or break blocks. Heavier 'ammo'Matter Balls in a Matter Cannon can be substituted with &bPaint Balls&f, which will apply a paint splatter effect on the face of whatever block being fired at. &bLumen Paint Balls&f are a variant of paint balls exclusively used by the Matter Cannon, whose paint splatters also give off some light once present in the world.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.weapons.translation:
最後的這三種物品基本上是 AE2 提供的一些額外玩具，不屬於任何任務線中。

&b充能手杖&f只是一把簡單的能量手杖，每次攻擊造成 3 顆心的傷害，並消耗 300AE。它還使用 1.9 版本以前的戰鬥機制，這代表你可以像舊時代一樣連續點擊。

&b熵變機械手臂&f當用來對世界上的某些方塊&o使用&r時，能將它們原地熔煉，例如將沙子變成玻璃，以及將金屬礦變成金屬錠。若不是上述類型方塊，它只會在方塊上點起火焰。

最後，&b物質加農砲&f的功能類似於染色器，用於存放「彈藥」物品，例如物質球、鐵與金粒，將這些彈藥發射出去，能對生物造成傷害或破壞方塊。重型「彈藥」物質球，在物質加農砲中可以用&b染色球&f替代，射擊在方塊表面時會套用顏料濺潑效果。&b流明染色球&f是物質加農砲專用的染色球，其濺潑效果在世界上呈現時，還會產生照明。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.wireless_AP.original: The next thing to make to allow for wireless network access is the &bME Wireless Access Point&f. The Access Point is used to open the network to wireless access via a &ewireless terminal&f, and has a set (finite) range depending on how many &bWireless Boosters&f are inserted into the access point.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.wireless_AP.translation: 下一步要製作的是 &bME 無線存取點&f。存取點能讓&e無線終端機&f遠端存取網路，網路訊號範圍（有限）取決於，存取點安裝的&b無線訊號增幅卡&f數量。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.wireless_terminal.original:
The &bWireless Terminal&f functions identically to a regular terminal, but wirelessly.

Before it can be used to access a network, it must first be &elinked&f to the network by placing it into the top-right slot of the &eWireless Access Point&r. If it is not linked to a network, or is out of either range or power, the terminal will not function.

Wireless terminals can also be upgraded with &eEnergy Cards&f to provide a larger internal battery.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.wireless_terminal.translation:
&b無線終端機&f的功能與普通終端相同，但能無線使用。

在用來存取網路之前，必須先將其放入&e無線存取點&r的右上角欄位，來&e連接&f至網路。如果它沒有連接至網路、超出網路訊號範圍或儲電量不足，終端將無法運作。

無線終端機還可以安裝&e能量卡&f來獲得更大的儲電量。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.workbench.original: The &bCell Workbench&f allows for cells to be 'partitioned' to hold specific items, i.e. given a whitelist filter. It also allows the cell to be upgraded with certain upgrade cards such as the Inverter Card, which sets the aforementioned whitelist to be a blacklist instead.\n\nCells can also be given a higher or lower 'priority' via the workbench, i.e. allow the cell to be the first to receive certain items until full, or made to wait for other higher-priority cells to fill up first.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.workbench.translation: &b元件工作檯&f允許元件被「分成幾個部分」來保存特定物品。換句話說就是給予白名單過濾器。它還允許使用某些升級卡對單元進行升級，比如說使用反向卡將上述的白名單替代成黑名單。\n\n元件也可以透過元件工作檯給予更高或更低的「優先權重」，也就是說，可以允許某些元件接收某些物品直到填滿，或是使之等待其它更高優先權的物品先填滿。

atm9.quest.ae2.desc.wrench.original: The &bQuartz Wrench&f does what any regular tech mod wrench would do. It rotates blocks and devices along the face you right-click on and dismantles them when right-clicked while sneaking.\n\nAE2's wrench comes in both certus and nether quartz flavours.
atm9.quest.ae2.desc.wrench.translation: &b石英扳手&f的功能與一般科技模組的扳手相同。右鍵點擊可以旋轉方塊和機器，而蹲下右鍵點擊可以拆解它們。\n\nAE2 的扳手有賽特斯石英和地獄石英兩種版本。

atm9.quest.ae2.subt.cards.translation: 其餘的兩張 IO 卡

atm9.quest.ae2.subt.crafting_coprocessor.translation: 下載更多 CPU（中央處理單元）核心

atm9.quest.ae2.subt.crafting_monitor.translation: 下載更多 VRAM（視訊隨機存取記憶體）

atm9.quest.ae2.subt.crafting_storage.translation: 下載更多 RAM（隨機存取記憶體）

atm9.quest.ae2.subt.equal_card.translation: ME 儲存 &m元件&r 抽屜

atm9.quest.ae2.subt.fiber.original: This has a use outside of crafting cables.
atm9.quest.ae2.subt.fiber.translation: 除了合成線纜外還有用處。

atm9.quest.ae2.subt.ininfity.original: I'm not writing the Toy Story line
atm9.quest.ae2.subt.ininfity.translation: 我不是在寫玩具總動員的劇情

atm9.quest.ae2.subt.terminals.translation: [在此處插入 Linux 使用者笑話]

atm9.quest.ae2.subt.wireless_terminal.original: This is what you're here for
atm9.quest.ae2.subt.wireless_terminal.translation: 這就是你來這裡的目的

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.affix.original: Affixed Weapons can be found plenty of ways but how do I know what's Affixed? Affixed Weapons will always have super long names usually with the type of weapon and name of who may have previously owned it. It will also be colored the Rarity it is, green for uncommon blue for rare and so on. It will also have bonus stats or at least Enchantability increase.
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.affix.translation: 詞綴武器有多種取得的方式，但我要怎麼知道什麼東西有詞綴？詞綴武器總是有個超長的名稱，通常會有武器的種類，以及前一個持有者的名字。物品名稱也會顯示稀有度的顏色，綠色是罕見的，藍色是稀有的等等。同時會有額外的素質加成，或至少增加可附魔的等級。

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.augment.original: This is what you really need for perfect affixes. First you need the Table, a Tool, and Sigils of Enhancement. Once you have all those, the world is all yours. You can reroll affixes, choose a specific affix, or upgrade set affixes!
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.augment.translation: 這是讓你打造出完美詞綴所需要的一切。首先你要準備詞綴改造台、一把工具，以及一些強化咒符。當你準備好了這些後，世界終將歸你所有。你可以洗鍊詞綴、選擇指定詞綴，或是提升你的詞綴屬性！

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.dust.original: To get Gem Dust you need an Apotheosis Gem and an anvil. Any Apotheosis Gem (Recommended only common and uncommon). Once you get your gems smash them with a falling anvil! Then to make this easier make a Salvaging Table.
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.dust.translation: 要取得寶石粉你需要一個神化寶石和一個鐵砧。任何的神化寶石（建議只用普通的和罕見的）。只要先將寶石用掉落的鐵砧砸碎，之後就能用分解台簡單的製作！

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.enhancement.original: Augmenting Table needs different Fuel to work, and that Fuel is Sigils of Enhancement.
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.enhancement.translation: 詞綴改造台需要使用不同的洗鍊材料，那就是「強化咒符」。

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.flawless.original: The better the Gem, the better the stats! Flawless is second best while Perfect is the best.
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.flawless.translation: 更好的寶石，更好的素質！無瑕的寶石是第二好的，而完美的寶石是最好的。

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.gem_cutting.original: Gem Cutting Table! To change the Rarity of your Gem you'll need to use this table. By using 2 of the same Gem and Rarity Materials you can increase your Gems rarity and that increases its power.
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.gem_cutting.translation: 寶石切割台！要改變寶石的稀有度，必須使用這個切割台。使用兩個相同的寶石，和一些稀有的材料，你能提升寶石的稀有度，意思是更強的寶石。

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.gems.original: If you want good gear you're gonna need Apotheosis Affixes, and that all starts with a Gem.
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.gems.translation: 若你想要弄一套好裝備，你絕對需要神化詞綴，而這一切的開始就是寶石。

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.mythic.original: Mythical Affixes are the best stats you can get so Mythical Weapons are what you want to aim for. Good luck getting one!
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.mythic.translation: 神話詞綴是你能拿到最棒的，因此神話詞綴武器會是你想要瞄準的武器。搞一把來吧，祝你好運！

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.rebirth.original: The Sigil of Rebirth is Fuel for the Simple and Better Reforging Table. They still need the other Material and obviously the item it'll change to work though.
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.rebirth.translation: 重生咒符是重鑄台所需的重鑄材料。除此之外你還會需要其他材料來對物品進行重鑄。

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.reforge.original: The Reforging Table does everything a Simple one does but better, it can do Epic and Mythic Affixes!
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.reforge.translation: 重鑄台和前一個東西一模一樣，但它能改變物品詞綴稀有度至史詩和神話！

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.salvaging_table.original: The Salvaging Table can finally get you materials and Gem Dust without using Anvils. You can recycle tools and armor with affixes to get their materials. And break down horse armor for some reason.
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.salvaging_table.translation: 分解台終於能讓你不用使用鐵砧，取得材料和寶石粉。你能將那些用不到的詞綴工具裝備重複利用，變為相對應的材料。普通的馬鎧也能分解。

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.sigils.original: Sigils are items used to change your Apotheosis Affixed items whether it be clearing sockets, adding more sockets, or removing the name. All are used with your item in a Smithing Table, Reforging Table, or Augementing Table.
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.sigils.translation: 咒符能用來改變你的《神化》詞綴物品，無論是清空鑲嵌槽、新增更多鑲嵌槽，又或是移除物品上與詞綴有關的名稱。\n\n這些咒符都需要在鍛造台、重鑄台，或詞綴改造台中與物品一同使用。

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.simple.original: The Simple Reforging Table is used like an Enchantment Table but with Affixes. With Gem Dust, Rarity Materials, Sigils of Rebirth, and an Affixed item, you can reroll the affixes for a cost of EXP. This can also be used to change the Rarity of the Affixed item up to Rare
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.simple.translation: 簡易重鑄台類似附魔台，只是它是用來附詞綴。使用寶石粉、稀有度材料、重生咒符，以及詞綴物品，就能消耗經驗來洗詞綴。這能改變物品的詞綴稀有度，最高能提升至稀有。

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.smith.original: You got tools and Gems so how do we combine them? First, make sure your tool has an open Socket. (For more on Sockets check the Vials and Sigils section). If one is open, you can combine your tool and Gem in a Smithing Table. If you aren't happy with your current Gems then you might need a...
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.smith.translation: 你有工具和寶石了，但我們要怎麼將它們組合在一起？首先，先確認你的工具有插槽。（想要有更多插槽請參閱咒符與試劑的任務。）若有空的插槽，你能在鍛造台中終將工具和寶石組合在一起。若你對現有的寶石不甚滿意的話，你需要...

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.socket.original: To those new to Apotheosis sockets are confusing and irritating. Your weapons and armor need sockets to use Gems with it. But what if it doesn't have a socket? Then you'll need a Sigil of Socketing! Combine your item and Sigil in a Smithing Table and boom you can get up to 3 sockets.
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.socket.translation:
對於剛接觸《神化》模組的玩家來說，寶石鑲嵌是如此地令人困惑與苦惱。

你的武器與盔甲需要有鑲嵌槽，才能將寶石鑲嵌上去。但它若沒有鑲嵌槽的話該怎麼辦？

這時你就會需要鑲嵌咒符！將你的物品與咒符放入鍛造台中結合，你最多能得到 3 個鑲嵌槽。

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.unnaming.original: Sigil of Unnaming does as it suggests. When you have an affixed item with an awkwardly long name, you can combine it with the Sigil in a smithing table to get rid of most of the name. (Only the material and weapon type as with the rarity color will stay).
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.unnaming.translation: 當附加在你詞綴物品上的名稱太長時，你可以將物品與除名咒符放入鍛造台中相結合，來消除大多數與詞綴有關的名稱（僅會保留造材、武器類型，以及稀有度顏色。）。

atm9.quest.affixes.desc.withdrawal.original: Thankfully Apotheosis has made taking sockets out of tools much easier! Now instead of having to choice whether to save the Tool or Gem you can now keep both. Use the Sigil of Withdrawal with an Affixed Tool in a Smithing Table and you'll separate the Gem.
atm9.quest.affixes.desc.withdrawal.translation:
值得慶幸的是，現在從工具上卸除寶石這件事，變得更簡單了！

你不再需要在你的工具或寶石間殘酷二選一，而是可以同時保留兩者。

在鍛造台中使用卸除咒符，便能將寶石從你的詞綴工具上卸下。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.64titanium.original: Dissolve Basalt to get Titanium Oxide, then dissolve that.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.64titanium.translation: 溶解玄武岩來獲得氧化鈦，並再次溶解它。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.Fr.original: Yes, this pun is for real...

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.Gd.original: No, I won't make you get a stack.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.Gd.translation: 不，我不會讓你拿到任何一個。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.Ho.original: What did you just call me?

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.K.original: Bananas are a good source of Potassium.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.K.translation: 食用香蕉是攝取鉀的好方式。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.Np.original: You should be able to get this... No problem.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.Np.translation: 你應該能夠得到這個...沒問題（No problem）。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.Og.original: Og? But isn't it the newest one?

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.Pm.original: Good, I'm not a morning person.

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.Pr.original: That's how these quests got added.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.Pr.translation: 這就是為什麼要加入這些任務章節。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.atomizing.original: Easy Ice - By Atomizing Water (the liquid), you can make Water (the item). Which you can then compact into Ice using the Compactor.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.atomizing.translation: 製造冰塊的簡單方式：你可以將水（流體）霧化來獲得水（物品），然後將它封壓成冰塊。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.basics.original: Alchemistry is a tech mod inspired by the mod MineChem. This mod allows you to decompose items into the elements that make them up, then recombine them to create new items. Start by making the guidebook.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.basics.translation: 煉金化學是一個啟發自《MineChem》模組的科技模組。該模組能夠讓你將物品解構為組成它們的化學元素，並能夠將這些化學元素重新組裝成新的物品。讓我們從製作模組手冊開始。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.bothreactors.original: Use the guidebook to help you build this (press on the eye). Glass isn't required, but is highly recommended.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.bothreactors.translation: 使用模組手冊來幫助你建造它（按那個眼睛），不一定要使用玻璃，但推薦使用。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.combining.original: It's like Little Alchemy, combine multiple elements, get another.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.combining.translation: 有點類似《小小煉金術》（網頁遊戲），將複數元素組合成物品。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.diamonds.original: Compact 16 Graphite Dust to make Diamonds!
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.diamonds.translation: 封壓16個石墨粉來製造鑽石！

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.dissolver.1.original: To create your first elements, you're going to want to make a Dissolver. When supplied with FE, the Dissolver will disolve items placed inside into their constituent elements.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.dissolver.1.translation: 要製造你的第一個化學元素，你會需要製作一個溶解機。當它通電時，它就會開始將放入的物品溶解為它們的組成元素。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.dissolver.2.original: Most elements are farmable with Productive Bees.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.dissolver.2.translation: 大多數的元素都可以透過《生產蜜蜂》模組來量產。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.dust.original: The elements for metals in ATO can be turned into dust.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.dust.translation: ATO模組內含的金屬對應的化學元素能夠被封壓成礦物粉。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.element.original: Some elements are also ingots in ATO.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.element.translation: 有些化學元素對應到了ATO模組中的金屬錠。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.fission.original: The Fusion Reactor is a multiblock structure used to divide an element into 2 new elements from the atomic numbers of the element put in. For example, if you put in Bismuth (83), you'll get Molybdenum (42) and Niobium (41). Requires FE to run.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.fission.translation: 核分裂反應爐是一個能夠將放入的化學元素的原子數除以二來產出兩個新的化學元素的一種多方塊結構。舉例來說：如果你放入了鉍（83），你會得到鉬（42）和鈮（41）。需要消耗FE來運作。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.fusion.original: The Fusion Reactor is a multiblock structure used to combine 2 elements together to create a new element from the atomic numbers of the elements put in. For example, if you put Molybdenum (42) and Niobium (41), you'll get Bismuth (83). Requires FE to run.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.fusion.translation: 核融合反應爐是一個能夠將放入的兩個化學元素的原子數相加來產出新的化學元素的一種多方塊結構。舉例來說：如果你放入了鉬（42）和鈮（41），你會得到鉍（83）。需要消耗FE來運作。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.graphite.1.original: Should be obtainable with Graphite essence...
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.graphite.1.translation: 為什麼不能用石墨精華來製作...

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.graphitedust.original: Compact 8 Graphite to make Graphite Dust.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.graphitedust.translation: 封壓8個石墨來製造石墨粉

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.ingot.original: The Dust can then be smelted into Ingots.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.ingot.translation: 這些礦物粉能夠被熔煉為金屬錠。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.netherstars.original: Alchemistry can also be used to automate nether stars. Combine 64 Titanium, 64 Mendelevium, 64 Dysprosium and 64 Lutetium in a Combiner to make a Nether Star.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.netherstars.translation: 煉金化學也能夠自動量產地獄之星。化合64個鈦、64個鍆、64個鏑和64個鎦來製作地獄之星。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.oxygen.original: I recommend atomizing water and dissolving the water you get from that. You'll need quite a bit of oxygen to get started.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.oxygen.translation: 我推薦你化合霧化過的水來獲得氧氣。你會需要很多氧氣來起步。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.periodic.original: Congratulations on gathering every element of the Periodic Table! As a reward have a one time placeable Periodic Table, once this is placed, you can't get it back...This is a 5x3 Painting.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.periodic.translation: 恭喜你收集完了元素週期表的所有元素！\n\n作為獎勵，有一個一次性可放置的元素週期表，一旦放置，你就無法將其取回...因為這是一幅 5x3 的繪畫。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.reactors.1.original: Both Reactors need Reactor Casings. Reactor Glass is highly recommended.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.reactors.1.translation: 兩種反應爐都需要反應爐外殼。推薦使用一些反應爐玻璃。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.reactors.2.original: You're going to need a lot of platinum for this.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.reactors.2.translation: 你會需要很多的鉑錠來製作它。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.silicon.original: Dissolve Silicon or Ender Pearls for a bunch.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.silicon.translation: 溶解一些矽或終界珍珠。

atm9.quest.alchem.desc.silicondioxide.original: Combine 2 Oxygen and 1 Silicon or dissolve stone.
atm9.quest.alchem.desc.silicondioxide.translation: 化合兩個氧和一個矽或是溶解石頭。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.Mundabitur.original: Mundabitur Dust can be annoying to craft, so you can alternatively obtain it by looting End City chests.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.Mundabitur.translation: 潔淨粉的製作過程可能有點麻煩，所以你也可以透過搜刮終界城的箱子來取得

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.Powah.original: The Nitro Crystal is the hardest part of making &6Allthemodium&r. You must progress through the &9Powah&r mod to get this.\n\nNote: Energizing through Powah is how you actually craft &6Allthemodium&r Ingots.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.Powah.translation: 地獄之星電晶是製作 &6ATM 金屬&r中最困難的一步。你必須先發展&9波瓦科技&r這個模組才能取得。\n\n注意：波瓦科技的充能室，也是製作 &6ATM 金屬錠&r的必要機制。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.alloysmelt.original: A simple Alloy Smelter. Combine Gold, Redstone, and Glowstone to get your Energetic Alloy Ingot.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.alloysmelt.translation: 一個簡單的合金爐。將黃金，紅石粉和螢石粉放入合金爐熔煉取得充能合金錠。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.arcane.original: You will need some Arcane Crystal Dust for &6Allthemodium&r, and it isn't common. Go ahead and sieve a bunch of dust for it (Iron/Diamond Mesh).
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.arcane.translation: 製作 &6ATM 金屬錠&r會需要一些神秘水晶粉，而這並不常見。繼續篩些塵土取得（鐵製 / 鑽石篩網）。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.ars.original: Go dive into &dArs Nouveau&r to create this.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.ars.translation: 發展&d新生魔藝&r模組取得它。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_apple.original: Who needs Enchanted Golden Apples now?
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_apple.translation: 誰現在還需要附魔金蘋果？

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_armor.original: Allthemodium armor is WAY better than Netherite!
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_armor.translation: ATM 金屬裝備可比獄髓裝好上不少！

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_bee.original: Need more &6Allthemodium&r? Make some bees!\n\nOnly better than the Ore Laser Base with Omega Upgrades (or lots of bees).
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_bee.translation: 需要更多的&6ATM 金屬&r嗎？製造一些蜜蜂！\n\n（只在擁有升級：生產Ω 的情況下比礦物雷射鑽更快）

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_carrot.original: It's much better than a Golden Carrot!

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_furnace.original: &6Allthemodium&r can be used to make an extremely fast Furnace! This Furnace smelts 16 items per operation (16x better than it's Netherite counterpart).
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_furnace.translation: &6ATM 金屬&r能夠用來製作一個非常快速的熔爐！該熔爐一次能夠熔煉 16 個物品（比獄髓熔爐快了 16 倍）。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_seeds.original: &6Allthemodium&r can be automated using seeds. These will produce &6Allthemodium Essence&r which can then be crafted into &6Allthemodium Nuggets&r. Can be made insanely fast with the right set up.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_seeds.translation: &6ATM 金屬&r能夠透過種子來進行自動化。這些種子會產出&6ATM 金屬精華&r，並能夠使用它來合成出&6ATM 金屬粒&r。藉由正確的搭配能夠以極快的速度進行產出。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_smith.original: The &6Allthemodium Smithing Template&r is needed to make &6Allthemodium Armor&r and makes &6Allthemodium Tools&r a lot cheaper.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_smith.translation: &6ATM 金屬鍛造模板&r是製作 &6ATM 金屬盔甲&r的必要材料，並使 &6ATM 金屬工具&r製作起來更加便宜。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_tools.original: Note: While the &aUpgrade Template&r is not needed to make the initial tool, it will save you a lot of &6Allthemodium Ingots&r!\n\nThese tools are unbreakable.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atm_tools.translation: 注意：製作一把 ATM 金屬工具其實並不需要&a鍛造模板&r，這能為你省下一堆的 &6ATM 金屬錠&r！\n\n這些工具是無法破壞的。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atmingredie.original: Used as a catalyst to summon the Vibranium Ingot.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.atmingredie.translation: 作為催化劑使用來召喚汎金屬錠。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.bucketoflif.original: Go dive into &4&lBlood Magic&r&r to create this.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.bucketoflif.translation: 發展&4&l血魔法&r&r模組取得它。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.fluxinfused.original: Craft together some Gold Dust and some Redstone Dust.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.fluxinfused.translation: 由金粉與一些紅石粉合成而來。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.infinite_at.original: The &6Allthemodium Block&r is how you make yourself an infinite source of &6Allthemodium&r.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.infinite_at.translation: &6ATM 金屬方塊&r是生產無限的&6ATM 金屬&r的方式。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.infinite_un.original: Same deal as the &6Allthemodium Block&r, use this to make an infinite source of &5Unobtainium&r. Can be made the same way with a Laser Drill only with a &5Unobtainium Block&r instead.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.infinite_un.translation: 和&6ATM 金屬方塊&r一樣，是生產無限的&5難得素&r的方式。一樣將&5難得素方塊&r放入雷射鑽之中就行。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.infinite_vi.original: Same deal as the &6Allthemodium Block&r, use this to make an infinite source of &3Vibranium&r. Can be made the same way with a Laser Drill only with a &3Vibranium Block&r instead.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.infinite_vi.translation: 和&6ATM 金屬方塊&r一樣，是生產無限的&3汎金屬&r的方式。一樣將&3汎金屬方塊&r放入雷射鑽之中就行。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.insanium.original: Go dive into &aMystical Agriculture&r to create this.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.insanium.translation: 發展&a神秘農業&r模組取得它。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.intro1.original: &6Allthemodium&r is the core mod in all AllTheMods modpacks. This mod adds endgame ores to the world that amplify your modded experience. In this pack, however, you get this a little differently than you normally would.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.intro1.translation: &dATM 金屬&r是所有 ATM 模組包的核心模組。這個模組在世界中增加了遊戲後期的礦物，加強了模組體驗。然而在本模組包中，取得的方式與你之前遊玩的略有不同。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.laserbase.original: The Ore Laser Base is incredibly easy to use, and is a great source of &6Allthemodium&r. Place a base and attatch the drills to the sides of it (so they face down). Then place an &6Allthemodium Block&r in the left slot of the Laser Base and give everything power.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.laserbase.translation: 礦物雷射基座相當容易使用，且是很好獲取 &6ATM 金屬錠&r的方法。放下基座並將雷射鑽放在基座的旁邊（雷射鑽面向基座）。然後在基座內的左側欄位放入 &6ATM 金屬方塊&r，然後對所有雷射鑽供電。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.osmiumcompr.original: Combining Osmium and Glowstone in an Osmium Compressor gives you the a Refined Glowstone Ingot.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.osmiumcompr.translation: 將鋨和螢石粉放入鋨壓縮機中製作強化螢光石錠。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.pulv.original: The Pulverizer is going to be your first step to making a Soul Infused Ingot needed for &6Allthemodium&r. Pulverize some Apatite to get Apatite Dust, then pulverize some Soul Sand to get Soul Sand Dust!
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.pulv.translation: 磨粉機是製作靈魂灌注錠的第一步，這是 ATM 金屬的必需品。將一些磷灰石研磨成粉，然後磨一些靈魂砂取得靈魂砂粉！

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.soulinfused.original: Make some Soul Infused Dust first, then smelt it.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.soulinfused.translation: 先製作一些靈魂灌注錠，然後燒製成錠。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob.original: &5Unobtainium Ore&r can be found rarely in the End Highlands biome.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob.translation: &5難得素原礦&r能夠在終界高地生態域中找到。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob_armor.original: &5Unobtainium Armor&r is even stronger than &3Vibranium Armor&r!
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob_armor.translation: &5難得素盔甲&r比&3汎金屬盔甲&r更強！

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob_bee.original: Need more &5Unobtainium&r? Make some bees!\n\nOnly better than the Ore Laser Base with Omega Upgrades (or lots of bees).
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob_bee.translation: 需要更多的&5難得素&r嗎？製造一些蜜蜂！\n\n（只在擁有升級：生產Ω 的情況下比礦物雷射鑽更快）

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob_furnac.original: The &5Unobtainium Furnace&r is even faster than a &3Vibranium Furnace&r!
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob_furnac.translation: &5難得素熔爐&r比&3汎金屬熔爐&r更快！

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob_seeds.original: &5Unobtainium&r can be automated using seeds. These will produce &5Unobtainium Essence&r which can then be crafted into &5Unobtainium Nuggets&r. Can be made insanely fast with the right set up.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob_seeds.translation: &5難得素&r能夠透過種子來進行自動化。這些種子會產出&5難得素精華&r，並能夠使用它來合成出&5難得素粒&r。藉由正確的搭配能夠以極快的速度進行產出。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob_smith.original: The &5Unobtainium Smithing Template&r is needed to make &5Unobtainium Armor&r and makes &5Unobtainium Tools&r a lot cheaper.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob_smith.translation: &5難得素鍛造模板&r是製作&5難得素盔甲&r的必要材料，並使&5難得素工具&r製作起來更加便宜。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob_tools.original: These are the same as &3Vibranium Tools&r but they mine even faster.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.unob_tools.translation: 和&3ATM 金屬工具&r相同，但能夠挖得更快。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.using_atm.original: Besides from being needed for &3Vibranium&r, &6Allthemodium&r can also be used to make some other useful items.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.using_atm.translation: &6ATM 金屬&r除了作為&3汎金屬&r的前置材料之外，它也能夠用來製造出其他有用的道具。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.using_unob.original: &5Unobtainium&r can also be used to make some very important items.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.using_unob.translation: &5難得素&r也能夠用來製造出一些重要道具。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.using_vib.original: &3Vibranium&r can also be used to make some very important items.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.using_vib.translation: &3汎金屬&r也能夠用來製造出一些重要道具。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib.original: Congratulations! However, 3 still won't be enough.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib.translation: 恭喜！但是只有 3 個還不夠。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib_armor.original: &3Vibranium Armor&r is even stronger than &6Allthemodium Armor&r!
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib_armor.translation: &3汎金屬盔甲&r比&6ATM 金屬盔甲&r更強！

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib_bee.original: Need more &3Vibranium&r? Make some bees!\n\nOnly better than the Ore Laser Base with Omega Upgrades (or lots of bees).
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib_bee.translation: 需要更多的&3汎金屬&r嗎？製造一些蜜蜂！\n\n（只在擁有升級：生產Ω 的情況下比礦物雷射鑽更快）

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib_furnace.original: The &3Vibranium Furnace&r is even faster than the &6Allthemodium Furnace&r!
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib_furnace.translation: &3汎金屬熔爐&r比&6ATM 金屬熔爐&r更快！

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib_seeds.original: &3Vibranium&r can be automated using seeds. These will produce &3Vibranium Essence&r which can then be crafted into &3Vibranium Nuggets&r. Can be made insanely fast with the right set up.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib_seeds.translation: &3汎金屬&r能夠透過種子來進行自動化。這些種子會產出&3汎金屬精華&r，並能夠使用它來合成出&3汎金屬粒&r。藉由正確的搭配能夠以極快的速度進行產出。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib_smith.original: The &3Vibranium Smithing Template&r is needed to make &3Vibranium Armor&r and makes &3Vibranium Tools&r a lot cheaper.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib_smith.translation: &3汎金屬鍛造模板&r是製作&3汎金屬盔甲&r的必要材料，並使&3汎金屬工具&r製作起來更加便宜。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib_tools.original: These are the same as &6Allthemodium Tools&r but they mine even faster.
atm9.quest.allthemodium.desc.vib_tools.translation: 和&6ATM 金屬工具&r相同，但能夠挖得更快。

atm9.quest.allthemodium.intro.translation: 為您介紹 ATM 金屬！

atm9.quest.allthemodium.subt.flux-inf.original: The easiest thing to make here
atm9.quest.allthemodium.subt.flux-inf.translation: 這些材料中最簡單的部分

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.alchemicalSou.original: The &9Alchemical Sourcelink&r produces Source from adjacent potion jars.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.alchemicalSou.translation: &9煉金魔源通道&r能夠利用附近的藥水罐來產出魔源。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.alchemicalSou.original: The amount of source varies per potion and complexity.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.alchemicalSou.translation: 提供的藥水數量越多、製作方式越複雜，所能夠產出的魔源也就越多。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.amuletOfManaB.original: The &9Amulet of Mana Boost&r gives a boost to max mana.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.amuletOfManaB.translation: &9魔力提升護身符&r會提供最大魔力量的加成。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.amuletOfManaR.original: The &6Amulet of Mana Regen&r gives a boost to your mana regen.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.amuletOfManaR.translation: &9魔力回復護身符&r會提供魔力回復速度的加成。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.arcanePedesta.original: Arcane Pedestals are needed for the Ritual Brazier and crafting items with an Enchanting Apparatus.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.arcanePedesta.translation: 儀式火盆和附魔裝置都會需要使用奧術基座。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.arcanePedesta.original: Go ahead and make yourself 8 of them!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.arcanePedesta.translation: 去幫它們做出 8 個奧術基座吧！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.castersWand.1.original: The &9Caster's Wand&r only accepts a single spell, and is inscribed using the Scribe's Table.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.castersWand.1.translation: 你能夠使用抄寫台來將一個法術抄入到&9巫師之杖&r之中。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.castersWand.2.original: Wand spells always start with Projectile > Accelerate, and MUST be inscribed with a spell that does not have another method (like touch, self, etc).
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.castersWand.2.translation: 透過法杖施放的法術會自動在前面加上「彈射物→加速」，但你不能夠在法術中使用其他的「型態」魔符。（如果你只是想要施放出「破壞」的話，就只要將「破壞」法術抄入到它之中即可）

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.castersWand.3.original: This allows you to cast spells beyond the 10 spell cap. If you want to use Break, just inscribe the wand with Break by itself.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.castersWand.3.translation: 這根法杖會讓你能夠打破只能使用 10 個魔符的法術限制。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.dominionWand.original: The Dominion Wand is used for controlling the creatures you might encounter in the world! Each being responds differently to the wand, so make sure to read up in the Worn Notebook!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.dominionWand.translation: 支配之杖是用來控制那些：你可能會在這個世界上遇到的生物！每種生物與支配之杖的互動方式都不太一樣，所以請在模組手冊中查詢牠們的頁面來取得更多的相關資訊！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.dowsingRod.original: The &6Dowsing Rod&r gives you Magic Find and Scrying when used.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.dowsingRod.translation: 你可以使用&6占卜杖&r來進行魔法探知和占卜。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.dowsingRod.1.original: This allows you to see nearby magic creatures as well as helping you find amethyst!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.dowsingRod.1.translation: 這會讓你能夠看到周遭的魔法生物，並能夠幫助你更容易的尋找到紫水晶！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersBow.original: This bow can be inscribed with a spell using a Scribe's Table.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersBow.translation: 你能夠使用抄寫台來將一個法術抄入到&9巫師之弓&r之中。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersBow.original: At the cost of mana, arrows will become Spell Arrows and will apply the spell on their target.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersBow.translation: 它會消耗一些魔力來讓射出的箭矢轉化為：能夠將該法術作用於目標之上的「法術箭矢」。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersBow.original: If you have no arrows, a spell arrow that deals 0 damage will be cast. If there is not enough mana, regular arrows will be fired instead.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersBow.translation: 如果你的物品欄中沒有任何箭矢，則它只會射出一根造成 0 點傷害的法術箭矢；如果你的魔力不夠的話，它只會射出一根普通的箭矢。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersBow.original: The &9Enchanter's Bow&r can also use special Augment Arrows that empower the inscribed spell.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersBow.translation: 你也可以使用那些特殊的增強箭來增加法術的威力。
