atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersMir.original: The &9Enchanter's Mirror&r will apply a self spell when used.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersMir.translation: 你可以透過&9巫師之鏡&r來施放一個作用於「自身」的法術。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersMir.original: Spells cast with this mirror are discounted and gain additional bonus duration.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersMir.translation: 透過此面鏡子施放的法術會使用較少的魔力，並能夠獲得額外的持續時間。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersMir.original: To apply a spell, use a Scribe's table. Create a spell without using a form.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersMir.translation: 使用抄寫台能夠將一個法術抄入到這面鏡子之中。（你需要創造一個沒有「型態」魔符的法術）

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersShi.original: When blocking damage, the &9Enchanter's Shield&r will give the user Mana Regen and Spell Damage for a short amount of time.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersShi.translation: &9巫師之盾&r能夠在擋下傷害後，讓使用者在一段時間內增加魔力回復量和法術傷害。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersShi.original: Additionally, the shield will repair itself over time using the wearer's mana.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersShi.translation: 更棒的是，這面盾牌能夠使用配戴者的魔力來隨著時間自動恢復耐久度。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersSwo.original: The &9Enchanter's Sword&r allows you to attach a Touch Spell to the sword.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersSwo.translation: 你能夠使用抄寫台來將一個「觸摸」法術抄入到&9巫師之劍&r之中。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersSwo.original: All spells on the Sword gain 1 additional Amplify augment to the last effect on the spell.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersSwo.translation: 抄入在此劍上的所有法術的最後一個「效果」都能夠獲得一次額外的「強化」。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersSwo.original: To apply a spell to the sword, use a Scribe's Table. Create the spell without using a form.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantersSwo.translation: 使用抄寫台能夠將一個法術抄入到這把劍之中。（你需要創造一個沒有「型態」魔符的法術）

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantingApp.original: The &9Enchanting Apparatus&r is used to craft various items within the mod. It requires Source to work.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantingApp.translation: &9附魔裝置&r用來製作模組中的各種物品。它需要魔源才能工作。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantingApp.original: It is also a multiblock structure that utilizes Arcane Pedestals to craft.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantingApp.translation: 但它是一種需要消耗掉奧術基座內的材料來進行合成的多方塊結構。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantingApp.original: Start by placing an Arcane Core in the ground, then place the Enchanting Apparatus on top of it. Surround the Apparatus with Arcane Pedestals.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.enchantingApp.translation: 首先，將奧術核心放在地上，然後把附魔裝置放在它上面。再用奧術基座環繞這個結構。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.finalTierSpel.original: To create the final tier of your Spellbook, you'll need to have killed the &6Wilden Chimera&r.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.finalTierSpel.translation: 你要先殺死&6荒野奇美拉&r才能製造出這本最高階級的法術書：「大法師法術書」。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.finalTierSpel.original: This is a Ritual that you'll need to complete using a &9Ritual Brazier&r.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.finalTierSpel.translation: 你會需要使用&9儀式火盆&r來召喚出這隻強大的魔王。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.jarOfLight.1.original: The &9Jar of Light&r summons a floating light source that follows you.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.jarOfLight.1.translation: &9光之瓶&r能夠召喚出一個跟隨著你的飄浮光源。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.jarOfVoiding..original: The &6Jar of Voiding&r destroys items you pick up in exchange for mana. This can be filtered.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.jarOfVoiding..translation: &9湮滅之瓶&r能夠銷毀你撿起的特定物品，並將它們轉換為魔力。你可以設定它的過濾器來決定哪些物品能夠被銷毀。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.jarOfVoiding..original: To add or remove an item to be destroyed by the jar, use the jar with the item in your off hand, or use an item on the Scribe's Table with the jar placed on it.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.jarOfVoiding..translation: 要將物品添加至或移除自它的銷毀名單的話，你需要將該物品放在副手並使用它；或是將它放在抄寫台上，然後對著抄寫台使用該物品。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.jarOfVoiding..original: The jar must be on your hotbar to function.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.jarOfVoiding..translation: 湮滅之瓶必須位於你的快捷欄之中才會開始工作。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.levitationBel.original: Have you ever wanted to just hover everywhere you go?
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.levitationBel.translation: 你是否曾經想要飄在空中？

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.levitationBel.original: This belt allows you to levitate. To activate, just sneak while in the air, either while falling or from jumping.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.levitationBel.translation: 浮空腰帶會讓你獲得能夠飄浮的能力。你只要在空中（墜落或跳躍時）潛行就能夠啟動它。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magebloom.1.original: When your Magebloom seeds.... bloom, you can use the Magebloom to create Fibers.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magebloom.1.translation: 當你的魔法之花種子...盛開之後，你就能夠製作出魔法之花纖維了。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magebloom.2.original: These are used to craft several items, including your first set of magical armor!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magebloom.2.translation: 你能夠用它來合成出很多種物品，包含了你的第一套魔法盔甲！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magebloomSeed.original: Using our Enchanting Apparatus structure, we'll want to craft our first seed, the &5Magebloom Seed&r.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magebloomSeed.translation: 透過我們剛剛蓋出來的附魔裝置，我們能夠做出我們的第一批&5法師之花種子&r。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magebloomSeed.original: This will be used to create us some magical clothing!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magebloomSeed.translation: 它能夠用來製造一些魔法布料！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magicModIntro.original: Ars Nouveau is a magic mod that allows you to create custom spells with the different Glyphs made within the mod!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magicModIntro.translation: 新生魔藝是一款魔法模組，能讓你透過不同魔符的組合，來創造自訂法術！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magicalWood.original: To gain further knowledge of spells, we'll need a specific type of magical wood!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magicalWood.translation: 我們會需要找到一種特殊的魔法之木，以幫助我們能夠對於法術有著更深一步的認知！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magicalWood.1.original: Archwood Tree Saplings can be gotten through sieving Moss!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.magicalWood.1.translation: 透過篩苔癬方塊來得到至高木樹苗！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.mana.original: In the bottom left of your screen, you'll see a bar. This bar is your mana pool!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.mana.translation: 你可以在螢幕的左下角看到你的一條東西：那就是你的魔力條！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.mana.1.original: There are several ways to increase your mana pool, or increase the efficiency of your spells as you progress through the mod. Upgrading your spellbook can also increase your mana!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.mana.1.translation: 在你發展本模組的過程中，你會發現有許多方式能夠增加你的魔力上限，或是提高你的法術的效率。升級法術書就是一個最好提升你的魔力上限的方法！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.nextUpgrade.1.original: This is the next upgrade to your Spellbook!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.nextUpgrade.1.translation: 法師的法術書是更高級的法術書！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.nextUpgrade.2.original: This will increase your overall mana and mana regen, as well as allowing you to create and use Tier 2 Glyphs.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.nextUpgrade.2.translation: 這本書會增加你的魔力總量和魔力回復速度，並讓你能夠創造或施放出二級魔符。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.noviceSpellbo.original: To get started, you'll need to craft yourself a &6Novice Spellbook&r.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.noviceSpellbo.translation: 你會需要先合成出一本&6初學者法術書&r來開始本模組。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.noviceSpellbo.original: This is where you create and store your spells.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.noviceSpellbo.translation: 這本書是你用來創造法術，並將它們儲存起來的地方。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.noviceSpellbo.original: Hitting the &9C&r key will open up the \"Create a Spell\" page. On the left, there are several tabs, but the main 3 are: Spell Creation, Color Picker, and Familiars.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.noviceSpellbo.translation: 按下 &9C&r 鍵能夠開啟「創造法術」頁面。左邊那排有很多不同的小頁面，但最重要的三個為：說明文件、顏色選擇器和使魔。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.noviceSpellbo.original: This spellbook will only allow you to create and use Tier 1 Glyphs. To create better spells, you'll need to upgrade your Spellbook!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.noviceSpellbo.translation: 你只能利用這本書來創造或施放出一級魔符。你會需要升級你的法術書來創造出更好的法術！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.plantSourceli.original: Placing this near growing plants or saplings will provide Source. Archwood trees provide more Source!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.plantSourceli.translation: 將它放在生長中的植物或樹苗的旁邊來產出魔源。使用至高木能夠產出更多的魔源！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.plantSourceli.original: Note: Bonemealing does not produce Source.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.plantSourceli.translation: 註：使用骨粉的話無法產出任何魔源。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.potionJar.1.original: The &9Potion Jar&r stores up to 100 potions. You can remove them by using an empty bottle or a potion flask on the jar.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.potionJar.1.translation: &9藥水罐&r能夠儲存 100 瓶藥水。你可以直接對著它使用玻璃瓶或是藥水燒瓶來裝填藥水。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.potionJar.2.original: Wixies will use these jars during Potion Autocrafting.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.potionJar.2.translation: 薇可精在進行藥水的自動合成時也會用到它。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.randomPotionB.original: This belt will give random positive potion effects for a short duration. These will vary in strength.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.randomPotionB.translation: 不穩定禮物腰帶會不定期地給予你一些隨機、強度不一且正面的藥水效果。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.ringOfDiscoun.original: The Ring of Discount provides a small bonus to max mana and mana regen. It also reduces the total cost to cast a spell.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.ringOfDiscoun.translation: 節魔之戒能夠為你提供最大魔力量和魔力回復速度的加成。它也會讓施放法術所需花費的魔力量減少。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.ritualBrazier.original: The &9Ritual Brazier&r is used to cast rituals. It can also be used for decoration. If you want to light the Brazier, use a Light spell on it.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.ritualBrazier.translation: &9儀式火盆&r是用來舉行各種儀式的。但它也能夠用來當作裝飾品：如果你單純只是想要把它點亮的話，就對它施放一次「召喚魔光」法術。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.ritualBrazier.original: To perform rituals, you'll need Arcane Pedestals as well. As there are so many rituals to cast, make sure to check out each of them using the &6Worn Notebook&r!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.ritualBrazier.translation: 你會需要使用到奧術基座來舉行某些儀式。因為儀式的種類真的是太多了，請多加善用你的&6破舊的筆記本&r來了解更多關於各個儀式的詳細資訊！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.ritualBrazier.original: This can be done by holding Ctrl on the Ritual Table while the book is in your inventory.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.ritualBrazier.translation: 當破舊的筆記本位於你的快捷欄時，你可以直接對著 JEI 或背包中的這些儀式石板按住 Ctrl 鍵來快速查閱到你想要的資料。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.runicChalk.original: Runic Chalk is used to draw permanent Runes on that ground. These runes will cast spells on entities that walk over them.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.runicChalk.translation: 符文粉筆是用來在地上畫出永久性的符文的一種物品。這些符文能夠對經過它們的生物施放法術。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.runicChalk.1.original: To attach a spell to a rune, inscribe a &eSpell Parchment&r using a Scribe's Table.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.runicChalk.1.translation: 你會需要使用抄寫台來為&e法術羊皮紙&r抄入法術，以讓該法術能夠連接到你的符文之中。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.runicChalk.2.original: Note: The Rune will need Source to operate.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.runicChalk.2.translation: 註：這些符文需要消耗魔源來啟動。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.scribesTable.original: Used to inscribe spells on with the Scribe's Table.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.scribesTable.translation: 用以在抄寫台上抄入法術。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.scribesTable..original: If you want to cast better spells, you'll need a &6Scribe's Table&r to unlock new glyphs for your spellbook.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.scribesTable..translation: 如果你想要施放出更好的法術的話，你就會需要使用&6抄寫台&r來為你的法術書解鎖出新的魔符。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.scribesTable..original: There are 3 tiers of glyphs to unlock, and each one requires some experience and items.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.scribesTable..translation: 總共有 3 種不同等級的魔符供你解鎖，並且每一個魔符都會需要消耗一些經驗值和不同的物品。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.scribesTable..original: The Scribe's Table is also used to attach spells to Spell Parchments. To do this, place a Spell Parchment on the table, select the spell in your Spellbook, then sneak right-click the book on the table.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.scribesTable..translation: 你也能夠在抄寫台上將法術抄入到法術羊皮紙之中：先將法術羊皮紙放在台上，再在你的法術書中選擇你要抄入的法術，最後手持法術書對著抄寫台潛行+右鍵就完成了。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.scribesTable..original: To create a Glyph, right-click on the Scribe's Table with your spellbook. Search for the glyph you want to make, then click Select at the bottom. Right-click the table with the items required, and the glyph will be created. Use the glyph to learn it.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.scribesTable..translation: 手持法術書對著抄寫台右鍵點擊以開始創造魔符：找到你想要創造出的魔符，然後點擊右下角的選擇，最後只要將需要的物品丟到台上，你就能夠將它創造出來了。右鍵使用魔符來學習它。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.scribesTable..original: Note: The table can pull items from nearby inventories.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.scribesTable..translation: 註：抄寫台能夠自動從相連的儲物方塊中提取物品。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceBerries.original: Source Berries produce more Source than other sources.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceBerries.translation: 對它使用魔源莓能夠產出更多魔源。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceBerries.original: This will also convert grass or dirt into Mycelium in a 3x3 area around it. It will also grow mushrooms around it if the space is empty.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceBerries.translation: 它也會將周圍3x3的草地或泥土轉化為菌絲土。如果這些菌絲土的上方是空的，則它也會讓上面長出一些磨菇。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceGem.1.original: To create one of the main crafting items in Ars, the &9Source Gem&r, we'll need to make an &6Imbuement Chamber&r.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceGem.1.translation: 要想製造出《新生魔藝》模組中最重要的合成材料之一「&9魔源寶石&r」的話，我們會需要先做出一台灌注室。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceGem.2.original: The Imbuement Chamber requires Source to imbue items. It produces a small amount of Source by itself, but can also use Source Jars as a power source.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceGem.2.translation: 灌注室會消耗魔源來進行灌注：它能夠以緩慢的速度自行產出魔源，也能夠使用附近的魔源罐之中的魔源來進行灌注。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceGem.3.original: Several recipes also require Arcane Pedestals to be placed around it as well.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceGem.3.translation: 在製作某些物品時，你會需要在它附近的奧術基座上放置某些物品。這些基座上的物品是不會被消耗掉的，只有灌注室之中的物品會被轉變成產物。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceGems.original: To create Source Gems, we'll need to put either Lapis or Amethyst Shards into the Imbuement Chamber. Over time, these will convert to Source Gems!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceGems.translation: 我們會需要將青金石或是紫水晶碎片放入灌注室之中以製造出魔源寶石。隨著時間的推移，它們便會慢慢的轉變為魔源寶石！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceSystem.original: In Ars Nouveau, the power system for machines is called &9Source&r.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceSystem.translation: 在《新生魔藝》模組之中，有著一套被稱作&9魔源&r：能夠用來驅動本模組中的機器的獨特電力系統。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceSystem..original: To start collecting some Source, we'll need a Source Jar.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceSystem..translation: 我們會需要使用魔源罐來儲存我們所收集到的魔源。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceSystem..original: Source can also be moved with buckets, or by breaking and picking up Source Jars.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourceSystem..translation: 你能夠透過鐵桶，或是直接破壞魔源罐來將魔源移動到別的地方。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourcestones.original: With Source Gems, you can get started crafting the various machines by creating &5Sourcestones&r.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.sourcestones.translation: 當你擁有了魔源寶石之後，你可以先製作一些&5魔源石&r來製造出本模組中的其他機器。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.spellCreation.original: While holding your Spellbook, you can press C to open up the spell creation page.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.spellCreation.translation: 你可以在手持法術書時按下 C 鍵來開啟「創造法術」頁面。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.spellCreation.original: Each spell must have a form. You start off with 3 basic forms: Projectile, Self-cast, and Touch.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.spellCreation.translation: 每個法術都會需要一種「型態」。你最開始會擁有 3 種基礎的「型態」：「彈射物」、「自身」和「觸摸」。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.spellCreation.original: For the Effect, this determines what happens when you cast the spell. You can have up to 9 effects per spell.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.spellCreation.translation: 「效果」則決定了你施放法術之後會發生的行動。你最多可以在法術之中使用 9 個「效果」。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.spellCreation.original: For starters, you have Harm and Break.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.spellCreation.translation: 最一開始，你只擁有「傷害」和「破壞」兩種「效果」。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.spellCreation.original: Select one Form and one Effect, name your spell, and click create!
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.spellCreation.translation: 選擇一種「型態」和一種「效果」，並命名你的法術，最後點擊製作！

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.tier1Glyphs.original: Tier 1 Glyphs require 3 levels of experience to be made.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.tier1Glyphs.translation: 一級魔符需要消耗掉 3 經驗等級來進行製作。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.tier2Glyphs.1.original: Tier 2 Glyphs require 5 levels of experience to be made.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.tier2Glyphs.1.translation: 二級魔符需要消耗掉 5 經驗等級來進行製作。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.tier2Glyphs.2.original: They also require a &9Mage's Spell Book&r to create.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.tier2Glyphs.2.translation: 也會需要一本&9法師的法術書&r來製作它們。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.tier3Glyphs.1.original: Tier 3 Glyphs require 10 levels of experience to be made.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.tier3Glyphs.1.translation: 三級魔符需要消耗掉 10 經驗等級來進行製作。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.tier3Glyphs.2.original: They also require an &6Archmage's Spell Book&r.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.tier3Glyphs.2.translation: 也會需要一本&9大法師法術書&r來製作它們。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.volcanicSourc.original: The Volcanic Sourcelink generates Source by consuming burnable items. Archwood logs will generate bonus Source.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.volcanicSourc.translation: 火山魔源通道能透過消耗可燃物來產出魔源。使用至高木原木能夠產出更多的魔源。

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.volcanicSourc.original: As it burns items, it will convert nearby stone into lava.
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.desc.volcanicSourc.translation: 由於它的溫度高到足以燃燒掉那些物品，放在它周圍的石頭會自動被轉換為熔岩。
熔岩的上方也會產生出熔岩睡蓮。（譯者著：該物品在1.18時就已被移除）

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.subt.createsSource.original: Creates Source using the growth of Plants
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.subt.createsSource.translation: 藉由植物的生長來產出魔源

atm9.quest.arsNouveau.subt.generatesSour.original: Generates Source from Mob Deaths and Animal Breeding
atm9.quest.arsNouveau.subt.generatesSour.translation: 藉由生物的死亡與動物的繁殖來產出魔源
藉由附近的食物來產出魔源

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.basicfil.original:
The Basic Filter is pretty... easy to use! Simply put Items into it and they are now filtered. 

You can change it so it either Whitelists/allows only those Items or that is Blacklists/denies only those Items. 

You can also have it so it either matches NBT data or not. Matching NBT Data would mean having same Enchantments, Durabilitiy, or even Mobs inside of whatever Item. If selected to not match it will do any of that Item regardless of NBT.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.cardclon.original: With each Card holding their own data it can be pretty annoying constantly changing each Cards settings. So lets just clone them instead! \n\nLeft Click a Card with the Cloner to copy its Data, then Right Click a Card to give it that Data!

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.cardhold.original: When using &c&lLaserIO&r for &lLogistics&r you might end up with MANY Cards. With each taking a slot in your Inventory it can get pretty crampt. I wish they had a storage for Cards... oh wait they do, it's the Card Holder! \n\nYou can store multiple Cards in it and when you open a Laser Node the Card Holder will open up as well like a second Inventory. Very helpful!

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.connecto.original: If you need to string your &cLaser Nodes&r a far distance try using Connectors! Just use the Wrench like normal.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.counter..original:
1... 2... there's a 4 somewhere as well. 

To set a Number put the Item in then you can Left or Right Click to change the amount. Shift and do the same to go by 10s. Once you have a set Number through it into a Card! 

It will then wait until that set Number of Items is there to start taking Items. It will also leave that amount in the first Inventory.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.energyca.original: &eEnergy&r has to get around somehow, preferably where we want it to go. Move it around just the same as with &2Items&r, &9Fluids&r, and &5Chemicals&r!

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.energyim.original: Just smack an &3Energy Importer&r onto a Power Source and connect it to an &3Energy Interface&r with Logic Cables! Put and edit the Variable Cards and you'll be moving Power like a pro! \n\nI do have to say I found it having problems with Importing or Exporting to Flux Plugs and Points so be mindful of that.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.energypi.original: Every Tech Mod needs &cEnergy&r, whether FE, EU, RF, OP, or some other acronym! &cEnergy Pipez&r don't discriminate, it just moves! \n\nSome Machines have strict IO ports for &cEnergy&r so make sure to check for those!

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.filterin.original:
&e&lPipez&r do have their own way of Filtering Items, you need atleast an Advanced Upgrade to get it though. When an Advanced Upgrade is in you can click the Add button to add Filters. 
Then you can add: Item, Tag, or NBT in the Filter. 

There you can also add the set Destination Filter. To set it, Shift Right Click an Inventory with it. 

You'll also have to set it to either Whitelist the Filter or Blacklist, so only the Filter or everything but the Filter.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.fluidcar.original: Works exactly like the &2Item Cards&r, you need Extract and Insert Cards. Just this time you take from Tanks holding &9Fluids&r to another Tank. No, it doesn't move Sources of &9Fluid&r in or out of the World.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.fluidimp.original:
Works just like the Item Importer, put the &eFluid Importer&r onto a Tank with Liquid. Then the &eFluid Interface&r on where you want it to go and connect with Logic Cables. Finally Variable Card just like before! 

Also can pull Liquids at the Integer Limit. 

Does not place or take Fluid Sources from in the world, it only moves Fluids from one Tank to another.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.fluidpip.original:
&bWater&r=&bBlue&r &bWater&r=&bFluid&r therefore &bBlue&r=&bFluid&r 

Lots of Mods have their own &bFluids&r, with even Minecraft having their own, with &bWater&r and &cLava&r. You'll most likely need to move those &bFluids&r and a good way of doing so is with &bFluid Pipes&r. 

This can be connected to Sinks to move Infinite &bWater&r!

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.gaspipez.original: These &e&lPipez&r are mostly due to &5&lMekanism&r. &5&lMekanism&r adds the last state of matter in the form of &aGas&r. &aGas&r can't be moved with any of the other &e&lPipez&r so if you need to move Hydrogen or Lithium you'll need &aGas Pipez&r. \n\n(I've always had problems telling whether the &5&lMekanism&r item is &aGas&r, &bFluid&r, or even Infuse Type. When it's in a Machine it might tell &aGas&r or &bFluid&r, which can help teach you. If it doesn't you can check JEI for other recipes that might involve it!)

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.integrat.original:
&3&lIntegrated Dynamics&r is all about &f&lLogistics&r! It's practically the definition of &lLogistic&r. 

It's all about moving, managing, and storing items. Heck you might not even need the Wrench for it, it's so well designed! Get one just incase though. 

(Least laggy pipe solution, I do recommend these!).

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.itemcard.original:
In order to move &2Items&r with &c&lLaserIO&r you'll need some &2Item Cards&r. 

Set one to Extract and put it on the side of the &cLaser Node&r you want to Import from. Then set the other to Insert and put it to the side you want the Items to Export to. 

There are mutliple settings you can change with the Extract in order of where you want the Items to go if there's multiple places to Extract from. Round Robin will make it Extract items in an order instead of closest Inventory first.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.itemimpo.original: To get this working put the Item Importer onto the Inventory you want Items pulled from. Next, put the Interface on the second Inventory and connect them with Logic Cables. Then, put in the Variable Card into the Importer and change it as you please. \n\nIt can be changed to Import Items at the Integer Limit (Over 2 Billion).

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.itempipe.original:
The simplest of the simplest of &e&lPipes&r, the &eItem Pipe&r. 

It will move Items from one Inventory to another. Could be from one Chest to another, could be a Farm to a System, or even a Quarry to a Smelter. 

Very simple just connect the &ePipes&r to what you want moved, and use your Wrench to configure which side it Pulls from.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.laserio..original:
&c&lLaserIO&r is DireWolf's continuation of &a&lEnderIO&r's &lLogistics&r. 

It's all about moving items via &cLasers&r! Who doesn't love &cLasers&r!!! 

And it all starts with the Logic Chip.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.lasernod.original:
Now this is the true Heart of &c&lLaserIO&r! The &cLaser Nodes&r are where the actual Cards will go into in order to work. 

They will move Items from any adjacent Inventory in the 4 Cardinal Directions and Up and Down. In order to move to Farther Inventories you'll need a second &cNode&r and Connect them with the Wrench by Shift Right Clicking 1 and Right Clicking the 2nd. 

You'll put the Cards into the Slots of the correct Direction and you can put Node Overclockers there as well to make it work faster.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.laserwre.original: These are just used to Connect &cLaser Nodes&r to each other and to Connectors. Not too important I just wanted to keep with the theme of Wrenches. \n\nIt does work as a Wrench for other Configs!

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.logicalt.original: Logical Transporters are what &5&lMeka&r uses to move Items and Blocks across distance. \n\nThey will need to be Configured to Pull or Push to Inventories like Chests or Drawers.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.logiccab.original: Logic Cables are different from other &e&lPipez&r or &5&lMeka pipes&r. The other Pipes act as hoppers, the items move from 1 Inventory, into the Pipe, then into the 2nd Inventory. Logic Cables just skip the middle man which also skips a lotta lag. \n\nThey are just for connecting Importers and Interfaces.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.logistic.original:
&n&f&lLogistics&r: 
A system of moving, managing, and storing items or resources. 

In Modded Minecraft it's quite the same, moving items! With Modded you will need items and by the thousands, heck if you want the &6&lStar&r it gets in the millions! So you'll need to move items from factories, machines, farms, and especially chests. That's what &l&fLogistics&r is for.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.mechanic.original: Mechanical Pipes are how &5&lMeka&r lets the Fluids flow. \n\nSome Machines in &5&lMeka&r will need Fluids like Electrolytic Separator needing Water or Evaporation Plants to make Lithium.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.mekanism.original:
&5&lMekanism&r is a huge and popular Tech Mod, so of course it has &lLogistics&r with it. 

The different Machines are picky with Configurations and will need to be changed in their GUI to properly move items. Then you can use the &5&lMeka Pipes&r to move whatever you need to move! 

But wait it's not just &5&lMekanism&r these work for! They work for plenty of other machines as well! Just need to be Configured with a Wrench to Push and Pull. 

(These can cause a bit of lag when used in mass so be careful with them).

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.modfilte.original: Mod Filter is another pretty basic Filter. This one you put Items in and it will do the same with either Whitelisting or Blacklisting. But instead of only being that Item it will be any Item from that Mod. \n\nApotheosis Gem will only allow Apotheosis Items. Mekanism Alloy will only allow Mekanism Items. And so on.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.overcloc.original:
Cards have their limits. Item Extration can only extract 8 items per Operation. Fluid Extract at only 5 Buckets. God knows with Chemical and Energy. 

This is Modded &2&lMinecraft&r these limits won't suffice we need to Overclock them. 

Throw some Overclockers in the top right of the Card and it'll upgrade the cap they can transfer! 

Max of 4.

Cards aren't the only ones with limits, so they also aren't the only ones with Overclockers! 

These go into the &cNode&r itself on bottom right and boost how fast it does Operations. 

Max of 8.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.pipezint.original:
&e&lPipez&r is the simplest &f&lLogistics&r Mod. It's so simple that the entire mod is fit in this Quest Page while having room for more Mods! 

Attach the specific Pipe to where you want to move items and use the Pipe Wrench to configure what side Pulls, Pushes, or doesn't connect. 

Other Wrenches do work with &e&lPipez&r as well! 

(Can be laggy when used in mass, just not as laggy as &5&lMeka&r pipes though).

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.pressuri.original:
Because the normal &2&lMinecraft&r Items, Blocks, and Fluids wasn't enough. And the added Heat and Energy wasn't either. 

The rest of &5&lMekanism&r is moved with Pressurized Tubes. Gases are the main ones as if you're using &5&lMekanism&r you will be using Gases like Hydrogen and Oxygen. 
Infuse Types are similar like Coal Infuse and Redstone Infuse. Slurries are used with Ore Processing. 
And Dye Pigments are the essence of Color, any item that is Dyed can be changed with that part of &5&lMekanism&r.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.redstone.original: Don't you just hate &4Redstone&r having to be wired to everywhere? If we can have Wireless FE why not Wireless &4Redstone&r? Finally we can thanks to &c&lLaserIO&r. You can Input a &4Redstone Signal&r with the &4Card&r then use an &4Output Card&r to Output the &4Signal&r somewhere else!

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.tags.1.original:
Tags are very important part of grouping Items in Minecraft. So of course we can take advantage of that for Filters! 

You can put an Item in and select a Tag or if you know it, type it in yourself. 

Really helpful for ones like taking Gear out of a system by using Tag for Tools. 

(You can also find Tags by doing /kubejs hand to find what's the Tags of the Item in your hand.)

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.thermcon.original: Heat is another factor in &5&lMekanism&r and it Fuels a lot of Machines and Multiblocks. Thermal Evaporation Plants and Fusion Reactors both use Heat to work. And Conductors is how you will be moving Heat!

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.universa.original: &5&lMekanism&r is Tech Mod... why are you surprised it needs Energy for its Machines?
Why worry about what's being moved when you can just move everything! &5Universal Pipez&r are even less discriminatory than &cEnergy Pipez&r. They can move &eItems&r, &bFluids&r, or &cEnergy&r.

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.upgrades.original:
&e&lPipez&r move more! 

All Upgrades increase the amount the &e&lPipez&r move but each grant more options to use with the &e&lPipe&r. 

Basic Upgrade allows Redstone Activation with &e&lPipez&r. 
Improved Upgrade allows you to change distribution either:Closest First, Farthest First, Round-Robin, or Random. 
Advanced Upgrade gives you option to add Filters. 
Ultimate doesn't grant anything new it just moves a lot!

atm9.quest.basic_logistics.desc.variable.original:
Variable Cards are necessary for starting Interactions like Importing Items. You will put them in one of the slots of the Importer to add them. 

From there you can edit everything via the + Button. You can change how much is Importer, which Item Slot, which Channel, practically everything with just that Card. 

If you're like me just wanting to move items, nothing too fancy just put it in and maybe change the Limit for how much is moved.

atm9.quest.bees.desc.advanced.original: After you get a total of 5 &eCombs&r, you can craft an &eAdvanced Beehive&r. With these, you no longer need your campfire or shears, since the bees will output all their combs straight into this thing!
atm9.quest.bees.desc.advanced.translation: 當你獲得了 5 個&e蜂巢&r之後，你就能製作出一個&e進階蜂箱&r：當你擁有了它之後，你就不需要再使用營火和剪刀了！因為現在蜜蜂能夠直接將牠們產出的蜂巢輸出到自己的蜂箱之中了。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.babee.original: This upgrade is particularly useful as it can generate bees out of &bThin Air&r. You can also breed bees like any other mobs by feeding them flowers.\n\nPlacing this in an advanced hive can make any bee (that can reproduce: check JEI to see) have a chance of being duplicated as a baby every harvest.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.babee.translation: 「升級：幼蜂」是一個非常好用的升級：它能夠&b憑空&r產生出新的蜜蜂。你也可以像繁殖其他動物那樣餵給牠們花朵來進行繁殖。\n\n將此升級放入進階蜂箱之中可以讓蜂箱中的任何蜜蜂（可以自我繁殖的那些，查看 JEI 來進行確認）在每次採集時都有機率複製出一個完全相同的幼蜂。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.beetree.original: The quests below shows what bees you can make, and hovering over any bee will show which two bees are needed to breed it. This &c&lis not&r&r all of the bees in &eProductive Bees&r, but it is a good majority, remember to always check JEI to see if resources can come from combs.\n\nThe ultimate goal is to have a BUNCH (hundreds) of draconic bees, and either some &eAllthemodium&r grade bees, or a &dWannaBee&r, which can farm mobs without killing them!
atm9.quest.bees.desc.beetree.translation: 下面的那些任務會告訴你可以製造出哪些蜜蜂，將滑鼠滑到蜜蜂上也會告訴你該如何獲得牠。這些蜜蜂&c&l並非&r&e《生產蜜蜂》&r模組中的所有蜜蜂，但包含了大多數。請常查看 JEI 來了解這些蜂巢能夠產出的資源。\n\n我們的終極目標是製造出成千上百隻的龍族蜜蜂，還有一些像是能夠產出&e《ATM 金屬》&r或是 &eATM 之星&r的蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.bottler.original: Collected 5 Bees? Good job, time to destroy your hard work, sort of. Place a piston facing downwards onto the bottler, and enclose the 1x1 area, preferably with a trapdoor. Place &bEmpty Bottles&r inside the bottler, then activate the piston. The Bee will die and drop &dsquashed Bee material&r.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.bottler.translation: 收集到 5 隻蜜蜂了？很好，是時候來破壞掉你的成果了...算是吧。在裝瓶機的上方兩格處放置一個向下的活塞，以確保它們之間有個 1x1 的空間。然後在裝瓶機之中放入&b玻璃瓶&r，再蜜蜂放入那個空間之中。最後啟動活塞，你就會看到蜜蜂被輾碎並掉落出了&d壓扁的蜜蜂樣本&r。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.breeding.original: This breeds two Bees to make a child. Bees don't get used up, and two of the same Bees will just make a child version of that Bee, but breeding different types can create entirely &dnew&r Bees. Check the breeding items needed for the Bees in JEI, and remember, &c&lBOTH BEES NEED TO BE ADULTS&r.\n\nOn our way to the best Bee, we want to breed several &9Water Bees&r, then grow them by feeding them flowers/using an Incubator, and finally &csquishing them&r.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.breeding.translation: 繁殖機能夠讓兩隻蜜蜂繁殖出新的幼蜂（蜜蜂不會被消耗掉）。使用兩隻相同的蜜蜂能夠製造出一樣的幼蜂，但使用特定的兩種不同的蜜蜂可以創造出&d全新&r的蜜蜂。查看 JEI 以了解繁殖所需的物品，並且請記得：「&c&l兩隻蜜蜂都必須成年才能培育出新的蜜蜂！&r」。\n\n在我們製造出最強蜜蜂的這條路上，我們會想要繁殖出一些 &9水蜜蜂&r，然後使用幼蜂孵化機或是餵牠們花朵來使牠們快速成年，最後&c碾碎牠們&r。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.cages.original: Sometimes, you have to move individual Bees from one place to another, and for this, you can use &eBee Cages&r! Sadly, once you place the Bee down, the Cage will disappear. Hold shift over a Bee to see its stats (except for vanilla Bees).
atm9.quest.bees.desc.cages.translation: 有些時候，你可能會需要將一隻蜜蜂單獨運輸到其他的地方，這時你可以使用&e蜜蜂籠&r！但當你將蜜蜂放出來時，蜜蜂籠就會壞掉並消失。\n\n除了原版的蜜蜂之外，對著本模組中的任何蜜蜂潛行就能夠看到牠的數值。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.catcher.original: The catcher does exactly what it sounds like it does, catches bees in an area around it and puts them into a cage. Add some cages inside and add upgrades for more range or filtering.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.catcher.translation: 顧名思義，捕蜂機就是用來捕捉蜜蜂的：它會捕捉周遭一定範圍內的蜜蜂，並將它們關到蜜蜂籠之中。需要為它添加一些蜜蜂籠，並能夠加裝升級來提升它的距離或進行過濾。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.centri.original: The &bCentrifuge&r is going to be super handy very soon. It's used for processing resource combs into their resources, Example: &bIron Comb&r -> &bRaw Iron&r.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.centri.translation: &b離心機&r是一個非常方便的方塊：它能夠將蜂巢處理成對應的資源。（像是將&b鐵蜜蜂蜂巢處理成&b鐵原礦&r）

atm9.quest.bees.desc.draconictip.original: Sorry to break it to you, but your Bees are going to be trash unless you have these &0Draconic Bees&r. Use &dDragon's Breath&r on an &dObsidian Hive&r to spawn in a Draconic Bee. I recommend getting 2 so you can breed them.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.draconictip.translation: 抱歉在這打個岔，但是如果你沒有&0龍族蜜蜂&r的話，你的蜜蜂的效率一定會很低。在終界對著&d黑曜石蜂窩&r使用&d龍之吐息&r來吸引龍族蜜蜂。我推薦你吸引到 2 隻，這樣你就可以讓它們繁殖了。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.element.original: There are Bees for each element of the Periodic Table. Their combs will give their respective elements from ChemLib.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.element.translation: 元素週期表上的每種化學元素都有對應的蜜蜂。它們的蜂窩能夠產出對應的化學元素。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.expansion.original: Placing an Expansion Box adjacent to an Advanced Beehive will give it more Bee slots, and allow for upgrades! (They're insane).
atm9.quest.bees.desc.expansion.translation: 將擴充箱放到進階蜂箱的旁邊，會讓蜂箱能夠容納更多隻蜜蜂，並且會讓你能夠為它加裝升級！（它們的效果超強）

atm9.quest.bees.desc.filterup.original: Catches only certain Bees you choose
atm9.quest.bees.desc.filterup.translation: 只能夠捕捉你想要的蜜蜂

atm9.quest.bees.desc.first.original:
To start &eProductive Bees&r, you'll need.. bees. We need vanilla bees to get our first combs going.

Start by bonemealing grass to get a &bVanilla Flower&r, easiest being a dandelion. Place a &aSapling&r within a few blocks of the flower, and spam sneak to grow the tree.

With a little luck, the tree will grow with a hive on it.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.first.translation:
要開始你的&e生產蜜蜂&r之旅，你會需要...蜜蜂。我們會需要原版的蜜蜂來獲得我們的前幾個蜂巢。

對著草地使用骨粉來獲得一朵&b原版的花&r，最輕鬆的選項會是一朵蒲公英。將&a樹苗&r放在距離花朵兩格方塊之內的地方，並施展蹲下跳舞來使樹木生長。

再加上一點運氣，你就會看到樹上長出了一個蜂窩。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.fishing.original: The next step is.. fishing? When catching a fish there is a chance to spawn a &9Water Bee&r. This thing comes with &dAny&r weather tolerance, meaning it'll make combs when it's raining and thundering!\n\nThankfully, you only need 2 of these since you can breed them, unlike &bKamikazbees&r.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.fishing.translation: 下一步是...釣魚？釣魚時有機率會生成出 &9水蜜蜂&r。牠擁有著能夠在&d任何&r天氣下進行工作的基因，這代表牠在下雨天或雷雨天時也能夠製造蜂巢！\n\n謝天謝地，你只需要獲得 2 隻，因為牠們能夠自行繁殖，而不像是&b特攻蜜蜂&r。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.fslab.original:
The &eFeeding Slab&r is a block that bees can harvest from. For example, place a flower on it, and bees will harvest it just as they would with a normal flower.

Why is this important? Well it can store 3 different items so it saves space, and two on top of eachother will make a &eDouble Feeding Slab&r.

This is going to be necessary later on.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.fslab.translation:
蜜蜂能夠對&e餵食板&r進行採集。舉例來說：將一朵花放在它的上面，蜜蜂就能夠像平常一樣採集到這朵花了。

為什麼這很重要呢？因為它可以存放三種不同的物品，所以可以節省空間，並且上下放置兩個會形成雙層餵食板。

這在後面會是必要的。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.gene.original: Run the squashed Bee material through a &bCentrifuge&r to break it down into different &aGene Samples&r, then send them into the gene indexer. The green ones are responsible for the productivity, and are the ones we need in this case.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.gene.translation: 將「壓扁的蜜蜂樣本」放入&b離心機&r之中來將它分成各種不同的&a基因樣本&r，然後再將它們送進基因整合機之中。綠色的基因代表的是產能，也是我們將會使用到的基因之一。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.helmet.original: Normally, bees are slow. Their productivity is only &aNormal&r and they only work during daytime. Our goal is to make &cVery High&r productivity bees which are &eMetaturnal&r and can tolerate any weather.\n\nWhat does the bee nest helmet have to do with this? Well, when you get hit by an enemy, it spawns &bKamikazbees&r. These by default have &cVery High&r productivity, &c&l5x&r&r better than normal bees. &lCollect 5 of these bees before you move on&r. To make things easier, hold a flower to attract bees or read the &bCatcher&r quest.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.helmet.translation:
一般情況下，蜜蜂的運作速度非常的慢：牠們的產能很&a一般&r，並且只能夠在白天工作。我們的目標是製造出產成&c非常高&r，並且能夠在&e全天&r和任何天氣下工作的蜜蜂。

但蜂窩頭盔的作用是什麼？嗯...當你穿戴著它被敵人攻擊時，它會召喚出&b特攻蜂&r：牠們的預設產能皆為&c非常高&r（一般蜜蜂的 &c&l5 倍&r）。

&l你會需要收集 5 隻這種蜜蜂來進行下一步&r。要更輕鬆的達成這件事情的話，你可以手持花朵來吸引蜜蜂或是閱讀下一個任務：「&b抓住蜜蜂&r」。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.incubator.original: With 20 &eHoney Treats&r, it will grow your bees into adults. Handy for breeding!\n\nThis can also be used to create bee spawn eggs, combine a &eType&r gene sample with a honey treat, and then use it here with a &bChicken Egg&r to make a bee spawn egg.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.incubator.translation: 幼蜂孵化機能夠使用 20 個&e蜜蜂點心&r來讓你的蜜蜂快速成年。這對於繁殖來說非常的方便！\n\n你也可以使用此機器來製造出蜜蜂的生怪蛋：將&e類型&r基因樣本與一個蜜蜂點心進行合成，然後在此機器中將它們與&b雞蛋&r進行結合以製造出蜜蜂的生怪蛋。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.indexer.original: This will combine genes, which you are about to get. This GREATLY helps with clearing out clutter with all the different gene percentages. Just power it on with a &bLever&r.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.indexer.translation: 基因整合機能夠將基因組合在一起。這能夠幫助你去除掉那些較弱的基因。只要使用&b控制桿r&r之類的紅石元件對它充能就能啟動它。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.metaturnal.original: Did you know you can tie bees to a lead? Well you can, and you have to. If you tie the bee down to a &eFence Post&r and leave it outside for the night it will turn &9Nocturnal&r. Leave it outside during the day after that and it should turn &eMetaturnal&r: AKA works 24/7.\n\nSometimes they get stuck at &aDiurnal&r or &9Nocturnal&r, in which case, leave them out for the &cENTIRE&r day/night, if that still doesn't work, pick them up and tie them back idk.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.metaturnal.translation: 你知道你可以使用栓繩拴住蜜蜂嗎？當然可以，而且你必須要這麼做：如果你將蜜蜂栓在一個&e柵欄&r上，並讓牠在蜂箱外面過夜的話，牠會轉變為&9夜行性&r。然後在早上時，又不讓牠回到牠的蜂箱之中的話，牠就會轉變為能夠&e全天&r工作的蜜蜂。\n\n有時候你會卡在&a晝行性&r或&9夜行性&r，這時候你可能會需要讓牠們經過&c整個&r白天或夜晚。如果還是沒有用的話，可以試試看把牠們裝起來，然後再放出來重複進行此操作。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.modifying.original: To apply the genes to a bee, you must combine the gene with a &eHoney Treat&r. Before you feed this to a bee though, first decide on a good one. &c&lDO NOT FEED TO VANILLA BEES: GENES WASTED.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.modifying.translation: 你需要將基因與&e蜂蜜點心&r合成來將基因附加到一隻蜜蜂身上。建議你選擇比較後期的蜜蜂來進行餵食。&c&l（不要將它餵給原版蜜蜂，它會被浪費掉）&r

atm9.quest.bees.desc.nbabee.original: Catches all bees in an area that are adults.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.nbabee.translation: 捕捉範圍內的所有成年蜂

atm9.quest.bees.desc.nests.original:
These nests will be used to acquire the most fundamental bees, I recommend starting by crafting a simple dirt nest.

These bees won't generate anything at first, especially if they are labelled &eSolitary&r while hovering over them in a cage. They will however, be used for breeding the actually useful bees.

Some of these nests don't accept honey treats, or must be in certain biomes. Check JEI by pressing U/R while hovering over the nests.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.nests.translation:
這些蜜蜂蜂窩能夠用來吸引本模組的蜜蜂鏈中最基本的蜜蜂，我推薦從最簡單的泥土蜂窩開始。

從中生成的蜜蜂剛開始不會產生任何的資源，尤其是當牠們被標記為&e獨居&r時。然而，我們會需要使用它們來繁殖出那些真正有用的蜜蜂。

其中的一些蜜蜂蜂窩不能使用蜂蜜點心，或是必須位於特定的生態域之中。將滑鼠滑到它們上面，並按 R/U 以在 JEI 中了解到更多相關資訊。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.patrick.original: While these Bees are required for Starry Bees, their Comb isn't.\n\nThis is the easiest way to automate Patrick Stars.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.patrick.translation: 你會需要用派大星蜂來轉換成繁星蜂。牠同時也是最簡單的獲得「派大星」的方式。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.poswarden.original: You must kill &b&lPossesed Wardens&r for these.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.poswarden.translation: 你必須要擊殺&b&l被附身的伏守者&r才能獲得這些物品。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.seeds.original: You will need A LOT of honey for &eProductive Bees&r, so it is highly recommended to get these seeds to farm a bunch of honey essence!
atm9.quest.bees.desc.seeds.translation: 在&e《生產蜜蜂》&r之中，你會需要非常非常多的蜂蜜，所以非常推薦製作一些蜂蜜種子來獲得大量的蜂蜜精華！

atm9.quest.bees.desc.shulkers.original: Needed for 10 &bHoarder Bees&r, which equates to around 2 spawn eggs.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.shulkers.translation: 你需要用界伏殼轉換出 10 個&b囤積者蜜蜂&r：用來做出 2 個牠們的生怪蛋。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.silktouch.original:
You don't want your bees escaping and flying off into the void do you? To prevent this, we are going to want to move the hive into an enclosure (or build an enclosure around our hive).

To move the hive with the bees still in it, we need &aSilk Touch&r. The easiest way is to make a silk touch pickaxe with &bSilent Gear&r. Here's the process:

Create a &bTip Blueprint&r -> Combine it with an &dAmethyst Shard&r -> Create a &bSilent Gear&r Pickaxe by putting any vanilla pickaxe into the crafting table with nothing else -> Combine the &bPickaxe&r and &dAmethyst Tip&r in a crafting table.

Now you have an easy silk touch pickaxe!
atm9.quest.bees.desc.silktouch.translation:
你是否不希望你的蜜蜂們到處亂飛然後掉到虛空之中？要預防這種情況的話，我們會需要將蜂窩移動到一個密閉空間。（或是直接幫蜂窩蓋一個密閉空間）

我們會需要&a絲綢之觸&r來移動內含著蜜蜂的蜂窩。最簡單的方式就是使用&b《寂靜裝備》&r模組。以下是中間的過程：

製造一個&b頂端升級藍圖&r→將它拿去與&d紫水晶碎片&r進行合成→將原版的鎬放入工作台之中來製造出一把&b《寂靜裝備》&r的鎬→將&b這把鎬&r拿去與&d紫水晶頂端升級&r進行合成。

現在，你就輕鬆地獲得了一把絲綢之觸的鎬！

atm9.quest.bees.desc.sqush.original: Squish the required Bees and use the &eType&r Gene, combined with a Honey Treat, to incubate an Egg. The result will be a Spawn Egg needed for the &c&dWannaBee&r&r.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.sqush.translation: 碾碎此蜜蜂以獲得牠的&e類型&r基因→用它與蜜蜂點心合成→在幼蜂孵化機中與蛋結合。我們會需要使用這個生怪蛋來製造出&c&d琥頭蜂。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.starry.original: With 2 ATM Star Blocks you can make infinite!
atm9.quest.bees.desc.starry.translation: 你可以使用 2 個「ATM 之星方塊」來製造出無限的「ATM 之星」！

atm9.quest.bees.desc.sturdy.original: They act the same as regular Bee Cages, except they don't disappear when you place the Bee. Get these from &eBeekeper&r Villagers (Advanced Beehives are their workstations).
atm9.quest.bees.desc.sturdy.translation: 這些蜜蜂籠的作用與一般的蜜蜂籠無異，但它不會在放出蜜蜂時消失。你可以從&e養蜂人&r（以進階蜂箱作為工作站）或是流浪商人處購買到這種蜜蜂籠。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.thebestbee.original: So, you should have all three of the genes by now. Pick a Bee that can breed with itself so you can duplicate it, best would be &0&lDraconic Bees&r&r.\n\nBreed lots of these Bees, don't worry, the best traits will always be passed on to baby bees. &c&lOnce you have a bunch, you can start squishing them to get more traits and apply them to other bees!
atm9.quest.bees.desc.thebestbee.translation: 所以，你現在應該擁有了所有的三種基因了。選擇一個能夠自主繁殖的蜜蜂來複製這些基因，最好的選擇會是&0&l龍族蜂&r。\n\n你需要大量繁殖出這種蜜蜂，不會擔心，只有那些最好的基因會遺傳給幼蜂。&c&l當你擁有了一堆這種蜜蜂時，你就可以開始碾碎牠們來產出這些基因，並能夠利用它們來改造其他的蜜蜂了！&r

atm9.quest.bees.desc.tip.original:
Your Bee journey is about to begin, so here's some things to keep in mind.

1. Keep &eWax&r, it seems useless now but it will be needed for &0&lOmega&r&r Productivity Upgrades.

2. Do &eGenetic Modification&r sooner rather than later, since genetically modified Bees can be over &c&l5x&r&r better than regular Bees.

3. There's a great guide on the &6All The Guides&r website, check it out if you wish.

4. When breeding Bees, the child will always have the stats of the better Bee.

5. &c&lALWAYS&r&r light up areas with Hives, or else empty slots will be filled up with Skeletal Bees or Zombees!
atm9.quest.bees.desc.tip.translation:
你的養蜂之旅才剛剛開始，你需要多加留意下列事項：

1.將&e蠟&r保存下來，它現在看起來沒有什麼用，但你會需要使用它來製作出 &0&lΩ&r 產率升級。

2.越快進行&e基因改造&r越好，因為經過基因改造後的蜜蜂最高能夠擁有&c&l 5 倍&r的產出。

3.在 &6All The Guides&r網站上有關於本模組的英文版詳細教學，如果英文能力夠好可以去看看。

4.當你在繁殖蜜蜂時，幼蜂的數值一定會隨著比較好的那隻。

5.&c&l請 務 必&r&r點亮蜂箱周圍的區域，否則這些空欄位將會被骷髏蜜蜂和殭屍蜜蜂填滿！

atm9.quest.bees.desc.treat.original: Honey Treats, when clicked on an &bEmpty Nest&r, will start to spawn Bees. This is slow, however, if you use more Treats the Bees will come faster!\n\nThese will also be used for &eGenetic Modification&r later...
atm9.quest.bees.desc.treat.translation: 當你對著一個&b空的蜜蜂蜂窩&r使用蜜蜂點心時，它就會開始生成出新的蜜蜂。這個過程非常緩慢，但你也可以對它使用更多的蜜蜂點心來進行加速！\n\n你之後也會需要使用蜜蜂點心來進行&e基因改造&r。

atm9.quest.bees.desc.upgrade.original: The &eUpgrade Base&r is very versatile, from making your bee machines faster, to making your bees produce &c&lHundreds&r of times more resources You can also simulate bees so that they never need to exit the hive and cause lag :)
atm9.quest.bees.desc.upgrade.translation: &e空白升級&r的用途非常的廣泛：從讓本模組中的機器運作得更快，到讓你的蜜蜂能夠產出&c&l百倍&r的資源...等。你也可以讓蜜蜂自動進行模擬，以讓牠們不會離開蜂箱，並能夠減少卡頓。:)

atm9.quest.bees.desc.vanillacombs.original: Bees will occasionally come out and harvest flowers before returning back to the Hive. Eventually, the Hive will fill up and you can collect &eCombs&r/&eHoney Bottles&r from it by right clicking with shears or a Bottle! One problem though, this will make the Bees &c&lAngry&r&r.\n\nNo worries, place a Campfire under the Hive so that when you harvest it, the Bees won't get mad. Keep in mind, if a Bee stings you, it will die.
atm9.quest.bees.desc.vanillacombs.translation:
蜜蜂偶爾會從蜂窩中出來採集花粉，並將它們轉變為蜂蜜。而當蜂窩滿了之後你就可以使用剪刀或玻璃瓶來收集&e蜂巢&r或是&e蜂蜜瓶&r了！但這樣做會產生出一個問題：蜂窩之中的蜜蜂會&c&l生氣&r。

不要擔心，如果你將一個營火放置在蜂窩的下面的話，你在收集蜂蜜的時候就不會讓這些蜜蜂生氣了。

記住一件事：如果蜜蜂螫了你，牠&c就會死掉&r！

atm9.quest.bees.desc.wannabee.original: Will farm any mob encased in &eAmber&r by an &eAmber Bee&r to generate mob drops out of thin air!
atm9.quest.bees.desc.wannabee.translation: 會從任何被&e琥珀蜂&r包在&e琥珀&r之中的生物處採集花粉，以憑空產生出牠們的掉落物！

atm9.quest.bees.desc.welcome.original: In this pack, bees can farm you any essential resource! Start your beekeeping journey getting honey, and end it by getting literal &6&lATM Stars&r&r\n\nLine 1 teaches you how to use bees, line 2 teaches you how to make the best bees, line 3 is the bee path!
atm9.quest.bees.desc.welcome.translation: 在本模組包中，可以用蜜蜂來為你產出任何的重要資源！你的養蜂之旅會從獲得蜂蜜開始，一路到獲得 &6&lATM 之星&r時結束。\n\n第一條任務線會教你如何使用蜜蜂、第二條任務線會教你如何製造出最棒的蜜蜂，而第三條任務線是蜜蜂的配種路線！

atm9.quest.bees.draconictip.original: If You Want THOUSANDS of Combs
atm9.quest.bees.draconictip.translation: 如果你想要成千上萬的蜂巢

atm9.quest.bees.subt.omega.original: It says 260%%, When Really, It's More Like 1040%%
atm9.quest.bees.subt.omega.translation: 它寫著 260%%，但我覺得更像是 1040%%

atm9.quest.bees.subt.rangeup.original: Without This, the Catcher is Practically Blind
atm9.quest.bees.subt.rangeup.translation: 不裝這個的話，捕蜂機幾乎捕捉不到任何的蜜蜂

atm9.quest.bees.subt.starry.original: Feed a Patrick Bee an ATM Star Block
atm9.quest.bees.subt.starry.translation: 將一個「ATM 金屬方塊」餵給派大星蜂。

atm9.quest.biggerR.coilList.original: List of Turbine Coils and Properties
atm9.quest.biggerR.coilList.translation: 渦輪機的各種線圈與它們的屬性的完整列表

atm9.quest.biggerR.coverting.translation: 為「被動型」反應爐做轉換

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.coilList.original: For a full list of all Turbine Coils and their properties click on the link to the top-right of this quest.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.coilList.translation: 你可以點擊此任務右上角的圖標以查看：「渦輪機的各種線圈與它們的屬性的完整列表」。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.coils.original: &dTurbine Coils&r are blocks placed around a shaft at one end of a Turbine. These are required to generate power from the turbine.\n\nThis quest requires at least one of the acceptable blocks you can use as coils.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.coils.translation: &d渦輪機線圈&r是一種需要在渦輪機的轉子的其中一端放置一整圈的方塊。必須要有線圈，渦輪機才會開始發電。\n\n你會需要獲得至少一種能夠用來當作線圈的方塊來完成此任務。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.components.original: To build a reactor, you'll need to start by making &6Reactor Casings&r.\n\nThese make up the frame and walls of your reactor, although the walls can be replaced by &9Reactor Glass&r if you'd like to see inside of your reactor.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.components.translation: 你會需要製作一些&6反應爐外殼&r來搭建反應爐。\n\n它們能夠作為反應爐的外框和外牆來使用，但如果你想要看到反應爐的內部的話，你也可以將外牆替換成&9反應爐玻璃&r。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.construction.original: The &9Turbine&r has a minimum shape of 5x4x5, but can go up to 32x192x32 in size.\n\nJust like the Reactor, the frame must be built out of &dCasings&r, but the walls can be &9Turbine Glass&r instead.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.construction.translation: &9渦輪機&r的最小尺寸為5x4x5，但最大可以到32x192x32。\n\n就像反應爐一樣，它的外框必須由&d渦輪機外殼&r來搭建，而它的外牆也同樣可以用&9渦輪機玻璃&r來代替。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.control.original:
There are several optional blocks you can make to control your reactor.

The &cRedstone Port&r allows you to control your reactor with redstone. This means levers, buttons, etc.

The &9Computer Port&r allows for control of the reactor using Lua scripts from mods like &eComputerCraft&r.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.control.translation:
使用某些方塊能夠更精確的控制反應爐。

&c反應爐紅石埠&r可以讓你能夠透過控制桿、按鈕...等紅石元件來控制你的反應爐。

&9反應爐電腦埠&r可以讓你能夠透過一些使用「Lua 程式語言」的模組（像是&e電腦：重製版（CC: Tweaked）&r）來控制你的反應爐。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.converting.original: When a reactor is Passive, it just burns fuel directly into power. When you add a &dReactor Coolant Port&r to one of the reactor's walls, it converts the reactor to an Active reactor, which will instead burn fuel to heat fluids, like water into &9Steam&r. You cannot have a &cPower Tap&r and a Coolant Port on the same reactor.\n\nOnce placed, it will also convert the reactor's interface, showing more information about your reactor. You will now have a tank for the coolant, a tank for the exhaust, and can see the &9Exhaust Generation Rate&r. For example: If you're pumping in water, this will be the steam output.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.converting.translation: 被動型反應爐會消耗燃料並直接產出電力。但當我們將它的&c反應爐能量埠&r換成了&d反應爐冷卻埠&r之後，它就會轉變為能夠產出加熱流體（像是將水加熱成&9蒸氣&r）的主動型反應爐。同一個反應爐上不能同時加裝能量埠和冷卻埠。\n\n當它轉變為主動型反應爐後，反應爐的介面會發生改變，並能夠查看更多反應爐的相關資訊。你現在可以看到冷卻液槽、廢氣槽和&9廢氣產率&r。舉例來說：如果你輸入的是水，那這一項就會是蒸氣的產率。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.expanding.original:
Reactors are multi-block structures, meaning you can create your own custom size!

The &lBiggest&r Reactor that you can make is 128x128x192. There are a lot of variables that contribute to the overall output of a reactor, so make sure to experiment!

Some overall tips:

The taller the reactor, the more fuel it can hold and burn because there are more fuel rods, meaning more overall power. This also means a higher &9burn rate&r.

The wider the reactor, the more efficient it is, as long as you don't add more fuel rods to the design. This means less consumption overall.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.expanding.translation:
反應爐是一種多方塊結構，這代表你可以選擇你自己想要的尺寸！

反應爐的&l最大&r尺寸為128x128x192。有很多的變數會影響到反應爐的最終產出，所以你需要慢慢測試！

大致上來說：

當反應爐「越高」，就代表有越多的燃料棒；它就能一次容納以及燃燒更多的燃料，並產出更多的電力。換句話說就是：更高的&9燃燒速率&r。

在你不添加更多的燃料棒的情況下，當反應爐「越寬」，它的效率就越高。換句話說就是：更低的燃料消耗率。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.fuel.original: To insert fuel into the reactor, you'll need to pick one of the sides that has a &9Reactor Access Port&r and pump in &eUranium&r from an inventory.\n\nThe easiest way to do this is to use something like a &aStorage Drawer&r or even just a &aChest&r with an &9Item Pipe&r connected at the top, like the image shown below.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.fuel.translation: 你需要選擇其中一個&9反應爐存取埠&r來將它作為燃料的輸入口，以將&e鈾錠&r輸入進反應爐。\n\n最簡單的方法就是將&a儲存抽屜&r或&a儲物箱&r的頂部連接上&9物品管道&r，就像下圖中的那樣。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.graphite.original: Before we can start building our reactor, we'll need to smelt some coal (or Charcoal) to create &9Graphite Ingots&r.\n\nGraphite, coupled with Iron, is one of the main materials when making a Reactor.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.graphite.translation: 在我們開始搭建反應爐之前，我們要先熔煉一些煤炭（或木炭）來製造出&9石墨錠&r。\n\n石墨錠，再加上鐵錠，就是我們搭建反應爐所需的主要材料。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.interacting.original:
To extract power or items from your reactor, or even input fuel, you'll need these &crequired&r items.

The &cPower Tap&r provides a way for you to 'tap' into the power that a &9passive&r reactor makes. You can attach pipes and cables to extract the power from it.

The &aAccess Ports&r are required for every reactor, and allows you to both input fuel (Uranium) from the reactor, or extract waste (Cyanite). While it only requires one, it's usually a good idea to have 2 per reactor. If the inventory can push &land&r pull (i.e. hopper), Cyanite will be pushed into the inventory as an input.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.interacting.translation:
你&c必須&r要使用這些元件才能對你的反應爐輸入燃料，或是輸出廢料和電力。

&c反應爐能量埠&r讓你能夠從你的&9被動型&r反應爐輸出電力。你可以對它連接管道或線纜來進行能量輸出。

&a反應爐存取埠&r是所有反應爐的必要元件，它讓你能夠對反應爐輸入燃料（鈾錠）或輸出廢料（藍晶錠）。就算只需要一個存取埠就能搭建出反應爐，最好還是讓每個反應爐都擁有兩個存取埠。不然如果你將藍晶錠輸出到同時具有輸入&l和&r輸出功能的儲物空間（像是漏斗）的話，藍晶錠會進到反應爐的燃料輸入槽中。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.interface.original:
Right-clicking on a Turbine Terminal when it is fully built will show you the Turbine Interface.

Here, you can see all of the stats for the Turbine. Hovering over each will tell you more info about each one.

On the right side, you'll have 2 arrows to control the &9Input Flow Rate&r. This controls how much heated fluid is pumped into the Turbine. To know how much you should set this to, check your reactor's &dExhaust Flow Rate&r as a starting point.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.interface.translation:
當你搭建完你的渦輪機之後，右鍵點擊你的渦輪機終端就可以打開渦輪機的介面。

你可以在這裡看到渦輪機你可以在這裡看到渦輪機的各項數據。將游標滑到它們之上會告訴你更加詳細的資訊。

你在右邊可以看到兩個箭頭，它們是用來調整&9通入流量&r的。通入流量是指在同一時間內能夠讓多少的加熱流體進到渦輪機內。如果要知道你該將此項設定調整為多少的話，可以參考你的反應爐的&d廢氣產率&r。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.ludicrite.original: We now have a way to create &5Ludicrite Blocks&r.\n\nThese are rather expensive to make, but they serve as great &9Moderators&r for reactors, as well as breaking down into Ingots to craft a component of the &cHeat Exchanger&r.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.ludicrite.translation: 我們現在能夠製作出&5鏀方塊&r了。\n\n雖然它的造價非常的昂貴，但它能夠當作一個很好的反應爐&9減速劑&r，也能夠被分解成金屬錠以合成出&c熱交換器&r的相關元件。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.makingTurbines.original: Now that we have Blutonium, we can create the heart of the Turbine, the &9Turbine Terminal&r.\n\nTurbines are multi-block structures, just like Reactors! They input heated liquids like &7Steam&r made by &dActive&r Reactors to create TONS of power! We'll need a few other pieces to be able to build our first one.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.makingTurbines.translation: 當我們擁有了藍鈽錠之後，我們就可以開始製作渦輪機的核心元件：「&9渦輪機終端&r」了。\n\n渦輪機和反應爐一樣都是多方塊結構！它能夠通入一些像是&d主動型&r反應爐產出的「&7蒸氣&r」之類的加熱流體來產出 大 量 的 電力！我們會需要更多的組件來幫助我們搭建出我們的第一個渦輪機。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderatorList.original: For a full list of all Reactor Moderators and their properties, click on the link to the top-right of this quest.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderatorList.translation: 你可以點擊此任務右上角的圖標以查看：「反應爐的各種減速劑與它們的屬性的完整列表」。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderators.1.original: Reactor &9Moderators&r are materials placed inside of a reactor to change how it performs, based on the properties of the moderator. These are placed &linside&r of the reactor during construction.\n\nThere are 4 properties of a Moderator:
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderators.1.translation: 反應爐&9減速劑&r是一些擁有不同的屬性，且能夠被放置在反應爐內部以改變運作效率的材料。需要在搭建反應爐時，將它們放在反應爐的&l內部&r。\n\n減速劑有 4 種不同的屬性：

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderators.2.original: Typically, the rarer the material is, the better of a Moderator it is. &dUnobtainium Blocks&r are considered one of the best moderators.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderators.2.translation: 一般情況下，材料的稀有度越高，它作為減速劑所帶來的效果就越好。在 ATM 系列之中，&d難得素方塊&r通常都被認為是最好的慢速劑。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderators.3.original: Adding these inside of your reactor can increase the overall performance and output of your reactor. Try using Diamond Blocks in the early game!
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderators.3.translation: 將它們加入到你的反應爐之中可以提升你的反應爐的整體表現和能量輸出。在前期推薦使用鑽石子來當作減速劑！

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderatorsA.original: - Absorption: The speed at which radiation is absorbed and converted to case heat.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderatorsA.translation: - 吸收率：能夠將吸收到的輻射轉化為多少外殼熱的比例。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderatorsC.original: - Conductivity: How well heat is transferred from the fuel rods to the reactor casing.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderatorsC.translation: - 導熱率：能夠讓多少熱量從燃料棒轉移到外殼上的比例。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderatorsE.original: - Efficiency: How efficiently absorbed radiation is converted into heat.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderatorsE.translation: - 熱效率：能夠將吸收到的輻射轉化為多少熱量的比例。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderatorsM.original: - Moderation: The effectiveness at which radiation is moderated.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.moderatorsM.translation: - 減速率：將輻射速率減慢多少的比例。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.ports.original:
To interact with our Turbine, we'll need several &6Ports&r.

The &9Fluid Port&r is used to insert heated liquid like steam, or extract exhaust, like water. Steam does get condensed back into water, so it's good to have 2 of these for your Turbine: One to input Steam, and one to output Water back into the reactor.

The &cPower Tap&r extracts power, and is required for us to get power from the turbine.

You can also make a &eComputer Port&r, but it is completely optional. It allows you to interact with the Turbine with ComputerCraft using scripts.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.ports.translation:
我們會需要透過不同的&6埠&r來對渦輪機進行各種特定操作。

使用&9渦輪機流體埠&r能夠輸入像是蒸氣之類的加熱流體，也能夠用來輸出像是水之類的廢料。蒸氣會在渦輪機運轉的過程中凝結成水，所以最好在你的渦輪機上裝設兩個流體埠：一個用來輸入蒸氣，另一個則用來將水輸出回反應爐。

&c渦輪機能量埠&r能夠輸出電力，我們必須要透過它才能得到渦輪機的電力。

你也可以製作一個&e渦輪機電腦埠&r，但這取決於你自己。它能夠讓你使用電腦（CC: Tweaked）模組運行一些腳本來自動控制你的渦輪機。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.reactor.original:
We're going to build the smallest passive reactor possible, the &93x3x3&r. The requirements for the quest are the exact amounts for what you need to build one.

To build this, you start by building a 3x3x3 frame made out of Casings. On the bottom wall, you can use glass or a casing to fill it in. You'll want each wall to have a &9reactor component&r, like a power tap or access port.

Every reactor you build will require exactly 1 &6Reactor Terminal&r, which is usually put in the middle of the front wall. Next, we'll place 1 &aControl Rod&r in the middle of the top, and 1 &eReactor Fuel Rod&r underneath it, meaning in the middle of your reactor.

You will need a way to input and output waste, which is done by using &9Reactor Access Ports&r. For this build, place one on the left side and one on the right.

To extract power, we'll place the &cPower Tap&r on the middle of the back wall. Once placed, the reactor should complete!
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.reactor.translation:
我們將會搭建最小型的被動型反應爐（3x3x3）。任務目標的需求量就是你要將它搭建出來所需的準確數量。

要搭建反應爐，你需要先用外殼搭建出一個3x3x3的框架。底部的中間可以使用外殼或玻璃。你需要在每面牆上放置功能各異的&9反應爐元件&r，像是反應爐能量埠或是反應爐存取埠

你搭建的每個反應爐都必須且只能放置「一個」&6反應爐終端&r，我們通常會將它放在正面的中間。接下來，我們會需要在反應爐的頂部放置一個&a反應爐控制棒&r，並在它的下方（也就是反應爐的正中心），放置一個&e反應爐燃料棒&r。

你會需要一個通道來輸入燃料和輸出廢料，這些動作都能透過&9反應爐存取埠&r來完成。在我們的搭建中，最好在左邊和右邊各放一個。

因為我們要輸出電力，我們會在後面放置一個&c反應爐能量埠&r。當你放下它後，反應爐應該就搭建成功了！

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.reprocessingWast.original: That waste is actually rather useful! Making a &9Cyanite Reprocessor&r allows you to convert &e2 Cyanite Ingots&r into &dBlutonium&r. The Reprocessor will also need water to complete the conversion.\n\nBlutonium is used in several crafting recipes, but can also be used in a reactor for fuel, just like Uranium.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.reprocessingWast.translation: 這些廢料有其他用途！製作一個&9藍晶再處理器&r來將 &e2 個藍晶錠&r轉化為 &d1 個藍鈽錠&r。藍晶再處理器會需要注水來正常運作。\n\n藍鈽錠能夠用來合成一些物品，但也能像鈾錠一樣放在反應爐之中當作燃料。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.rods.original:
Every reactor needs &9Reactor Control Rods&r and &9Fuel Rods&r. These control how fuel is inserted into the reactor.

The Control Rods are placed on the top of the reactor. You can also have more than one per reactor, but you must have at least 1. Typically, the more you have, the more fuel the reactor can use and burn. That can mean more overall power, but at the cost of higher burn rates depending on the setup of your reactor.

For every Control Rod, you'll need enough Fuel Rods to extend to the base of the reactor. For example, if your reactor is 5 blocks tall, you'll need 3 Fuel Rods extending from each Control Rod.

If you right-click on a Control Rod, you can control how much fuel is burned in the reactor by inserting or retracting the fuel rods. The further that you extend the rods, the less fuel that will be burned.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.rods.translation:
所有的反應爐都需要&9反應爐控制棒&r和&9反應爐燃料棒&r來運行。你能夠用它們來控制你要插多少燃料進反應爐。

反應爐控制棒被放置於反應爐的頂部。你的反應爐可以放置多個控制棒，但一定至少要有一個。通常情況下：你放置的越多，你的反應爐就能同時燃燒更多的燃料。這代表你可以以更快的速率來產生電力，但代價就是你會更快的消耗燃料。

對於每個控制棒來說，你會需要從反應爐的底部一路放置燃料棒，直到燃料棒接觸到它們。舉例來說：如果你有一個 5 格方塊高的反應爐，你每放置一個控制棒就需要在它的下方放置 3 個燃料棒。

如果你右鍵點擊你的控制棒的話，你能夠透過插入或抽出燃料棒來控制反應爐的燃燒速率。你插入的越深，反應爐的燃燒速率就越慢。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.shaft.original:
To get a Turbine spinning, we'll need these &crequired&r components:

- &9Rotor Bearings&r are placed at each end of the shaft of the turbine. While the shaft technically does not have to be centered in the turbine, it's generally the optimal place for it. You will need exactly 2 per Turbine, one at the top and one at the base.

- &eRotor Shafts&r extend from one Rotor Bearing to the other, creating the shaft for the Turbine. The shaft can be vertical or horizontal.

- &9Rotor Blades&r make the rotor spin. These are placed onto the Rotor Shafts and can be multiple blocks in length.

Here is an example of a Horizontal Shaft setup for a Turbine, with the Turbine Coil of Gold on the right side.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.shaft.translation:
要讓渦輪開始旋轉，我們會需要下列&c重要&r元件：

- &9渦輪機轉子軸承s&r是放置在渦輪兩端的一個裝置。雖然渦輪機轉子不一定要放置在渦輪的正中心，但通常這會是效率最高的位置。每個渦輪機會需要2個渦輪機轉子軸承，一個放在頂端，另一個放在底部。

- &e渦輪機轉子&r需要從其中一個渦輪機轉子軸承一路延伸到另一個渦輪機轉子軸承，它們會形成整個渦輪機的主軸。主軸可以是垂直的也可以是水平的。

- &9渦輪機扇葉&r會使渦輪機轉子轉動。它們可以被放置在渦輪機轉子上並能夠向外延伸多格方塊。"

下圖是一種水平主軸的設置範例，右邊為黃金方塊所形成的渦輪線圈：

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.terminal.original:
The &dReactor Terminal&r is the heart of the reactor. When a reactor is formed, you can right-click the terminal to open up the reactor interface.

Depending on if it is a &9Passive&r or an &eActive&r reactor, the interface will change. Passive reactors are used to produce power directly by burning fuel. Active Reactors burn fuel to create heat to power Turbines for power generation.

In the interface of a passive reactor, you can see and toggle the status and waste ejection. You'll also see the temps, how much RF/t the reactor is producing, and how much fuel the reactor is burning per tick.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.terminal.translation:
&d反應爐終端&r是反應爐的核心部位。當反應爐成形後，你可以右鍵點擊終端來開啟反應爐的介面。

介面會根據你的反應爐是&9被動型&r還是&e主動型&r的反應爐發生變化。被動型反應爐能夠直接透過消耗燃料來進行發電。而主動型反應爐則是透過消耗燃料來產生熱量，以使渦輪機能夠進行發電。

你能夠在被動型反應爐的介面中開關反應爐或廢料輸出。你也能看到一些資訊，像是：反應爐正產出的 RF/t 或是反應爐每 tick 會消耗多少的燃料。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.turbine.original:
Instead of building the smallest Turbine at this point, it's better to build a Turbine based off of the design of your &9Active Reactor&r.

For starters, you want to build a Turbine that can handle the &9Exhaust Flow Rate&r of your reactor. To get the most power out of it, it'll need to maintain 1800RPM as well. This takes a lot of experimenting with different coils, # of blades, and overall size of the Turbine!

Note: To complete this quest, you'll need to create a &dTask Screen&r of any size. Once placed, you can right-click the screen and select this quest as the requirement, then output power into the task screen block to fill it up and complete the quest.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.turbine.translation:
比起建造一個最小尺寸的渦輪機，你現在最好的選擇是：根據你的&9主動型反應爐&r的產率來搭建一個適配的渦輪機。

首先，你會需要搭建一個足以承受住你的反應爐的&9廢氣產率&r的渦輪機。要獲得最高的發電量，你需要讓它維持在 1800 RPM。這代表你會需要花很多時間來慢慢測試不同的線圈、不同的扇葉數量以及不同尺寸的渦輪機！

註：你會需要製造一個任意尺寸的&d任務目標螢幕&r來完成這個任務。當你放下它並對他點擊右鍵後，你就可以將任務目標設為此任務，然後你就可以對它輸入電力來完成此任務了。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.waste.original: Just as you'll need to pump in Fuel, burning Uranium creates a byproduct of &9Cyanite&r as a waste.\n\nNote: &eCyanite Dust&r is craftable.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.waste.translation: 就像你會需要輸入燃料那樣，反應爐會產生一個副產物：「&9藍晶錠&r」來作為它的廢料產出。\n\n註：你也可以直接合成出&e藍晶粉&r。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.welcome.1.original: Based off the original mod &eBig Reactors&r, this mod aims to provide fun and engaging power systems by making customizable multi-block reactors.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.welcome.1.translation: 該模組為基於原本的&e大型反應爐（Big Reactors）&r的官方高版本移植，旨在透過搭建可自定義的多方塊反應爐來提供有趣且具有吸引力的的電力系統。

atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.welcome.2.original: The main element is of course, Uranium (which you can get from sieving Deepslate). You'll need this and a lot of Coal and Iron to get building.
atm9.quest.biggerR.desc.welcome.2.translation: 該模組的主要元素為：鈾錠（可以透過篩深板岩獲得）。你會需要很多的鈾再加上一大堆的煤炭和鐵錠來開始搭建你的反應爐。

atm9.quest.biggerR.fuel.translation: 為你的被動型反應爐添加燃料

atm9.quest.biggerR.moderatorList.original: Full List of Moderators and Properties
atm9.quest.biggerR.moderatorList.translation: 反應爐的各種減速劑與它們的屬性的完整列表

atm9.quest.biggerR.reactor.translation: &d搭建你的第一個被動型反應爐

atm9.quest.biggerR.subt.moderators.translation: 請稱呼它們為減速劑，而非冷卻劑。

atm9.quest.biggerR.subt.waste.original: Waste Not Want Not or something...
atm9.quest.biggerR.subt.waste.translation: 不浪費、不想要什麼之類的...

atm9.quest.biggerR.welcome.translation: 歡迎來到&9更大的反應爐&r！

atm9.quest.biggerR.wiki.original: Click here to open the Wiki!
atm9.quest.biggerR.wiki.translation: 點擊此處以開啟英文版 Wiki！

atm9.quest.biggerRc.rods.translation: 反應爐控制棒和燃料棒

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.airSigil.1.original: &9Air Sigil&r - Right Click to throw you in a direction you are facing for 50 LP.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.airSigil.1.translation: &9風之印記&r：使用右鍵以花費 50 LP 來讓你朝著面朝方向衝刺一段距離。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.alchemicalCha.original: While not fully implemented yet, the &6Alchemical Reaction Chamber&r functions like a Furnace.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.alchemicalCha.translation: 因為&6煉金術反應爐&r目前是個未完成的工作站，它現在像熔爐一樣運作。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.alchemicalCha.original: This is currently the only way to obtain &cWeak Blood Shards&r, which we'll need to upgrade our Altar.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.alchemicalCha.translation: 這是目前唯一一種獲得&c微弱血碎片&r的方式，我們會需要用到它來升級我們的祭壇。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.alchemyTable..original: The &9Alchemy Table&r can craft various objects, catalysts, and more by using LP from a player's Soul Network (aka using a Blood Orb).
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.alchemyTable..translation: &9煉金桌&r可以透過使用玩家的靈魂網路（血寶珠）之中的 LP 來製作各種物品、催化劑等。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.alchemyTable..original: This table can also convert many things, like Rotten Flesh to Leather, Wool to String, etc. It's pretty useful!
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.alchemyTable..translation: 煉金桌的用途很多！它也可以用來轉換一些物品，像是：將腐肉轉換為皮革、將羊毛轉換為線...等。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarCapacity.original: This rune increases the capacity of the Altar by a multiplicative amount of 7.5% per rune. These apply after regular Capacity Runes.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarCapacity.translation: 該符文會使祭壇的「總容量」上升 7.5%% 。此效果會在增容符文之後計算。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarMobSacri.original: Now you can stab others to use their Blood instead!
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarMobSacri.translation: 你現在可以去戳其他生物來獲得牠們的血了！

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarMobSacri.original: Stabbing any mob within 2 blocks of your Altar with one of these will insta-kill them and drain their LP into your Altar!
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarMobSacri.translation: 在距離祭壇兩格方塊內的地方使用這把刀攻擊任何生物會秒殺牠們並使你的祭壇獲得 LP。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarMobSacri.original: If you have Runes of Sacrifice around your Altar, you'll get more per kill.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarMobSacri.translation: 如果你的祭壇裝有獻祭符文的話，你會獲得更多的 LP！

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarMobSacri.original: I'm also totally not giving you 16 eggs for you to potentially get chickens for blood. Totally just for cooking.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarMobSacri.translation: 我給你這16個雞蛋完全不是讓你利用這些雞來獲取LP的。它們是用來煮食物的。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarUpgrade..original: To upgrade our Altar to Tier 5, we'll need 60 more Runes, to make a total of 116, as well as 4 Demonite Blocks.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarUpgrade..translation: 要將我們的祭壇升至階級 5 ，我們會需要再加 60 個血符文（總共 108 個血符文）和 4 個獄火鍛造塊。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarUpgrade..original: Follow the Sanguine Scietiem (the guide book for the mod) for a detailed guide on how to build the structure.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarUpgrade..translation: 查看血染之書以找到詳細的建造指引。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarUpgrade..original: You want to start by going one block down and three blocks out from the previous set of runes of your Tier 4 Altar. You want to place 15 runes along each side.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarUpgrade..translation: 你會需要在階級 4 祭壇的符文往下一個方塊、往外三個方塊的地方放置新的血符文。每一邊 15 個血符文。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarUpgrade..original: In the corners of the newly created ring, place a Demonite Block with one empty space on each side.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.altarUpgrade..translation: 並在新的一圈符文的四個角落各放置一個獄火鍛造塊。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.arcaneAshes.1.original: With our Alchemy Table and our Orb full of Blood, we want to make some &9Arcane Ashes&r.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.arcaneAshes.1.translation: 我們會想要利用煉金桌和血寶珠來製作一些&9奧術灰燼&r。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.arcaneAshes.2.original: With the Ashes, we'll be able to draw a circle on the ground, known as an Alchemy Array. You can insert 2 items in by right-clicking, and will either craft a new item or perform an action, like turning day into night!
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.arcaneAshes.2.translation: 當你使用了奧術灰燼後，會在地板上畫出一道鍊金陣。你可以使用右鍵放入兩個物品，然後它們會合成出一個新的物品或是觸發一些功能，像是將白天轉換成黑夜！

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.bloodLamp.1.original: &cBlood Lamp&r - Launches a blood light when used. Costs 10LP
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.bloodLamp.1.translation: &c血光印記&r：使用它會花費 10 LP 來對著面向的方塊放置一個能夠照亮附近的血光。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.capacityRuneI.original: This rune increases the total capacity of the Altar by 20% for each Capacity rune.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.capacityRuneI.translation: 該符文會提高血祭壇的總容量。每一個符文給予 20%% 基本容量（2000 LP）。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.collectingDem.original: Before we can craft the &cHellfire Forge&r, we'll need a way to power it by acquiring &bDemon Will&r.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.collectingDem.translation: 在我們合成出&c獄火鍛造爐&r之前，我們需要先獲得它所需的燃料：&b惡魔意志&r。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.collectingDem.original: To start collecting it, we'll need to create some &dSoul Snares&r that we can use on mobs.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.collectingDem.translation: 要開始收集它，我們需要製造一些&d靈魂掠奪者&r，並將它們丟到生物上。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.collectingDem.original: Once you use a few of these on a mob, white particles will appear around them. Slay them, and you'll acquire Demonic Will.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.collectingDem.translation: 當你將它們丟到生物身上之後，在牠們的周圍會出現一些白色粒子。殺掉牠們，你就可以獲得惡魔意志了。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonRealmLoo.original: Using loot from the Demon Realm, you can upgrade each rune to double its effect.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonRealmLoo.translation: 你能夠利用在魔域中找到的戰利品來加倍符文的效果。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonWillStoc.original: Hopefully by this point, you've been stocking up on some Demon Will with a Sentient Sword. If not, make sure to go and grab that part of the questline!
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonWillStoc.translation: 在這個時間點，你應該已經開始使用感知之劍並擁有一定數量的惡魔意志了。如果沒有，請回頭去跟著那段任務走！

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonWillStoc.original: With our Saturated Tau and our Alchemical Reaction Chamber, we can make the required materials to upgrade our Altar and Blood Orb, the &4Weak Blood Shard&r.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonWillStoc.translation: 當我們擁有了飽滿血命果和煉金術反應爐之後，我們就能開始製作升級我們的祭壇和血寶珠的必要材料：&4微弱血碎片&r。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonWillStoc.original: This does require the Sanguine Reverter, which takes a couple of upgrades to your Tartaric Gem.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonWillStoc.translation: 你會需要一個血染復原器，它需要一定階級的魂石才能製作。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonicWillSt.original: Demon Will stacks up very quickly in your inventory.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonicWillSt.translation: 惡魔意志會占用很多的背包空間。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonicWillSt.original: We're going to need a lot of it, so we'll need to create a way to store all of it. Creating a &9Tartaric Gem&r is just what we need.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonicWillSt.translation: 我們將會用到很多惡魔意志，所以我們需要一個能夠儲存它的方式。讓我們來製作一個&9地獄魂石&r吧。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonicWillSt.original: The &bPetty Tartaric Gem&r is what we'll spend our first Demon Will on. This will store up to a maximum of 64 Will.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonicWillSt.translation: &b微小地獄魂石&r是我們的第一個目標。它會儲存最多 64 個惡魔意志。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonicWillSt.original: Note: If you drop any Demon Will you have in your inventory, the Gem will absorb it into its storage.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.demonicWillSt.translation: 註：如果你將你背包內的惡魔意志丟出再撿回的話，它們會自動存進地獄魂石之中。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.divinationSig.original: The &9Divination Sigil&r is the first Sigil we'll be making.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.divinationSig.translation: &9占卜印記&r會是我們首先製作的印記。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.divinationSig.original: This Sigil has two primary uses:
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.divinationSig.translation: 該印記有兩個主要用途：

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.divinationSig.original: 1) When you right-click with the Sigil in your hand, it will display the amount of LP you have in your Soul Network.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.divinationSig.translation: 一：當你手持它點擊右鍵時，你可以看到你的靈魂網路中的 LP 量。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.divinationSig.original: 2) If you right-click a Blood Altar with it, you'll see how much LP is stored, the max it can store, and what tier the altar is.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.divinationSig.translation: 二：當你手持它並對血祭壇點擊右鍵時，你可以看到裡面儲存的 LP 量、可以儲存的最大數量以及祭壇的階級。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.duskRitualDiv.original: Now we'll need to make the Dusk version of the Ritual Diviner.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.duskRitualDiv.translation: 現在我們需要製作一個薄暮版本的儀式占卜杖。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.duskRitualDiv.original: This gives us access to even more rituals, including the ritual that gets us to the Demon Realm.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.duskRitualDiv.translation: 這讓我們能夠舉行更多種的儀式，包含了能夠讓我們前往魔域的儀式。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.finalSlateUse.original: The last piece of Slate that has any use...
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.finalSlateUse.translation: 最後一塊有功用的石板...
至少原本的模組是這樣。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.fruitThirsts..original: Just like everything in this pack, &cthe fruit thirsts for blood&r. Plant the fruit and force a mob on top of it.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.fruitThirsts..translation: 就像這模組的其他物品一樣，&c這個果實渴望著鮮血&r。種下該果實並讓生物站在它上面。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.fruitThirsts..original: It will drain the life force of the mob to become Saturated Tau.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.fruitThirsts..translation: 它會吸收該生物的生命力，並轉變為飽滿血命果。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.gettingStarte.original: To get started with Blood Magic, we'll need to collect some blood.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.gettingStarte.translation: 要開始血魔法之路，我們必須要先收集一些血液。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.gettingStarte.original: To do this, we'll need to craft the &dSacrificial Knife&r and the &4Blood Altar&r.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.gettingStarte.translation: 為此，我們會需要合成&d犧牲匕首&r和&4血祭壇&r。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.gettingStarte.original: Go ahead and place the Altar somewhere with plenty of space around it. We might want to expand on it more in the future.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.gettingStarte.translation: 去將血祭壇放在一個空曠的地方。我們在未來會將它擴展。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.gettingStarte.original: To acquire blood, stand by the Altar and... well... use the knife. You'll take a little damage, but &oit's for the cause&r.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.gettingStarte.translation: 要獲得血液，你需要站在祭壇前，並使用該匕首。你會扣血，但&o這是有原因的&r。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.gettingStarte.original: Each stab will generate around 200 LP.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.gettingStarte.translation: 每戳一下自己會產生 200 點生命精華。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.greenGroveSig.original: &2Green Grove Sigil&r - Right Clicking a crop that is growable will give it a bonemeal effect for 150LP. Shift-Right Clicking will consume 150LP per 5 seconds, increasing the growth rate of a 7x7x5 area.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.greenGroveSig.translation: &2綠叢印記&r：對著作物點擊右鍵以花費 150 LP 來給予它一次骨粉效果。潛行+右鍵能夠讓你以每 5 秒扣除 150 LP 的代價來增加 7x7x5 範圍內植物的生長速率。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.hellfireForge.original: The &4Hellfire Forge&r is one of the main blocks needed for creating certain items in Blood Magic.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.hellfireForge.translation: &4獄火鍛造爐&r是血魔法模組之中的一個合成站。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.hellfireForge.original: It is powered by &dDemon Will&r, and can be used to create several items including the &bSentient Sword&r.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.hellfireForge.translation: 當你賦予了它&d惡魔意志&r時，就能夠用它來製作像是&b感知之劍&r之類的物品。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.hiddenRealm.1.original: Once you make it to the Hidden Realm, you'll find a chest with some basic loot in it.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.hiddenRealm.1.translation: 當你進入隱域之後，你會發現一個內含一些基本戰利品的箱子。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.hiddenRealm.2.original: Keep an eye out for &9Iron Keys&r. These unlock the extra rooms within the Hidden Realm, giving access to even more loot.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.hiddenRealm.2.translation: 多加留意那些&9鐵鑰匙&r。它們能夠用來開啟隱域的其他房間，並讓你獲得更多的戰利品。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.holding.1.original: &9Holding&r - Holds up to 5 other Sigils at a time, providing their passive effects and allowing you to activate them on a while. You can keybind buttons to access the inventory and cycle through the Sigils.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.holding.1.translation: &9維持印記&r：能夠同時容納 5 個其他的印記，並提供它們的被動效果，且你能夠隨時開關它們。你可以設定按鍵綁定來開啟它或是在各個印記之間切換。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.imbuedSlates..original: Combing Reinforced Slate with some blood in our new Altar will give us Imbued Slates.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.imbuedSlates..translation: 將強化石板放入現在的祭壇之中會得到灌注石板。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.imbuedSlates..original: This is the next upgrade for our Blood Magic journey.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.imbuedSlates..translation: 這是我們在血魔法之旅的下一步。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.infusingLifeE.original: We'll want to infuse Life Essence (aka LP or Blood) into some stone.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.infusingLifeE.translation: 我們會需要將生命精華（也稱 LP 或血液）注入到石頭之中。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.infusingLifeE.original: Placing stone in the Altar with 1000 LP inside will create Blank Slates. You'll need a lot of these.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.infusingLifeE.translation: 在擁有 1000 LP 的祭壇中放入石頭會產生空白石板。你會需要大量的空白石板。
