atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.internalBuffe.original: This rune creates a 1000LP internal buffer whenever the Altar is not being used for crafting or filling blood orbs.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.internalBuffe.translation: 該符文會為祭壇增加一個 1000 LP 的內部緩衝。當祭壇閒置時，多餘的LP會被送進裡面。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.internalBuffe.original: Whenever an item is placed inside of the altar, it will instantly consume the stored charge and apply it to the item.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.internalBuffe.translation: 當物品被放上祭壇時，它會瞬間消耗掉所需的 LP。
不用再等它慢慢製作了！

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.lavaSigil.1.original: With the Lava Sigil in hand, if you right-click, you'll create a source block of lava for the low low cost of 1,000 LP.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.lavaSigil.1.translation: 當你手持它時，你可以使用右鍵花費極少極少的 1000 LP 來創造一個岩漿源。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.lavaSigil.2.original: If you don't have enough LP, that's cool too. It'll just take 5 hearts from you. No biggie.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.lavaSigil.2.translation: 如果你沒有足夠的 LP，那也沒關係。它只會讓你失去 5 顆心。這沒什麼大不了的。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.livingEquipme.original: You can create Living Equipment by making some Binding Reagents in an Alchemy Table. You'll also need at least a Common Tartaric Gem in order to hold the Demon Will required.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.livingEquipme.translation: 你能夠在煉金桌內製作一些束縛試劑，並利用它們來製作一套束靈盔甲。你也會需要一個普通以上的地獄魂石來維持它對於惡魔意志的需求。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.livingEquipme.original: &9Living Equipment&r is the equivalent in durability of Diamond Armor, and can be repaired in an Anvil using Binding Reagents.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.livingEquipme.translation: &9束靈裝備&r擁有與鑽石盔甲相同的耐久度，並能夠在鐵砧上使用束縛試劑來修理。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.livingEquipme.original: It starts off as the equivalent of Iron, but has Upgrade Points that can be spent to train it in specific ways. It starts with 100, but there are ways to increase this limit.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.livingEquipme.translation: 它的性能一開始與鐵製盔甲相同，但它擁有能夠用來訓練出各種功能的升級點數。升級點數一開始為 100 點，但有些方法能夠讓你突破這個上限。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.livingEquipme.original: As you use it, it will \"learn\" from you. You can see what it has learned so far by holding left shift while looking at it.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.livingEquipme.translation: 當你穿戴著它時，它會向你「學習」。你可以在背包內按住 左Shift 來查看它現在學習到的知識了。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.lpBonusFromRu.original: This rune increases the amount of LP gained from taking blood away from non-player entities. Each one gives a bonus of 10% additively per rune.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.lpBonusFromRu.translation: 該符文會提高從非玩家實體身上獲得的 LP 量。每一個符文給予 10%% 加成量。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.lpFlowRateInc.original: Increases the flow rate of LP in and out of the Altar when pumping to and from an external tank by 20% per rune.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.lpFlowRateInc.translation: 該符文會增加從能夠一次從其他儲罐抽送的 LP 量。每一個符文給予 20%% 加成量。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.lpGainIncreas.original: This rune increases the amount of LP gained from getting blood from Players. :D
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.lpGainIncreas.translation: 該符文會提高從玩家身上獲得的 LP 量。:D

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.lpGainIncreas.original: Each rune gives a bonus of 10% additively.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.lpGainIncreas.translation: 每一個符文給予 10%% 加成量。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.magnetism.1.original: &6Magnetism&r - Activate for a magnet up to 7 blocks at the cost of 50LP every 5 seconds.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.magnetism.1.translation: &6磁引印記&r：潛行+右鍵能夠讓你以每 5 秒扣除 50 LP 的代價來自動吸取 7 格方塊內的物品。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.minersSigil.1.original: &aMiner's Sigil&r - Shift-Right Click to use 100LP per 5 seconds to give yourself a Haste buff.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.minersSigil.1.translation: &a速掘印記&r：潛行+右鍵能夠讓你以每 5 秒扣除 100 LP 的代價來獲得挖掘加速效果。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.pathwayToEndl.original: Performing the &cPathway to the Endless Realm&r ritual will give you access to the proper Demon Realm.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.pathwayToEndl.translation: 你能夠透過舉行&c無盡之路&r儀式來開啟通往魔域的傳送門。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.pathwayToEndl.original: This is the only place where you can find &9Demonite Ore&r. This is used to create the Tier 5 Altar.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.pathwayToEndl.translation: 可以找到能夠將血祭壇升至階級 5 的必要材料：&9惡魔合金礦&r的唯一地點。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.pathwayToEndl.original: There is also a ton of rare loot, so make sure to keep an eye out for Intricate Hellforged Parts.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.pathwayToEndl.translation: 裡面也有很多的稀有戰利品，請特別留意精密獄火鍛造組件。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualDiviner.original: While not required, the Ritual Diviner is great to have as it shows exactly how the Ritual is built, and helps build it. (You should totally make one.)
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualDiviner.translation: 就算你不一定要使用儀式占卜杖才能建造儀式，但它依然是個非常好用的工具：它能讓你看到儀式的模樣，並能夠幫你將儀式蓋出來。（你完全該製作一個。）

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualDiviner.original: To build a ritual, shift-right click with the Ritual Diviner in the air until you find the ritual you want to create. You can shift-left click to go back as well.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualDiviner.translation: 當你手持它空中潛行+右鍵就能切換你要建造的儀式。你也可以使用潛行+左鍵進行反向切換。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualDiviner.original: Start by doing the Edge of the Hidden Realm ritual, as we'll need a few items from the dimension to get started.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualDiviner.translation: 建議從隱域儀式開始，我們會需要從該維度中獲取一些物品來繼續發展下去。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualDiviner.original: Once selected with the Ritual Diviner, right click on a Master Ritual Stone until the structure is complete. You will need a bunch of Ritual Stones to perform these rituals. Once the structure is fully built, you can right click the Master Ritual Stone with a Weak Activation Crystal to activate it.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualDiviner.translation: 當你選擇好你要建造的儀式之後，手持它對著主儀式石點擊右鍵就會開始自動建造儀式。你會需要一大堆儀式石來蓋出這些儀式。當儀式建造完成後，你就可以手持微弱活化水晶對著主儀式石點擊右鍵來啟動儀式。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualPrepara.original: With our Tier 3 Altar, we can start performing Rituals.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualPrepara.translation: 當我們擁有了階級 3 的祭壇，我們就可以開始舉行儀式了。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualPrepara.original: Rituals require a Master Ritual Stone and enough regular Ritual Stones to create.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualPrepara.translation: 創造儀式需要一個主儀式石和足夠的儀式石。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualPrepara.original: Start by crafting a bunch of Ritual Stones as well as a Master Ritual Stone. These are the basic blocks we'll need to start doing rituals.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.ritualPrepara.translation: 讓我們從合成一些儀式石和一個主儀式石開始。它們是我們用以舉行儀式的基礎方塊。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.runeOperation.original: This rune accelerates the operations of other runes, like the Charging or Displacement Rune.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.runeOperation.translation: 該符文可以加速充能符文和流動符文的運作速度。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.runeOperation.original: It removes 1 tick of delay per rune, down to a minimum of 1 operation per tick.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.runeOperation.translation: 每一個符文會縮短 1 tick 的時間，最多降至每 tick 啟動一次。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.runeTypes.1.original: There are several Rune types that can change how an Altar functions.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.runeTypes.1.translation: 有很多種的血符文可以用來改變祭壇的功能。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.runeTypes.2.original: For example, Speed Runes increase the speed of all crafting operations within the Altar by 20% per rune.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.runeTypes.2.translation: 舉例來說：每一個速度符文都會將祭壇的工作速度提升 20%% 。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.runeTypes.3.original: This is the first rune you can use to upgrade your Altar.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.runeTypes.3.translation: 這也是能夠用來升級你的祭壇的第一種血符文。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.seersSigil.1.original: &6Seer's Sigil&r - A better version of the Divination Sigil. Gives more info when looking at Altars.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.seersSigil.1.translation: &6先知印記&r：強化版的占卜印記。能夠在對著祭壇使用時提供更多的資訊。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.sentientSword.original: We can't use Soul Snares forever.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.sentientSword.translation: 使用靈魂掠奪者不是長久之計。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.sentientSword.original: The Sentient Sword allows you to collect Demon Will a lot easier. Simply kill a hostile mob with the sword, and the mob will drop Demon Will.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.sentientSword.translation: 使用感知之劍能夠更方便的獲取惡魔意志。只要用這把劍擊殺敵對生物，牠們就會掉落惡魔意志。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.suppressionSi.original: &9Suppression Sigil&r - You can push liquids away from you in a 6 block radius. It's pretty cool.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.suppressionSi.translation: &9抑制印記&r：你可以將半徑 6 格方塊內的流體排開。這功能滿酷的。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.tauFruitUsage.original: Tau Fruit can be obtained from loot chests within the Hidden Realm. You'll need this to upgrade your Altar even further!
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.tauFruitUsage.translation: 血命果可以從隱域的戰利品箱之中獲得。你會需要它幫助你繼續升級你的祭壇！

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.tauFruitUsage.original: Once collected, the fruit can be planted to farm it. However, it has 2 potential products instead of one.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.tauFruitUsage.translation: 當你收集到它之後，就可以將它種在耕地上了。但是，它有兩種產物。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.tauFruitUsage.original: Growing the fruit naturally will result in more Tau Fruit, which can be turned into Oil. But what if we give it some blood......
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.tauFruitUsage.translation: 用普通的方式栽種它會得到更多的血命果，並能夠用它來製作血命油。但如果我們灌溉一些血液...

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.telepositionS.original: &6Teleposition Sigil&r - Will teleport the user to a linked Teleposer at the cost of 1000LP. You can shift-click with the sigil on a Teleposer to set the location.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.telepositionS.translation: &6傳送印記&r：花費 1000 LP 將使用者傳送到綁定的傳送器。你可以在手持印記時對著傳送器潛行+右鍵來綁定它。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltar..original: To upgrade our Altar, we'll need 28 more, to make 56 total Blood Runes (Blank or better).
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltar..translation: 要升級我們的祭壇，我們會需要再加 28 個血符文（空白或是更好的），總共會需要 56 個。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltar..original: We'll do just like we did last time. Go one block down and two blocks out, then place 7 Blood Runes along each edge. You're basically making a pyramid at this point.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltar..translation: 就像我們上次做的那樣。往下一個方塊再往外兩個方塊，然後在每一邊放置 7 個血符文。你基本上現在就是在蓋一個金字塔。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltar..original: We want to create pillars in each of the corners, starting &9above&r the new ring of runes. These pillars are 5 tall, with the pillar cap being made of &cBloodstone Bricks&r or &cLarge Bloodstone Bricks&r.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltar..translation: 我們同樣需要在每個角落都建造一個柱子，從新的一圈符文的&9上方&r開始。這些柱子都有 5 格高，柱子的頂端必須要是&c血石磚&r或&c大血石磚&r。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltar..original: Instead of a picture, look in your Sanguine Scientiem and search for the Blood Altar section. Scroll until you find the Tier 4 Altar, and all of the information is there. You can even click the eye to visualize the structure.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltar..translation: 要想找到一張具體的圖片：打開你的血染之書，並點開血祭壇章節，翻頁到階級 4 血祭壇。你也可以點擊那個眼睛來使用結構可視化。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltarT.original: To upgrade our Altar to Tier 3, we need to get a lot more runes. 20 more to be exact, to make 28 total.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltarT.translation: 要將我們的祭壇升至階級 3 ，我們會需要很多的符文。再加 20 個，讓它變成總共 28 個。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltarT.original: You need to place 5 Blood Runes (Blank or better) one block down and two blocks away from the Tier 2 Altar runes, along each edge.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltarT.translation: 你會需要在階級 2 祭壇的符文往下一個方塊、往外兩個方塊的地方放置新的血符文（空白或是更好的）。每一邊 5 個血符文。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltarT.original: You'll then want to create a pillar in each corner out of any block, with a pillar cap of Glowstone sitting one block higher than the Altar itself.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltarT.translation: 你會需要在四個角落蓋出一個柱子，每個柱子的頂端都放一個比祭壇本體還高出一格的螢光石。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltarT.original: If you want to check if the Altar was built correctly, use a &9Divination Sigil&r to check the Tier.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltarT.translation: 如果你想要檢查你有沒有蓋對，可以使用&9占卜印記&r來檢查它的階級。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltarT.original: Note: Any non-air block can be used for the pillar, as long as the cap is Glowstone.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeAltarT.translation: 註：所有的非空氣方塊都能夠用來蓋柱子，但頂端要是螢光石。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeJourne.original: With our Altar now at Tier 2, we can make even better Runes. We'll need some Reinforced slate to continue our journey in Blood Magic, including doing some Rituals.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradeJourne.translation: 我們擁有了階級 2 的血祭壇，這代表我們現在可以製作更好的符文了。我們會需要一些強化石板來繼續我們的血魔法之旅，並在未來利用它們來完成儀式。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradingAlta.original: To craft even more items using blood, we'll want to upgrade our altar by surrounding it in &9Blank Runes&r.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradingAlta.translation: 為了利用血液來合成更多種物品，我們會需要使用&9空白符文&r圍繞祭壇來升級它。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradingAlta.original: If you want, you can replace the Blank Runes in each of the cardinal directions to runes like the &6Speed Rune&r. These runes can affect how the Altar functions.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradingAlta.translation: 如果你想要，你也可以將空白符文替換成像是&6速度符文&r的血符文（現在還不能換掉四個角落的符文！）。這些血符文會影響到祭壇的功能。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradingAlta.original: Below is an example of how you'd build a Tier 2 Altar, but you can also visualize it in the guidebook.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradingAlta.translation: 下圖是建造階級 2 血祭壇的範例，你也可以透過模組手冊來將它可視化。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradingAlta.original: Note: Speed Runes are the only runes available (besides Blank Runes) until you make a Tier 2 Altar, but can be replaced later on.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.upgradingAlta.translation: 註：速度符文是你在階級 2 時唯一可以使用的血符文，但之後可以把它換掉。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.voidSigil.1.original: &cVoid Sigil&r - Right Click on any liquid to void it, costing 50 LP.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.voidSigil.1.translation: &c虛無印記&r：對著任何液體使用右鍵以花費 50 LP 來將它消除。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.waterSourceCr.original: When held in hand, you can right-click to create a water source block for 100LP. Not bad huh?
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.waterSourceCr.translation: 當你手持它時，你可以使用右鍵花費 100 LP 來創造一個水源。還不錯吧？

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.waterSourceCr.original: Unless you don't have 100LP. In that case, it'll just take your health. :)
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.waterSourceCr.translation: 除非你沒有 100 LP。在這情況下，它會讓你扣血。:)

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.weakBloodOrbF.original: The &9Weak Blood Orb&r is used to store blood (or LP). It can be used as a way to transport blood to and from Altars. It also is used in several crafting recipes.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.weakBloodOrbF.translation: &9微弱血寶珠&r是用來儲存血（或稱 LP）的。能夠用它來傳輸各個祭壇之中的血。它也被包含在許多的合成配方之中。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.weakBloodOrbF.original: To craft this, you'll need to place a Diamond on top of the Blood Altar, then generate enough LP to craft it.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.weakBloodOrbF.translation: 要合成它，你必須要將一塊鑽石放在血祭壇上，並獲取足夠的 LP 來製作它。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.weakBloodOrbF.original: To charge a Blood Orb, you can right-click to sacrifice some of your health to the Orb. This also links your Soul to your Soul Network. :)
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.weakBloodOrbF.translation: 要將血填充進血寶珠之中，你要先手持它點擊右鍵來獻祭你的生命。它會將你的靈魂注入進該血寶珠之中，並形成一個靈魂網路。:)

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.weakBloodOrbF.original: You can also place the Orb in a Blood Altar that has some LP in it. It'll drain faster the more Speed Runes it has.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.weakBloodOrbF.translation: 你也可以透過將血寶珠放入含有 LP 的血祭壇之中來進行填充。放置越多的速度符文，它吸收的速度就會越快。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.welcome.2.original: This mod is all about using the Blood of your enemies (or yourself) to create powerful items and networks!
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.welcome.2.translation: 這是一個使用你的敵人（或你自己）的血液來製造強力物品和網路的模組。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.welcome.3.original: The guidebook contains all of the information about the mod if you ever need any help.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.welcome.3.translation: 如果你遇到了任何困難，模組手冊中包含了該模組的所有資訊。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.willStorageUp.original: An upgrade to our Will storage. This will hold a max of 256 Will.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.willStorageUp.translation: 升級版的惡魔意志儲存器。該魂石最多能夠儲存 256 個意志。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.willStorageUp.original: This will hold a max of 1024 Will.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.willStorageUp.translation: 該魂石最多能夠儲存 1024 個意志。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.willStorageUp.original: This is the maximum storage item for Demon Will, and will hold 4096 Will max.
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.desc.willStorageUp.translation: 這是最高階級的地獄魂石，最多能夠儲存 4096 個意志。

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.subt.drawingGround.original: We're drawing on the ground now.

atm9.quest.bloodMagic.subt.useGuidebook.original: Use the Guidebook for help building this!
atm9.quest.bloodMagic.subt.useGuidebook.translation: 使用模組手冊來幫助你建造它！

atm9.quest.botania.creatingMorePowerfulI.translation: 製造更加強力的金屬錠

atm9.quest.botania.desc.aflsteel.original:
By combining Dragonstone, Pixie Dust, and an Elementium Ingot plus 1.5 Mana Pools, you'll get AlfSteel! 

If you're just here for the Star just craft the Ingot into Nuggets then make your Pylons. 

If you actually care about using AlfSteel then keep reading! AlfSteel is Botanias version of Netherite. You can upgrade TerraSteel with an AlfSteel Ingot and Smithing Template. 

To get the Smithing Template you need to kill Witches or Evokers with an Elementium Sword or other Botania Swords.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.aflsteel.translation:
透過結合龍石、精靈塵和一個源質鋼錠以及 1.5 盆魔力池，你就能獲得精靈鋼！

如果你只是為了那顆星而來，那就把鋼錠合成金粒，然後製作你的蓋亞水晶。

如果你真的想使用精靈鋼，那就繼續讀下去！精靈鋼是植物魔法版本的獄髓。你可以用精靈鋼錠和鍛造模板來升級泰拉鋼。

要獲得鍛造模板，你需要用源質鋼劍或其他植物魔法的劍擊殺女巫或喚魔者。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.alchemyCatalyst.original: The &dAlchemy Catalyst&r can be placed under a &bMana Pool&r to allow it to perform &9Alchemy&r. This is useful to convert certain items into more useful items, like Rotten Flesh into Leather.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.alchemyCatalyst.translation: &d煉金催化劑&r可以被放置在&b魔力&r池下方，使魔力池可以製作&9煉金&r配方。這對於將某些物品轉化為更有用的物品非常有用，例如將腐肉轉化為皮革。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.asgard.original:
Mythic Botany is addition to Botania which adds more content to the End Game. 

In 9Sky we are only doing a quick pitstop into Mythic Botany, if you wish to have a more extensive set of Quests for it then look for ATM10! 

To start off with Mythic Botany, you'll want the Rune of Asgard.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.asgard.translation:
神話植物學是植物魔法的一個擴展模組，為遊戲的終局增加了更多內容。

在ATM9 翱翔天際中，我們只會快速地介紹一下它，若你想獲得更全面的相關任務，請遊玩 ATM10！

要開始神話植物學，你需要阿斯加德符文。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.bandOfAura.original: When equipped, the &9Band of Aura&r will slowly generate a trickle of Mana over time, and stores it into Mana-containing items within your inventory.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.bandOfAura.translation: 裝備&9光環之戒&r後，會持續產生些許魔力並存入魔力容器中。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.bandOfAuraUpgrad.original: By upgrading the Band of Aura with an ingot of Terrasteel, it increases the mana generation rate of the band significantly.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.bandOfAuraUpgrad.translation: 光環之戒和泰拉鋼合成能夠做出&d高級光環之戒&r，生產魔力的速率更快。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.bandOfMana.original: The &9Band of Mana&r is a wearable Mana Tablet that can be equipped like a trinket.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.bandOfMana.translation: &9魔力之戒&r就像是個能夠當作飾品穿戴的魔力石板。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.bestManaSpreader.original: Combining an &2Elven Mana Spreader&r with the power of Dragonstones and a &6Gaia Spirit&r creates the best Mana Spreader you can get.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.bestManaSpreader.translation: 將&2精靈魔力發射器&r與龍石和&6蓋亞之魂&r的力量相結合之後...你將能夠創造出世界上最好的魔力發射器。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.blackLotus.original: Found only in treasure chests, the &0Black Lotus&r can be thrown into a non-empty Mana Pool to give it a good deal of concentrated Mana.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.blackLotus.translation: 只能在寶藏箱中找到，&0黑蓮花&r可以被丟入非空的魔力池轉換成魔力。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.blockBreaking.original: Allows Mana Bursts to break through blocks by using its own mana.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.blockBreaking.translation: 讓魔力脈衝能夠使用魔力來破壞方塊。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.blockFalling.original: When a block is hit by a Mana Burst from this lens, the block will fall as if it were Sand or Gravel.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.blockFalling.translation: 讓魔力脈衝擊中方塊時能夠使那些方塊像沙子或礫石一樣開始墜落。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.botaniaIntro.original: &aBotania&r is a tech mod disguised as a magic mod, but with TONS of cool trinkets and toys to play with!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.botaniaIntro.translation: &a植物魔法&r是一個偽裝成魔法模組的科技模組，但是有 超 多 很酷的飾品以及玩具可供遊玩！

atm9.quest.botania.desc.botanicalBrewery.original: Using vials, Mana, and reagents in a &aBotanical Brewery&r, you can create &9Brews&r which are just like Potions.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.botanicalBrewery.translation: 你可以在&a植物釀造台&r之中使用魔法玻璃小瓶、魔力和一些材料來製造出與藥水類似的&9佳釀&r。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.catchFire.original: Allows the Mana Burst to catch blocks on fire. It will not work on living beings.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.catchFire.translation: 讓魔力脈衝能夠使方塊著火。這對生物無效。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.colorDyeRequirem.original: Needs to be dyed with a color first.

atm9.quest.botania.desc.colorPainting.2.original: Allows the Mana Bursts to paint any colorable block it hits, as well as any colorable block it is connected to. It also works on sheep.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.colorPainting.2.translation: 讓魔力脈衝能夠對它所擊中的可染色方塊（和它所連接到的相同方塊）進行染色。也會作用在羊身上。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.conjurationCatal.original: Similar to the Alchemy Catalyst, when placed under a Mana Pool, the &9Conjuration Catalyst&r unlocks the abillity to use conjuration recipes.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.conjurationCatal.translation: &9煉造催化器&r和鍊金催化劑的功能很類似：當它被放置於魔力池的下方時，你就能在魔力池使用煉造配方。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.continuousPartic.original: This converts the Mana Spreader's bursts to only fire a continuous particle rather than short bursts. No mana is consumed. Great for decorative uses.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.continuousPartic.translation: 讓魔力發射器從發射脈衝轉成發射一些連續粒子效果。這不會消耗任何的魔力。具有不錯的裝飾用途。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaCrystalC.original: The &9Corporea Crystal Cube&r is used to show the total count of an item in the Corporea Network of the Spark placed above it by right clicking it with that item.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaCrystalC.translation: &9多媒體水晶魔術方塊&r是一種能夠用來展示「它上方的多媒體火花所屬的&9多媒體網路&r」中某件特定物品的數量的方塊。\n\n你需要手持物品對它點擊右鍵來將它設定成該物品。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaFunnelUs.original: The &9Corporea Funnel&r is a simple version of the Index, and can be used to request items from the Network by giving it a redstone signal.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaFunnelUs.translation: &9多媒體漏斗&r是簡易版的多媒體索引，你能夠透過給予它紅石訊號來向儲存網路中請求物品。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaFunnelUs.original: To tell the Funnel which item to request, place the item in an Item Frame on the block. If the Funnel has more than one item frame on it, the Funnel will pick one at random. Rotating the item in the frame will change the request quantity.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaFunnelUs.translation: 你會需要在多媒體漏斗上放上一個「放著你想要請求的物品的物品展示框」來讓它輸出該物品。而如果漏斗上有多於一個物品展示框的話，它就會隨機輸出其中一種。旋轉展示框中的物品能夠改變它的請求頻率。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaFunnelUs.original: For more information, make sure to check out the &aLexica Botania&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaFunnelUs.translation: 請查看&a植物魔法辭典&r以了解更多資訊。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaIndexUsa.original: The &5Corporea Index&r is the interface block you need to access and request items from the &9Corporea Network&r of the Corporea Spark placed above it.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaIndexUsa.translation: &5多媒體索引&r是一種用來從「它上方的多媒體火花所屬的&9多媒體網路&r」之中進行物品的存取和請求的介面方塊。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaIndexUsa.original: To use this, approach the Index and it will intercept Chat Messages from nearby players. These players can request items from the network by typing in what they are looking to get. For example, you could say &b10 Iron Ingots&r, and if the system has it, it will drop it out for you.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaIndexUsa.translation: 請接近索引來使用它的功能：它會攔截來自附近玩家的聊天訊息。這些玩家可以在聊天室中輸入想要獲得的物品來向網路請求物品。舉例來說：你可以在聊天室中輸入 &b10 個鐵錠&r；如果系統裡面有足夠的鐵錠的話，它就會向你丟出 10 個鐵錠。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaIndexUsa.original: For more information, you can always check your &aLexica Botania&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaIndexUsa.translation: 你完全可以查看&a植物魔法辭典&r以了解更多資訊。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaNetworkS.original: With Botania, you can create a &dCorporea Network&r by using &9Corporea Sparks&r over inventories.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaNetworkS.translation: 你可以在多個儲物方塊上使用&9多媒體火花&r來創造出《植物魔法》模組中的&d多媒體網路&r。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaNetworkS.original: While the network will need at least one &bMaster&r &9Corporea Spark&r to work, you can expand the network with as many Corporea Sparks as you want. When these Sparks are placed, it will connect to all of the same colored Corporea Sparks and form an item network. Each Spark only has a range of 8 blocks.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaNetworkS.translation: 該網路會需要至少一個&b主&9媒體火花&r以正常運作，你可以放置任意數量的多媒體火花來擴展你的網路。當這些火花被放置出來之後，它會自動連接上所有相同顏色的火花，並創造出一個物品網路。每個火花都只有 8 格的連接距離。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaNetworkS.original: These Sparks can only see the inventory directly beneath it, but can only access items from its top side. Each Spark can also see every item in the Corporea network, and can be accessed by other Corporea blocks, like the Funnel or Index.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.corporeaNetworkS.translation: 這些火花只能連接到它正下方的儲物方塊，但也能夠存取到位於它頂端的物品。每個火花都能看到多媒體網路中的所有物品，而且都可以透過其他的多媒體方塊（像是漏斗或索引）來進行存取。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.createFlame.original: Causes the Mana Burst to create flame on the block it hits. This flame provides light and is purely decorative. It can be put out by using another Mana Burst on it.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.createFlame.translation: 讓魔力脈衝能夠在擊中方塊時生成一團火焰。這團火焰能夠用來當作照明或裝飾品。能夠使用魔力脈衝射擊它來將它消除。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.creatingTerraste.original: To create &aTerrasteel&r, we'll first need to set up the multiblock for it. The first part of this is crafting the &9Terrasteel Agglomeration Plate&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.creatingTerraste.translation: 我們會需要使用&9泰拉凝聚板&r搭建出一個多方塊結構，然後才能製造出&a泰拉鋼&r。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.damageLivingBein.original: Allows Mana Bursts to use its own mana to damage any living being it hits.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.damageLivingBein.translation: 讓魔力脈衝能夠使用魔力來傷害擊中到的任何生物。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.elementiumArmorF.original: Just like most armor in Botania, the &9Elementium&r set can repair itself with mana.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.elementiumArmorF.translation: 就像《植物魔法》中的大多數盔甲一樣，&9源質鋼&r套裝也能夠使用魔力來進行自我修復。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.elementiumArmorF.original: It also has a chance to spawn a &aPixie&r whenever the wearer is harmed.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.elementiumArmorF.translation: 並且穿戴它時有機率會在受傷後召喚出一個&a小精靈&r。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.elvenTradeFeatur.original: While you may not be able to enter the &dPortal to Alfheim&r, you can perform an &2Elven Trade&r by tossing in certain items through the portal. This does use mana for each trade! These materials can also be used to upgrade some of your items, like creating &2Elven Mana Spreaders&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.elvenTradeFeatur.translation: 因為生物無法穿過&d精靈傳送門&r，所以你必須要將物品丟進去以進行&2精靈交易&r。每次交易都會消耗魔力！交易來的材料能夠用來升級你的某些物品，像是&2精靈魔力發射器&r。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.elvenTradeFeatur.original: Throwing in our &aLexica Botania&r will also upgrade it with &6Elven Knowledge&r, giving you more insight into your journey in Botania.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.elvenTradeFeatur.translation: 將你的&a植物魔法辭典&r丟進傳送門也會讓裡面多出&6精靈學&r的內容：能夠讓你探知到更多《植物魔法》模組中的內容。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.endoflameFunctio.original: The &cEndoflame&r will absorb any combustible items or blocks dropped nearby, one at a time. It will then burn them to generate &bMana&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.endoflameFunctio.translation: &c火紅蓮&r會吃掉掉落在附近的任何可燃物，每次一個。然後它會燃燒它們以產生魔力。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.entropicBurst.original: Imbues a Mana Burst with entropic forces, or in simple terms, turns it into a bomb when it hits something that can't receive Mana.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.entropicBurst.translation: 將熵力灌注到魔力脈衝之中。簡單來說就是當它撞到無法接收魔力的方塊之上時會引發一場爆炸。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.festiveFireworks.original: Allows the Mana Bursts to launch festive fireworks when they hit a block.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.festiveFireworks.translation: 讓魔力脈衝能夠在擊中方塊時發射一個節慶煙火。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.floraTypes.1.original: Using the Petal Apothecary, we can create several different types of flowers that can help us on our journey, and these are broken down into two different categories: &9Functional Flowers&r and &aGenerating Flowers&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.floraTypes.1.translation: 我們能夠使用花藥台來製造出各種不同種類的花朵來幫助我們。這些花朵被分成兩種類型：&9功能花&r和&a產能花&r。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.floraTypes.2.original: &9Functional Flowers&r are flowers that help you with everyday tasks. For example, the &7Hopperhock&r will function like a hopper, and pick up items within a certain range around it. Some of the Functional Flowers will require &dMana&r to operate.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.floraTypes.2.translation: &9功能花&r是一些能夠幫助你完成日常工作的花朵。舉例來說：&7漏斗花&r的功能就像是個漏斗，它能夠撿起周圍特定範圍內的物品。而有些功能花也會需要使用&d魔力&r來啟動。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.floraTypes.3.original: &aGenerating Flowers&r are flowers that produce &dMana&r using different methods, depending on the flower. The most common flower used to generate mana is the &cEndoflame&r, which generates Mana by consuming nearby combustible like coal.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.floraTypes.3.translation: &a產能花&r是一些能夠使用各式各樣的方法來產出&d魔力&r的花朵。最常見的產能花為「&c火紅蓮&r」：它能夠透過消耗附近的可燃物（像是煤炭）來產出魔力。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.floraTypes.4.original: In this questline, Flowers with the quest shape of a &cSquare&r are Generating Flowers, where as flowers with the shape of a &9Circle&r are Functional Flowers. You can also find out what each flower does by using the &aLexica Botania&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.floraTypes.4.translation: 在我們的任務線之中：任務外框為&c方形&r的那些花朵為產能花；而外框為&9圓形&r的那些為功能花。你可以在&a植物魔法辭典&r中找到每朵花的具體用途。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.floralFertilizer.original: To use the power flowers of Botania you'll need Mystical Flowers. To get Mystical Flowers you need Floral Fertilizer which can be crafted with bonemeal and dyes. Use the Floral Fertilizer on Grass to grow Mystical Flowers.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.floralFertilizer.translation: 你需要神秘花來利用植物魔法中的花朵中的力量。神秘花需要使用花肥來取得，它可以用骨粉及染料來製作。對草地使用花肥來使其長出神秘花。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaSpiritQuest..original: To continue your journey, you will need to get your hands on &6Gaia Spirits&r. To do this, you will need to perform the &9Ritual of Gaia&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaSpiritQuest..translation: 你會需要開始著手獲得&6蓋亞之魂&r來繼續發展下去。而要達成這一點的話，你就必須要舉行&9蓋亞儀式&r。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaSpiritQuest..original: You will need 4 Gaia Pylons around an &aActive Beacon&r, as well as a single Terrasteel ingot. Once the structure is built, sneak-right click the Beacon with the Terrasteel ingot and prepare for the fight of your life.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaSpiritQuest..translation: 你會需要在一個&a啟動中的烽火台&r周圍放置 4 個蓋亞水晶，並且會需要一個泰拉鋼錠。當你搭建完所需結構之後，手持泰拉鋼對著烽火台潛行+右鍵就能與「你」之生命體一戰。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaSpiritQuest..original: If you need help with building the structure, you can always use the &aLexica Botania&r to help you build it. Look for the &9Ritual of Gaia&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaSpiritQuest..translation: 如果你想要知道該如何搭建出蓋亞儀式的相關結構的話，你可以使用&a植物魔法辭典&r中的「結構可視化」功能來幫助你搭建它。（請查詢&9蓋亞儀式&r）

atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaSpiritReward.original: Upon defeating the &9Guardian of Gaia&r, you'll be rewarded with &6Gaia Spirits&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaSpiritReward.translation: 當你擊敗了&9蓋亞守護者&r之後，你就能夠獲得&6蓋亞之魂&r。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaSpiritReward.original: Both the game difficulty and the number of people participating in the ritual determine the amount of drops you will receive.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaSpiritReward.translation: 蓋亞之魂的掉落數量取決於兩點：遊戲的難易度和參與儀式的玩家數量。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaTrinkets.1.original: There are many trinkets that harness the power of &6Gaia Spirits&r. Make sure to check them out!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaTrinkets.1.translation: 有很多種飾品都蘊含著&6蓋亞之魂&r的力量。請務必去查看它們！

atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaTrinkets.2.original: You can find all of the descriptions within the &aLexica Botania&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.gaiaTrinkets.2.translation: 你可以在&a植物魔法辭典&r中找到它們的相關敘述。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.gravityAffectedB.original: When breaking a block that is affected by gravity, this will auto-break all blocks above or below it.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.gravityAffectedB.translation: 當源質鋼鍬破壞掉一個重力方塊時，它也會自動破壞掉該方塊上方和下方的所有同種方塊。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.gravityEffectInc.original: Makes gravity affect a Mana Burst, making it move in an arc. It also slightly increases the time before it starts to lose mana.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.gravityEffectInc.translation: 讓重力能夠對魔力脈衝造成影響，讓它的行動軌跡變成一道弧線。也會稍微減慢魔力流失所需的時間。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.greaterBandOfMan.original: By upgrading the Band of Mana with an ingot of Terrasteel, it creates the &dGreater Band of Mana&r which allows it to hold up to 4x the amount of mana.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.greaterBandOfMan.translation: 魔力之戒和泰拉鋼合成能夠做出&d高級魔力之戒&r，魔力容量是魔力之戒的四倍。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.harderGuardianRe.original: Using Gaia Ingots to summon the harder version of the &5Guardian of Gaia&r will get you more &6Gaia Spirits&r, but the Guardian can also drop the &6Dice of Fate&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.harderGuardianRe.translation: 使用蓋亞魂錠來召喚困難版的&5蓋亞守護者&r：就能夠獲得更多的&6蓋亞之魂&r以及一顆&6命運骰子&r。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.homingAbility.original: Allows a Mana Burst to home in on any nearby blocks that can receive Mana. This also slightly decreases the speed of the burst.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.homingAbility.translation: 讓魔力脈衝能夠自動飛向附近能夠接收到魔力的方塊，但也會減慢脈衝的速度。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.incenseSticks.original: &2Incense Sticks&r can be infused with Brews in a Botanical Brewery. These can be lit using flint and steel on an &9Incense Plate&r to provide the brew effect for sixty times longer than its liquid counterpart, in a 30-block radius around the plate.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.incenseSticks.translation: 你也可以將這些佳釀注入到&2薰香&r之中：它們需要被放在香盤中，然後使用打火石來點燃；它們的持續時間為原本的佳釀的 6 倍，並能夠持續為半徑 30 格之內的生物提供它的效果。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.influenceMotion.original: Allows a Mana Burst to influence nearby dropped items, experience orbs, and falling blocks, having them move in the exact same vector of the motion as the burst itself.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.influenceMotion.translation: 讓魔力脈衝能夠讓周圍的「掉落物、經驗球和重力方塊」隨著它的方向移動。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.infuser.original:
The Terrasteel Agglomeration is great and all but we need better! 

Set up a checkerboard pattern of 5 Shimmerrocks. Then fill the other 4 spots with Blocks of Gold. Finally place down the Mana Infuser on the middle Shimmerrock. 

Similar to the Terrasteel Agglomeration you'll need Sparks to move Mana to it. The Spark will need a Dominant Augment to work the Mana Infuser though. 

You can now make AlfSteel and TerraSteel at half the cost!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.infuser.translation:
泰拉凝聚板雖然很棒，但我們需要更好的！

用 5 個微光石放成棋盤狀。然後用黃金方塊填滿其他 4 個位置。最後將魔力灌注板放在中間的微光石上。

與泰拉凝聚板類似，你需要火花將魔力傳輸到它。不過，火花需要一個聚集升級才能將魔力灌注。

現在你可以用一半的成本製作精靈鋼和泰拉鋼了！

atm9.quest.botania.desc.instantMoisten.original: Instantly moisten farmland it creates. Do we know if there is a better word for that?
atm9.quest.botania.desc.instantMoisten.translation: 他可以導致耕地瞬間濕潤。不知道有沒有其他更好的詞來形容這一點？

atm9.quest.botania.desc.lexicaBotaniaInf.original: For more information on the items in the mod, make sure to check out the &aLexica Botania&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.lexicaBotaniaInf.translation: 如需模組物品的更多資訊，請務必查看&a植物魔法辭典&r。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.lexicaReference.original: Refer to the &aLexica Botania&r on how to use this lens.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.lexicaReference.translation: 查看&a植物魔法辭典&r來了解該如何使用此透鏡。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaBurstBounce.original: Allows Mana Bursts to bounce off of walls.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaBurstBounce.translation: 讓魔力脈衝能夠在牆壁上反射。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaBurstSpeedIn.original: Dramatically increases the speed of the Mana Bursts at the expense of initial capacity and faster mana loss.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaBurstSpeedIn.translation: 顯著提高魔力射出的速度，但代價是容量更低且魔力流失的速度更快。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaCapacityDoub.original: Doubles the amount of Mana a Mana Burst can carry, at the cost of speed and increased mana loss over longer distances.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaCapacityDoub.translation: 讓魔力脈衝能夠射出的魔力量加倍，但代價是魔力射出的速度更慢且隨著距離增加的魔力流失量更多。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaCarryDecreas.original: Greatly decreases the amount of Mana a Mana Burst carries and dramatically increases the burst's speed and distance.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaCarryDecreas.translation: 將魔力脈衝能夠攜帶的魔力量降低非常多，但能夠顯著提高魔力脈衝的速度和距離。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaInfusion.1.original: By tossing in certain items into a &bMana Pool&r, you can infuse them with &9Mana&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaInfusion.1.translation: 透過投擲某些物品至&b魔力池&r，你可以對其注入&9魔力&r。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaInfusion.2.original: To see how much mana is needed for the item, make sure to check the recipe in JEI!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaInfusion.2.translation: 要查看需要多少魔力，請務必用JEI檢查配方！

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaInfusion.3.original: Pro Tip: If you have enough mana, try creating Manasteel or Mana Diamond blocks to save time!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaInfusion.3.translation: 小撇步：如果你有足夠的魔力，直接做魔力鋼方塊和魔力鑽石方塊能節省一些時間。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaLossDecrease.original: Significantly increases the amount of time a Mana Burst can go without starting to lose Mana, but slows it down as well.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaLossDecrease.translation: 顯著減慢魔力脈衝流失魔力所需的時間，但代價是魔力射出的速度更慢。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaLossRateDecr.original: Decreases the amount of time that it takes for a Mana Burst to start losing its Mana, but will also decrease its rate of loss.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaLossRateDecr.translation: 會讓魔力脈衝流失魔力所需的時間變短，但魔力流失的速度也更慢。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaPoolIntro.1.original: With our &bLivingrock&r we've created, we can now make the &9Mana Pool&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaPoolIntro.1.translation: 有了&b活石&r之後，我們就可以製作&9魔力池&r了。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaPoolIntro.2.original: The Mana Pool is our storage for our Mana we generate. Once it has some mana stored inside, we can begin converting specific resources into Mana resources, like Manasteel, Mana Diamonds. To create these resources, throw the item into the pool with enough mana inside to convert the item.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaPoolIntro.2.translation: 魔力池是用來儲存我們產出的魔力的儲存空間，當內部儲存了一些魔力，我們即可將特定資源轉換為魔力素材，好比如 魔力鋼、魔力鑽石。為了製作這些素材，我們需要將其丟進有足夠魔力的魔力池去轉換它們。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaPoolIntro.3.original: To &bgenerate mana&r, you'll need to create a &2Generating Flower&r, like the &9Hydroangeas&r or the &cEndoflame&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaPoolIntro.3.translation: 為了&b產生魔力&r，你會需要製作&2產能花&r，像是&9水繡球&r或是&c火紅蓮&r。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaPoolIntro.4.original: Note: The Mana Pool stores a massive amount of mana. To see how much Mana is stored, try looking at one while holding the &2Wand of the Forest&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaPoolIntro.4.translation: 注：魔力池可以儲存巨量的魔力，要查看儲存了多少魔力，請嘗試拿著&2森林法杖&r查看其中的魔力。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaSplitter.1.original: The &bMana Splitter&r can be used as a way of splitting incoming Mana bursts into several Mana Pools at once.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaSplitter.1.translation: &b魔力分配器&r可被用於平分輸入的魔力脈衝至多個魔力池。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaSplitter.2.original: &dSparks&r are used to transfer Mana to specific blocks, which are needed for in the progression of Botania.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaSplitter.2.translation: &d火花&r是被用來對特定方塊傳輸魔力，它將會在未來植物魔法的發展中被用上。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaSplitter.3.original: To use a Spark, place one over a Mana Pool, then another over a nearby block that can accept it. Think of this like \"wirelessly\" transferring Mana from your Mana Pools to the desired nearby block.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaSplitter.3.translation: 要使用火花，你需要將其放置在魔力池上，再將另一個放在附近的可接受他的方塊。你可以把它當成從魔力池將魔力「無線」傳輸至附近的所需方塊。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaSplitter.4.original: To remove a Spark, sneak-right click it with a &2Wand of the Forest&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaSplitter.4.translation: 要移除火花，使用&2森林法杖&r對其蹲下+右鍵。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaSpreaderIntr.original: The &2Mana Spreader&r is used to direct the flow of Mana by shooting out Mana Bursts.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaSpreaderIntr.translation: &2魔力發射器&r是以發射魔力脈衝來引導魔力流向。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaSpreaderIntr.original: You can set the direction that the Spreader shoots by binding it to a block using the &2Wand of the Forest&r. While holding the Wand, you can also see the mana buffer, as well as the Mana Bursts.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaSpreaderIntr.translation: 你可以用&2森林法杖&r來綁定某個方塊以設定發射器的方向。當拿著法杖，你同時也能看到其中的魔力暫存以及魔力脈衝。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaTablet.1.original: The &9Mana Tablet&r is a portable Mana Pool!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaTablet.1.translation: &9魔力石板&r是攜帶式的魔力池！

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaTablet.2.original: Tossing the tablet into a Mana Pool will allow it to either give or take Mana from the pool. You can switch between the modes by sneak-right clicking with a &2Wand of the Forest&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaTablet.2.translation: 將魔力石板丟入魔力池中可以向魔力池抽取或注入魔力，拿著&2森林法杖&r對著魔力池蹲下 + 按下右鍵能調整魔力的流向。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaTablet.3.translation: 註：魔力石板不會自然消失。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manastarUse.1.original: This is considered a miscellaneous flower that is used to measure if you are turning a profit or loss in your Mana Pools.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manastarUse.1.translation: 魔力星能夠檢測魔力池內的魔力正在增加還是減少。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manastarUse.2.original: To do this, place the &dManastar&r next to a pool, and watch for the color of the flower to change. If it shines red, the pool is operating at a loss. If it shines blue, there is a profit!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manastarUse.2.translation: 將&d魔力星&r擺在魔力池旁邊，並觀察它的顏色變化。如果閃紅光，那麼魔力池的魔力正在減少；如果閃藍光，就是增加。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manasteelArmor.original: Similar to the qualities of Iron, &9Manasteel Armor&r has superior enchantability and durability. Manasteel items can also repair themselves with Mana from the user's inventory.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manasteelArmor.translation: &9魔鋼盔甲&r有和鐵製盔甲相似的耐久度和附魔等級，並且能夠抽取玩家物品欄中的魔力來自我修復。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaweaveRobes.1.original: While the &bManaweave Robes&r don't offer the greatest overall protection, the set bonus is pretty powerful!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaweaveRobes.1.translation: &b魔源套裝&r的防禦力不怎麼樣，但是套裝效果非常強力。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaweaveRobes.2.original: When all four pieces are worn, you'll get a discount on Mana cost for mana tools and rods. The set can also repair itself using Mana from one's inventory.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.manaweaveRobes.2.translation: 穿上整套套裝後，會降低魔力消耗。魔源套裝也能用魔力自我修復。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.mobOnlyBurst.original: Using this on a Spreader will cause it to fire a Mana Burst only if it can hit a mob or player.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.mobOnlyBurst.translation: 讓魔力發射器只會在能夠擊中生物或玩家時發射魔力脈衝。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.moreGaiaSpiritsC.original: Want more of a challenge, or need more &6Gaia Spirits&r from the fight? Try combining 4 Gaia Spirits with a Terrasteel ingot, and use that to activate the Ritual of Gaia. :)
atm9.quest.botania.desc.moreGaiaSpiritsC.translation: 你想要追求更多的挑戰，或是想要一次從戰鬥中獲得更多的&6蓋亞之魂&r嗎？試著將 4 個蓋亞之魂和泰拉鋼錠結合，然後使用它來啟動蓋亞儀式。:)

atm9.quest.botania.desc.moveBlock.original: Allows the Mana Burst to move a block just as if a piston would.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.moveBlock.translation: 讓魔力脈衝能夠像活塞一樣推動方塊。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.mysticalFlowersN.original: To start your journey in Botania, you'll need plenty of &9Mystical Flowers&r!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.mysticalFlowersN.translation: 如要開始你植物魔法的旅途，你會需要大量的&9神秘花&r！

atm9.quest.botania.desc.passThroughBlock.original: This lens allows a Mana Burst to pass through blocks, while decreasing the amount of time it can survive without losing mana.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.passThroughBlock.translation: 讓魔力脈衝能夠穿過方塊，但也會讓流失魔力所需的時間變短。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.petalApothecaryI.original: Now that we have some flowers, we can start converting the basic flora into functioning and generating flora using the &9Petal Apothecary&r!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.petalApothecaryI.translation: 現在我們有一些花了，我們可以開始用&9花藥台&r把花瓣變成功能花跟產能花了！

atm9.quest.botania.desc.petalApothecaryI.original: To start harnessing the energy from Mystical Flower Petals, we will need to fill the Apothecary with &bWater&r. This can be done by right clicking with a water bucket, or by throwing the water bucket on the Apothecary.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.petalApothecaryI.translation: 若要開始掌握神秘花花瓣的能量，你需要將花藥台填滿&b水&r。這可以以水桶對其右鍵完成，或對花藥台丟入水桶。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.petalApothecaryI.original: To create items, just throw the appropriate items for the recipe into the Apothecary. Right clicking with an empty hand will remove items from it as well.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.petalApothecaryI.translation: 要製作物品，只需將配方的物品扔進花藥台即可。使用空手右鍵點擊從中拿出物品。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.petalApothecaryI.original: Once a recipe has been completed, you will have about 20 seconds where &aright clicking with an empty hand&r will refill the last recipe, making it easier to create multiple of the same items!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.petalApothecaryI.translation: 當配方被完成時，你有二十秒的時間可以對它&a使用空手右鍵&r來自動補充上一份配方，這可以使你更方便的倍化相同物品。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.pixieSpawnAugmen.original: Increases the chance of a Pixie spawning when hit, and augments the strength of any Pixies that are spawned.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.pixieSpawnAugmen.translation: 源質鋼劍能夠增加被擊中時生成出小精靈的機率，並且能夠為生成出的小精靈提供加成。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.portalSetup.1.original: To create a &dPortal to Alfheim&r, start with the frame. We'll need to use 8 Livingwood blocks, 3 Glimmering Livingwood blocks, and an &9Elven Gateway Core&r to create the frame.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.portalSetup.1.translation: 要搭建出&d精靈傳送門&r的話，你會需要先搭建出一個框架。我們會需要使用 8 個活木類方塊、3 個微光活木類方塊以及一個&9精靈門核心&r來搭建出這個框架。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.portalSetup.2.original: Once the frame is created, we'll need to open it by using at least &d2 Mana Pools&r, a huge amount of mana, and a &aNatura Pylon&r over the 2 pools. These mana pools can be within an 11x11x11 area around the core.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.portalSetup.2.translation: 當框架搭建完成之後，我們需要一些東西來開啟它：&d2 個魔力池&r、大量的魔力以及 2 個放在魔力池上的&a自然水晶&r。（這 2 個魔力池能夠放在核心周圍的 11x11x11 區域之中的任何位置）

atm9.quest.botania.desc.portalSetup.3.original: With everything set up, right click the Elven Core with your wand to activate the portal.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.portalSetup.3.translation: 當你完成所有的準備之後，你就可以使用森林法杖右鍵點擊精靈門核心來啟動精靈傳送門了。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.portalSetup.4.original: Note: Even though the Mana Pools need a large amount of Mana to activate the portal, activating the portal does not cost Mana itself. However, converting materials over will use a little each time. If there is not enough mana, the portal will close.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.portalSetup.4.translation: 註：啟動傳送門需要消耗掉魔力池中的大量魔力，但是維持它並不需要消耗任何的魔力。然而，與精靈交易任何材料都會使用掉一些魔力。如果魔力池內的魔力歸零，則精靈傳送門會自行關閉。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.portalSetup.5.original: You can also use the &aLexica Botania&r to help you build it.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.portalSetup.5.translation: 你也可以使用&a植物魔法辭典&r中的「結構可視化」功能來幫助你搭建它。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.pulseManaSpreade.original: When you combine a piece of &4Redstone&r with a &2Mana Spreader&r, it creates a &9Pulse Mana Spreader&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.pulseManaSpreade.translation: 當你將&4紅石&r與&2魔力發射器&r相結合之後，就能製造出&9魔力發射器（紅石）&r。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.pulseManaSpreade.original: These can be controlled to only shoot a mana pulse when given a Redstone pulse.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.pulseManaSpreade.translation: 它的運作模式會被改變成：當它接收到紅石脈衝後才會發射出魔力脈衝。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.pureDaisyFunctio.original: This flower will convert up to 8 nearby &2Wooden Logs&r or &9Stone&r into &2Livingwood&r or &9Livingrock&r, respectively. This only converts in a 1 block radius around the flower.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.pureDaisyFunctio.translation: 這朵花將會把周圍 8 個&2原木&r或&9石頭&r分別轉換為&2活木&r或&9活石&r。轉換範圍只有花朵周圍 1 格半徑。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.pureDaisyIntro.original: The &aPure Daisy&r is one of the first flowers you'll create!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.pureDaisyIntro.translation: &a白雛菊&r將會是你首先要製作的前幾朵花之一！

atm9.quest.botania.desc.redirection.original: This lens will redirect any Mana Spreaders or entities it collides with to face towards the block or entity that fired the burst.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.redirection.translation: 讓魔力脈衝擊中其他的魔力發射器時，會讓它們改為指向發射出魔力脈衝的這個魔力發射器。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.rodOfTerraFirma..original: Tired of using a shovel to level out grass? Try using the &2Rod of Terra Firma&r!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.rodOfTerraFirma..translation: 不想要再花費大量時間整地了？那你可以試試這把&2大地權杖&r！

atm9.quest.botania.desc.rodOfTerraFirma..original: At the cost of Mana, this will flatten the surrounding land to your own altitude by charging up the rod by holding right click.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.rodOfTerraFirma..translation: 你可以在手持它的情況下按住右鍵來消耗魔力進行充能，以讓它能夠將周圍的地形皆改造成與你現在所站方塊的高度相同。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.rodOfTerraFirma..original: Note: Blocks removed by the rod are not recoverable.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.rodOfTerraFirma..translation: 註：此權杖沒有回退功能。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.runicAltar.1.original: &9Runes&r are vital crafting components in many of the more advanced recipes in Botania, and these are created on a &aRunic Altar&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.runicAltar.1.translation: &9符文&r是《植物魔法》中的一種能夠在&a符文祭壇&r上製造出來的重要高階合成元件。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.runicAltar.2.original: To use the Altar, start by placing the components of the rune you want on it. This can be done either by right clicking or dropping the item. It will also need Mana, so make sure to point a Mana Spreader that is getting Mana towards it as well.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.runicAltar.2.translation: 要使用符文祭壇的話，你要先將符文的所需材料放上去（右鍵或丟上去）。而它會需要花費魔力來進行製作，所以記得要將你的魔力發射器對著它。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.runicAltar.3.original: Once you've finished placing the items, you can hover over the Altar with your wand and it will show you the progress of the recipe. When it completes, drop a piece of Livingrock on the Altar, then use your wand to collect your rune.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.runicAltar.3.translation: 當你將所需的物品都放上去之後，祭壇上就會顯示出你現在的合成進度。最後，當魔力充滿之後：將一塊活石丟上祭壇，然後對它使用森林法杖。這樣你現在就獲得你想要的符文了。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.runicAltar.4.original: Note: Runes used for recipes in the Runic Altar function as catalysts, and will not be consumed. Just like the Petal Apothecary, right-clicking the Altar with an empty hand after a recipe is complete will refill it with the items used in the last recipe.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.runicAltar.4.translation: 註：使用於符文祭壇之中的任何符文都不會被消耗掉（它們就像是製作所需的催化劑）。而你也可以像使用花藥台一樣，對著祭壇空手右鍵來自動填入上個合成配方所需的物品。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.skullDropping.original: Can drop skulls from certain mobs or players when dealing the finishing blow. Can also be enchanted with Looting.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.skullDropping.translation: 使用源質鋼斧對某些生物或玩家造成最後一擊時會有機率掉落對應的頭顱。可以透過掠奪附魔來提升此機率。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.tAPlate.1.original: Now it's time to create our platform for the &9T.A. Plate&r so we can make &aTerrasteel&r!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.tAPlate.1.translation: 我們現在要來搭建製造&a泰拉鋼&r所需的&9泰拉凝聚板&r的多方塊結構了！

atm9.quest.botania.desc.tAPlate.2.original: To create the platform, you'll need to place 5 pieces of Livingrock and 4 Blocks of Lapis in a checkerboard pattern, like in the image below. Place the plate on the center Livingrock block, and the platform will be complete!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.tAPlate.2.translation: 你需要棋盤式放置 5 塊活石和 4 塊青金石方塊來搭建出它的平台（就像下圖中的那樣）。最後在中間的那塊活石上放置泰拉凝聚板，整個結構就搭建完成了！

atm9.quest.botania.desc.tAPlate.3.original: Terrasteel needs a lot of Mana to craft, requiring the use of &9Sparks&r. Place several Sparks over your Mana Pools, then one over the T.A. Plate to direct your mana for crafting.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.tAPlate.3.translation: 泰拉鋼會需要使用很多的魔力來製作，所以你會需要用到&9火花&r：將火花分別放置在你的魔力池和泰拉凝聚板上，魔力池中的魔力就能夠自動被引入到泰拉凝聚板之中了。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.tAPlate.4.original: Once you have the platform ready for crafting, toss one Manasteel Ingot, Mana Diamond, and a Mana Pearl on the plate to start crafting Terrasteel.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.tAPlate.4.translation: 當你搭建完這個平台之後，將一塊魔力鋼錠、一顆魔力鑽石和一顆魔力珍珠丟到凝聚板上以開始製造泰拉鋼。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraBlade.original: With the damage of a Diamond Sword, the &2Terra Blade&r will sometimes fire a beam that will deal as much as a melee hit would.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraBlade.translation: &2泰拉之刃&r和鑽石劍的攻擊力相同，並且能夠發出射線，對生物造成和近戰相同的傷害。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraShatterer.1.original: It's not just a pickaxe, the &9Terra Shatterer&r also acts just like a Mana Tablet when tossed into a Mana Pool and can store a ton of mana. However, you will not be able to release the absorbed mana from the Shatterer.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraShatterer.1.translation: &9泰拉粉碎者&r能像魔力石板一樣從魔力池吸收魔力，然而此過程是不可逆的。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraShatterer.2.original: The higher the amount of Mana stored in the tool, the higher the rank that it has, with D being the lowest and SS being the highest.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraShatterer.2.translation: 吸收的魔力越多，泰拉粉碎者的等級越高。由 D 級開始，最高可以達到 SS 級。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraShatterer.3.original: Increasing the tool's rank does not increase its speed, but instead increases the AoE of its &bActive Ability&r, which can be toggled on and off by sneak-right clicking. When active, it increases the Shatterer's mining width and height based on the rank. Being at a rank of D will not have an ability.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraShatterer.3.translation: 雖然等級並不影響採掘速度，但是會影響啟動狀態下的挖掘範圍。蹲下 + 按下右鍵能啟動泰拉粉碎者，挖掘範圍從 D 級不增加範圍開始，隨著等級提升擴大挖掘範圍。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraShatterer.4.original: Note: As long as the tool is active, it will consume its stored mana.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraShatterer.4.translation: 註：當泰拉粉碎者啟動時，就會消耗其儲存的魔力。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraShattererFe.original: Has an ability to clear away Cobblestone, Dirt, Netherrack, and other common materials, leaving behind only ores and fine resources.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraShattererFe.translation: 源質鋼鎬會破壞掉任何像是鵝卵石、泥土、地獄石以及其他類似的常見方塊，讓你只能夠挖下礦物和各種稀有資源。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraShattererFe.original: Can combine with the Terra Shatterer in a crafting grid, which will allow the latter to take on the former's power. This cannot be undone.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraShattererFe.translation: 你可以在合成台中將它與泰拉粉碎者結合，以讓後者能夠取得它的力量。此操作無法回退。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraTruncator.original: Using Mana, the &2Terra Truncator&r will feel entire trees in one fell swoop.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.terraTruncator.translation: &2泰拉斷裂者&r能消耗魔力直接砍倒整棵樹。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.terrasteelArmor.original: Just like Manasteel armor, &aTerrasteel Armor&r can repair itself using Mana. It has the durability comparable to Diamond armor as well.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.terrasteelArmor.translation: &a泰拉鋼盔甲&r也能用魔力自我修復，並有著和鑽石盔甲相似的強度。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeManaSprea.original: To upgrade the &2Mana Spreader&r, you can attach &9Mana Lenses&r to the front of the Spreader. However, the most basic Mana Lens does nothing.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeManaSprea.translation: 要升級&2魔力發射器&r，你可以在發射器前方貼上&9魔力透鏡&r。但是基礎魔力透鏡沒有任何用處。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeManaSprea.original: You'll need to upgrade the Mana Lens to give it different effects on the bursts of Mana it sends out. Lenses can also be dyed by crafting it with any color, or with a Mana Pearl to create a Rainbow Lens.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeManaSprea.translation: 你需要升級魔力透鏡來給射出的魔力脈衝效果。透鏡也可以被任意染料染色，或是用個魔力珍珠做個彩虹透鏡。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeManaSprea.original: By combining a Mana Lens with specific runes and items, we can use them to upgrade our Spreaders. You can also combine 2 lenses together with a &aSlime Ball&r to create &9Composite Lenses&r, combining the powers to create even stronger effects.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeManaSprea.translation: 將魔力透鏡與特定符文或物品結合，我們可以使用它們來升級我們的發射器。您還可以將2個透鏡與 &a史萊姆球&r組合在一起來製作&9複合透鏡&r，結合各種力量來創造更強大的效果。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeSparks.1.original: With the new Elven materials, we're able to upgrade our sparks using &dAugments&r. With the Augment in hand, you can right click a spark with it to upgrade it. Using the wand, you can sneak-right click to remove it.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeSparks.1.translation: 由於我們剛獲得了這些精靈材料，我們現在能夠使用&d火花升級&r了。你可以手持它對著火花右鍵來讓火花升級。你也可以使用森林法杖來移除火花升級。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeSparks.2.original: Dispersive Augment: Allows a Spark to drain the Mana in its pool to charge nearby players' Mana-containing items.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeSparks.2.translation: 「火花升級：彌散」會使火花能夠抽出魔力池中的魔力，來幫附近玩家背包中能夠容納魔力的物品充能。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeSparks.3.original: Dominant Augment: Makes a Spark pull Mana from nearby non-augmented Sparks' pools into its own.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeSparks.3.translation: 「火花升級：聚集」會使此火花附屬的魔力池能夠從周遭未加裝升級的火花附屬的魔力池之中抽取魔力。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeSparks.4.original: Recessive Augment: Makes a Spark distribute all of the Mana in its pool into nearby non-augmented or Dispersive Sparks' pools.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeSparks.4.translation: 「火花升級：擴散」會使此火花附屬的魔力池能夠向周遭未加裝升級（或加裝了聚集升級）的火花附屬的魔力池之中發送魔力。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeSparks.5.original: Isolated Augment: Prevents a Spark from interacting with any Dominant or Recessive Sparks.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.upgradeSparks.5.translation: 「火花升級：隔絕」會使此火花附屬的魔力池從上述兩項升級的對象之中移除。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.usePureDaisy.original: Use a &bPure Daisy&r to convert Stone into Livingrock!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.usePureDaisy.translation: 使用&b白雛菊&r將石頭轉換為活石！

atm9.quest.botania.desc.usePureDaisyWood.original: Use a &bPure Daisy&r to convert Wooden Logs into Livingwood!
atm9.quest.botania.desc.usePureDaisyWood.translation: 使用&b白雛菊&r將原木轉換為活木！

atm9.quest.botania.desc.wandOfTheForestI.original: The &2Wand of the Forest&r is a must-have item if you want to continue your journey in Botania.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.wandOfTheForestI.translation: &2森林法杖&r是植物魔法必不可少的物品。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.wandOfTheForestI.original: The wand has two modes: &aBind&r and &9Function&r.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.wandOfTheForestI.translation: 這隻法杖有兩種模式：&a綁定&r和&9工作&r模式。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.wandOfTheForestI.original: &aBind mode&r is used to bind flowers and blocks together in Botania. Start by sneak-right clicking the first block or flower you want, then sneak-right click another block or flower to bind them together.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.wandOfTheForestI.translation: &a綁定模式&r用來綁定花朵和方塊。先蹲下右鍵你要綁定的方塊或花朵，然後再蹲下右鍵要綁定的另一個方塊或花朵，就可以將其綁定在一起。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.wandOfTheForestI.original: &9Function Mode&r essentially acts like a wrench, and is used to rotate blocks.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.wandOfTheForestI.translation: &9工作模式&r可以讓法杖變成扳手，用來旋轉方塊。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.waterSourceMana..original: These flowers generate Mana by consuming &bWater Source Blocks&r in a 3x3 area around it. These are very slow, and will eventually decay.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.waterSourceMana..translation: 這朵花透過消耗周遭3x3區域的&b水源方塊&r來產生魔力。它的速度非常慢，而且最後會自然凋謝。

atm9.quest.botania.desc.waterSourceMana..original: Below is an example of a basic setup.
atm9.quest.botania.desc.waterSourceMana..translation: 下方是個基礎設置的範例。

atm9.quest.botania.infuser.translation: 魔力灌注板的多方塊結構

atm9.quest.bounty.desc.board1.original: Here you'll find all of the rewards you can get by slaying enemies.
atm9.quest.bounty.desc.board1.translation: 在這裡你可以找到擊殺這些生物能獲得的獎勵。

atm9.quest.bounty.desc.board2.original: This page is a work in progress!

atm9.quest.bounty.desc.trader1.original: 'While making a lot of the questlines for the ATM7, the Trader Villager thought it'd be funny to constantly push me around in the quest screen.
atm9.quest.bounty.desc.trader1.translation: 「當我在製作 ATM7 的任務時，流浪商人認為當我在編輯任務的時候，一直把我推來推去很好玩。

atm9.quest.bounty.desc.trader2.original: Take them out. All of them.'

atm9.quest.bounty.elder.translation: 擊殺（被附身的）遠古深海守衛

atm9.quest.bounty.subt.chimera.original: This isn't even my final form.
atm9.quest.bounty.subt.chimera.translation: 這甚至不是我的最終型態。

atm9.quest.bounty.trader.original: Kill the Trader Villager and His Annoying Llamas
atm9.quest.bounty.trader.translation: 擊殺流浪商人與其擾人的商駝們

atm9.quest.create.desc.adjustableChainDr.original: The &n&5Adjustable Chain Drive&r works similar to the normal Chain Drive when it has no redstone signal.
atm9.quest.create.desc.adjustableChainDr.translation: &n&5可調式鍊式變速箱&r在未接受到紅石訊號時與鍊式傳動箱無異。

atm9.quest.create.desc.adjustableChainDr.original: When you apply a redstone signal and it is the block receiving the rotational force, it will double the speed for the connected Chain Drives.
atm9.quest.create.desc.adjustableChainDr.translation: 當你讓接收到動力源的可調式鍊式變速箱接受紅石訊號時，它會將轉速加倍傳遞給相連的鍊式傳動箱。

atm9.quest.create.desc.adjustableChainDr.original: When you apply a redstone signal and it is not the block receiving the rotational force, it will half the speed for the connected Chain Drives.
atm9.quest.create.desc.adjustableChainDr.translation: 當你讓未接收到動力源的可調式鍊式變速箱接受紅石訊號時，它會將轉速減半傳遞給相連的鍊式傳動箱。

atm9.quest.create.desc.arm.1.original: The &n&5Arm&r is a machine that can take items from a Depot or a Belt and place them into a different Depot, Belt or Crafter.
atm9.quest.create.desc.arm.1.translation: &n&5機械臂&r是一個能夠將置物台或輸送帶上的物品放到不同的置物台、輸送帶或機械合成器的機器。

atm9.quest.create.desc.arm.2.original: To select input/output hold the Arm in your hand and R-Click the blocks you want to assign.
atm9.quest.create.desc.arm.2.translation: 手持它並右鍵點擊你想要在它們之間傳輸物品的方塊來選擇它的輸入/出端。

atm9.quest.create.desc.arm.3.original: To deselect a block, L-Click it with the Arm in your hand.
atm9.quest.create.desc.arm.3.translation: 只要手持它並左鍵點擊就能取消方塊的選擇。

atm9.quest.create.desc.basin.original: The &n&5Basin&r is used for recipes, mainly including the &n&5Mechanical Press&r and the &n&5Mechanical Mixer&r.
atm9.quest.create.desc.basin.translation: &n&5作業盆&r是用來放置&n&5機械鍛壓機&r和&n&5機械攪拌器&r所需的合成材料的方塊。

atm9.quest.create.desc.belts.1.original: &n&5Belts&r can be placed between two &n&5Shafts&r to transfer mobs/items or to simply transfer rotational energy from one point to another.
atm9.quest.create.desc.belts.1.translation: &n&5輸送帶&r能夠被放置在兩個&n&5傳動軸&r之間，並用來傳輸生物、物品或是動力。

atm9.quest.create.desc.belts.2.original: The &n&5Shafts&r must be at either 45, 90 or 180 degrees from each other.
atm9.quest.create.desc.belts.2.translation: &n&5傳動軸&r之間的夾角必須保持在 45 、 90 或 180 度。

atm9.quest.create.desc.blazeBurnerFeatur.original: To get the &n&5Blaze Burner&r, you need to make an Empty Blaze Burner and R-Click it on a Blaze.
atm9.quest.create.desc.blazeBurnerFeatur.translation: 要得到&n&5烈焰使者動力爐&r的話，你需要製作一個空的烈焰使者動力爐，並手持它對著烈焰使者點擊右鍵。

atm9.quest.create.desc.blazeBurnerFeatur.original: This is used under a Basin to heat it or super-heat it for different recipes.
atm9.quest.create.desc.blazeBurnerFeatur.translation: 它能夠被放置在作業盆下方以加熱或超級加熱作業盆並製作不同的物品。

atm9.quest.create.desc.blazeCake.original: The &n&5Blaze Cake&r is used to Super-Heat the Blaze Burner for crafting the Chromatic Compound.
atm9.quest.create.desc.blazeCake.translation: &n&5烈焰蛋糕&r能夠用來使烈焰使者動力爐超級加熱以便製作出異彩化合物。

atm9.quest.create.desc.cannon.original: The Cannon will build the structures from Schematics, taking materials from nearby chests and using gunpowder as fuel.
atm9.quest.create.desc.cannon.translation: 藍圖加農砲會以火藥作為燃料並使用附近箱子內的材料來建造藍圖中的結構。

atm9.quest.create.desc.cartAssembler.1.original: The &n&5Cart Assembler&r can be placed on tracks. Anything you build on top of it will be picked up by a Minecart if the Assembler has a redstone signal.
atm9.quest.create.desc.cartAssembler.1.translation: &n&5礦車裝修站&r可以被放置在鐵軌上。當它接收到紅石訊號時蓋在上面的任何方塊都會被通過它的礦車載走。

atm9.quest.create.desc.cartAssembler.2.original: The blocks must be glued together and any blocks requiring rotational force will automatically be working.
atm9.quest.create.desc.cartAssembler.2.translation: 上方的方塊必須用強力膠黏在一起，並且所有需要動力的方塊會自動運作。

atm9.quest.create.desc.cartAssembler.3.original: To \"unmount\" the blocks from the Minecart, simply turn off the redstone signal and let the Minecart ride through.
atm9.quest.create.desc.cartAssembler.3.translation: 要讓這些方塊「下車」，只要讓礦車經過沒接受到紅石訊號的礦車裝修站即可。

atm9.quest.create.desc.casings.original: &n&5Casings&r are used as a crafting ingredient for most blocks.
atm9.quest.create.desc.casings.translation: &n&5機殼&r是模組內大多數方塊的合成原料。

atm9.quest.create.desc.chainDrive.original: The &n&5Chain Drive&r can be linked with others in any direction as long as they are touching. They will relay the rotation sideways.
atm9.quest.create.desc.chainDrive.translation: &n&5鍊式傳動箱&r能夠橫向傳輸動力。只要將它們的側邊接在一起，它們就能以任意方向相連。

atm9.quest.create.desc.chute.original: The &n&5Chute&r is used to insert/extract from inventories, or to place/take items from a belt.
atm9.quest.create.desc.chute.translation: &n&5滑槽&r能夠用來對儲物方塊或是輸送帶進行物品的輸入或輸出。

atm9.quest.create.desc.clutch.original: The &n&5Clutch&r will stop any rotation if a redstone signal is applied.
atm9.quest.create.desc.clutch.translation: &n&5離合器&r會在接受到紅石訊號時停下它所接收到的任何動力。

atm9.quest.create.desc.cogwheelFeatures..original: The &n&5Cogwheel&r transfers rotational power but also doubles or halves speed.
atm9.quest.create.desc.cogwheelFeatures..translation: &n&5齒輪&r可以用來傳輸動力，也能用來使轉速加倍或減半。

atm9.quest.create.desc.cogwheelFeatures..original: Doubling speed will also double the stress in the system.
atm9.quest.create.desc.cogwheelFeatures..translation: 當轉速加倍時系統的動能也會跟著加倍。

atm9.quest.create.desc.crafters.1.original: The &n&5Crafters&r can be connected to each other to form a huge in-world crafting table.
atm9.quest.create.desc.crafters.1.translation: &n&5機械合成器&r之間能夠互相連接並創造出一個大型的實體合成台。

atm9.quest.create.desc.crafters.2.original: The arrows on the Crafters must eventually converge on the same Crafter to finish the recipe. You can turn the arrows by R-Clicking it with the Wrench.
atm9.quest.create.desc.crafters.2.translation: 合成器上的箭頭最終必須聚集在同一個合成器上才能完成製作。你可以手持扳手對它點擊右鍵來改變箭頭的方向。

atm9.quest.create.desc.deployer.original: The &n&5Deployer&r can be used to either place items/blocks or to use items like Swords.
atm9.quest.create.desc.deployer.translation: &n&5機械手&r能夠用來放置物品、方塊或是使用像是劍之類的物品。

atm9.quest.create.desc.depot.original: The &n&5Depot&r is used to store items, mainly for the Spout.
atm9.quest.create.desc.depot.translation: &n&5置物台&r能夠用來儲存物品，主要是拿來搭配注液器使用。

atm9.quest.create.desc.drill.original: The &n&5Drill&r will break any block in front of it. If it has a connected inventory, the items will be stored in it.
atm9.quest.create.desc.drill.translation: &n&5機械鑽頭&r會破壞它面前的任何方塊。它會將收集到的物品自動存入連接到的儲物方塊之中。

atm9.quest.create.desc.encasedFan.original: The &n&5Encased Fan&r is used to pull/push items and entities if you spin it. The arrow will show you the direction it's facing and the rotation direction will determine if it pushes or pulls.
atm9.quest.create.desc.encasedFan.translation: &n&5鼓風機&r是一個能夠透過轉動來推/拉物品與實體的機器。它側邊的箭頭只會告訴你它面向的方向，它的運作方式（推或拉）是以它接收到的轉動方向來決定的。

atm9.quest.create.desc.fluidTank.original: The &n&5Fluid Tank&r is used to store liquids. A single tank stores 4 buckets. It can be connected to other tanks to form a bigger tank. However, it cannot be directly bucketed into or out of, so it must be done through automation.\n\nFor our small setup, we're gonna need 4 tanks to start.
atm9.quest.create.desc.fluidTank.translation: &n&5流體儲罐&r用於儲存液體。單一儲罐可以儲存 4 桶。它可以連接到其他儲罐以形成更大的儲存空間。然而，它不能直接用鐵桶裝入或取出液體，因此必須透過自動化來完成。\n\n對於我們的小型設置，一開始我們需要 4 個槽。

atm9.quest.create.desc.funnel.original: The &n&5Funnel&r can import or export items from connected inventories.
atm9.quest.create.desc.funnel.translation: &b&5漏斗&r可以對著連接的儲物方塊進行物品的輸入或輸出。

atm9.quest.create.desc.gantryCarriage.original: The &n&5Gantry Carriage&r can be attached to Gantry Shafts and if the Shaft is rotating, it will move the Carriage along it.
atm9.quest.create.desc.gantryCarriage.translation: &n&5橋式起重機&r可以連接在橋式起重機導軌上。當導軌轉動時，它會讓導軌上的起重機沿著它移動。

atm9.quest.create.desc.gearbox.original: The &n&5Gearbox&r can rotate the direction of the rotation in any direction by 90 degrees.
atm9.quest.create.desc.gearbox.translation: &n&5齒輪箱&r能夠將來自任何方向的動力轉動 90 度。

atm9.quest.create.desc.gearshift.original: The &n&5Gearshift&r will reverse the direction of rotation if a redstone signal is applied.
atm9.quest.create.desc.gearshift.translation: &n&5變速箱&r會在接受到紅石訊號時使旋轉方向反轉。

atm9.quest.create.desc.goggles.1.original: These goggles will allow you to see your contraptions in more detail.
atm9.quest.create.desc.goggles.1.translation: 藉由這副護目鏡，你能夠獲得各個裝置的詳細資訊。

atm9.quest.create.desc.goggles.2.original: It will show things as rotation speed and stress.
atm9.quest.create.desc.goggles.2.translation: 它會告訴你像是轉速或動能之類的資訊。

atm9.quest.create.desc.harvester.original: The &n&5Harvester&r will harvest any crops it goes over. If it has a connected inventory, the items will be stored in it.
atm9.quest.create.desc.harvester.translation: &n&5機械收割機&r會採收它經過的任何作物。它會將收集到的物品自動存入連接到的儲物方塊之中。

atm9.quest.create.desc.hosePulley.original: The &n&5Hose Pulley&r is a pump that can extract liquids or place liquids in the world.
atm9.quest.create.desc.hosePulley.translation: &n&5軟管滑輪&r是一個能夠在世界上抽取或放置流體的幫浦。

atm9.quest.create.desc.linearChassis.original: The &n&5Linear Chassis&r can be used similar to the &n&5Super Glue&r. It will connect blocks in a line without the need for glue.
atm9.quest.create.desc.linearChassis.translation: &n&5機殼底盤&r與&n&5強力膠&r的功能類似。它可以在不需要膠水的情況下將面向方向一直線上的所有方塊連接起來。

atm9.quest.create.desc.mainIngredient.original: This will be the main ingredient for most of this mod's items and blocks.
atm9.quest.create.desc.mainIngredient.translation: 這是該模組內的大部分物品和方塊的主要原材料。

atm9.quest.create.desc.mechanicalPiston.original: The &n&5Mechanical Piston&r is similar to the Piston, it can push blocks, but you can add as many Extension Poles as you wish.
atm9.quest.create.desc.mechanicalPiston.translation: &n&5機械活塞&r與活塞類似，它可以推動方塊，但你可以盡你所能地對它添加活塞桿。

atm9.quest.create.desc.mixer.original: The &n&5Mixer&r can be used combined with the Basin to craft.
atm9.quest.create.desc.mixer.translation: 將&n&5機械攪拌器&r與作業盆結合可以一些製作物品。

atm9.quest.create.desc.plough.original: The &n&5Plough&r will destroy any non-solid block, turn dirt into farmland and launch entities without doing damage. If it has a connected inventory, the items will be stored in it.
atm9.quest.create.desc.plough.translation: &n&5機械犁&r會破壞任何的非實體方塊、將泥土轉變為耕地以及在不傷害到實體的情況下推動牠們。它會將收集到的物品自動存入連接到的儲物方塊之中。

atm9.quest.create.desc.portableInterface.original: The &n&5Portable Interface&r works in pairs. You need to have one placed in the world and another one on a moving entity, like a Minecart.
atm9.quest.create.desc.portableInterface.translation: &n&5移動式物品介面&r是成對運作的。你需要將其中一個放在世界上，另一個則放在移動的實體（像是礦車）上。

atm9.quest.create.desc.portableInterface.original: When the two interfaces are facing each other, they will link and transfer items between each other.
atm9.quest.create.desc.portableInterface.translation: 當兩個介面面對面時，它們會連接在一起，並在它們之間傳輸物品。

atm9.quest.create.desc.portableInterface.original: The &n&5Portable Interface&r works in pairs. You need to have one placed in the world and another one on a moving entity, like a Minecart.
atm9.quest.create.desc.portableInterface.translation: &n&5移動式流體介面&r是成對運作的。你需要將其中一個放在世界上，另一個則放在移動的實體（像是礦車）上。

atm9.quest.create.desc.portableInterface.original: When the two interfaces are facing each other, they will link and transfer liquids between each other.
atm9.quest.create.desc.portableInterface.translation: 當兩個介面面對面時，它們會連接在一起，並在它們之間傳輸液體。

atm9.quest.create.desc.press.original: The &n&5Press&r can be used to create metal plates or blocks.
atm9.quest.create.desc.press.translation: &n&5機械鍛壓機&r可以用以生產金屬板或金屬方塊。

atm9.quest.create.desc.radialChassis.original: The &n&5Radial Chassis&r can be used similar to the &n&5Super Glue&r. It will connect blocks in a line, on the sides, without the need for glue.
atm9.quest.create.desc.radialChassis.translation: &n&5旋轉底盤&r與&n&5強力膠&r的功能類似。它可以在不需要膠水的情況下將側邊一直線上的所有方塊連接起來。

atm9.quest.create.desc.rollingMill.original: The &n&5Rolling Mill&r is a machine that can be used to create wires from plates and rods from ingots.
atm9.quest.create.desc.rollingMill.translation: &n&5輥軋機&r是一台能用板製作線，用錠製作桿的機器。

atm9.quest.create.desc.ropePulley.original: The &n&5Rope Pulley&r can move blocks up or down, they can be glued together.
atm9.quest.create.desc.ropePulley.translation: &n&5滑輪繩索&r可以垂直輸送方塊，可以將方塊黏在一起以一次輸送更多的方塊。

atm9.quest.create.desc.roseCrystals.1.original: You can create this by making Rose Crystals and Sand Paper.
atm9.quest.create.desc.roseCrystals.1.translation: 你可以合成一些玫瑰石英和砂紙來製作出這個物品。

atm9.quest.create.desc.roseCrystals.2.original: You can either hold the crystals in your off-hand, or throw them on the ground and then R-Click while holding Sand Paper.
atm9.quest.create.desc.roseCrystals.2.translation: 你可以把玫瑰石英放在副手，或是將它們丟在地板上，然後手持砂紙對著它們點擊右鍵。

atm9.quest.create.desc.saw.original: The &n&5Saw&r will harvest trees in front of it. It can also be used as a Sawmill. If it has a connected inventory, the items will be stored in it.
atm9.quest.create.desc.saw.translation: &n&5機械圓鋸機&r會砍下它面前的樹。它也能當作鋸木機來使用。它會將收集到的物品自動存入連接到的儲物方塊之中。

atm9.quest.create.desc.scalingup.original: Now that we have a small setup, we can scale up our system. We can add more steam engines, more tanks, and more blaze burners to increase our power output!\n\nThis is entirely optional but if you want to be able to have max rotation speed for every machine you can dream of, larger steam engines are a nice way to go! A single steam engine can only output 16,384SU, so if your assembly produces more than that, you'll need more engines to output the maximum!
atm9.quest.create.desc.scalingup.translation: 現在我們有了一個小型設置，我們可以擴大我們的系統。我們可以增加更多的蒸汽引擎、更多的流體儲罐和更多的烈焰使動力爐來提高我們的動力輸出！\n\n這完全是可選的，但如果你想讓每台你想像得到的機器都擁有最大的旋轉速度，更大的蒸汽引擎是一個不錯的選擇！單個蒸汽引擎只能輸出 16,384 SU，所以如果你的組件產生超過這個數值，你需要更多的引擎來輸出最大動力！

atm9.quest.create.desc.schematicTable.1.original: The Schematic Table will read and write structures to/from your schematics.
atm9.quest.create.desc.schematicTable.1.translation: 藍圖桌可以將世界上的結構寫入成藍圖檔案，或是從藍圖檔案中讀取內部的結構。

atm9.quest.create.desc.schematicTable.2.original: You can use it to copy buildings or to share them with others!
atm9.quest.create.desc.schematicTable.2.translation: 你可以用它來複製建築或是將它傳給其他人！

atm9.quest.create.desc.shafts.original: &n&5Shafts&r transfer rotational power without changing the speed of the gears.
atm9.quest.create.desc.shafts.translation: &n&5傳動軸&r可以在不改變齒輪轉速的情況下傳輸動力。

atm9.quest.create.desc.smartChute.original: The &n&5Smart Chute&r is the same as the Chute but with additional functionalities, such as stack size and filters.
atm9.quest.create.desc.smartChute.translation: &n&5智慧滑槽&r在滑槽的基礎之上增加了一些可調整項，像是物品堆疊數量和過濾器。

atm9.quest.create.desc.speedometer.original: The Speedometer will show you the speed of the currently connected gear.
atm9.quest.create.desc.speedometer.translation: 轉速計能夠告訴你它所連接到的元件的轉速。

atm9.quest.create.desc.spout.original: The &n&5Spout&r is used to fill items with liquid. It is best to use a Depot under it to hold the items.
atm9.quest.create.desc.spout.translation: &n&5注液器&r能夠用來將液體灌注進物品。最好在它下方使用置物台來放置要灌注的物品。

atm9.quest.create.desc.steamEngine.original:
The &n&5Steam Engine&r is a simple engine that can be used to generate Rotational Power. It attaches to a fluid tank which it then turns into a steam engine assembly. This assembly has several stats you can see with the engineer goggles.

&l&aHeat:&r In our case this is a &n&5Blaze Burner&r, but could even be as simple as lava or fire

&l&aWater:&r Any supply of water will work but the sink works well

&l&aSize:&r In our case, the size will only be 1 bar as 4 tanks is the smallest engine you can make.

Now if a shaft is attached to the steam engine, it will output rotational energy. The steam engine is the best source of rotation in Create and can be scaled up! What we made here is the 'passive' level, but engines can go all the way up to level 18!
atm9.quest.create.desc.steamEngine.translation:
&n&5蒸汽引擎&r是一個簡單的引擎，可以用來產生旋轉動力。它會附著在一個流體儲罐上，然後將其轉變為一個蒸汽引擎組件。你可以使用工程師護目鏡查看這個組件的幾個屬性。

&l&a熱量：&r在我們的例子中，使用&n&5烈焰使者動力爐&r，但甚至可以是像熔岩或火焰這種簡單的東西。

&l&a水量：&r任何水源都可以，但水槽效果很好。

&l&a尺寸：&r在我們的例子中，尺寸只有 1 格，因為 4 個流體儲罐是你所能製作的最小引擎。

現在，如果一個傳動桿連接到蒸汽引擎，它就會輸出旋轉能量。蒸汽引擎是動力機械模組中最好的旋轉動力來源，而且可以擴大規模！我們在這裡製作的是「被動」等級，但引擎可以一直升級到 18 級！

atm9.quest.create.desc.straw.original: The &n&5Straw&r is an item made from putting bamboo in the rolling mill. This item can be used on blaze burners to make them accept fluid inputs rather than item inputs. This allows you to pipe liquid fuel directly into the blaze burner. Check JEI for what liquids can be burned.
atm9.quest.create.desc.straw.translation: &n&5吸管&r是一個將竹子放入輥軋機中製成的物品。這個物品可以用在烈焰使者動力爐上，使其接受流體輸入而不是物品輸入。這使你能直接將流體燃料用管道輸送至烈焰使者動力爐。查看 JEI 以了解哪些流體可以燃燒。

atm9.quest.create.desc.stressometer.original: The Stressometer will show you how stressed the system is when you connect it.
atm9.quest.create.desc.stressometer.translation: 動力計能夠告訴你它所連接到的系統的動能。

atm9.quest.create.desc.superGlue.original: &n&5Super Glue&r can be used to attach blocks to each other to move them with pistons or other means.
atm9.quest.create.desc.superGlue.translation: &n&5強力膠&r可以用來將方塊連接在一起，並讓他們能夠同時被活塞或其他裝置移動。

atm9.quest.create.desc.tunnels.original: The &n&5Tunnels&r can be placed on belts and they will filter items that pass through them. You can link multiple tunnels by placing them next to each other.
atm9.quest.create.desc.tunnels.translation: &n&5物品隧道&r可以被放置在輸送帶上以用來過濾經過它們的物品。你可以透過將它們並排放置來連接它們。（譯者著：這些功能都是黃銅物品隧道專屬。）

atm9.quest.create.desc.waterWheelFeature.original: The &n&5Water Wheel&r is one of the most basic ways of generating rotational force. You can hook up multiple wheels by placing them next to each other.
atm9.quest.create.desc.waterWheelFeature.translation: &n&5水車&r是所有動力來源裡面最基礎的一種。你可以透過將多個水車並排放置來使它們串聯。

atm9.quest.create.desc.waterWheelFeature.original: You can also change the appearance by using different Wooden Logs on them!
atm9.quest.create.desc.waterWheelFeature.translation: 你也能對著它們使用各種木材來改變他們的外型！

atm9.quest.create.desc.weightedEjector.original: The &n&5Weighted Ejector&r can launch items or entities to a selected location.
atm9.quest.create.desc.weightedEjector.translation: &n&5彈射置物台&r可以將上方的物品或實體發射至指定的地點。

atm9.quest.create.desc.welcome.2.original: Create is an immersive tech mod, bringing realism into Minecraft on a whole new level!
atm9.quest.create.desc.welcome.2.translation: 動力機械是一個沉浸式的科技模組，將麥塊的真實感提升到一個全新的高度！

atm9.quest.create.desc.welcome.3.original: If you have doubts about any blocks or items, hold W to ponder and see an amazing 3D in-game wiki!
atm9.quest.create.desc.welcome.3.translation: 如果你對於模組內的任何方塊或物品有疑問，可以在物品欄內對著它們按住 W 鍵來查看他們的「3D 遊戲內 Wiki 介紹」。

atm9.quest.create.desc.windmill.original: Combine with &n&5Radial Chassis&r to create a very powerful windmill that has high stress capacity.
atm9.quest.create.desc.windmill.translation: 與&n&5旋轉底盤&r相結合可以創造一個具有高動能上限的強力風車。

atm9.quest.create.mainIngredient.original: This will be the main ingredient for most of this mod's items and blocks.
atm9.quest.create.mainIngredient.translation: 這是該模組內的大部分物品和方塊的主要原材料。

atm9.quest.creative.desc.welcome.original: If you make 9 Stars, or enough to make an ATM Star Block, you'll be able to create a &dStarry Bee&r. This bee gives you &6ATM Star Shards&r from their combs.\n\nOh, and they will also need another ATM Star Block for their flower! Simple enough, right?
atm9.quest.creative.desc.welcome.translation: 當你製作出了 9 顆「ATM 之星」之後，你能夠將它們合併為「ATM 之星方塊」來製造出&d繁星蜂&r。你能夠從牠們的蜂巢提煉出「&6ATM 之星碎片&r」！\n\n喔對了，牠們還會需要另一顆「ATM 之星方塊」來採集花粉！雖然我不是數學家，但這聽起來不錯，對吧？

atm9.quest.creative.img.star.original: What do I do with the ATM Star?

atm9.quest.creative.subt.welcome.original: Enough to make everything in the pack?
atm9.quest.creative.subt.welcome.translation: 能夠製造出模組包中的所有物品了？

atm9.quest.draconic.WLSCaM.translation: &9雙足飛龍大型護盾容量模組&r

atm9.quest.draconic.WPGrCM.translation: &9雙足飛龍投射物重力補償模組&r

atm9.quest.draconic.binder.original: What is Energy or as we call it, OP?
atm9.quest.draconic.binder.translation: 什麼是能量，又或者說是 OP？

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.1.original: Tier 1 only needs the Core and 4 Stabilizers to be made.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.1.translation: 等級 1 的能量核心：只需要 1 個能量核心和 4 個穩定器來搭建。
