atm9.quest.draconic.desc.2.original: Tier 2 needs 6 Draconium Ingot Blocks, 1 on each side of the Core. Then, obviously the 4 Stabilizers to be made.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.2.translation: 等級 2 的能量核心：需要在能量核心的每個面都加上 1 個龍金屬方塊（總共 6 個）。當然還要再加上 4 個穩定器來搭建。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.3.original: Tier 3 needs 26 Draconium Ingot Blocks around it, fully encasing the Core, to be made.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.3.translation: 等級 3 的能量核心：用 26 個龍金屬方塊將能量核心圍成一個 3x3x3 的立方體來搭建。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.4.original: Tier 4 is different. First, it needs 26 Redstone Blocks encasing the Core. Then above the Redstone it needs 56 Draconium Ingot Blocks.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.4.translation: 等級 4 的能量核心：此等級開始有點變化了，首先用 26 個紅石方塊來取代上個等級的那 26 個龍金屬方塊。然後放置 54 個龍金屬方塊來將這些紅石方塊完全覆蓋住。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.5.original: Tier 5 needs 90 Draconium Ingot Blocks and 80 Redstone Blocks, along with 4 Advanced Stabilizers or 36 Stabilizers.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.5.translation: 等級 5 的能量核心：需要 90 個龍金屬方塊、80 個紅石方塊和 4 個進階穩定器（36 個穩定器）來搭建。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.6.original: Tier 6 needs 150 Draconium Ingot Blocks and 178 Redstone Blocks (Don't forget 36 Stabilizers).
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.6.translation: 等級 6 的能量核心：需要 150 個龍金屬方塊和 178 個紅石方塊來搭建（別忘了你的那 36 個穩定器）。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.7.original: Almost there! Tier 7. 210 Draconium Ingots and 328 Redstone Blocks!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.7.translation: 就快到盡頭了！等級 7 的能量核心：需要 210 個龍金屬方塊和 328 個紅石方塊來搭建。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.8.original: Last and the best one Tier 8! You'll need 378 Awakened Draconium Blocks and 786 Draconium Ingot Blocks! Is it worth it?
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.8.translation: 最後也是最棒的一個！等級 8 的能量核心：需要 378 個覺醒龍金屬方塊和 786 個龍金屬方塊來搭建！這樣做真的值得嗎？

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.AAM.original: Water is a little viscous, or at least more dense than air. Because of that, mining underwater is slower. You can use the Enchantment of Aqua Affinity, or use this Module. Your choice!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.AAM.translation:
水的密度比空氣還高。因此，在水下挖掘方塊會比平常還慢。

你可以使用親水性附魔或是適應水生模組來解決這個問題。

選擇適合自己的方式！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.AFiM.original: Most Bows are Semi-Automatic. You have to draw the string, release, and put another Arrow in the bow, and repeat. Instead skip all that let the Bow automatically fire everytime it's fully drawn. Just hold Right Click and watch it go!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.AFiM.translation:
大多數的弓都是半自動的：你會需要重複地把箭矢放到弦上→拉弦→然後鬆開。

安裝了自動開火模組後你的弓就能在它拉滿時自動射出箭矢。

現在只要按住右鍵然後看著它們飛出去就好了！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BAFeM.original: Auto-Feed will automatically feed you any food in your inventory when hungry. It has a max Food Point storage though, each full bar is 2 Food Points. So the Basic one can only hold 8 Steaks worth.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BAFeM.translation: 自動餵食模組能夠預先將食物存在它裡面，並在之後自動為你補充飢餓值。\n\n它有一個飢餓值儲存上限，在計算儲存的數量時，會將飽食度（那些黃色的飢餓值）和飢餓值都算進去。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BAOEM.original: Area of Effect is a phrase most Gamers would know. Basically it upgrades the working area of the Tool it's on. Pickaxes with 3x3 AOE will mine in a 3x3 area. Swords with 3x3 AOE will kill all mobs hit within that area. The better the upgrade the bigger the area. No, it's not stackable!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BAOEM.translation:
大多數的遊戲玩家應該都知道甚麼是 AOE 。

AOE 模組基本上就是用來增加工具的作用範圍的：
安裝了 3x3 AOE 模組的鎬能夠一次挖下 3x3 範圍的方塊。
安裝了 3x3 AOE 模組的劍能夠一次攻擊到該區域內的所有生物。

AOE 模組的等級越高，它所提供的範圍就越廣。

此升級模組是無法疊加的。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BCore.original: Draconium Cores are a vital ingredient in many recipes in &5Draconic Evolution&r. Especially for Basic Tier items.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BCore.translation: 龍族核心是《&5龍族進化&r》模組中，許多配方的重要材料，尤其是基礎等級的物品。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BCrystal.original: Basic (Energy Relay) Crystal is the start to moving energy with &5Draconic Evolution&r!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BCrystal.translation: 基礎（能量中繼）水晶是《&5龍族進化&r》模組中的輸送能量的方法！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BDM.original: Pretty simple premise, Axes and Swords can do more Damage. Yes, it stacks!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BDM.translation: 傷害模組的功能非常的簡單：讓劍和斧能夠造成更多的傷害。\n\n沒錯，它可以疊加！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BEnM.original: Energy Modules are the most important Modules and are needed for using DE items. The amount in them determines how much OP an item can hold and take in, check out the Energy Infuser to learn more about charging. The later the Tier of Energy Module the more OP items can hold and use. This is important as when items are upgraded they use more OP per use.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BEnM.translation: 能量模組是最重要的一種升級模組，《龍族進化》模組的一系列道具至少都必須安裝一個才能運作。\n\n安裝的數量和階級決定了該道具能夠容納多少 OP ，查看「將 OP 存入物品」任務來了解該如何幫這些道具充能。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BJuM.translation: 事實上就只是跳躍提升。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BSpM.original: Speed Modules are fun, they work in just about everything and make them faster! Swords swing faster, Pickaxes mine faster, Axes chop faster, Bows shoot faster, and Chestplate makes you faster. The better the Speed Module the faster they go! (BTW good time to mention most stats stack up. 2 Basic Speed Modules increase Speed by 20%% then!)
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.BSpM.translation:
速度模組是個很有趣的升級模組，它們幾乎能夠被安裝在任何道具之中，並使這些道具的使用速度更快！

安裝在劍上能夠讓你揮得更快、安裝在斧上能夠讓你砍得更快、安裝在弓上能夠讓你射得更快，而安裝在護胸上能夠讓你走得更快！

它們之間的數值能夠疊加。舉例來說：安裝 2 個速度模組就能將速度增加 20%% ！

安裝更高等級的速度模組也能提供更多的速度加成！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CAxe.original: This is what it comes down to: do you like to hit your enemies like a truck but at the cost of slow attack speed? Or would you rather be a normal person who uses a Sword?
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CAxe.translation: 說到底，你會希望像個卡車一樣攻擊敵人但是攻擊速度比較慢？還是你會像個正常人一樣用劍來攻擊敵人。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CBow.original: Best Bow from &5Draconic Evolution&r, also with more Module slots!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CBow.translation: 《&5龍族進化&r》模組中最好的弓，有更多的升級模組插槽！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CCapacitor.translation: 《&5龍族進化&r》模組中最好的能量電池。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CCore.original: This will be needed for the last Tier, &5Chaotic Tier&r. Hopefully you followed the branch of quests that explain how to get &5Chaos Shards&r!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CCore.translation: 你會需要混沌核心來達到最後一個等級：&5混沌&r。你可以去跟著左上角的一連串任務來獲得&5混沌碎片&r！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CHoe.original: A &5Chaotic Hoe&r, for the most intense farming needs.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CHoe.translation: &5混沌鋤&r，為了更高度密集的種田需求而存在。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CPick.original: All Pickaxes mine at the same Mining Tier so the only need to upgrade is to be faster and get the Staffs.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CPick.translation: 所有鎬的挖掘等級都相同，所以升級它的用途只有讓它的挖掘速度更快或是製作神龍權杖。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CStaff.original: The best Sword plus the fastest Pickaxe plus the Shovel?! What more could you want?
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CStaff.translation: 最好的劍 + 最快的鎬 + 鏟？！？！你不能再奢求更多了！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CSword.original: It's like the Netherite Sword but much better and much cooler!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.CSword.translation: 類似於一把更強、更酷的獄髓劍！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.DChest.original: One of the two Basic Tier Infusions, Don't underestimate the Draconic Chest! It holds more space than a double chest, it can smelt and craft items, and best of all it can change colors! Easily my favorite chest in any mod!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.DChest.translation:
只需要龍族聚合注入器就能製造的兩種物品之一：龍族儲物箱。

請不要因為它的注入等級就小看它：它的儲物空間遠多於一般的儲物箱、它能夠熔煉或合成物品，而且還能夠換顏色！

這是我在所有模組之中最喜歡的儲物箱！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.DChestplate.translation: 加強版的&9雙足飛龍護胸&r。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.DCore.original: I know it's &9Wyvern Tier&r so why is a &6Draconic&r item in here? In order to get to &6Draconic Tier&r you need &6Draconic Injectors&r. To get &6Draconic Injectors&r you'll need &6Draconic Cores&r. See why they are here now?
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.DCore.translation:
我知道這區任務是&9雙足飛龍等級&r，但為甚麼會有&6神龍&r等級的物品在這？

你需要&6神龍聚合注入器&r才能到達&6神龍等級&r。但你會需要先製作出&6神龍核心&r才能做出&6神龍聚合注入器&r。

你現在知道為什麼要將神龍核心放在這了嗎？

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.DCrystal.original: These can move more Energy and have more links. The highest level Energy Crystals go.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.DCrystal.translation: 能夠容納更多能量並能夠製造更多連結。最高等級的能量水晶。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.DFlM.original: Okay now this ones give both Gliding and actual Flying, Creative Flight to be more exact.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.DFlM.translation: 這個飛行模組能夠讓你同時獲得（鞘翅）滑翔和（創造）飛行的能力。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.DHoe.original: An upgraded hoe, so would just be a fine and nice lady?
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.DHoe.translation: 一把可升級的鋤頭，真像是位完美的好女人？

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.DStaff.original: You know the legendary Paxel? A combination of Picks, Axes, and Shovels? This is similar, being a combination of Swords, Pickaxes, and Shovels! It does everything the Draconic Tools do!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.DStaff.translation: 你知道那些由鎬、斧和鏟結合而成的超實用鎬尖斧嗎？力量權杖的作用和它們類似，不過力量權杖是由使用劍、鎬和鏟來合成的！它能夠當作所有的雙足飛龍工具來使用！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.ECoM.original: Items gotten from the Tool this is on will go to your Ender Chest. The Minecraft one not modded one.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.ECoM.translation: 終界收集模組會將被你的工具挖下的方塊自動送到你的終界箱之中。（原版的那個終界箱，不是模組裡的。）

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.FECoM.original: Same deal but with options of filtering.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.FECoM.translation: 與前一等級的作用相同，但附帶一個過濾器。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.HSM.original: Basically it turns auto-jump on. Personally I like it, but it's up to you if you want to use it!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.HSM.translation: 有點類似於不用真的跳起來的自動跳躍。\n\n我個人滿喜歡裝爬坡模組的，但你可以自己決定要不要使用它！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.IO.original: The IO Crystals work as blocks that can connect to each other and move power from one another. To link them Shift Right Click with a Crystal Binder to set one and then right click whichever Crystal you want connected. When you look at the Crystal it will say either Input from block or Output to block. Input is the one you want to take OP from and Output to where you want it to go.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.IO.translation:
能量 I/O 水晶是一個能夠將能量從一個方塊運輸到另一個方塊之中的裝置。

要將方塊綁定到水晶上的話，你只需要在手持水晶綁定工具時潛行 + 右鍵點擊該方塊，並右鍵點擊你想要連接到的水晶。

當你看向水晶時，你會看到水晶上寫著：「從方塊提取能量」或是「向方塊輸出能量」。

前者代表你會從你綁定的方塊之中輸入能量，而後者則代表你會向你綁定的方塊輸出能量。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.MSM.original: When 'falling' your Mining is slowed down. That includes when creative flying or even bouncing in water. Thankfully you can use Air Affinty Enchantment to negate that! Not a vanilla Enchantment but still helpful! Oh wait I was supposed to talk about the Module... same thing!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.MSM.translation:
當你正在墜落時（創造飛行或是水中），你的挖掘速度會下降。

謝天謝地，在這模組包中有著空中速掘附魔能夠幫我們解決這個問題！

喔不對，我剛剛本來是想講挖掘穩定器模組的...算了都一樣！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.NVM.original: Unless you're a little cheater who uses Night Vision Texture Packs, you might find the dark a little worry some. Thankfully Night Vision Module in a DE Chestplate helps get over the fear of not being able to see in the dark. Not the fear of what's in the dark though...
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.NVM.translation: 除非你是一個使用夜視資源包的小作弊者，否則你可能會發現黑暗有些令人擔心。值得慶幸的是！DE 胸甲里的夜視組件可以幫助你克服在黑暗中無法看見東西的恐懼。但不是對黑暗中的東西的恐懼...

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.PICaM.original: Thanks to Newton we know for every action there is an equal and opposite reaction. Basically when an Arrow hits a mob the force of the Mob applies to the Arrow which will slow it down. Unless you have this Module. It doesn't act as if every mob was paper, it acts as if every mob isn't in the way. Arrows won't slow down after Piercing a target.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.PICaM.translation: 根據《牛頓第三運動定律》，我們能夠知道兩個物體進行交互作用時會產生一道反作用力。簡單來說就是當箭矢碰到某些生物之前，牠會強行讓箭矢的速度減慢。\n\n但當我們使用了投射物抗順移模組後，它會將這些生物當作不存在。這讓箭矢不會再在擊中目標之前/後被減速了。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.QEnT.original: The better the Energy Link or Tunnel obviously the more OP it can transfer, but also you might have noticed sonething missing with the Energy Link. It doesn't work between Dimensions! Thankfully the better ones can, just make sure the other side is chunkloaded.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.QEnT.translation: 更好的能量連結，照理來說應該要能夠傳輸更多的 OP 對吧，但不知道你有沒有注意到能量連結的一項缺點。它無法將能量傳輸到不同的維度！\n\n謝天謝地，升級過後的能量連結能夠改善這一情況，只要確保能量核心所在的區塊有被強制載入即可。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.RCore.original: The Reactor Core is the most important part of the Reactor, IE the Core! Place it 5 blocks or more from the Injector and Stabilizers, and you can right click it to see it's GUI here you'll find a few bars, a ball, buttons, and slots. The Bars go from left to right: Heat, Containment Field, Energy Saturation, and Fuel Conversion. You already learned about the Field and Energy and you will learn about the Fuel in a next quest. So the Heat is pretty important as when warming up it will raise to 2000C before being ready to activate. Make sure it doesn't get too high or else... meltdown! The Ball is the image of your Core, right now I have a bug where the Core doesn't have a texture so I can't explain much. The Buttons change the appearance of GUI, to activate or shutdown the Reactor, and charge it.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.RCore.translation: 反應爐核心是整個反應爐之中最重要的部分，意思就是核心！要放置在距離反應堆穩定器及反應堆能量注入器至少五個或以上方塊的距離，你可以右鍵點擊核心來看它的GUI，你可以在裡面一些長條圖、一顆球、按鈕及插槽。長條圖由左至右依序為：熱量、遏止場、能量飽和度及燃料轉換率。你已經學習過遏止場及能量，現在你將在接下來的任務中瞭解燃料。熱量非常重要，因為它在準備激活之前的預熱時升至 2000 ℃。請確保讓溫度不要升到太高，否則...熔毀！球狀圖是你核心的圖像，現在有一個核心圖片沒有紋理的錯誤，所以我沒辦法解釋太多。按鈕可以改變GUI的外觀、開機或關閉反應爐以及為其充電。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.RStabilizer.original: Stabilizers are what form the Containment Field (Force Shield around the Reactor Core). Once Containment Shield is down to 0 while Reactor is turned on it will begin a Meltdown. All 4 Stabilizers need to be a few blocks away (5 or more) from the Core and need to be around same Axis as the Core to work. These are also where you will pipe out OP from the Reactor, just not too mcuh!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.RStabilizer.translation:
反應爐穩定器是用來維持控制場強度（反應爐核心周圍的能量盾）的。

如果控制場強度在反應爐開機之後掉到 0 的話，反應爐就會開始熔毀。

所有的 4 個穩定器都必須要距離核心 5 格以上，並且一定要讓它們繞著核心的其中一個方向（x、y、z）放一圈。

反應爐穩定器也是你用來將反應爐的電力輸出的裝置，要注意不要一次輸出太多！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.SInM.original: Filtering isn't enough?!?! You want the items destroyed?!?! You monster!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.SInM.translation: 能夠過濾還不夠？！？！你居然想要丟掉這些物品？！？！你這個禽獸！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WAxe.original: Check out the Modules to learn more on how to use and upgrade the DE items! The &9Wyvern Axe&r is similar to vanilla axes after Combat Updates. They can serve as a weapon to slay foes, or a tool to chop down trees.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WAxe.translation: 查看右邊那些升級模組來學習如何利用它們來升級你的《龍族進化》系列道具！\n\n&9雙足飛龍斧&r和自原版 1.9 版本以來的斧頭相同。你可以將它當作一把用來屠殺敵人的重型武器，也能夠當作一把用來砍樹的工具。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WBow.original: Check out the Modules to learn more on how to use and upgrade the DE items! Works as a normal Bow does by shooting arrows. Each shot takes an amount of energy from the Bow itself, so yes you'll need Energy Modules at least.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WBow.translation: 查看右邊那些升級模組來學習如何利用它們來升級你的《龍族進化》系列道具！\n\n雙足飛龍弓能夠像一般的弓那樣射出箭矢。但每射出一隻箭矢就需要花費一些能量，所以你首先要幫它安裝一個能量模組。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WCapacitor.original: The Capacitors act as the batteries for &5Draconic Evolution&r. They need Energy Modules to actually hold energy and remember, 'The more the merrier!'.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WCapacitor.translation: 《&5龍族進化&r》模組中的電池稱作電容。它們需要裝上能量模組才能開始儲存能量，越多越好！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WChestplate.original: Draconic Evolution doesn't see the need for covering the whole body in pathetic armor when you can use a single Chestplate with built-in shields. Wait, they aren't built-in, you need Modules for them... sorry.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WChestplate.translation: 《龍族進化》模組認為：當你可以單獨裝備一件內建護盾的胸甲時，你就不需要透過裝備整套盔甲來佔用你的裝備欄。等等，護盾不是內建的，抱歉...你需要裝上那些升級模組。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WCrystal.original: &9Wyvern&r (Energy Relay) Crystal. Does exact same as the Basic Crystal just more Energy and more Links.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WCrystal.translation: &9雙足飛龍&r（能量中繼）水晶。和基礎水晶大致相同，但能夠容納更多能量並能夠製造更多連結。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WEnL.original: Wireless Energy Links help to make it so Wireless Crystals can charge your items. The more modules, the more OP it can take it and at a better rate.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WEnL.translation: 安裝無限能量連結能夠讓能量核心自動對你的道具進行無線充能。\n\n安裝更多此升級模組能夠提升充能的速率。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WFlM.original: With this on your Chestplate you can glide as if you were using an Elytra, but without sacrificing armor. I don't like to call it flying, rather 'falling with style'.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WFlM.translation: 將飛行模組安裝在你的護胸上你就能夠滑翔了！就像你以前使用鞘翅（但你就沒有辦法穿戴胸甲）那樣。\n\n我不喜歡講：「使用鞘翅『飛行』」，它比較像是「優雅地墜落」。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WHoe.original: Check out the Modules to learn more on how to use and upgrade the DE items! It can make farmland or take your money. Oh wait Minecraft Hoe sorry I was thinking of a different one.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WHoe.translation: 查看模組去瞭解有關如何使用和升級《龍族進化》的道具！它可以用來耕地或拿走你的錢。喔！等等，《 Minecraft 》原版鋤頭，真抱歉！我正在想著的是另一款。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WLSCaM.original: Same as the previous quest, just more, a lot more.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WLSCaM.translation: 大型護盾容量模組的功能和上個模組相同，只是容量更多、更多。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WPAcM.original: With something so primitive as a Bow you can't expect perfect Accuracy. Well you can if you use these Modules. The Arrow is much more likely to hit its target and not go off course.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WPAcM.translation: 對於弓這種原始武器，你並不能指望它的精確度。\n\n但你可以安裝一些投射物精度模組，來讓你的箭矢能夠更容易地擊中目標，而不會射偏。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WPDaM.original: These Modules are only for the DE Bows, unlike the previous ones. The Projectile Damage Module increases the damage of Arrows shot by the Bow. Some Modules happen to have negative effects with it, like these give a slight more Inaccuracy to Bows. All of these can stack!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WPDaM.translation:
與上面那些升級模組不同，接下來的 8 種升級模組只能裝給《龍族進化》的弓。

有些升級模組會讓弓獲得負面效果，像是讓它射出的箭矢的精準度更低。

投射物傷害模組會增加從弓射出的箭矢的傷害。

這些升級模組都能夠疊加！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WPGrCM.original: What is up with DE defying physics? Gravity pulls the Arrow down over the time it's shot. Gravity Compensation makes us worry less about that.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WPGrCM.translation: 物理學與龍族進化和背叛他們的東西是怎麼一回事？當射箭的過程中，重力會將箭矢往下拉。重力補償使我們不需要擔心這件事。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WPPeM.original: If you haven't played Minecraft since 1.13 this might confuse you, but you know Crossbows and Piercing. They have an enchantment which allows their Arrows to go through multiple targets and continuously dealing damage. This Module does exactly that!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WPPeM.translation:
如果你自 1.13 版本之後就沒有玩過麥塊的話，這個升級模組可能會讓你感到有點疑惑。

你應該知道麥塊中有弩，它有一種附魔叫做貫穿，這會讓它所射出的箭矢能夠穿透目標並也對後面的生物造成傷害。

投射物穿透模組和貫穿附魔的作用相同！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WPVeM.original: Velocity is the speed of an item at a certain direction. Since our Arrow aren't from Guardians of the Galaxy it basically just means the Speed of an Arrow. With each upgrade it takes less time from the Arrow to go from your Bow to your Target. Comes at a cost of a little inaccuracy.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WPVeM.translation: 投射物速度模組會讓你的箭矢能夠更快的到達目標處。但代價是會增加一點點的不精確度。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WPick.original: Check out the Modules to learn more on how to use and upgrade the DE items! Pickaxes work as a normal Tier 6 Pickaxe. They can mine every level of block, from Stone to Unobtainium. Items mined will automatically go to your inventory.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WPick.translation: 查看右邊那些升級模組來學習如何利用它們來升級你的《龍族進化》系列道具！\n\n雙足飛龍鎬和挖掘等級：6 的那些鎬相同。它可以挖下所有方塊（從石頭一路到難得素方塊）。被它挖下的方塊會自動送到你的物品欄之中。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WSCaM.original: Chestplates work similar to the Meka-Suit. Any damage that would be dealt to you is negated and instead taken off your Shield. Shield capacity is how much Shield you can hold, recharge rate is how fast it fills up, and OP will be used when recharging.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WSCaM.translation:
《龍族進化》中的護胸能夠以類似於《通用機械》中的 MekaSuit 的方式運作：你接收到的所有傷害會被吸收，並轉為由你的護盾來承受。

護盾容量代表你能夠吸收掉多少點傷害，而護盾充能代表它每秒會恢復多少護盾量。

恢復護盾需要消耗 OP 。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WSCoM.original: Shield Control changes the actual Shielf you have and when it regenerates.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WSCoM.translation: 護盾控制模組可以讓你的護胸獲得一道護盾，並決定了你需要停止受到傷害幾秒之後，護盾才會開始恢復。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WSReM.original: Want your Shield to come back and not just when you almost die? Then, you'll need Recovery Modules. The more Modules the faster it recovers.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WSReM.translation: 想要你的護盾不是在你幾乎快要死的時候才回來嗎？那麼，你將需要恢復組件，組件越多、恢復越快。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WShovel.original: Check out the Modules to learn more on how to use and upgrade the DE items! I know what you really care about, fellow player: the Wyvern Shovel. You don't need to spend any more sleepless nights wondering, because now you know: the DE Shovels can make pathways.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WShovel.translation: 查看右邊那些升級模組來學習如何利用它們來升級你的《龍族進化》系列道具！\n\n我知道你們這些玩家非常關心雙足飛龍鏟。你現在不用再因為《龍族進化》模組中的鏟無法製造土徑而輾轉難眠了！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WSword.original: Check out the Modules to learn more on how to use and upgrade the DE items! Swing it and hit something with it. It's a sword. What more is there to say?
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WSword.translation: 查看右邊那些升級模組來學習如何利用它們來升級你的《龍族進化》系列道具！\n\n揮動雙足飛龍劍來攻擊其他生物。喔拜託，它就只是一把劍，我還能怎麼介紹它。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WTrH.original: All Trees attached to whats chopped down, comes with it.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WTrH.translation: 伐木模組能夠讓與被你砍下的原木相連的所有其他原木一起被砍下。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WUnM.original: Undying acts as the thing that makes it, the Recovery Totem! When your hearts are down to 0 instead of dying the Module will activate, giving you Absorption and Regeneration, saving your life. It has a Cooldown and needs to use OP to power up again. Try not to die during that time! Better upgrades means less cooldowns.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.WUnM.translation:
不死模組的功能就與用來製作它的物品：「不死圖騰」相同！

當你的生命值降至 0 時，不死模組會讓你免除此次死亡，並給予你吸收和回復效果。

它需要經過一個冷卻時間和消耗一些 OP 來恢復作用。記住不要在冷卻時再次死亡！

將不死模組的等級提高能夠降低它的冷卻時間。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.awake.original: &6Awakened Draconium&r comes from Fusion Crafting the blocks. The blocks can be uncrafted into 9 Ingots. These are the second most important Ingots in &5Draconic Evolution&r and very necessary for the &9Wyvern&r and &6Draconic&r Tiers.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.awake.translation: &6覺醒龍金屬&r能夠透過聚合注入龍金屬方塊來獲得。你可以將覺醒龍金屬方塊分解為 9 個覺醒龍金屬錠。\n\n覺醒龍金屬錠是《&5龍族進化&r》模組中的第二種重要金屬錠，你會需要利用它們來合成&9雙足飛龍&r和&6神龍&r等級的物品。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.basic.original: Fusion Crafting has Tiers which is determined by the Injectors. The Tiers go in ascending order: Draconium (I refer to it as Basic to help differentiate), &9Wyvern&r, &6Draconic&r, and &5Chaotic&r. The Injectors need to be placed on the Left and Right of the Fusion Crafting Core, a few blocks away from it. They can be placed in a cross shape at a max of 5 on each side of the Crafting Core. To give them Energy putting Relay IO Crystals connected to them will work, check out Crystak Binding to learn more.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.basic.translation:
聚合注入的等級是由聚合注入器來決定的。

等級由低到高分別是：&9龍族&r（我將它稱作「基礎」來對應上某些物品）、&9雙足飛龍&r、&6神龍&r以及&5混沌&r。

你需要將它們放在至少距離聚合核心 3 格方塊遠的地方，每一面最多放置 9 個（3x3）。

你需要透過能量 I/O 水晶來為它們輸入電力，查看「傳輸 OP」任務來獲得相關資訊。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.binder.original: Operational Potential is the Energy source of &5Draconic Evolution&r. The main way (not the only way) of moving OP is with IO Relay Crystals. To actually get OP into items you'll need an Energy Transfer.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.binder.translation:
OP（Operational Potentional）是《&5龍族進化&r》模組中的能量計量單位（1 FE = 1 OP）。

用來傳輸 OP 的主要的（不是唯一的）方式是能量 I/O 水晶。

而要將 OP 存入物品的話則會需要用到能量注入器。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.chaotic.original: End of the road for Crafting Infusions, &5Chaotic Tier&r. Everything can be created once you are here. Not just the Tools but also everything you'll need for the Reactor.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.chaotic.translation:
聚合注入的終點：&5混沌等級&r。

到達這個階級之後你就能聚合注入出任何物品了。

除了那些工具之外，你也能夠開始合成神龍反應爐的所需元件了。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.core.original: The Energy Core is one, if not the, greatest Energy bank in all of Minecraft. And it all starts with the Core. This is the middle and heart of the Energy Core Multiblock (make sure it's a bit off the ground). When you place it down you can see it's GUI with the: Build Guide, Tier Down, Tier Up, and Assemble Core. The Tiers determine how big and powerful the Core is. The Build Guide shows you how to assemble this Tier of Core. If you have all the blocks necessary you can press Assemble Core and it will automatically make it!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.core.translation:
能量核心一定算得上是全 Minecraft 中最大的電容庫之一。

它從能量核心方塊：「能量核心多方塊結構的正中心（請將它放離地面一段距離）」開始。

當你將它放置出來時，你就能夠對它點擊右鍵來查看它的介面，內有：建築指南、降低等級、提升等級和組裝核心。

等級代表了能量核心的尺寸和容量。

而「建築指南」會告訴你要如何組裝所選定等級的能量核心。

如果你身上有建造該等級的能量核心所需的所有方塊的話，你也可以點擊「組裝核心」來讓它幫你自動搭建出能量核心！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.destroy.original: The first stage of the fight involves breaking the &cCrystals&r that hold the &cChaos Guardians&r Shield. You can't hurt him until they are destroyed. Destroying these &cCrystals&r is no easy task without a Draconic weapon. &cChaos Guardian&r fireballs can weaken this shield, allowing you to destroy it. (Yes, he will need to shoot at you, hitting the &cCrystals&r). You'll notice particles being produced when it's vulnerable to damage, and when hit it will make a noise. The closer to destruction, the deeper the noise and dimmer the &cCrystal&r will get. Once they are destroyed you can finally damage him!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.destroy.translation:
與&c混沌守衛&r戰鬥的第一階段會需要破壞能夠讓他恢復護盾的&c混沌水晶&r。在它們被破壞之前你很難對他造成有效傷害。

（在沒有神龍武器的情況下摧毀這些&c混沌水晶&r不是一件簡單的事。）

&c混沌守衛&r的火球可以讓附加在&c混沌水晶&r上的無敵護盾失效（對，你需要站在&c水晶&r附近來吸引他的砲火），讓你可以順利破壞它。

當它進入可破壞的狀態時，你會在它的附近觀察到一些粒子效果，並且在你破壞它時會產生出不同的音效。當&c水晶&r的血量越低，音效就越低沉，它也會越暗。

當你將全部的&c混沌水晶&r都破壞掉之後，你就開始可以對&c混沌守衛&r造成有效傷害了！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.draconic.original: This is what &6Draconic Cores&r are for.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.draconic.translation: 這就是&6神龍核心&r的用途。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.dust.original: Sieving Crushed Endstone can rarely get you &5Draconium Dust&r. This is needed for most recipes and can be smelted to get &5Draconium Ingots&r. These are 1 of the 2 important Ingots from &5DE&r, the other comes from &6Awakened Draconium Blocks&r.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.dust.translation: 篩分粉碎終界石時，有低機率會獲得&5龍塵&r。這種粉末能熔煉出&5龍金屬錠&r，這種錠是《&5龍族進化&r》中大部分配方所需的材料，也是這模組中兩種重要金屬錠的其中之一，另一種錠來自&6覺醒龍金屬方塊&r。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.end.original: To get into &5Draconic Evolution&r you'll need &5Chaos Shards&r. &5Chaos Shards&r are in &5Chaos Islands&r guarded by &cChaos Guardians&r in &dThe End&r. Go to &dThe End&r at an X/Z coordinate that is a multiple of 10,000.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.end.translation: 在《&5龍族進化&r》模組的後半部分，你會需要使用&5混沌碎片&r來製作一些物品。位於&d終界&r的&5混沌之島&r上的&c混沌守衛&r保護著&5混沌碎片&r。你會需要到達&d終界&r的 X / Z 座標為 10000 的倍數的地方以找到混沌之島：像是 (10000,10000) / (10000,-20000) / (-20000,-20000) ...之類的地方。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.endstone.original: Welcome to &5Draconic Evolution&r, a very fun and overpowered mod! To get started you'll need End Stone to crush and sieve. You can make some with Barrel mixing or find it in &dThe End&r.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.endstone.translation:
歡迎來到《&5龍族進化&r》，這是一款既有趣又相當 OP 的模組！

要開始遊玩這款模組，你會需要先粉碎終界石過篩。

至於終界石的取得方式，你可以使用《Ex Deorum》模組的桶子混合，又或是直接到&d終界&r挖掘。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.fuel.original: The Reactor takes Awakened Draconium as Fuel, don't worry its efficient! Fuel Conversion determines when the Awakened Draconium will change to Chaos. It can take only 8 BLocks at a time and can only be Fueled or Refueled when the Reactor is shut off. SAS mode helps to make that easier! Also Fuel goes into the bottom right Slots.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.fuel.translation: 這個反應爐使用覺醒龍的物質當作燃料，不用擔心它的效率！燃料轉換效率決定了覺醒龍物質何時會轉換成混沌碎片。反應爐只能在關閉時進行添加或補充燃料，並且最多一次只能添加八個覺醒龍塊。SAS 模式可以幫助這一切更加容易！另外，燃料要放入右下角的插槽中。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.fusion.original: Fusion Crafting is how most (fun) items will be made. To get started you need a Fusion Crafting Core, place it down about a block above the ground. The Core is where recipes can be autoplaced in from JEI, where the middle item goes, and where the end item will be put. It will need the Injectors put a few blocks away from it looking toward the Core on two sides of it. Check next Quest to find more on those. The Injectors will also need Energy which will be explained more in the Crystal Binding Quest.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.fusion.translation:
聚合注入是製作大多數（至少是有趣的物品）物品的方法。

要開始進行注入，你需要一個聚合核心，將其放置在距離地面一格方塊的高度。

核心是可以從 JEI 自動轉移配方材料的地方，也是配方中心物品放置的位置，以及最終成品產出的位置。注入器需要與核心間隔數個方塊，並將其面對著核心放置。查看下一個任務來了解更多有關於聚合注入的資訊。

注入器還需要供應能量，這在「傳輸 OP」任務中會有更詳細的說明。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.guardian.original: Now the actual fight starts, he has two health bars both need to get taken to 0 to get the &5Chaos Shards&r. Don't get too close or he'll hit you with a barrage of fireballs! (In older versions, the &cChaos Guardian&r could even kill someone in Creative mode! Fortunately it can't anymore).
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.guardian.translation:
戰鬥現在才正式開始，他的血量有兩條，你需要讓兩條血都降至 0 才能得到&5混沌碎片&r。

記住不要離他太近不然他會對你噴出一大堆的火球！

（在以前的版本中，&c混沌守衛&r甚至能夠殺死創造模式中的玩家！但還好現在已經沒辦法了。）

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.injector.original: The Injector needs to be on a different side of all the Stabilizers and has to share the same Axis as the Core. This is where OP will need to pumped in from! To activate and make OP the Energy Saturation needs to be raised up a bit. Energy Saturation is the stored Energy and soon to be made Energy.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.injector.translation: 反應堆能量注入器需要位於所有反應堆穩定器的不同側，並且必須與核心共用同一軸。這裡就是 OP 注入的地方！為了啟動及使用 OP ，你需要稍微提高一些能量飽和度。能量飽和度的意思是儲存起來的能量，並很快就會作為能量使用。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.module.original: Modules are very important to our &5DE&r items. So important that the items don't work without them! Most Modules are made from a Module Core or a previous Module. Hold an item and press Shift and C to open the Module Menu. There you'll see some slots and buttons! The Slots are where Modules will actually go and the Grid is what determines how many Modules can go. When a Module says 1x1,it'll only take 1 Slot, while one that says 2x2 will take uo 4 slots. The lowest button on the right will show what Modules can be applied to the item you are holding. The rest just change the look of GUI.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.module.translation:
升級模組是《&5龍族進化&r》模組中非常重要的一部分。甚至重要到此模組的系列道具沒有它們就無法運作！

大多數升級模組都是透過模組核心或是前一等級的升級模組來製作的。

拿著此模組的系列道具並按下 Shift + C 來開啟升級模組設定。接下來你會看到一些插槽和各種按鈕！

插槽是我們安裝升級模組的地方，且插槽的數量決定了我們能夠安裝多少個升級模組。

當升級模組的大小為 1x1 時它就只會占用 1 格插槽，而如果為 2x2 則會占用 4 格插槽。

介面右側最下面的那顆按鈕能夠讓你看到現在這件物品能夠安裝的升級模組。而其他的按鈕都只是用來改變介面的外觀的。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.more_pylons.original: Technically this is optional but recommended! You can use more Pylons to take in and out more OP!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.more_pylons.translation: 你可以放置更多的能量塔來輸入/出更多的 OP ！你不一定要這麼做，但極度推薦多放一些！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.more_stabilizer.original: For Tier 5-8 you'll need Advanced Stabilizers. What's an Advanced Stabilizer? It's 9 Stabilizers all in a 3x1x3 Area. When made right it'll transform into a circle! Just do that same way you'd do 1 Stabilizer.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.more_stabilizer.translation: 等級 5 ~ 等級 8 的能量核心需要進階穩定器。但什麼是進階穩定器呢？就是以 3x1x3 方式擺放的 9 個能量穩定器。當你擺對時它們就會自動變成一個圓圈！基本上它們的功能和 1 個穩定器無異。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.on.original: 500 Million OP? Check. Fuel? Check. Heat at 2000 C? Check. Just click that activate button and pray it doesn't Meltdown!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.on.translation:
500M OP？就緒。
燃料？就緒。
核心溫度為 2000°C？就緒。

接下來只要按下啟動按鈕，並開始祈禱它不會熔毀就行了！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.ore.original: Don't feel like sieving? You can always find the ore in &dThe End&r and mine it!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.ore.translation: 受夠篩礦了嗎？你也可以選擇直接到&d終界&r去挖掘礦石！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.power.original: The Reactor can only hold 1 Billion OP and while that may seem like a far number, it won't be for long. When Energy Saturation reaches 100%% it will increase Heat a ton which can lead to Meltdown. It will need 500,000,000 OP to activate and a Flux Gate will help limit how much OP comes in and out. (BTW 1 RF = 1 OP) They need Redstone to activate and can be used for both adding OP and taking out OP. You'll need Energy out to not Meltdown, try putting it in an Energy Core!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.power.translation:
反應爐只能容納 10 億 OP，這數字雖然看起來很大，但無法持續太久時間。當能量飽和度達到 100%% 時，反應爐溫度會開始大幅提高，這可能導致反應爐熔毀。

反應爐啟動時需要 5 億 OP，能量閥門能為限制 OP 的進出量起到很好的幫助。（順帶一提，1 RF = 1 OP）

你需要及時排出反應爐裡的能量，來避免反應爐因溫度過高熔毀，試著將這龐大的能量輸入進能量核心中！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.prep.original: Now before you get to the &5Chaos Island&r I recommend preparing, he may look like the Ender Dragon but this one is much more difficult. You'll want Draconic Weapons or Tools that do a lot of damage as those will make it easier. He will also do a ton of damage! Good armor like Unobtainium or the Meka-Suit is recommended. Effects like Regeneration, Absorption, and Resistance will also help you survive. Don't worry, you can always come back to fight another day if you aren't ready.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.prep.translation:
我推薦你先做一些準備再前往&5混沌之島&r：雖然他長得跟終界龍很像，但擊敗他要比擊敗終界龍難上非常多。

你會需要製作一些能夠造成大量傷害的神龍武器和工具來使該過程更加輕鬆。

他也會造成非常多的傷害，所以建議你從下列盔甲中選擇一套穿戴：
《ATM 金屬》模組中的難得素盔甲
《通用機械》模組中的 MekaSuit
《等價交換》模組中的寶石盔甲（譯者最推薦的一套，除了混沌毀滅光束之外都免疫）
再加上回復、吸收和抗性等效果來幫助你擋下更多的攻擊。

不用擔心，你隨時能夠回到混沌之島上來接續你上次的進度。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.pylon.original: Pylons are how you get OP in and out of the Energy Core. Place them at least close to the Core, 2 of them 1 for input and 1 for output (you can use more). Then, place Glass over them and they will be assembled automatically targeting the closest Energy Core. Right Click the newly formed balls ontop of the Pylons to change whether they are Input or Output (you'll know from the arrows and design of them). Then, you can attach Crystals to them to move OP in and out!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.pylon.translation:
能量塔是一種能夠讓我們對能量核心進行 OP 輸入或輸出的裝置。

將它們放在能量核心的附近，你至少會需要 2 個（當然你也可以放更多個）：1 個用來輸入，1 個用來輸出。然後再在能量塔向著能量核心的那一面放置一塊玻璃，它們就會自動連接到你的能量核心了。

右鍵點擊能量塔上的那顆球可以讓能量塔在輸入或輸出模式之間切換。你可以透過能量塔上的箭頭和它們的顏色來判斷它們的模式。

然後你就可以將水晶綁定到能量塔上來進行 OP 的輸入和輸出了！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.shard.original: Once defeated he'll drop EXP, a &6Dragon Heart&r, and most importantly free the &5Chaos Shards&r. Look for a lightning strike, then mine below where it struck. There you will find the &5Chaos Shard&r. Mine it to be granted 5 &5Chaos Shards&r which can be crafted into smaller pieces.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.shard.translation:
當你擊敗他之後，他會掉落一些經驗值、一個&6龍族之心&r，但最重要的是讓你能夠挖掘這座島上的&5混沌碎片&r。

看看哪邊會落雷，然後朝著那個位置向下挖。你就可以找到&5混沌碎片了&r。

挖掉它能夠獲得 5 個能夠用來分解成其他更小的部份的&5混沌碎片&r！

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.stabilizer.original: Energy Core Stabilizers... stabilize? The Core. For the first 4 Tiers of Cores you need only 4 Stabilizers around it. You can access the GUi of the Core through the Stabilizers as well. If they are placed too close to the Core or in the wrong spots it will tell you it's incorrect.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.stabilizer.translation: 能量核心穩定器...穩定核心？對於前四層的核心，只需要四個穩定器環繞它。你也可以透過穩定器存取核心的 GUI 。如果將穩定器放置在錯誤的地點或太過靠近核心，它會告訴你這是錯誤的。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.transfuser.original: Before you get here first you need an item that needs OP in it: Wyvern Bow, Chaotic Capacitor, Staff of Power whatever. Then you need an Energy Module in the item, that determines the OP storage in the item and that's what the item will use to power up. Once you have that, make and place the Energy Transfuser, get OP in it, then place your item into it! You'll know it's working when the OP in it lights up and moves.
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.transfuser.translation:
在你來到這之前，你首先要擁有一個需要 OP 的道具，像是：雙足飛龍弓、混沌電容、力量權杖...等。

接著你要在這些道具之中安裝能量模組：決定了你的道具的 OP 儲量和能量傳輸速率的升級模組。

當你完成上面這些之後，你就可以製作一個能量注入器，並向它輸出一些 OP ，就可以將你的道具放進去充能了！

將道具放入之後，如果上面的條有開始上升就代表你做對了。

atm9.quest.draconic.desc.wyvern.original: In order to Tier up in &5Draconic Evolution&r Fusion Crafting, the needed Injectors for a recipe must be at least the Tier or higher. Like if you want to make the &9Wyvern Axe&r you need at least 6 &9Wyvern Injectors&r, with 3 on each side. Don't worry, the Crafting Core stays the same!
atm9.quest.draconic.desc.wyvern.translation:
要提高你在《&5龍族進化&r》模組中的聚合注入等級的話，你就會需要更高等級的聚合注入器。

高等級的聚合注入器可以製作低等級的物品，但低等級的聚合注入器沒辦法製作高等級的物品。

例如：如果你想要製作一把&9雙足飛龍斧&r，你就會需要至少 6 個&9雙足飛龍聚合注入器&r。

不用擔心，每種等級的聚合核心都是同一個。

atm9.quest.draconic.destroy.translation: 找到並摧毀 14 顆守衛水晶

atm9.quest.draconic.ore.original: It used to come from here!

atm9.quest.draconic.prep.original: It's tough you'll need to prepare
atm9.quest.draconic.prep.translation: 這很艱難，你需要做好準備

atm9.quest.draconic.pylon.original: Power comes and goes through these

atm9.quest.draconic.subt.reactor.translation: 無 限 電 力 ！

atm9.quest.enchant.book.original: Vanilla Max is just the start

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.Soul_deep.original: Like an improved &4Hellshelf&r, the &9Soul Touched Deepshelf&r gives a lot of &cQuanta&r, it does give higher &aEterna&r max to &a37.5&r though! Which means better Enchants!
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.Soul_deep.translation: 就像改良版的&4地獄書櫃&r一樣，&9觸及靈魂伏聆書櫃&r提供大量的&c量子化&r，而且最大&a位階&r提高到 &a37.5&r！這使你獲得更好的附魔效果！

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.Soul_sculk.original: Suprisingly you don't need infusion for these! You just need to kill the most powerful boss in vanilla Minecraft! The &9Skulk shelves&r increase &aEterna&r to &a40&r which will allow us to Infuse the next item.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.Soul_sculk.translation: 令人驚訝的是，這些不需要灌注！你只需要擊敗原版中最強大的 Boss！&9觸及靈魂伏聆書櫃&r將&a位階&r提高到 &a40&r ，這讓我們能夠灌注下一個物品。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.alexandria.original: The Library of Alexandria is a better Enchantment Library. It can hold more, that's it. you need to Infuse a Enchantment Library. It needs exactly &a50 Eterna&r, between &c45%%-50%% Quanta&r, and &5100%% Arcana&r. This can be done with &97 Echoing Deepshelves&r, &92 Soul-Touched Deepshelves&r, and &d3 Draconic Shelves&r.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.alexandria.translation: 亞歷山大圖書館是更好的附魔圖書館。他的容量更大，僅此而已。你需要灌注附魔圖書館以獲得它。灌注它需要正好 &a50 點位階&r，&c45%% 到 50%% 的量子化&r，及 &5100%% 的阿卡那&r。可以透過設置 &97 個回聲伏聆書櫃&r、和 &92 個觸及靈魂深板岩書櫃&r，以及 &d3 個龍裔終界書櫃&r來達成。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.arcana.original: &5Arcana&r is very important quantity, it increases the amount of Enchantments you get and makes rare Enchantments more common. An example would be like with Swords, smite is a very common enchantment but looting is much more rare. &5Arcanas&r default is &50%%&r and max is &5100%%&r.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.arcana.translation: &5阿卡那&r是非常重要的屬性，它能增加你獲得的附魔數量，並使稀有附魔變得更常見。例如，對於劍來說，鋒利是一個非常常見的附魔，而掠奪則更為稀有。&5阿卡那&r的預設值是 &50%%&r，最大值是 &5100%%&r。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.blazing.original: The &4Blazing Hellshelf&r is an upgrade to the &4Infused Hellshelf&r. It increases max &aEterna&r to &a30&r. The negative &3Enchanting Clues&r makes it a little worse for normal Enchanting but the &cQuanta&r is incredible for how cheap it is. Do you really need to know exactly which Enchantments you'll get?
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.blazing.translation: &4烈焰地獄書櫃&r是&4灌注地獄書櫃&r的升級版本。它的將&a位階&r上限提升至&a30&r。負的&3附魔提示&r使它對普通附魔效果稍差，但&c量子化&r的性價比非常高。你真的需要精確知道會獲得哪些附魔嗎？

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.book.original: Bookshelves are your starting point, but definitely not your end point. Atleast not normal bookshelves. With only normal bookshelves you can only get &aEterna&r up and to a max of 15. (I will explain the Enchantment Levels soon but just know you need them up)
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.book.translation: 書櫃是你的起點，但絕對不是終點。至少不是原版書櫃。若你只有原版書櫃，你最多只能獲得 15 點的&a位階&r。（接下來將會解釋附魔等級，但只要知道你需要提高它們即可）

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.charms.original:
Charms are new items within Apotheosis that allow you to get Potion Effects for much longer. You can Infuse them to make them Unbreakable (infinite). It needs &a50 Eterna&r, between &c8.5&r and &c13.5 Quanta&r, and between &532.5&r to &537.5 Arcana&r. 

One way you can do this is with &d4 Draconic Endshelves&r, &92 Echoing Deepshelves&r, &d1 Endshelf&r, 1 &aMelonshelf&r and 4 normal Bookshelves (can use more normal bookshelves to replace &dDraconic Endshelves&r). 

&6Only Apotheosis Charms can be made unbreakable.&r
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.charms.translation: 護符是《神化》模組的新部分，它可以讓你獲得持續更久的藥水效果。你可以對它們進行灌注，使其無法破壞。這需要 &a50 點位階&r、&c8.5%%&r 到 &c13.5%% 的量子化&r，以及 &532.5%%&r 到 &537.5%% 的阿卡那&r。一種方法是使用 &d5 個龍裔終界書櫃&r、&92 個回聲深板岩書櫃&r、&d1 個終界書櫃&r，以及 1 個西瓜書櫃。（順便說一下，我使用了「任何 curios 護符」標籤，所以一些可用於提交任務的物品，實際上並不能被灌注成無法破壞，只有神化模組的護符可以。）

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.crystalline.original: The &bSeashelf&r way to &6Perfect Enchanting&r is different from &4Hellshelf&r way. Here you will need both upgraded versions of the &bInfused Seasehelf&r. To get next Infusion you need &b9 Crystalline Seashelves&r, &b2 Heart-Forged Seashelves&r, and &b4 Infused Seashelves&r.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.crystalline.translation: 運用&b海洋書櫃&r達到&6完美附魔&r的方式，與&4地獄書櫃&r大為不同。\n\n這條路線你會需要 2 種&b灌注海洋書櫃&r的升級版本。為了邁入下個灌注階段，你需要&b9 個結晶海洋書櫃&r、&b2 個鍛心海洋書櫃&r，以及&b4 個灌注海洋書櫃&r。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.deepshelf.original: The &9Deepshelf&r (not dormant) is your next step to Enchanting. Like everything else it needs Infusion. The &9Deepshelf&r needs 30 &aEterna&r, &c40%% Quanta&r, and &540%% Arcana&r. Hopefully you took one of the Pathways here and use those to Infuse for your &9Deepshelf&r.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.deepshelf.translation: &9深板岩書櫃&r（非沉睡狀態）是你下一步的附魔。和其他一樣，它需要灌注。&9深板岩書櫃&r需要 30 點&a位階&r、&c40% 量子化&r和 &540% 阿卡那&r。但願你已經選擇好了要走的路線，並用來灌注你的 &9深板岩書櫃&r。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.draconic.original: The &dDraconic Shelf&r is the last Shelf we'll need for perfect set up. It might only give &aEterna&r but it has the Max Max &aEterna&r of &a50&r.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.draconic.translation: &d龍裔終界書櫃&r是我們完美設置所需要的最後一個書櫃。它只能提供&a位階&r，但它的最大&a位階&r為 &a50&r 。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.echo_deep.original: A little expensive but the &9Echoing Deep Shelf&r is like a much better &bSeashelf&r. (BTW you'll need to kill quite a few wardens to advance more in Enchanting... shoulda warned you earlier). Also increases Max &aEterna&r to &a37.5&r.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.echo_deep.translation: 雖然有點貴，但&9回聲深板岩書櫃&r就像一個更好的&b海洋書櫃&r。（順帶一提，你需要擊殺不少伏守者才能在附魔方面有更多的進展...早該提醒你了）。它還將最大&a位階&r提高到 &a37.5&r。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.echo_sculk.original: You might need to kill a few Wardens for these, but that's okay, Apotheosis makes it easier! This shelf is mostly for &5Arcana&r but it's a good source for all quantities. It will be needed for next Infusion.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.echo_sculk.translation: 你可能需要擊殺一些伏守者來獲得這些，但沒關係，《神化》模組使其變得更容易了！這個書櫃主要用於&5阿卡那&r，但它也做為所有數值的來源是非常好的。在下一次灌注中將會需要用到它。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.enchant.original: Enchanting gets a few changes with Apotheosis. To summarize it, 15 bookshelves won't be enough now. There's new bookshelves and actions you can do with Enchantment Tables now and hopefully these quests will help you understand.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.enchant.translation: 《神化》模組對附魔進行了一些改變。總的來說，現在15個書櫃已經不夠用了。現在有新的書櫃且你可以在附魔台上進行新的操作，希望這些任務能幫助你理解。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.endshelf.original: The last sets of Shelves you'll need are &dEndshelves&r, to get them you need Infused Dragon's Breath. This one was hard to get but you need at least &a40%% Eterna&r, &c15%%-25%% Quanta&r, and at least &560%% Arcana&r. It has to be between &c15%%-25%% Quanta&r to get that you can use &95 Echoing Skulkshelves&r, &95 Soul-Touched Skulkshelves&r, and 10 Melonshelves.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.endshelf.translation: 你需要的最後一組書櫃是&d終界書櫃&r，獲得它們需要灌注龍息。這個過程很困難，你至少需要 &a40%% 位階&r、&c15%%-25%% 量子化&r，和至少 &560%% 阿卡那&r。量子化必須界在 &c15%%-25%% 之間，為了達到這個要求，你可以使用 &95 個回聲伏聆書櫃&r、&95 個觸及靈魂伏聆書櫃，以及 10 個西瓜書櫃。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.eterna.original: &aEterna&r sets the Enchantment Level which determines what Enchantments you can or will get. It's default is &a0&r and max is &a50&r.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.eterna.translation: &a位階&r設置了附魔等級，這決定了你能夠或將會獲得的附魔效果。它的預設值是0，最大值是50。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.glowing.original: The &4Glowing Hellshelf&r is an upgrade to the &4Infused Hellshelf&r. It also increases the Max &aEterna&r and decent stats for everything else. We can use these for the next step, Infusing &9Dormant Deepshelves&r to &9Deepshelves&r. You'll need &410 Glowing Hellshelves&r and &46 Infused Hellshelves&r to get it.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.glowing.translation:
&4發光地獄書櫃&r是&4灌注地獄書櫃&r的升級版本。它同樣提升了&a位階&r最大值，還附帶其它不錯的附魔屬性。

我們可以利用它們來邁入下一個階段附魔，也就是將&9沉睡的深板岩書櫃&r，灌注成&9深板岩書櫃&r。

你將會需要 &410 個發光地獄書櫃&r，和 &46 個灌注地獄書櫃&r來達到要求。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.heart-forged.original: These little Hearts of the Sea are very important for Minecraft, it's mods, and of course Apotheosis. You can craft them with Mystical Agriculture or Mekanism. Or the normal Minecraft way of killing Elder Guardians! Wait, sorry, I forgot the sky doesn't have Oceans to spawn Elder Guardians... Thankfully our friend Occultism can help us with that! You can Conjure an Elder Guardian with a ritual, check JEI!
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.heart-forged.translation:
這些小小的海洋之心，對於原版麥塊、相關的模組，當然還有《神化》來說，都非常重要。

你可以使用《神秘農業》或《通用機械》來合成取得它們。又或是按照正常的麥塊流程，殺死遠古深海守衛！

喔等等，抱歉，我忘記天空上沒有海洋可以生成遠古深海守衛......所幸我們的朋友《神祕學》可以幫助我們！你可以透過儀式召喚一隻遠古深海守衛，快去查看 JEI！

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.hellshelf.original: &4Hellshelves&r is one route you can take toward Perfect Enchanting. If you like exploring the Nether rather than the Seas then these are what you want! &4Hellshelves&r are your introduction to &cQuanta&r, they give &c3%% Quanta&r and &a1.5 Eterna&r. Better than normal shelves right? You're going to need 15 for the next step, just craft 10 I'll give you 5 extra!
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.hellshelf.translation: &4地獄書櫃&r是你作為&c量子化&r的入門，它提供了 &c3%% 量子化&r及 &a1.5 位階&r。比原版書櫃好，對吧！你將至少需要 15 個地獄書櫃來進行下一步，只要做出其中 10 個，我就會給與你 5 個作為獎勵！

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.infused_hellshel.original: In order to get higher Max Enchantments and levels you'll need Infused Hellshelves. To get them you will need &a22.5 Eterna&r and &c30%% Quanta&r. You can get that with 15 normal shelves and &45 Hellshelves&r or just &415 Hellshelves&r. Obviously you'll need a spare &4Hellshelf&r to actually be Infused. You can keep replacing the &4Hellshelves&r with their Infused counterparts but it will increase EXP needed to do so.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.infused_hellshel.translation: 為了獲得更高級的附魔和等級，你需要灌注的地獄書櫃。要獲得它們，你需要 &a22.5 位階&r和 &c30%% 量子化&r。你能透過使用 15 個原版書櫃，和&45 個地獄書櫃&r，或僅用 &415 個地獄書櫃&r來達到要求。\n\n顯然，你還需要一個備用的地獄書櫃來進行灌注。你可以使用灌注過的地獄書櫃替換原有的地獄書櫃，但這會增加灌注附魔所需的經驗值。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.infused_seashelf.original: If you want higher &aEterna&r and &5Arcana&r you'll need Infused Seashelves. To get them you need at least &a22.5 Eterna&r, &c15%% Quanta&r, and &510%% Arcana&r. You can use 15 Bookshelves and &b5 Seashelves&r or just &b15 Seashelves&r. (&c15%% Quanta&r is default you won't need &4Hellshelves&r for this).
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.infused_seashelf.translation: 如果你想要更高級的&a位階&r和&5阿卡那&r，你需要灌注的海洋書櫃。要獲得它們，你需要至少 &a22.5 位階&r、&c15%% 量子化&r和 &510%% 阿卡那&r。你能透過使用 15 個原版書櫃和 &b5 個海洋書櫃&r，或僅用 &415 個海洋書櫃&r來達到要求。（&c15% 量子化&r是預設值，你不需要額外設置&4地獄書櫃&r）。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.infusion.original: Infusion is a special version of Enchanting which ironically is used for better enchantments. When the right amount of &aEterna&r, &cQuanta&r, and &5Arcana&r is reached the enchantments will offer Infusion. (To know the Levels needed you can check JEI or follow these Quests).
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.infusion.translation: 灌注是一種特別的附魔方式，出乎意料的是它是用來獲得更好的附魔效果。當達到適量的&a位階&r、&c量子化&r和&5阿卡那&r時，附魔將提供灌注效果。（要知道所需等級，你可以查閱JEI或跟隨任務線）

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.library.original: This is arguably one of the most important blocks added by Apotheosis, the Enchantment Library. You put Books in and they collect over time and can be taken out anytime. Warning 1. It has limits, high limits but limits 2. It can only take out the highest level put in regardless of how many are in.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.library.translation: 這無疑是《神化》模組添加的最重要的方塊之一—附魔圖書館。你可以將附魔書放入，它們會隨著時間推移而累積，並且你可以隨時取出。注意！1. 它的容量有上限，即使他的上限非常高 2. 它只能取出放入的最高等級的附魔書，不管放了多少本。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.negative.original: Some infusions need very very exact amounts of &aEterna&r, &cQuanta&r, or &5Arcana&r to get these you might need one of these shelves. Each lowers the amount of its respective mystic value.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.negative.translation: 有些灌注需要非常精確的&a位階&r、&c量子化&r或&5阿卡那&r，你可能需要其中一個書櫃來獲取這些。每個書櫃會降低其相應的量。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.other.original: It's not just bookshelves that can be Infused!
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.other.translation: 不只是書櫃可以進行灌注！

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.pearlescent.original: The &dPearlescent Endshelf&r is the best all-around shelf. It also gives a Max &aEterna&r of &a45&r, but this isn't the shelf we're looking for to get perfect set up.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.pearlescent.translation: &d璀璨終界書櫃&r是最全能的書櫃。它還能提供 &a45 點位階&r，但這不是我們尋求的完美設置所需要的書櫃。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.perfect.original: Ever want THE most perfect Enchants? Then this is the setup you need, for 100%% everything. &95 Echoing Skulkshelves&r, &95 Soul-Touched Sculkshelves&r, and &d1 Draconic Shelf&r will get you &a50 Eterna&r, &c100%% Quanta&r, &5100%% Arcana&r and &96 Enchanting Clues&r. &e3 Shelves of End Fused Rectification&r will give &e100%% Rectification&r. And &6Deepshelf of Arcane Treasures&r will top it all off with &6Treasure Enchantments&r.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.perfect.translation: 想要得到最完美的附魔嗎？那麼這就是你需要的設置，達到 100%% 的一切。使用 &95 個回聲伏聆書櫃&r、&95 個觸及靈魂伏聆書櫃&r和 &d1 個龍裔終界書櫃&r，你將獲得 &a50 點位階&r、&c100%% 量子化&r、&5100%% 阿卡那&r和 &96 個附魔提示&r。 &e3 個終界校正書櫃&r將提供 &e100%% 的修正值&r。再加上&6一個奧術寶藏深板岩書櫃&r，將完美附魔效果推向巔峰。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.quanta.original: &cQuanta&r sets how random the Enchants you get will be. It can be used against you though depending on &eRectification&r. If the &cQuanta&r is high and &eRectification&r is low, you're more likely to get bad enchantments and curses. Default &cQuanta 15%%&r and its max is &c100%%&r. &eRectification&r default is &e0%%&r and max is &e100%%&r.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.quanta.translation: &c量子化&r決定了你獲得附魔的隨機程度。它可能會根據&e校正&r來對你產生影響。如果&c量子化&r很高而&e校正&r很低，你更有可能得到不好的附魔或詛咒。&c量子化&r的預設值是&c15%%&r，最大值是&r100%%&r。&e校正&r的預設值是&e0%%&r，最大值是&e100%%&r。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.retification.original: &eRectification&r is a quantity that works with &cQuanta&r, it determines if the enchantments will be good or bad. The more &eRectification&r the better the Enchantments. Definitely necessary for those wanting good gear.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.retification.translation: &e校正&r是一個與&c量子化&r共同作用的數值，它決定了附魔效果是好是壞。&e校正&r越高，附魔效果越好。對於那些想要好裝備的人來說，這絕對是必需的。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.seashelf.original: Find the Nether too warm and deadly? Maybe the Seashelf path is better for you, you can use Seashelves as a path to Perfect Enchanting rather than Hellshelves. &bSeashelves&r are your introduction to &5Arcana&r, they give &52%% Arcana&r and &a1.5 Eterna&r. Better than normal shelves right? You're going to need 15 for the next step, just craft 10 I'll give you 5 extra!
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.seashelf.translation: &b海洋書櫃&r是你作為&c阿卡那&r的入門，它提供了 &52%% 阿卡那&r及 &a1.5 位階&r。比原版書櫃好，對吧！你將至少需要 15 個海洋書櫃來進行下一步，只要做出其中 10 個，我就會給與你 5 個作為獎勵！

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.sight.original: You ever spend 3 months studying Galatic Code to finally understand Enchantment Table language just for it to be gibberish? No? Me either, but &9Enchanting Clues&r are your actual translator for it. Each &9Enchanting Clue&r will tell you 1 Enchantment before you actually use it.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.sight.translation: 你有沒有花了 3 個月來學習火星文來理解附魔台語言，結果發現它卻是胡言亂語？沒有嗎？我也沒有，但&9附魔提示&r才是真正的翻譯器。每一個&9附魔提示&r在你附魔之前會告訴你一個附魔效果。

atm9.quest.enchant.desc.trident.original: Apotheosis knows how annoying Tridents can be to get so they made it easier... well kinda easier. You can now make an Inert Trident and Infuse it to get a normal Trident. The Trident requires between &a20-30 Eterna&r, &c20%%-50%% Quanta&r, and at least &535%% Arcana&r. You can get this with &94 Echoing Skulkshelves&r or &b2 Crystalline Seashelves&r and &b6 Heart-Forged Seashelves&r.
atm9.quest.enchant.desc.trident.translation: 《神化》模組知道獲得三叉戟有多麻煩，因此他們讓這個過程變得更容易了...或者說更容易了一點點。現在你可以製作一個惰性三叉戟並對其灌注以獲得原版三叉戟。這個三叉戟需要 &a20 到 30 點位階&r，&c20%% 到 50%% 的量子化&r，以及至少 &535%% 的阿卡那&r。你可以通過 &94 個回聲伏聆書櫃&r或者 &b2 個結晶海洋書櫃&r和 &b6 個鍛心海洋書櫃&r來獲得這些數值。

atm9.quest.farm.animals.original: We're doing this the old fashioned way.
atm9.quest.farm.animals.translation: 我們正在使用西部牛仔時代的方法。

atm9.quest.farm.book.original: Making a Kitchen, with a book.
atm9.quest.farm.book.translation: 使用一本書來建造廚房。

atm9.quest.farm.cake.original: You can have your Cake and Eat it too.

atm9.quest.farm.cookbook.original: Cooking with the power of Diamonds
atm9.quest.farm.cookbook.translation: 使用鑽石之力來進行烹飪

atm9.quest.farm.desc.animals.original: The classic Lead. Use this to get animals into your farm area.\n\nThis isn't the same thing found in paint.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.animals.translation: 就是原版的拴繩，能夠把動物牽到農場。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.book.original: Go ahead. Put a book in a furnace.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.book.translation: 去吧，去將書進入一個熔爐之中。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.botany.original: Hopper pots will automatically output into the storage beneath it. This can be used to automate all of your crops!
atm9.quest.farm.desc.botany.translation: 漏斗盆栽會自動將物品漏至下方的儲存空間。這可以用來自動化你所有的作物！

atm9.quest.farm.desc.cabinet.original: This works just like the kitchen counter, except in the air.\n\nAnd you can't put things on top of it.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.cabinet.translation: 廚房櫃的功能就和廚房流理臺一樣，只不過它是懸空的。\n\n而且你不能把東西放在它上面。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.cake.original: Time to bake a cake, if you've got some milk and eggs ready.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.cake.translation: 如果你已經獲得了一些牛奶和雞蛋的話，就該來烤個蛋糕了。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.chicken.original: Chickens will lay these naturally. I guess it's not really considered naturally...\n\nI guess the chickens are just getting... &oEggs-ercise!!!&r.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.chicken.translation: 雞會自然產下這些雞蛋。我想這不算是真正的自然......\n\n我猜這些雞只是正在進行.....雞力訓練！

atm9.quest.farm.desc.cookbook.original: Craft the next version of the book. I promise you, it's worth it.\n\nI'll even give you a Diamond back.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.cookbook.translation: 合成出升級版的食譜。我向你保證，它絕對值得。\n\n我甚至會還你一顆鑽石。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.cool.translation: 解鎖冰和雪的相關食譜！

atm9.quest.farm.desc.counter.original: This block stores items for cooking.\n\nYou can also place other kitchen multi-block items on it, like toasters and a Cow in a Jar.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.counter.translation: 廚房流理臺能夠儲存用來烹飪的物品。\n\n你也可以將其它的多方塊廚房物品放在它的上方，像是烤麵包機或是罐中乳牛。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.cows.original: I don't wanna know how you got these.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.cows.translation: 我不想知道你是如何獲得這些皮革的。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.fish.original: But he usually closes by 5, so who cares.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.fish.translation: 但是他經常被 5 關閉，所以誰在乎。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.flax.original: &2Flax Seeds&r are a great way to get string in the early game!
atm9.quest.farm.desc.flax.translation: &2亞麻種子&r是一個前期很好的取得線的方式。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.food.original: Welcome to the Food and Farming chapter!\n\nHere, you'll find different ways for you to grow and make food!
atm9.quest.farm.desc.food.translation: 歡迎來到農作與食物章節！\n\n你可以在這裡找到各種能夠幫助你發展下去或是製造食物的方法！

atm9.quest.farm.desc.fridge.original: Stores items in the multi-block kitchen. Stack them on top of each other!\n\nYou can also shift-right click on it to open then door, and you can just right click items right in.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.fridge.translation: 冰箱能夠儲存多方塊廚房中的物品。將它們以兩格高放置！\n\n你也可以潛行+右鍵點擊來打開它的門，然後你就可以點擊右鍵來將物品放入了。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.grass.translation: 讓我們獲得一些小麥種子。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.heat.original: Allows you to attach power to the Stove.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.heat.translation: 加熱單元會讓你能夠使用電力來驅動烤箱。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.jar.original:
This block produces milk over time, and enables milk recipes for the kitchen multi-block.

To get a cow in the jar, place the jar in a hole. Lure the cow to fall in said hole above the jar, then drop an anvil on it.

I have no clue what this glass is made of, but it's stronger than my relationship with Chicken.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.jar.translation:
罐中乳牛會隨著時間產出牛奶，並為你的多方塊廚房解鎖牛奶的相關食譜。

要將牛裝入罐中，你需要在一個洞裡面放置一個牛奶罐。然後將牛引誘到洞中（牛奶罐的上方），接下來在牠頭上放置一個鐵砧。

我不知道這些玻璃的材質，但它們一定比我和雞之間的友誼還要堅固。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.kitchen.original:
This block is part of a multi-block kitchen.

This will show you every recipe that is available to you with the food you have in your inventory, or stored in the kitchen multi-block.

You can finally create a nice kitchen in Minecraft.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.kitchen.translation:
烹飪臺是多方塊廚房之中的一部分。

它會向你展示能夠利用你的物品欄之中的食物創造出的新食品，或是將那些食物存在多方塊廚房之中。

你終於能夠在麥塊中創造出一個有用的廚房了。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.market.original: Markets provide you with a villager than can sell you anything if you have the right amount of emeralds.\n\nSpoiler: It's usually just 1 Emerald per item. BUT THEY HAVE EVERYTHING.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.market.translation: 農牧市集會提供一個販售著大部分農牧產品的村民。\n\n劇透：每個物品通常只需要花費 1 顆綠寶石。但它有售賣所 有 東 西。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.milk.original: Find a cow and Right Click it with a bucket.\n\nSeriously, why no bulls?
atm9.quest.farm.desc.milk.translation: 找到一隻牛並手持鐵桶對牠點擊右鍵。\n\n說真的，到底為什麼沒有公牛？

atm9.quest.farm.desc.pot.original: &9Botany Pots&r makes it easy to grow your resources!\n\nThese pots auto-grow almost anything you put into them, and can even be upgraded for automation!
atm9.quest.farm.desc.pot.translation: &9植物盆栽&r讓耕種資源變得簡單！\n\n這些盆栽會種植幾乎任何你放進去的東西，而且甚至還能被升級成自動的！

atm9.quest.farm.desc.sink.original: This block provides water to the multi-block kitchen.\n\nIt can also provide infinite water by pumping water out via cables or pipes.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.sink.translation: 水槽會為多方塊廚房供水。\n\n也能夠透過線纜或管道來從中輸出無限多的水。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.stove.original: This block enables smelting recipes in your kitchen multi-block!
atm9.quest.farm.desc.stove.translation: 烤箱會為你的多方塊廚房解鎖燒烤的相關食譜！

atm9.quest.farm.desc.sugar.original: You should have everything you need already.
atm9.quest.farm.desc.sugar.translation: 你現在應該已經擁有你所需的所有東西了。

atm9.quest.farm.desc.wool.original: Let's gather some pieces of wool!
atm9.quest.farm.desc.wool.translation: 讓我們來剪下一些羊毛！

atm9.quest.farm.egg.original: I'm not gonna make an Egg pun
atm9.quest.farm.egg.translation: 我不會講個蛋（爛）笑話的

atm9.quest.farm.kitchen.original: THE BEST THING SINCE SLICED BREAD

atm9.quest.farm.milk.original: Find a cow. Milk the cow. Profit.

atm9.quest.farm.stove.original: Honey, there's a Furnace in the Kitchen
atm9.quest.farm.stove.translation: 老婆，廚房裡有一個熔爐

atm9.quest.farm.subt.book.original: Smelt a book. Totally won't catch on fire...
atm9.quest.farm.subt.book.translation: 熔煉一本書，它完全不會著火...

atm9.quest.farm.subt.cane.original: This grows to the sky now!
atm9.quest.farm.subt.cane.translation: 它們現在能夠長得非常的高！

atm9.quest.farm.subt.chicken.original: How else do you think Fried Chicken is made?
atm9.quest.farm.subt.chicken.translation: 不然你覺得炸雞是怎麼做的？

atm9.quest.farm.subt.farming.original: Just wait until you get machines for this...
atm9.quest.farm.subt.farming.translation: 在得到機器之前只能先這樣...

atm9.quest.farm.subt.fridge.original: You'll open it, close it, then open it again, just because you're bored
atm9.quest.farm.subt.fridge.translation: 你會將它打開，關上，然後再打開，只是因為你很無聊

atm9.quest.farm.subt.grass.translation: 3...2...1...草失去戰鬥能力，手獲得勝利。

atm9.quest.farm.subt.jar.original: Phenomenal Milking Powers....Itty bitty living space
atm9.quest.farm.subt.jar.translation: 驚人的擠奶能力......狹小的生活空間

atm9.quest.farm.subt.kitchen.original: Betty White was born before Sliced Bread
atm9.quest.farm.subt.kitchen.translation: 貝蒂‧懷特出生在切片麵包之前

atm9.quest.farm.subt.market.original: The villager has more than one way to spawn
atm9.quest.farm.subt.market.translation: 有很多種方式能夠生成出村民

atm9.quest.farm.subt.milk.original: Why aren't there any bulls in the game?
atm9.quest.farm.subt.milk.translation: 為什麼這遊戲沒有公牛？

atm9.quest.farm.subt.sink.original: Why Use 3 Block when 1 Block Do Trick?
atm9.quest.farm.subt.sink.translation: 為甚麼要使用 3 格方塊來做到 1 個方塊就能做到的事？

atm9.quest.farm.subt.wheat.translation: 速通玩家很喜歡這個東西

atm9.quest.farm.subt.wool.translation: 誰家的羊身上會有彩虹羊毛？

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.canInfect.translation: 可以用來感染村民和馬

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.arca.original: Smelting down Arcane Crystals will give you Arcane Crystal Dust.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.arca.translation: 熔煉神秘水晶會得到神秘水晶粉。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.arca.original: This is used for most of the items in the mod.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.arca.translation: 這能夠用來製作本模組中的大部分物品。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.aure.original: &dAureal Bottles&r can be found in loot chests, but they can also be crafted using Arcane Crystal Dust.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.aure.translation: &d輝光瓶&r可以從戰利品箱之中找到，或是使用神秘水晶粉來製作。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.aure.original: You can also generate Aureal with Arcane Crystal Obelisks.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.aure.translation: 你也可以透過神秘水晶方尖碑來產出輝光。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.bloo.original: Blood is collected by crafting Test Tubes, then killing mobs with the Mystical Dagger.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.bloo.translation: 你可以製作出一個試管，然後使用神秘匕首擊殺怪物來收集血液。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.bloo.original: Note: The Test Tube must be in your inventory when killing mobs.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.bloo.translation: 註：當你擊殺生物時，試管必須位於你的背包之中。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.corr.original: Used to corrupt Souls and Runes. You'll need this for later.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.corr.translation: 腐化粉能夠將靈魂或符文腐化。你之後會需要用到這些。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.corr.original: If you throw down Dark Matter, then throw down Corrupti Dust, it'll create a Black Hole. Feed it small entities like Arrows or Experience Orbs, and it'll produce Xpetrified Orbs.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.corr.translation: 如果你丟出一個暗物質，然後再丟出一個腐化粉，它們就會製造出一個黑洞：餵給它像是箭矢或經驗球之類的小型實體就能產生出石化經驗球。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.corr.original: Killing passive mobs will increase your corruption. Killing &9Aureal Entities&r has a higher chance to increase your corruption.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.corr.translation: 擊殺被動生物會增加你的腐敗值。而擊殺&9輝光生物&r則會增加更多的腐敗值。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.corr.original: Be careful! At higher levels of corruption, negative things will happen!
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.corr.translation: 如果你的腐敗值很高的話，會開始發生一些不好的事情！所以請多加注意！

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.corr.original: Making a Sanity Meter will give your UI an upgrade to show your total corruption, for those who want to hit new high scores and such.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.corr.translation: 如果你想要體驗看看那些不好的事情的話，你可以製作一個理智表來查看你的腐敗值。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.dark.original: Combine 2 Runes with Corrupti Dust and you'll make 2 Dark Runes! These are needed for the Mystical Dagger.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.dark.translation: 將 2 個符文與腐化粉結合，你將製作出 2 個暗黑符文！這些是製作神秘匕首所需的材料。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.dark.original: Usually you Mine for this... but we can't do that in the Sky. Igneous Extruders can help make Darkstone for you!
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.dark.translation: 通常來說挖礦時會挖到..但這裡是空島無法辦到。岩石擠製機能幫你製作暗黑石！

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.deor.original: The &6Deorum Ingot&r is needed to continue your progression in the mod!
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.deor.translation: 你會需要&6聖金錠&r來繼續發展本模組！

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.deor.original: This is a very important crafting ingot used in a lot of recipes, plus it also makes some pretty blocks!
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.deor.translation: 它是一種被大量使用在各個合成配方之中的金屬錠，你也能夠用它來做出一些漂亮的方塊。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.deor.original: These can be planted to grow &6Deorum Nuggets&r.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.deor.translation: 金蘭花種子能夠長出&6聖金粒&r。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.deor.original: To create one, you'll need to buy Yellow Orchids at a Market.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.deor.translation: 你會需要先在農牧市集購買黃蘭花，才能製造出它。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.drac.original: The Scepter shoots out energy orbs when charged up with Right-Click. If a mob is hit, it'll strike it with lightning.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.drac.translation: 手持神秘天龍權杖並按住右鍵來射出一顆擊中生物時能夠產生一道閃電的能量球。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.drac.original: To create an Arcane Crystal Obelisk, place down an Arcane Polished Darkstone block, then place two Arcane Crystal Blocks on top of it.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.drac.translation: 要創造出一座神秘水晶方尖碑的話：你要先放一個神秘拋光暗黑石，然後在它上方放置兩個神秘水晶方塊。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.drac.original: Right-click with Mundabitur Dust and you'll create the obelisk.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.drac.translation: 接下來使用潔淨粉右鍵點擊它們之中的任何一個方塊來創造出方尖碑。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.drac.original: When placed on a Arcane Chiseled Polished Darkstone block on the Hephaestus Forge structure, it will slowly generate Aureal over time.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.drac.translation: 當你將這座方尖碑放在赫菲斯托斯鍛爐外圍的那些神秘浮雕拋光暗黑石上方時，它會為你的鍛爐緩慢地提供輝光。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.drag.original: This Dragon Egg is a cool decoration piece. That's pretty much it.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.drag.translation: 這顆龍蛋是一個很酷的裝飾品。對，差不多就這樣而已。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.drag.original: Combining a Dragon Head with a Mystical Dagger will give you &9Dragon Scales&r.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.drag.translation: 將龍首與神秘匕首相結合就能獲得&9龍之鱗片&r。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.edel.original: The &2Edelwood Bucket&r can store more than one bucket of liquid, and can also be used to capture small animals like chickens or squids.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.edel.translation: &2埃德木桶&r可以用來儲存多於一桶的流體，也能用用來捕捉像是雞或魷魚之類的小型動物。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.edel.original: You'll need the Permafrost enchant to use it to carry Lava.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.edel.translation: 你會需要將它附上「永凍」附魔來使它能夠裝起熔岩。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.edel.original: Smelting &9Edelwood&r will give you Dark Matter.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.edel.translation: 熔煉&9埃德木&r會得到暗物質。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.edel.original: You can make Black Holes with this.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.edel.translation: 你可以用它來製造黑洞。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.edel.original: There's biomes still in the sky, but not much natural generation. Instead of finding Edelwood trees you'll need to get a sapling. By sieving Moss you can get an Edelwood Sapling.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.edel.translation: 在天空中仍然會生成一些生態域，但數量並不多。我們現在不需要透過跑圖來獲得埃德木了，你只需要篩一些苔癬方塊就能獲得生長中的埃德木（埃德木樹苗）了。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.edel.original: You'll need to break the branches off and collect the logs, as these are used for crafting various items within the mod.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.edel.translation: 你會需要折斷那些樹枝並收集這些原木，它們是本模組中的重要合成原料。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.ench.original: To enchant items, you'll need Darkstone Pedestals placed around the Forge.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.ench.translation: 你會需要使用暗黑石基座來放置鍛造所需要的材料。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.ench.original: Make sure to place these on the Arcane Chiseled Polished Darkstone.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.ench.translation: 記得要將基座放在那些神秘浮雕拋光暗黑石上方。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.endC.original: Found randomly in loot chests from the End City.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.endC.translation: 你能夠在終界城的戰利品箱中找到短暫飛行之球。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.endC.original: When used, it grants 5 minutes of creative flight.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.endC.translation: 當你使用它之後，你會獲得 5 分鐘的創造飛行能力。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.eter.original: The &6Eternal Stella&r has 3 charges, and when right-clicked, can fully repair all of your items in your inventory.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.eter.translation: 當你手持&6永恆之星&r點擊右鍵時，你背包中的所有物品都會被修理至滿耐久度。每顆都只能使用 3 次。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.eter.original: The main purpose of it is to give the enchant &9Unbreakable&r to an item, which is done by combining it with a tool and an &dApply Item Modifier Smithing Template&r in a Smithing Table.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.eter.translation: 但它的主要用途是用來使物品變為&9無法破壞的&r：將它、一把工具以及&d套用物品改造緞造模板&r一起放入鍛造台之中來完成這點。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.eter.original: This stuff used to be everywhere. Now it can only be gained through sacrificing Items to a Black Hole. Check out the Corrupti Quest to learn how to make a Blackhole. Once it's made throw XP Orbs into it to make an Xpetrified Orb.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.eter.translation: 這東西本來應該到處都能找到。現在它只能透過將物品獻祭給黑洞來獲得。查看腐化粉的任務以了解如何製作黑洞。一旦製作完成，將經驗球丟進去以製作一個經驗石化球。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.eter.original: It can be used to give yourself experience, or used to make the Eternal Stella.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.eter.translation: 你能夠直接使用它來獲得經驗值，或是用來它緞造永恆之星。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.forg.original: The Forge requires 4 different items to be powered: Aureal, Souls, Blood, and Experience.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.forg.translation: 鍛爐需要 4 種元素來驅動，它們分別為：輝光、靈魂、血液以及經驗。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.forg.original: To learn more about each, follow the corner quests!
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.forg.translation: 要深入了解每種元素的話，請跟著角落的那些任務！

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.forg.original: This goes in the right side of the forge.

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.gold.original: The Dragon Scale can be made into a Golden and Aquatic Dragon Scales.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.gold.translation: 龍之鱗片能夠用來製作出金龍之鱗和水龍之鱗。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.gold.original: These are mainly used to craft &dTyr Armor&r.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.gold.translation: 它們是&d戰神提爾盔甲&r的合成材料。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.heph.original: We'll be using all of that Darkstone to create the &dHephaestus Forge&r.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.heph.translation: 我們將會使用我們的暗黑石來搭建出&d赫菲斯托斯鍛爐&r。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.heph.original: Once you have all of the blocks needed, you'll need to build the platform for the forge!
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.heph.translation: 當你擁有了所需的所有方塊之後，你就需要為鍛爐搭建出它的專屬平台！

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.heph.original: The 8 Chiseled Arcane Polished Darkstone blocks on the outer ring of the platform can be used for pedestals or Arcane Cryal Obelisks, with the last block being placed in the center of the platform.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.heph.translation: 以環狀排列的那 8 個神秘浮雕拋光暗黑石是用來放置暗黑石基座或是神秘水晶方尖碑的地方。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.heph.original: On top of the center block, place a Smithing Table and sneak+right-click it with a piece of Mundabitur Dust to convert it to the Forge!
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.heph.translation: 而中間那一個則是我們鍛爐的所在之處：將鍛造台放在上面，並手持潔淨粉潛行+右鍵點擊它來將它轉換為鍛爐！

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.lens.original: The &9Lens of Veritatis&r is used to see Aureal entities.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.lens.translation: 你能夠藉由&9真理透鏡&r來看到耀光生物。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.lens.original: These are entities that will grant Aureal when killed, but will also increase your corruption....
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.lens.translation: 當你擊殺它們時能夠獲得輝光，但你的腐敗值也會跟著上升。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.magi.original: Using this bone meal on Farmland will convert it to Magical Farmland.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.magi.translation: 對著耕地使用神秘骨粉能夠將它們轉化為魔法耕地。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.magi.original: Crops will produce double the output when grown on Magical Farmland.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.magi.translation: 所有種在魔法耕地上的作物都能夠雙倍產出。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.main.original: This is the main resource in the mod. You'll need to sieve Dust to get some!
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.main.translation: 神秘水晶是本模組中的主要資源。你需要篩塵土以取得一些！

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.mort.original: Crafted with skulls, bones, and cloth, this armor is slightly stronger than Iron.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.mort.translation: 亡骨盔甲使用頭顱、骨頭以及布料製作。這套盔甲比鐵製盔甲稍微好一點。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.mund.original: Using our Arcane Crystal Dust, we'll need to combine it with other dusts and powders to create &dMundabiter Dust&r.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.mund.translation: 我們能夠將我們剛剛獲得的神秘水晶粉拿去和其他的粉末一起混和成&d潔淨粉&r。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.mund.original: This dust is used in several recipes, as well as activating the Hephaestus Forge.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.mund.translation: 這種粉末有很多種用途，像是用來啟動赫菲斯托斯鍛爐。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.myst.original: The Mystical Dagger is used to break Dragon Heads down to Dragon Scales.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.myst.translation: 神秘匕首能夠將龍首切成龍之鱗片。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.myst.original: When used to kill mobs, it will fill &aTest Tubes&r with &cBlood&r.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.myst.translation: 當你使用它來擊殺怪物時，它能夠為&a試管&r填充&c血液&r。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.newA.original: Forbidden and Arcanus adds new ways to get better armor, enchants, and more!
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.newA.translation: 《禁忌與奧祕》模組添加了一些能夠用來獲得更好的盔甲、附魔...等的方法！

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.newA.original: This magic-themed mod has amazing animations, as well as some overpowered items like the &6Eternal Stella&r.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.newA.translation: 此魔法主題模組具有精美的動畫，還有像是&6永恆之星&r這樣的強力物品。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.newA.original: To get started you'll need Darkstone. Now we can't really mine for it so we'll need to create some! With Lava, Blue Ice, and Obsidian you can make some.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.newA.translation: 你需要從獲得暗黑石開始。但我們現在無法挖到它們，所以我們會需要創造出一些暗黑石：使用熔岩、藍冰、黑曜石和岩石擠製機來達成這點！

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.nipa.original: Have you seen the random floating island in the sky?
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.nipa.translation: 你有沒有看過隨機的空島在天空上？

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.nipa.original: These have the Nipa plant on them. You can break these and replant them!
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.nipa.translation: 水椰在這上面，你可以破壞掉之後重新種植它們！

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.nipa.original: They produce Arcane Crystal Dust Specks over time, which can be used to create Arcane Crystal Dust.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.nipa.translation: 隨著時間的推移，它會產生神秘水晶塵埃斑點，可以用來製造神祕水晶塵埃。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.perf.original: To perform a ritual, place the ingredients on the Arcane Pedestals around the Forge.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.perf.translation: 要進行鍛造的話，你要先把材料放在鍛爐周圍的那些暗黑石基座上。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.perf.original: You'll need a &9Blacksmith's Gavel&r to activate the ritual. To do this, right click on the Forge with the Gavel.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.perf.translation: 然後再使用&9緞工錘&r右鍵點擊鍛爐來啟動緞造儀式。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.quan.original: The &9Quantum Catcher&r is used to capture and transport mobs.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.quan.translation: &9量子捕捉器&r是用來捕捉，並傳輸生物的。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.rune.original: Like Darkstone ususally we Mine these, and we still will! First we need to get the Ore though which we do from using the Occultism Dimensional Mineshaft.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.rune.translation: 就像暗黑石一樣，通常我們是挖礦的時候會挖到，這次我們仍然會這麼做！但首先我們需要取得它的礦石，而我們需要使用神秘學的維度礦井來取得。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.soul.original: Souls are gathered by creating a &9Soul Extractor&r, and then using it on Soul Sand.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.soul.translation: 你可以對靈魂砂使用&9靈魂提取器&r來獲得靈魂。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.spaw.original: Breaking spawners will now drop &9Spawner Scraps&r.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.spaw.translation: 破壞生怪磚會掉落&9生怪磚碎片&r。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.stel.original: Similar to how Runes are obtained we need to Mine the Ore which we get from the Occultism Dimensional Mineshaft.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.stel.translation: 和取得符文的方法類似，我們必須挖那個礦，透過神祕學的維度礦井來取得神秘隕石。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.upgr.original: The &dHephaestus Forge&r can be upgraded into higher tiers using things like Spawner Scraps, Arcane Crystals, and more!
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.upgr.translation: 你能夠使用像是生怪磚碎片、神秘水晶...之類的材料來升級你的&d赫菲斯托斯鍛爐&r！

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.upgr.original: You'll need higher tiers to make some of the higher tier items, like the &aEternal Stella&r. Make sure to check out JEI for more info!
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.upgr.translation: 你會需要較高的鍛爐等級來製造出一些更好的物品，像是：&a永恆之星。你可以透過 JEI 查看鍛造出每種物品所需的鍛爐等級。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.xRay.original: This gives X-Ray vision for mobs, highlighting them from afar to make it easier to spot them.
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.desc.xRay.translation: 幽靈之眼護身符可以讓你能夠透視看到其他生物：能夠從很遠的地方就看到牠們，以更好尋找牠們的位置。

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.highlight.translation: 啟用它時會讓其他生物發光

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.leavesAoE.original: Leaves an AoE Cloud that damages living mobs
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.leavesAoE.translation: 射中生物時會產生一朵能夠對生物造成傷害的藥水雲

atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.useOnFarm.original: Use on Farmland to make it Magical!
atm9.quest.forbiddenAndArcanus.useOnFarm.translation: 對著耕地使用來將它魔法化！

atm9.quest.force.clock.original: Can you tell me the Time?

atm9.quest.force.desc.0.original: The first Tier of infusing, it starts off at Tier 0 and needs 96 Points to Tier up.
atm9.quest.force.desc.0.translation: 最低階的灌注，初始為等級 0，且需要 96 力量點數才能升級。

atm9.quest.force.desc.1.original: With each new Tier you unlock more Infusions but also more spaces in the Infuser. Tier 0 you only get 1 and in Tier 1 you get 2, which means you can now stack Infusions. Use 2 Force Nuggets to add Knockback II to a Force Sword.
atm9.quest.force.desc.1.translation: 升級能解鎖更多灌注的配方，同時也會開啟灌注台中更多的欄位。等級 0 時你只有一格欄位，而等級 1 時有兩格，這代表你現在可以堆疊灌注。放入兩個力量粒，就能灌注力量劍擊退 II 的效果。

atm9.quest.force.desc.2.original: Tier 2 comes after you Infuse with Sugar, Golden Power Source, and Force Wood. You get new Infusions and 3 squares to Infuse with.
atm9.quest.force.desc.2.translation: 等級 2 是當你使用糖，金色能量源和力量木原木灌注後升級的。現在你有三格欄位能夠進行灌注。

atm9.quest.force.desc.3.original: Yes you will need to Infuse the Cores to Tier up.
atm9.quest.force.desc.3.translation: 沒錯，你需要灌注那個核心才能升級。

atm9.quest.force.desc.4.original: Now can use 5 squares to Infuse, which also means you can stack the Upgrades to their max amounts. Like Sharpness to Sharpness 5 with 5 Claws.
atm9.quest.force.desc.4.translation: 現在有五格可以灌注，這也代表你能堆疊這些灌注效果到最高值。像是用五個蝙蝠爪灌注鋒利 V。

atm9.quest.force.desc.7.original: Last Tier of Infusing, Tier 7. Every Infusion and square has been unlocked. Just get the 2 Infusions and you have mastered ForceCraft.
atm9.quest.force.desc.7.translation: 最後一階的灌注，等級 7。所有的灌注配方和欄位都已解鎖。只差兩種灌注你就完全掌握力量工藝。

atm9.quest.force.desc.FCore.original: Freezing Core will give you more recipes with Freezing items. Like snowballs from slime balls! Still needs Fuel.
atm9.quest.force.desc.FCore.translation: 冰凍核心將熔爐轉換成冰凍模式，能使用力量熔爐：冰凍的配方。例如史萊姆球能冰凍成雪球！也需要燃料。

atm9.quest.force.desc.GCore.original: Grinding Core will break down items into what they are made of. Wool to String, Doors to Wood, Gold Weighted Pressure Plate into Gold Ingots. Still needs Fuel.
atm9.quest.force.desc.GCore.translation: 研磨核心能將物品反向研磨回原材料。羊毛研磨成線，門變木材，金壓力板變金錠。也需要燃料。

atm9.quest.force.desc.HCore.original: Heat Core makes the Furnace more Efficient. A coal chunk will now smelt 2 items instead of 1.
atm9.quest.force.desc.HCore.translation: 高溫核心使熔爐運作更有效率。一個煤炭能熔煉 16 個物品而非 8 個。

atm9.quest.force.desc.SCore.original: Speed Core makes the Furnace faster without ruining the Fuel more.
atm9.quest.force.desc.SCore.translation: 速度核心讓熔爐運作得更快，不會再浪費更多燃料了。

atm9.quest.force.desc.armor.original: Force Armor has similar stats between Iron and Diamond Armor but more Toughness. Another thing better with Force Armor is the ability to Infuse.
atm9.quest.force.desc.armor.translation: 力量裝備的防禦數值介於鐵製到鑽石裝備之間，但有更多的抗擊退。比普通裝備更好的是，力量裝備能灌注。

atm9.quest.force.desc.arrow.original: Bleeding is an Effect given that's similar to Poison. Infuse Swords, Bows, or Armor with an Arrow to give Bleeding with hits.
atm9.quest.force.desc.arrow.translation: 流血的效果和藥水類似。使用箭矢灌注力量劍，弓，或裝備，擊中生物時賦予流血效果。

atm9.quest.force.desc.bacon.original: The Baconater is an item you can make with a pig flask. Shift Right clicking with it will add whatever Cooked Bacon in your inventory into the Baconater. You can hold right click while using it to eat the Bacon or Shift Right click to set it to auto-eat.
atm9.quest.force.desc.bacon.translation: 培根終結者是用豬燒瓶製作而成。手持它 Shift 右鍵能將你身上的所有烤培根裝到培根終結者內。你能拿它右鍵直接吃培根，或是 Shift 右鍵設為自動進食。

atm9.quest.force.desc.belt.original: Force Belts work as a worse Force Pack, can't be upgraded and can't be worn. Also can have color and named with Shift Right Click.
atm9.quest.force.desc.belt.translation: 力量腰帶比力量背包更糟糕的背包，而且還不能升級也不能穿戴在飾品欄中。但也可以手持它，Shift 右鍵改變顏色並對它命名。
