atm9.quest.force.desc.claw.original: The Claw can be used to Infuse a few different items. On Force Swords it'll give Sharpness. On Force Bows it'll give Power. On Force Armor it gives something different, the ability to Force Punch. Force Punch is what happens when you shift left click a mob with an Empty Hand. It'll do more damage than a regular punch along with cool karate noises. The more Armor with Force Punch the more damage it does.
atm9.quest.force.desc.claw.translation: 蝙蝠爪能灌注在一些不同的物品上。灌注在力量劍上賦予鋒利效果。在力量弓上賦予強力效果。在力量裝備上賦予的效果有點不同，賦予的是力量拳的能力。力量拳觸發條件是，當你對生物空手蹲下左鍵，會比普通的空手攻擊造成更多的傷害，且還會有個酷酷的音效。穿戴更多灌注力量拳的裝備，能造成更多的傷害。

atm9.quest.force.desc.clock.original: Infuse a Force Torch with a Clock to make a Time Torch. Some modpacks may have it Configured to disable the Time Torch, when that happens it can crafted but not used. Thankfully we aren't other modpacks, we have the Time Torch. Still needed to Tier up.
atm9.quest.force.desc.clock.translation: 用時鐘灌注力量火把製作時間火把。雖然有些模組包能製作時間火把，可是他們把設定關閉了所以不能使用。但還好我們不是那些模組包，我們有時間火把能用。仍需要用於灌注升級。

atm9.quest.force.desc.core.original: Upgrade Core is made by crafting Force Rod with an Experience Tome. You'll need to Infuse them to make the different ones. Cores will break when you take them out of the Furnace.
atm9.quest.force.desc.core.translation: 升級核心是使用力量權杖和經驗寶典合成製作。你必須灌注不同的材料取得不同的核心。核心取出時會銷毀。

atm9.quest.force.desc.dye.original: Blue Dye can be used to make Force Shears, rainbow! Every sheep those Shears are used on will drop random color of Wool.
atm9.quest.force.desc.dye.translation: 藍色染料灌注力量剪刀會賦予它，彩虹！用它剪羊毛時會隨機掉落不同顏色的羊毛。

atm9.quest.force.desc.engine.original: The Force Engine is... well the only Energy producing block in ForceCraft. It needs 2 things to make Energy, Fuel and a Redstone Signal. The Fuel can be Liquid Force, Lava, or some other mods Fuel. It will give Energy to where it was placed down facing. It also has a second Liquid spot which helps it become more efficient. Water makes it 2 times efficient and Milk by 2.5 times.
atm9.quest.force.desc.engine.translation: 力量引擎是... 嗯，力量工藝中唯一的一台發電機。發電需要兩件事，燃料和紅石訊號。燃料可以是液態力量，熔岩，或其他模組的燃料。它會自動將能量傳輸到面對的方向。它同時也有第二個液體欄位，這能使它更有效率。水能使其效率變 2 倍，牛奶是 2.5 倍。

atm9.quest.force.desc.exp.original: Okay this is gonna take a little to explain but it's important. Bottle O' Enchanting can be made a few different ways but one is with Force Rod and any Enchanting Book. Then the Bottle O' Enchanting can be used to Infuse with a Book for Experience Tome. The Experience Tome can be used with Right Click to Store EXP or can be crafted with a Force Rod to make an Upgrade Core. Those are needed for the other Infusions including using Bottle O' Enchanting to create an Experience Core. Hopefully you understood all that.
atm9.quest.force.desc.exp.translation: 好，這會花點時間解釋，但很重要。經驗瓶有許多不同的取得方式，但其中之一是，使用力量權杖和任何附魔書合成。經驗瓶能灌注在書上變成經驗寶典。經驗寶典能右鍵使用保存經驗值，或將它與力量權杖合成製作升級核心。升級核心是是用來進行其他灌注的必需品，包含使用經驗瓶灌注升級核心製作經驗核心。說了這麼多希望你能懂。

atm9.quest.force.desc.eye.original: Spider Eye Infused with Weapons or Armor make your attacks inflict Bane. Not Arachnids Bane, but Bane the Effect. Bane takes away Creepers ability to explode and Endermens ability to Teleport.
atm9.quest.force.desc.eye.translation: 用蜘蛛眼灌注力量武器或裝備賦予禁制效果。不是節肢剋星，而是禁制效果。禁制能奪走苦力怕爆炸的能力，以及終界使者的傳送能力。

atm9.quest.force.desc.feather.original: This will give Force Swords a special move to dash forwards with right click.
atm9.quest.force.desc.feather.translation: 賦予力量劍一種特殊的移動方式，右鍵使用向前突進。

atm9.quest.force.desc.flask.original: With a similar recipe to bottles, Force Flasks are much different. They can hold Liquid Force, Milk, or animals. Shift Right click to toss the Flask at a Mob to capture them. Right click to release them.
atm9.quest.force.desc.flask.translation: 雖然和玻璃瓶的配方長得很像，力量燒瓶的功能大有不同。它能裝液態力量，牛奶，或是動物。對生物 Shift 右鍵丟出燒瓶將其捕捉。右鍵使用放出。

atm9.quest.force.desc.flint.original: By Infusing an Upgrade Core with Flint you'll get a Grinding Core. Yes, Cores are needed to Tier up.
atm9.quest.force.desc.flint.translation: 使用燧石灌注升級核心會取得研磨核心。沒有錯，研磨核心是升級必要的灌注。

atm9.quest.force.desc.forcecraft.original:
Say 'Helllo' to ForceCraft!

This mod focuses on the power of Force and using it to Infuse items!

Everything is yellow!
atm9.quest.force.desc.forcecraft.translation:
向力量工藝說聲「嗨」！

這個模組專注一種稱為「力量」的能量，並用來灌注物品！ 
 
全部都是黃色的！

atm9.quest.force.desc.fortune.original: Crafting Paper and a Cookie makes a Fortune Cookie! You can eat it, craft it with a Force Rod to get a Fortune, or Infuse with it. Infusing it with a Pickaxe gives Fortune, a Sword gives Looting, and Bow or Armor gives Luck Effect.
atm9.quest.force.desc.fortune.translation: 用紙和餅乾能做出幸運餅乾！你可以吃下肚，或和力量權杖合成取得幸運籤，或拿來灌注。用幸運餅乾灌注力量鎬賦予幸運效果，力量劍賦予掠奪，弓或裝備賦予幸運效果。

atm9.quest.force.desc.fuel.original: To work the Infuser needs Fuel and Power. Fuel comes from Force Gems you can put in the Infuser or even Pipe in Liquid Force. Power needs RF, heck you can just put a Wind Generator next to it and it'll be fineee!
atm9.quest.force.desc.fuel.translation: 進行灌注會需要燃料與電。燃料由力量寶石提供，你能直接放入灌注台中，或是直接用管道輸入液態力量。電則是 RF，反正你在旁邊放個風力發電機就可以了，沒事的啦！

atm9.quest.force.desc.furnace.original: Force Furnace works like a normal Furnace just with Core slot.
atm9.quest.force.desc.furnace.translation: 力量熔爐和普通熔爐的功能一樣，只是多了核心的欄位。

atm9.quest.force.desc.glow.original: Glowstone can be used on Force Rod or Bow to make whatever they hit Glow. Very exciting last Tier Infusion.
atm9.quest.force.desc.glow.translation: 螢光石能灌注在力量權杖或力量弓上，使其擊中的生物發光。最高等級的灌注就這，真是感人。

atm9.quest.force.desc.heat.original: Infusing an Upgrade Core with a Golden Power Source makes a Heat Core. Which is needed to craft the ATM Star!
atm9.quest.force.desc.heat.translation: 用金色能量源灌注升級核心製作高溫核心。這同時也是製作 ATM 之星所需的材料！

atm9.quest.force.desc.inert.original: The Force Engine can use more than just liquids, it can also use a Nether Star! By putting one in the Engine you can make tons of power. But once it's drained you're left with an Inert Core which can be used by...
atm9.quest.force.desc.inert.translation: 力量引擎不只能使用液體發電，也能使用地獄之星！一顆地獄之星能發出大量的電。但一旦榨乾後，會變成惰性核心，這是用來...

atm9.quest.force.desc.infuser.original: Now this is where the fun happens. Place down the Infuser and you'll notice a few parts in it's GUI. Top Left is for the Upgrade Tome, below it is where the Force Fuel goes and stays. The far right is where power will be, yes it needs RF power. The middle is where Infusing happens. Middle square is where the item to be Infused goes, like swords or armor. The ones around it is for the Infusees like Force Nuggets or Claws. The top right button in the middle brings up the Book if you have it and the bottom left is to complete the Infusion.
atm9.quest.force.desc.infuser.translation: 這是這個模組最有趣的核心機制了。將灌注台放出來，點開介面，你會看到分為幾個部分。左上方欄位是放置升級寶典的，其下方是力量燃料補充的地方。最右邊是能量欄，是的，它需要電。中間的部分則是進行灌注的地方。正中央是放入想要灌注的物品的欄位，像是劍或是裝備。圍繞著它的是放入灌注材料的欄位，像是力量粒或是蝙蝠爪。中間右上方的問號按鈕點擊後，會直接打開該模組的說明書。中間左下的箭頭按鈕，是一切就緒後開始灌注的按鈕。

atm9.quest.force.desc.ingot.original: Force Ingots are what most tools and items will be made of. Listen carefully though, the recipe is kinda confusing. You take 1 Force Gem and either 2 Gold Ingots or 2 Iron Ingots and you get Force Ingot!
atm9.quest.force.desc.ingot.translation: 力量錠是大多數工具和物品製作的材料。仔細聽好，這個配方有點困惑。拿一個力量寶石和兩個金錠或兩個鐵錠合成，就能取得力量錠！

atm9.quest.force.desc.invis.original: You can Infuse with an Invisibility Potion to give Armor Camo, or make a Force Rod Invisible. Armor with Camo will not make you Invisible it just won't show your Armor, just your skin.
atm9.quest.force.desc.invis.translation: 使用隱形藥水灌注力量裝備賦予迷彩效果，或灌注力量權杖賦予隱形效果。迷彩裝備不會讓你隱形，只是不會顯示你的裝備，就只有你。

atm9.quest.force.desc.liquid.original: Liquid Force is an important part of Force Craft. You can mainly get it from the Infuser, just right click it with an empty Bucket or Flask.
atm9.quest.force.desc.liquid.translation: 液態力量是力量工藝一個重要的部分。你主要能從灌注台中取得，只要拿著鐵桶或燒瓶對它右鍵。

atm9.quest.force.desc.lumberjack.original: Lumberjack is only used with Force Axes, by Infusing them with Force Wood. Lumberjack will make it so any Logs above or below the Log you cut down will also be cut down.
atm9.quest.force.desc.lumberjack.translation: 伐木效果只能灌注在力量斧上，使用力量木原木灌注。伐木的效果是，砍伐任何原木時，其正上方或正下方的原木能同時被砍下。

atm9.quest.force.desc.nugget.original: The Force Nugget can be used to Infuse with a Force Sword or Force Axe, and will give them knockback!
atm9.quest.force.desc.nugget.translation: 力量粒能灌注在力量劍或力量斧上，賦予擊退效果！

atm9.quest.force.desc.obsidian.original: Infusing items with Obsidian gives them Unbreaking! Remember to use multiple.
atm9.quest.force.desc.obsidian.translation: 用黑曜石灌注物品賦予耐久效果！記得多放幾個。

atm9.quest.force.desc.pack.original: Force Pack acts as a Backpack but with limited space and can't be placed on you. You can upgrade them with Infusion through ForceCraft to increase their space. Shift Right Click to change color and name of it!
atm9.quest.force.desc.pack.translation: 力量背包的作用就是個空間有限背包，且不能穿戴在飾品欄中。你能透過該模組的灌注機制來升級，增加它的空間。手持它 Shift 右鍵能改變顏色並對它命名！

atm9.quest.force.desc.pack1.original: Force Pack can now hold 16 stacks or items!
atm9.quest.force.desc.pack1.translation: 力量背包現在有 16 格的儲物空間！

atm9.quest.force.desc.pack4.translation: 最終的背包升級，有 40 格！

atm9.quest.force.desc.pearl.original: Using an Ender Pearl with a Force Rod will allow you to teleport to a set location. A Sword with Ender will teleport a few blocks in the direction you're looking. A Bow with Ender Pearl Infusion will make mobs hit by the Bow's Arrows to teleport.
atm9.quest.force.desc.pearl.translation: 用終界珍珠灌注力量權杖賦予傳送效果，使你能傳送到綁定的座標。灌注力量劍，使其能傳送你至面對的方向一小段距離。灌注力量弓，射出的箭矢擊中的目標隨機傳送。

atm9.quest.force.desc.rod.original: The most important item in ForceCraft is arguably the Force Rod. First, you can only craft one with normal sticks which will give you one at 2 durability. I recommend using those on a Force Sapling so you can make a full durability one, but who am I to tell you what to do.
atm9.quest.force.desc.rod.translation: 力量工藝模組中最重要的物品，可以說是力量權杖了。剛開始，你只能用普通的木棍合成，但只會有兩點的耐久值。建議先用它來製作力量木樹苗，就能製作滿耐久的力量權杖，但你的遊戲你做主。

atm9.quest.force.desc.rods.original: Crafting one with a Force Stick gives you one at full durability.
atm9.quest.force.desc.rods.translation: 用力量木棒製作的力量權杖，會是滿耐久的。

atm9.quest.force.desc.sapling.original: Crafting a Force Rod with an Oak Sapling will give you a Force Sapling. It will grow into a Force Tree so you can get Force Wood to be crafted into Force Sticks. So much Force.
atm9.quest.force.desc.sapling.translation: 用一個力量權杖，和一個橡木樹苗合成會得到力量木樹苗。長大後變成力量木樹，砍下取得力量木原木，用來製作力量木棒。這句話也包含太多「力量」了吧！

atm9.quest.force.desc.shears.original: Now these are fun items. For Sheep they work as normal Shears, takes off their wool. But with the other farm animals it has unique uses. Cows will drop Leather, Chickens drop Feather, Pigs Drop Bacon! Once used though they will become cold. Cold animals can't be breed and will only drop meat.
atm9.quest.force.desc.shears.translation: 這個是個有趣的物品。對於剪刀來說，它能做到與普通剪刀一樣的事情，比如說剪羊毛。但對於一些其他眷養的動物，它有些獨特的用途。能對牛剪皮革，對雞剪羽毛，對豬剪培根！一旦剪過這些生物，它們會感到寒冷，變成愛斯基摩種。愛斯基摩種的動物無法繁殖，且擊殺只會掉落對應的肉。

atm9.quest.force.desc.snow.original: Snow Cookies which are crafted with a Snowball, by itself, nothing else just a Snowball. They can be used with an Upgrade Core to make a Freezing Core, or with a Force Bow to get Freezing on it. Currently on my test world Freezing just sets mobs on fire which is kinda ironic but maybe it'll be different for you!
atm9.quest.force.desc.snow.translation: 雪餅是由雪球合成的，只有它，沒有其他東西，就只有雪球。能用來灌注升級核心製作冰凍核心，或是灌注力量弓賦予冷凍效果。目前我測試的狀況是，冰凍效果只會讓生物著火，這有點諷刺，但或許對你而言會有所不同！

atm9.quest.force.desc.source.original: Golden Power Source comes from Smelting Force Wood. When used on a Force Sword or Axe it'll give it Fire Aspect. When used on Force Pickaxe or Shovel it will give it Heat, which will smelt any items mined with it. When used on Force Armor it gives more Damage to the Force Punch and sets the mobs on Fire. Infuse Armor with both the Claw and Golden Power Source to get both!
atm9.quest.force.desc.source.translation: 金色能量源是透過熔爐熔煉力量木而來的。當灌注在力量劍或斧上，賦予燃燒效果。當灌注在力量鎬或鏟上，賦予高溫效果，意思是挖掘方塊時會自動熔煉。當貫注在力量裝備上，賦予力量拳更多傷害且會使生物著火。同時使用蝙蝠爪與金色能量源灌注裝備，同時取得兩種效果！

atm9.quest.force.desc.speed.original: Infusing Sugar with an Upgrade Core gives you a Speed Core.
atm9.quest.force.desc.speed.translation: 使用糖灌注升級核心取得速度核心。

atm9.quest.force.desc.sugar.original: Sugar can be used to give Efficiency to Tools, make Arrows shoot and fly faster, or make Armor give you a Speed Buff. Also can be used with Force Punch items.
atm9.quest.force.desc.sugar.translation: 糖能賦予工具效率的效果，讓弓射得更快，飛得更快。或賦予裝備速度的效果。也能和力量拳的物品一起使用。

atm9.quest.force.desc.tear.original: These will give a Force Rod healing.
atm9.quest.force.desc.tear.translation: 賦予力量權杖治療效果。

atm9.quest.force.desc.tools.original: The Force Pickaxe has same Tier as an Iron Pickaxe, it can only mine up to Diamond Ores. The Sword does the same damage as a Diamond Sword. The Bow does the same damage as a normal bow. Axe and Shovel are the same.
atm9.quest.force.desc.tools.translation: 力量鎬有與鐵鎬相同的挖掘等級，最硬只能挖到鑽石礦。力量劍有與鑽石劍相同的傷害。力量弓有與普通弓相同的傷害。力量斧和力量鏟則與力量鎬相同。

atm9.quest.force.desc.treasure.original: Quite expensive, the Treasure Core is crafted with a Nether Star, 2 Diamonds, 4 Force Ingots, and 2 Force Ingot Blocks. It can be Infused onto Swords or Axes to give them Treasure buff. When mobs are killed by the Treasure buff they drop Treasure Cards to craft Spoils Bag.
atm9.quest.force.desc.treasure.translation: 相當昂貴，寶藏核心的合成需要一個地獄之星，兩個鑽石，四個力量錠，和兩個黃金方塊。可灌注在力量劍或力量斧上，賦予寶藏效果。當生物被寶藏效果的武器擊殺時，會掉落卡片，用來製作戰利品袋。

atm9.quest.force.desc.upgrade.original: The Upgrade Tome is what determines the Tier of Infusion. It starts off at Tier 0 and goes to 7. You need 2 thins to Tier up: Force Points and Mastery. You get Force Points from Infusing and Mastery comes from using every Infusion in that Tier. To get to Tier 1 you need to infuse with a Nugget and a Claw.
atm9.quest.force.desc.upgrade.translation: 升級寶典決定了你能進行哪些等級的灌注。剛開始是等級 0，最高是等級 7。需要兩種要素才能升級：力量點數和精通灌注。每次進行灌注能獲得力量點數，精通灌注則需要完成該等級所能進行的所有灌注項目。舉例來說，要升到等級 1，你需要使用力量粒和蝙蝠爪進行灌注。

atm9.quest.force.desc.web.original: Quite simple, it gives Silk Touch to Force Tools.
atm9.quest.force.desc.web.translation: 相當單存，賦予力量工具絲綢之觸的效果。

atm9.quest.force.desc.wither.original: Setting the Inert Core on Fire and Right Clicking it with a Force Rod you'll get a Bottled Wither. It will spawn a Wither ready to fight when Right Clicked on the ground. No waiting, no initial explosion, just Wither.
atm9.quest.force.desc.wither.translation: 將惰性核心丟入火中，然後拿力量權杖右鍵，你會拿到瓶裝凋零。對地板右鍵放出凋零，它會立即進入戰鬥狀態。沒有等待時間，沒有初始的爆炸，就是一個嗜血的凋零。

atm9.quest.force.flask.translation: 精靈球，我是說力量燒瓶

atm9.quest.generators.desc.augmentblasti.original: &4Augment&r: Blasting transforms your Iron Furnace to an Iron Blast Furnace! It will now only smelt Ores but at twice the speed! Yes this stacks with the effects of other Augments and different Tiers of Furnace.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.augmentfactor.original: &3Augment&r: Factory makes your Furnace more like the Smelting Factory from Mekanism. Instead of using Fuel it will now use Energy! Pipe in some Energy and it will start Smelting.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.augmentfuel.1.original: &2Augment&r: Fuel Efficiency is for all you Earth-Loving, Tree-Hugging, Captain Planet Embracing, Hippies. The Furnace consumes half of the amount of Fuel at the cost of half the time. Coal will not Smelt 8 items but rather 16!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.augmentgenera.original: &3Augment&r: Generator is the opposite of the &3Augment&r: Factory, instead of using Energy to Smelt, it Smelts for Energy. You will no longer smelt items in it, every Fuel used will be made into Energy! \n \n(I wonder if it's better to connect a Generator and Factory Furnaces instead of just using Fuel in one)

atm9.quest.generators.desc.augmentsmokin.original: &4Augment&r: Smoking transforms your Iron Furnace into an Iron Smoker. Now it will only smoke Food items but twice as fast! Like &4Augment&r: Blasting this one also stacks with other upgrades!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.augmentspeed..original: &2Augment&r: Speed makes it so your Furnace is faster! &bDiamond Furnace&r will instead smelt every 40 Ticks instead of 80 Ticks. At the cost of twice the Fuel usage.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.christmas.1.original: During Christmas all the Chests look like Presents... but the Furnaces just stick out like a sore thumb! Now that can be changed with the Wrapping Paper! You can Right Click it onto any &lIron Furnace&r and it'll be all set for the holiday season! And after the season is over you can Shift Right Click it to unwrap it!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.configuration.original: Like most Modded machines, Iron Furnaces has Configurations. Configs can be found by clicking the Top Left. There will be the Inputs, Outputs, and Redstone activation. The Redstone activation changes when the Furnace will smelt. The top buttons determine if it auto Inputs or Outputs, which means it will automatically move to and from connected Inventories. The boxes are each side of the Furnace and determine whether it Inputs, Outputs, does both, Inputs Fuel, or does nothing. This matters for Items being Piped in or out. The Furnace Settings Linker will copy all of these settings to other Furnaces!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.copperfurnace.original:
&6Copper&r is one if not the most common Ore you can find, so why not use a bunch of spare &6Copper&r to upgrade your furnace! 
 
Normal Furnaces take 200 Ticks to smelt 1 Item, (20 Ticks = 1 Second) while &6Copper Furnaces&r take 180 Ticks. 
 
They can be crafted into either &7Silver&r or &fIron Furnaces&r.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.coppergenerat.original: &lGenerator's Galore&r adds very simple Generators. The most basic ones act like Furnaces with &3Augment&r: Generator. They'll take Fuel and make it into Energy! \n \nYes you have to start with &6Copper Generator&r.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.crystalfurnac.original:
If &aEmeralds&r aren't your thing the &3Crystal Furnace&r might be what you want! 
 
Works the same as an &aEmerald Furnace&r at 40 Tick. 
 
Made with a &bDiamond Furnace&r and can be made into an &dObsidian Furnace&r. 
 
(No you can't see the Items smelting inside it, it's just transparent)

atm9.quest.generators.desc.culinarygener.original: Finally a unique Generator! Culinary is the name for the art of Food. These Generators don't take Coal, Lava, or even logs, they take Food. Anything with Food Points can be used to make Energy, the amount it makes is based off the amount of Food Points the Food consists of. Steak will give more Energy than a Carrot.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.diamondfurnac.original:
&bDiamonds&r the staple of &2Minecraft&r, and of upgraded Furnaces apparently...
 
These work even faster only taking 80 Ticks or 4 Seconds to smelt items. That's even faster than a Blast Furnace! 
 
These are only crafted by &eGold Furnaces&r and can be crafted into &3Crystal&r or &aEmerald Furnaces&r.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.diamondgenera.original: &bDiamonds&r are usually expensive... for Vanilla, but this is modded you'll have enough for atleast 1 &bDiamond Generator&r. Still uses normal Furnace Fuel.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.emeraldfurnac.original:
The &aEmerald Furnace&r, I wonder if Villagers will trade for it? 
 
It works at 40 Ticks or only 2 Seconds to smelt! Blink and you might miss it. 
 
These are crafted by &bDiamond Furnace&r and can be made into an &dObsidian Furnace&r.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.emeraldgenera.original: Very fast Rate of making Energy from Fuel which makes it the very efficient. Only problem is it can't be upgraded anymore. Still uses normal Furnace Fuel.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.enchantmentge.original: There's so many useless &5Enchantments&r out there, why not get some Energy out of them! The &bEnchantment Generator&r uses &5Enchanted Books&r to make Energy. The Level and Rarity of &5Enchanted Books&r changes the amount of Energy you get from them.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.endergenerato.original: I always hate when I have an &5Endermen&r Farm for either XP or Apotheosis Gems but end up with all these &3Ender Pearls&r (hehe end up, &3ender pearls&r). Now you can use those &3Ender Pearls&r for Energy with the &3Ender Generator&r. You can even make &aEyes of Ender&r for even more Energy!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.generatorintr.original: &lGenerator's Galore&r and &lIron Furnaces&r are two different but also similar mods. Both start with the legendary Furnace!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.goldenfurnace.original: The &eGolden Furnace&r is better than the Iron ones with a Cooktime of 120 Ticks.\n\nIt can be crafted with &7Silver&r or Iron Furnace and is crafted into a &bDiamond one&r!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.goldgenerator.original: Why are you surprised that &eGold&r is actually used in mods? You've seen it in real life it does plenty! Also opens up for more unique Generators that don't just take Furnace Fuel!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.halitosisgene.original: &dDragon's Breath&r is a powerful, (stinky), and mysterious item. Powerful means we can make Energy from it, and lots of it! &5Halitosis Generator&r makes Energy from &dDragon's Breath&r!.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.halloween.1.original: At the time of writing this it's the end of July so I've got about 3 months until Halloween. But it's never to early to start getting Spooky! Just like Spirit Halloween we can get Spooky 3 months before it actually starts. This time by Right Clicking a Furnace with the Spook-alator! Once it's time to start getting ready for Thanksgiving Shift Right Click them to Un-Spook-Alate!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.honeygenerato.original: If you know &l&6Productive Bees&r you should know LobsterJonn. He made &l&6Productive Bees&r and &lGenerator's Galore&r (along with many others). The &6Honey Generator&r is a good way of connecting both these mods! &6Honey Generator&r uses &6Liquid Honey&r to make Energy.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.ironfurnaces..original: Iron Furnaces (Don't be confused with each of the titles with &lIron Furnaces&r being the mod name and an Item name) work even faster than Normal and Copper Furnaces. They take 160 Ticks to work, or 8 seconds. \n \nThese can be crafted from either a normal Furnace or &6Copper Furnace&r! And they can be made into either a &7Silver Furnace&r or &eGold Furnace&r.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.irongenerator.original: Each upgrade upgrades everything, from the amount it makes to how much it can hold to what it can transfer to other blocks! \n \nYou'll need a &6Copper Generator&r to make an Iron Generator, sorry &6Copper&r haters.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.netheritefurn.original:
The best Vanilla gets! &5Netherite&r! Don't worry you won't need Smithing Template for it, just a lotta &5Netherite&r. 
 
It smelts an item every 5 Ticks which means 4 Items Smelted every Second. Yes it's no longer S.P.S. (Seconds per Smelt) it's now S.P.S. (Smelts per Seconds). 
 
Crafted from &dObsidian Furnace&r... wait this isn't the final Furnace?

atm9.quest.generators.desc.netheritegene.original: Makes Energy at the same rate as an &aEmerald Generator&r but has a much higher Transfer Rate. Also arguably cheaper as it takes less items but that item is also &5Netherite&r so...

atm9.quest.generators.desc.netherstargen.original: The most powerful and efficient Generator, the Netherstar Generator. Take a guess what it uses to make Energy!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.obsidianfurna.original:
It may be &dObsidian&r but don't worry you don't need a &bDiamond Pickaxe&r to pick it up, just to craft it. 
 
It works every 20 Ticks or every Second. Yeah not Seconds just Second. 
 
It can be crafted with a &3Crystal Furnace&r or &aEmerald Furnace&r, and can be crafted into a &5Netherite Furnace&r!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.obsidiangener.original: The &dObsidian Generator&r is slower than the &aEmerald&r and &5Netherite Generators&r but it has more upgrades than all of those combined!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.potiongenerat.original: Want something exciting and new to make Energy? What about using &dPotions&r for it! That's what the &dPotion Generator&r does, it will take your &dPotions&r and make Energy out of it depending on its strength and duration.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.rainbowcoal.1.original: You blew up the &cR&6a&ei&2n&3b&9o&5w &cF&6u&er&2n&3a&9c&5e&r?!?! Just lit TNT right next to it? Are you mad? That took so many Furnaces and resources and you just blew it up!!! Did you atleast get something good from it? &cR&6a&ei&2n&3b&9o&5w&r &cC&eo&3a&5l&r? Coal that lasts forever? Actually that's pretty worth it.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.rainbowcore.1.original: For this you need 2 &5Netherite Furnaces&r and 7 pieces of glass which are each the color of the Rainbow. &cRed&r, &6Orange&r, &eYellow&r, &2Green&r, &3Blue&r, &9Indig&r- &5Purple&r, and &5Vi&r-&dMagenta&r. Yep! The whole Roy G. Bpm!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.rainbowfurnac.original: The &cR&6a&ei&2n&3b&9o&5w&r &cF&6u&er&2n&3a&9c&5e&r needs quite literally every other Furnace to Craft. 8 &cR&6a&ei&2n&3b&9o&5w&r &cP&6l&ea&2t&3i&9n&5g&r and 1 &cR&6a&ei&2n&3b&9o&5w&r &cC&eo&3r&5e&r gives us the best Furnace we could imagine! \n \nYes it takes 20 Ticks to smelt or 1 Second to smelt, but it doesn't smelt 1 item. How many items you ask? How many is in a stack of items?

atm9.quest.generators.desc.rainbowgenera.original: The &cR&6a&ei&2n&3b&9o&5w &cG&6e&en&2e&3r&9a&5t&ce&6r&r is a boost to the &cR&6a&ei&2n&3b&9o&5w &cF&6u&er&2n&3a&9c&5e&r while using &3Augment&r: Generator. If all other 8 Furnaces (not counting &5Netherite Furnace&r) are around the &cR&6a&ei&2n&3b&9o&5w&r &cF&6u&er&2n&3a&9c&5e&r, have &3Augment&r: Generator, and are actively making Energy (fueled up and not full) they will give a boost to a &cR&6a&ei&2n&3b&9o&5w &cF&6u&er&2n&3a&9c&5e&r that has &3Augment&r: Generator and is working. It will make 50kFE a tick more!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.rainbowplatin.original: You'll need every Furnace before &5Netherite&r for these. Yes all, even the &6Copper&r! Even the &7Silver&r! Even the &3Crystal&r!

atm9.quest.generators.desc.silverfurnace.original: Following the same pattern, these ones smelt at 140 Ticks or 7 Seconds. \n \nThey can be crafted with &6Copper&r or Iron Furnaces and can be used to craft a &eGold Furnace&r.

atm9.quest.generators.desc.wirelessheat..original: Wireless Heat is a fun and easy way of powering Furnaces. First place the Wireless Heat Transmitter and put Energy into it. Then put the Receiver into the Transmitter to bind it. Finally put the Receiver into the Furnace Fuel section to start powering it!

atm9.quest.hostile.desc.data.original:
Once you make your first Data Model, you'll need to level it up to be useful.

Data Models start out at the first tier: &7Faulty&r. You'll need to at least level it to &aBasic&r if you'd like to run some simulations on it!

Once placed inside of the Deep Learner, the HUD will tell you how many kills are required to level it up. You can also see this info in the tooltip of the Model itself, although you'll have to do math.
atm9.quest.hostile.desc.data.translation:
當你建立了你的第一個資料模型，你會需要將它升級來讓它變得更實用。

資料模型一開始會是&7缺陷&r等級。你會需要讓它的等級至少為&a基礎&r才能開始使用它來進行模擬！

當你將它放在深度學習機之中時，該 HUD 會告訴你需要多少擊殺數才能到達下一個等級。你也可以從它的物品提示來查看該資訊，但你會需要自己算一些數學。

atm9.quest.hostile.desc.end.translation: 用來製作一些終界材料。

atm9.quest.hostile.desc.learn.original:
The &9Deep Learner&r is one of the core components of HNN.

With this item, you can right click to open up a HUD and store &6Data Models&r to gather data while killing mobs.

Each Learner can hold 4 Data Models, and as long as you have the Learner anywhere in your inventory, it will collect data for the models placed inside!

Note: You can have multiple Deep Learners in your inventory, and it will count the kills for all Data Models inside all of the Learners.
atm9.quest.hostile.desc.learn.translation:
&9深度學習機&r是 HNN 中的一個核心元件。

右鍵打開它的 HUD 並放入&6資料模型&r，就能夠在擊殺生物時收集到牠們的資料。

每個學習機能夠容納 4 個資料模型，且無論你將它放在物品欄內的任何位置，它都會幫裡面的模型收集資料。

註：你可以同時將多個深度學習機放在你的物品欄內，它會將擊殺數同時算在所有學習機裡面的資料模型之中。

atm9.quest.hostile.desc.loot.original:
The &5Loot Fabricator&r is the machine that gets you that sweet, sweet loot from Mob Predictions.

When given power and a successful Mob Prediction, you will be able to choose which item you'd like to get from that mob's Data Model. The machine will remember your choice, so it can be automated.

Notable Mob Predictions:

- &dEnder Dragons&r for &dDragon Eggs&r
- &2Zombies&r for Iron
- &0Withers&r for &5Nether Stars
atm9.quest.hostile.desc.loot.translation:
&5戰利品製造機&r是一台可以讓你從預測產物中獲得甜美戰利品的機器。

將它通電並放入一個生物預測時，你能夠選擇你想要從該資料模型中獲得的物品。機器會記住你的選擇，所以它可以進行自動化。

 值得關注的生物預測產物：

 - &d終界龍&r可以產出&d龍蛋&r
 - &2殭屍&r可以產出鐵錠
 - &0凋零怪&r可以產出&5地獄之星&r

atm9.quest.hostile.desc.modeling.original:
&9Model Frameworks&r are the starting point for creating Data Models.

To start collecting data on a specific mob, you'll want to make one of these then &9right click&r the mob you'd like to gather data on. When done properly, the Model Framework will turn into the Data Model of the mob you clicked on.

To 'gather data' for that mob, place the newly created Data Model inside of a &aDeep Learner&r, then start killing that specific mob with the Deep Learner in your inventory.
atm9.quest.hostile.desc.modeling.translation:
&9模型框架&r是建立資料模型的起點。

你會需要製作它並對你想要的生物&9點擊右鍵&r，才能開始收集特定生物的資料。如果你操作得當，模型框架會轉變為你剛點擊的生物的資料模型。

要幫該生物「收集資料」，你需要將剛建立的資料模型放在&a深度學習機&r之中，並在深度學習機位於你的物品欄之中時擊殺該特定生物。

atm9.quest.hostile.desc.nether.translation: 用來製作一些地獄材料。

atm9.quest.hostile.desc.overworld.translation: 用來製作一些主世界材料。

atm9.quest.hostile.desc.simulator.original:
The &dSimulation Chamber&r is the main machine within HNN.

When given power, it will run simulations based on the &bData Model&r that is placed inside. The power required also depends on the Data Model placed inside, and can be seen within the Model's tooltip.

The machine also requires at least one &9Prediction Matrix&r to run a simulation.

The result of the simulation will be output onto the Matrix. Simulations will always produce some kind of &eGeneralized Prediction&r, which can be used in various crafting recipes. They also vary depending on the origin of the mob in the Data Model.

If the simulation succeeds, you will receive a &dMob Prediction&r based off of the model. The higher the tier of the Data Model used, the higher the success rate is for a simulation.
atm9.quest.hostile.desc.simulator.translation:
&d戰鬥模擬室&r是HNN中的主要機器。

當它通電時，它會根據放入地&b資料模型&r進行模擬。它的電耗取決於放入的資料模型（可以從資料模型的物品提示中查看）。

該機器也會需要至少一個&9預測矩陣&r來進行模擬。

模擬的成果會輸出在Matrix上。模擬會產出各種可以用來合成一些物品的&e通用化預測產物&r。產物的種類取決於資料模型中的生物原型。

atm9.quest.hostile.desc.twilight.translation: 用來製作一些暮光森林材料。

atm9.quest.hostile.desc.welcome.original: &6Hostile Neural Networks&r (or HNN for short) is a mod based around simulating mob kills for loot!\n\nTo do this, you will be collecting 'data' on mobs, then running simulations from the data to create their drops!
atm9.quest.hostile.desc.welcome.translation: &6敵對生物神經網路（Hostile Neural Networks，簡稱 HNN）&r是一個基於模擬來擊殺生物並獲取戰利品的模組！\n\n要做到這件事，你必須要從生物身上收集到足夠的「資料」，並利用這些資料來進行模擬並製造牠們的掉落物！

atm9.quest.hostile.overworld.translation: 通用化主世界預測產物

atm9.quest.hostile.welcome.translation: 歡迎來到&9敵對生物神經網路&r！

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.bloc.original: Automate block placing/breaking using these, especially useful when automating latex.
atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.bloc.translation: 用這些自動放置/破壞方塊，特別是在乳膠自動化時很好用。

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.ethe.original: Getting your first &bEther Gas&r is going to be scary.
atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.ethe.translation: 取得你的第一桶&b乙醚氣體&r是一件有點恐怖的事情。

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.ethe.original: &bEther Gas&r is made from drilling a &0Wither&r, using a Fluid Drill with &5Purple Lens&r.
atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.ethe.translation: &b乙醚氣體&r是透過使用了&5紫色 雷射透鏡&r的流體雷射鑽來鑽取&0凋零&r以獲得的。

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.ethe.original: But worry not, Industrial Foregoing has a machine just to help you in that task: &4Stasis Chamber&r - this machine freezes in place anything that is on top, in a 3x3 area, so spawning a wither on there is safe.
atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.ethe.translation: 但不要擔心，《工業先鋒》模組中有一台機器能夠幫助你完成這個目標，&4靜滯室&r：一台能夠將頂部 3x3x3區域內的任何生物凍結的機器。所以在它的範圍之內生成凋零是非常安全的。

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.ethe.original: &cHope you don't run out of power, because if you do... well... i hope you are ready to fight the &0Wither&r.
atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.ethe.translation: &c希望你沒有把能源用光，因為如果用光了...嗯...希望你準備好要跟&0凋零&c戰鬥了。&r

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.flui.original: Check JEI for acceptable logs and latex amounts. Best log to use is Acacia.
atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.flui.translation: 透過 JEI 確認提取器所接受的原木類型，以及乳膠的提取量。\n\n相思木原木能提供的乳膠量最多。

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.give.original: When smelted, gives Plastic, which is the main resource in Industrial Foregoing
atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.give.translation: 當你將它熔煉之後，就能獲得塑膠片：《工業先鋒》模組中的主要資源。

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.lase.original: Use some sort of wither-proof glass.

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.late.original: Welcome to &bIndustrial Foregoing&r, one of the main resources in this mod, is &fLatex.&r It's used to craft machine frames, needed to make.. well... machines, and upgrades.
atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.late.translation: 歡迎來到&b工業先鋒&r，這個模組的主要資源是&f乳膠&r。它可以用來合成機器框架，當製作...嗯...機器，及升級的時候會用到它們。

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.late.original: Making Latex is pretty simple, &aFluid Extractor&r extracts Latex from &6Logs&r (Acacia gives the most).
atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.late.translation: 製造乳膠的方法很簡單，使用&a樹液提取器&r來從&6原木&r中提取出乳膠（相思木提供的乳膠量最多）。

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.late.original: Now about making Plastic: Plastic results from smelting Dry Rubber - which is made in the &aLatex Processing Unit&r, that transforms Latex into Dry Rubber.
atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.late.translation: 現在來講講該如何製造塑膠片：塑膠片能夠透過熔煉乾橡膠塊來獲得，而乾橡膠塊是透過將乳膠輸入進&a乳膠加工機&r來進行製造的。
&b所以基本上就是：乳膠→乾橡膠塊→塑膠片。&r

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.more.translation: 友善生物 -> 更多粉色史萊姆

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.myce.original: The &bMycelial Reactor&r consists of all the Mycelial Generators working at the same time, near the reactor block, and it produces a total of &a25MFE/t&r.
atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.myce.translation: &b菌絲網路反應爐&r由附近所有的處於發電狀態下的菌絲網路發電機所組成。\n\n它總共能產出 &a25M FE/t&r。

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.myce.original: That all sounds great, but you need to automate some stuff to get it working. Take a look at what each Mycelial Generator consumes to work, and automate it, so you have stable power generation. Most things are simple, but others, not so much... &osuch as the Disenchanting Mycelial Generator&r.
atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.myce.translation: 這聽起來還不錯對吧，但你會需要自動化一些東西來使它正常運作。查看每種菌絲網路發電機需要消耗什麼來運作，然後嘗試自動化它們，就能擁有穩定的電力來源。大多數的東西都很簡單，但有一些，就沒有那麼簡單了...&o例如菌絲網路附魔發電機&r。

atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.myce.original: But after you get it all automated, you don't need to stop at one, you can make more reactors.
atm9.quest.industrialForegoing.desc.myce.translation: 但當你擁有所有的自動化產線之後，你就不需要止步於一台反應爐，你可以製造更多台。

atm9.quest.ma.FarmStart.translation: 讓我們的農場開始運作吧！

atm9.quest.ma.Info.translation: 值得製作的一些酷東西

atm9.quest.ma.dec.SoulSand.original: To get started with Mystical Agriculture, we need Soul Sand. This was outlined in the &6&lGetting Started&r&r Quest Chapter.
atm9.quest.ma.dec.SoulSand.translation: 我們會需要一些靈魂砂以在《ATM9 翱翔天際》之中開始我們的《神祕農業》之旅。在&6&l由此開始&r任務章節中有提到如何製造靈魂砂。

atm9.quest.ma.dec.Welcome.original: Welcome to Mystical Agriculture, the place where you can farm most fundamental resources in the game!
atm9.quest.ma.dec.Welcome.translation: 歡迎來到《神秘農業》，在這裡你可以種植遊戲中最基本的資源！

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Animals.original: Mystical Agriculture allows you to farm Mob Drops! To get started you'll need Soulium.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Animals.translation: 你能夠使用《神秘農業》來獲取怪物（或動物）的掉落物！你會需要一些靈魂沙來進行下一步動作。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Apples.original: Just like Golden Apples, Essence Apples give effects that get better with the higher tier essence used. Insanium Apples are...&5&linsane&r&r.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Apples.translation: 精華蘋果有點類似於金蘋果：使用越高等級的精華來製作它，就能給予你越好的效果。\n\n而究極精華蘋果給予的效果非常的...&5&l究極&r。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Armor.original: Just stronger Diamond armor. Augments allow for this armor to give insane effects.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Armor.translation: 基本上就只是稍微好一點的鑽石盔甲。你可以為它們安裝升級來獲得各種強大的效果。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Augments.original: The Unattuned Augment is used in an Infusion Table to create various augments. Get Haste, Night Vision, Fall Damage Resistance, Fire Resistance, and much more with these OP augments!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Augments.translation: 空白升級用以在注魔祭壇中製造出各種升級。你能夠透過這些升級來獲得：挖掘加速、夜視、無視掉落傷害、抗火...等各種強大的效果！

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Bees.original: The Prosperibee will passivly generate Prosperity Shards, if you have the setup for it at least. This is harder than simply visiting The End so I recommend you come back to this quest later.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Bees.translation: 如果你操作得當，能夠利用活化水晶蜂來自動產出活化水晶碎片。這比去終界挖活化水晶回來還要難上許多，所以我建議你之後再回頭來使用這個方案。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.BoneM.original: The Infusion Altar needs Red Wool, which needs Red Dye, which needs red flowers. Bonemeal some dirt and get your red flowers!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.BoneM.translation: 你會需要使用紅花來製作紅色染料來製作紅色羊毛來製作注魔祭壇。有點拗口對吧，簡單來說就是你會需要對草地使用骨粉來獲得一朵紅花！

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Coal.original: Coal that burns longer, you can make it into blocks too.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Coal.translation: 更持久的燃料，你也可以將它們製作成方塊。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.ElementalSeeds.original: These elemental seeds, except for air, are used in tons of crafting recipes that will come very handy later on.\n\n&lYou will need all of them for &6Awakening&r later on...
atm9.quest.ma.desc.ElementalSeeds.translation: 除了風之種子之外的這些元素種子被廣泛運用在各種方便的合成配方之中。\n\n&l你會需要所有種類的元素種子來使用後面的&6覺醒&r&l功能...&r

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Farm.original: This farm is extremely simple and VERY fast, only problem is that it is manual. This is going to be fine for a while though, so get building!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Farm.translation: 此農場非常的簡單，也非常的快速，唯一的問題就是它需要人工。不過，在很長一段時間內這都會是一個好選擇，所以加緊建造一個吧！

atm9.quest.ma.desc.FarmStart.original: Plant your seeds, connect the Item Collector to a chest (preferably a Sophisticated  Storage Chest with Stack Upgrades), then spam &bsneak&r while holding your ultimine keybind and spamming &bright click&r!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.FarmStart.translation: 種下你的種子、將你的物品收集器連接到儲物箱（最好是安裝了堆疊升級的《精巧儲存》儲物箱），然後開始施展&b蹲下跳舞&r，你就能在按住你的連鎖挖礦鍵時狂點&b右鍵&r來感受你的農場的效率了！

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Farmreq.original: A single water source block can supply a 9x9 area of farmland, which is 80 farmland. The issue is you don't have much dirt early on, so start by building a 5x5 square with water in the center!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Farmreq.translation: 一格水方塊可以灌溉 9x9 區域的耕地，總共是 80 個耕地。但你前期可能沒有這麼多的泥土，所以先從建造一個 5x5 的農田開始！

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Furnace.original: Just a better Furnace. Would recommend over Iron Furnaces if you don't have power.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Furnace.translation: 基本上就只是一個更好的熔爐。只有在你還沒有電力的情況下才會比《鐵熔爐》模組中的熔爐更好用。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.IA.original: The Infusion Altar is how you are going to make all of your seeds. Place the Altar first and it'll show you where to place the Pedestals after.\n\nRemember to give the Altar a &cRedstone&r pulse for it start infusing! (Just use a lever next to it).
atm9.quest.ma.desc.IA.translation: 注魔祭壇是你用來製作所有種子的地方。先將祭壇放下，然後它就會告訴你注魔基座的擺放位置。\n\n記得要給予注魔祭壇&c紅石&r訊號來使它開始注魔！（放個控制桿在它旁邊）

atm9.quest.ma.desc.IC.original: You can farm a lot of crops by holding your ultimine keybind (default is `) and right clicking the crops. This will drop a lot of crops and the Item Collector will come in handy by storing them in a chest for you!\n\nIf you only have one pearl, multiply it using ProjectE first! Don't waste it here.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.IC.translation: 你可以透過在按住你的連鎖挖礦鍵（預設為「`」，在 1 的左邊）時右鍵點擊作物來一次性採收它們。而這會一次掉落很多的作物，所以最好製作一個物品收集器來幫你自動將它們存入儲物箱中。\n\n如果你只有一顆終界珍珠，記得先使用《等價交換》將其複製，別在此處浪費掉了。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.IE.original:
You will need thousands, no, TENS of thousands of Inferium Essence so start by getting just one stack.

Next to each essence will be listed some of the seeds you will use most, in the case of inferium, this is dirt, stone, and elemental seeds.

&lThe seeds listed in this questline aren't ALL of the seeds in Mystical Agriculture, always check resources for whether they have an essence crafting recipe!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.IE.translation:
你會需要數以千計，不，成千上萬的下級精華，所以讓我們從獲得一組下級精華開始。

每個精華的旁邊都將列出一些最常用到的種子，在下級精華等級之中，最常用到的就是泥土、石頭以及那些元素種子。

&l任務線列出的這些種子「並非」《神祕農業》模組中的「所有」種子，記得要常查詢你所需要的資源是否能夠使用精華來合成！&r

atm9.quest.ma.desc.IS.original: Inferium is the lowest tier essence in the game. You can get it by killing mobs or mining it in the end, but you will need a &lLOT&r, these seeds are going to come in pretty handy.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.IS.translation: 下級精華是本模組中等級最低的精華。你可以透過擊殺怪物或是到終界挖礦來取得它，但你會需要&l非常多&r，所以這些下級精華種子將能夠派上用場。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Info.original: Essences allow you to create a lot of useful stuff, ranging from anti-fall damage boots, to apples way better than even &denchanted golden apples&r. I &lhighly&r recommend checking out the chapters below even though they aren't necessary for progression.\n\nAll of the following items are available for all tiers of essences, from Inferium to Supremium
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Info.translation: 你可以利用精華來製作出一些有用的東西，從讓你不會摔傷的靴子，到比&d附魔金蘋果&r更好的蘋果...應有盡有。我&l極度&r推薦你去查看下面那些任務，就算它們對於對於你的遊戲進程來說不是必要的。\n\n以下的所有物品都能夠用所有等級（從下級到終極）的精華來製作。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.InfusionCrystal.original: Infusion Crystals are needed to upgrade lower tiers of essence to higher tiers, in this case, Inferium to Prudentium. Better crystals are needed for even higher tiers.\n\nNote: Essences can be crafted down into lower tiers.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.InfusionCrystal.translation: 你需要使用注魔水晶來將低等級的精華製作成更高等級的精華，以現在來說，就是將下級精華製作成初級精華。在更高的等級會需要使用更好的注魔水晶。\n\n註：高等級的精華能夠被直接分解為低等級的精華。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Mesh.original: The Infusion Altar needs gold, and if you haven't gotten any automated sieving yet, your best bet would be running a ton of gravel through a Sieve with a &eGold Mesh&r.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Mesh.translation: 注魔祭壇需要使用黃金來製作，如果你現在還沒有任何自動篩礦裝置的話，你最好的選擇就是使用&e黃金篩網&r篩大量的礫石來獲得黃金。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.PSB.original: The Prosperity Seed Base is used in an Infusion Alter to turn it into a certain type of seed. You will need a lot of these.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.PSB.translation: 活化種子基底是用以在注魔祭壇之中製作其他種子的一種材料。（你會需要非常多）

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Prosperity.original: Prosperity Shards are the core of Mystical Agriculture, being used in tons of crafting recipes!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Prosperity.translation: 活化水晶碎片是《神秘農業》模組中的核心原料，需要用它來製作非常大量的物品！

atm9.quest.ma.desc.SSeedBase.original: Just like the Prosperity Seed Base was used to make Resource Seeds, the Soulium Seed Base is used to make Mob Seeds!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.SSeedBase.translation: 就像要用活化水晶種子基底來製作出資源種子那樣：必須要用靈魂種子基底才能製作出生物種子！

atm9.quest.ma.desc.SSeeds.original: No one wants to sieve a thousand Soul Sand for some Soulium, so it's highly recommended to make Soulium Seeds!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.SSeeds.translation: 沒有人會想要篩大量的靈魂砂來獲得靈魂沙，所以我建議你製作一些 Soulium種子。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.SSpawner.original: Uses mob essence to spawn the mob, pretty useful for what's to come...
atm9.quest.ma.desc.SSpawner.translation: 使用生物精華來生成生物，對於上面的那條任務線非常有用。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.SSprocessing.original: Soulium is rather rare, so your best bet is a Diamond Mesh and A LOT of Soul Sand.\n\nHint: Steal some from Nether Fortresses!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.SSprocessing.translation: 靈魂沙有一點點稀有，所以你最好使用鑽石篩網和一 大 堆的靈魂沙。\n\n提示：從地獄堡壘偷一些！

atm9.quest.ma.desc.SoulDagger.original: To turn mobs into seeds, we need to kill lots of them (or use a Soul Extractor). Make one Soulium Dagger, then kill mobs with it in order to fill Soul Jars (they must be in your inventory).
atm9.quest.ma.desc.SoulDagger.translation: 我們需要擊殺一定數量的特定生物（或是使用靈魂提取器）來將它們轉化為種子：製作一把靈魂匕首，並用它擊殺生物來填滿你物品欄中的靈魂瓶。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.SoulExtractor.original: Uses mob drops, such as Wool, to fill Soul Jars.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.SoulExtractor.translation: 能夠使用像是羊毛之類的生物掉落物來填滿靈魂瓶。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.SoulStone.original: Next up, we need Soul Stone. Normally we'd find it in the nether, but now there's nothing there. However, placing an Igneous Extruder on top of a Soulium Block, then placing Water and Lava on both sides of the Extruder, will generate tons of Soul Stone!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.SoulStone.translation: 接下來，我們會需要一些靈魂石。一般情況下，我們會去地獄尋找它們，但現在地獄空空如也。\n\n所以我們會需要用到岩石擠製機：將它放在靈魂方塊的上方，並在它的兩端分別放置水和熔岩，接下來它就會開始產出大量的靈魂石了。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.SupremiumGear.original: Supremium tools are unbreakable. Seriously.\n\nArmor is REALLY strong but not unbreakable
atm9.quest.ma.desc.SupremiumGear.translation: 終極精華工具是無法破壞的。我講認真的。\n\n而終極精華盔甲則是非常強大但並非無法破壞的。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.TT.original: Use the tinkering table to add these augments to your essence gear!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.TT.translation: 使用工具裝配台來將這些升級裝到你的精華系列道具之上！

atm9.quest.ma.desc.TheEnd.original: The End happens to be completely normal in this empty world, and there happens to be plenty of Prosperity Ore there. If you're tired of sieving Soul Sand, go visit The End!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.TheEnd.translation: 就算是在這個空曠的世界之中，終界的生成機制還是與原版無異，所以終界具有豐富的活化水晶礦。如果你對篩靈魂砂感到厭煩的話，不妨去終界逛逛！

atm9.quest.ma.desc.UltimatePhyto.original: The fastest augments for a Phyto, good job.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.UltimatePhyto.translation: 對於有機灌注器來說最快的增強，幹得好。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Upgrade.original: Used to speed up Mystical Agriculture machines, like the Soul Extractor.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Upgrade.translation: 能夠用來讓像是靈魂提取器之類的《神秘農業》機器加速。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Upgrades.original: Phytos are pretty dang slow, but with these upgrades, you can go &lWAY&r faster. 3 Flux Linkage Amplifiers and 1 Integral Component is the fastest combination. Right click to install these augments, or click the augment tab inside the Phyto.\n\nNow we just need to automate the Phytos.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Upgrades.translation: 有機灌注器現在的運作速度非常慢，但在安裝了這些增強之後，它們就能&l更加&r快速的運作。3 個通量鏈結放大器 + 1 個整合元件是最快的組合方案。對著有機灌注器右鍵來安裝這些增強，或是點開有機灌注器介面裡的增強頁面。\n\n現在我們只需要讓有機灌注器能夠自動化就大功告成了。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.Weapons.original: Inferium tools and weapons start off similar to Diamond, but get INSANELY strong later on. Augments can be used to give effects, definitely worth it
atm9.quest.ma.desc.Weapons.translation: 下級精華的工具和武器與鑽石製的基本上相同，但它們升級的幅度很誇張。你也可以為它們安裝升級來獲得各種效果，這絕對值得。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.ae2.original: AE2 is much easier than SFM for Phyto automation, but it is more resource-heavy and requires you to already have an AE2 system set up.\n\nHere is a tutorial on how to automate a bunch of phytos with AE2: https://allthemods.github.io/alltheguides/atm9/mysticalagriculture/#the-modules
atm9.quest.ma.desc.ae2.translation:
使用 AE2 來進行有機灌注器的自動化要比使用 SFM 還要更簡單，但它會需要使用更多的資源，也需要你已經有一套正在運行的 AE2 系統。

以下是使用 AE2 來自動化大量有機灌注器的教學（英文）：
https://allthemods.github.io/alltheguides/atm9/mysticalagriculture/#the-modules

atm9.quest.ma.desc.asbee.translation: 很好，一個無限的覺醒的終極精華來源。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.awakeningaltar.original: Same deal as the Infusion Altar, but now uses Essence Vessels. Remember to give redstone power to the altar.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.awakeningaltar.translation: 與注魔祭壇的運作方式相同，但現在會需要使用精華容器。記得要為祭壇提供紅石訊號。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.buildlily.original:
This farm design is by AlfredGG, and here is the tutorial to build the farm: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iLSlFHweJsI

Remember, ignore the bottom lilypad layer, just have the lilypads surround the dirt.

You can always add the 289 lilypads under if you WANT to.. but those aren't exactly easy to come by.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.buildlily.translation:
此農場由 AlfredGG 所設計，以下是農場的建造教學：
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iLSlFHweJsI
（BEST Mystical Agriculture Farm Design | All The Mods 8）

記得，忽略掉最下面的那層蓮葉，只要放上圍繞著泥土的那些。

如果你想要，你隨時都可以在下方加上那 289 朵蓮葉...但取得那些材料並不簡單。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.cognizant.original: If you want the best essence for your tools and armor, then awakening is the way to go. Start by getting Cognizant Dust by killing a Wither or Ender Dragon with a weapon enchanted with &bMystical Enlightenment&r.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.cognizant.translation: 如果你想要為你的工具和盔甲取得最強的精華，你就必須借助「覺醒」之力。\n\n我們要先用附魔著&b神秘啟蒙&r的武器擊殺凋零怪或終界龍來獲得認知粉。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.cognizantdust.original: You can only awaken a &4Supremium Block&r, but after you do, you can uncraft it into Awakened Supremium Essence.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.cognizantdust.translation: 你只能使用&4終極精華方塊&r來進行覺醒，但在這之後，你可以將它分解為覺醒的終極精華。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.craftert3.original: The Crafter Tier 3 was outlined in the &6&lGetting Started&r&r Quest Chaptere, but for crafting essences it's a little different. If you click the 'EXT' at the top you can change it to either INT or EXTc. INT means the crafting result will stay in the crafter, and EXTc means only reusable items will stay in the Crystal (like the Master Infusion Crystal).\n\nTo autocraft essences, create a crafting recipe for each tier of essence with the Master Infusion Crystal and set them to INT. For the last essence, Insanium, set it to EXTc.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.craftert3.translation:
我們在&5&l由此開始：第二部分&r章節中，有稍微提到過自動合成機（三階），但用它來合成精華會稍微有點不同。

點擊上面的「Ext」按鈕能夠將該合成配方切換至「Int」或「ExtC」模式。處於「Int」模式的合成配方會將合成出來的物品留在合成機之中，而「ExtC」模式則只會將能夠重複使用的物品（像是終極注魔水晶）留在合成機之中

要用它來自動合成精華的話，你會需要將每個等級的精華的合成配方都設定為「Int」模式，並將究極精華的合成配方設定為「ExtC」模式。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.crux.original: Needs to be placed below the seeds above in order for them to grow (Phyto's ignore this).
atm9.quest.ma.desc.crux.translation: 必須放置在種子的耕地下方，耕地上的種子才會開始正常生長（有機灌注器能夠無視此特性）。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.cyclical.original: Don't want to deal with cycling seeds externally? The Cyclical Processing Augment will keep the seeds inside the Phyto at all times, at the cost of a Flux Linkage Amplifier. :(
atm9.quest.ma.desc.cyclical.translation: 不想要外部循環處理這些種子？循環處理器能夠幫你自動將種子留在有機灌注器之內，但代價就是你會少安裝一個通量鏈結放大器。:(

atm9.quest.ma.desc.inferiumcan.original: Watering plants with a Watering Can increases their growth speed by a lot, and the Modular Router below will automatically water the crops below. Don't worry, there will be a proper tutorial at the end.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.inferiumcan.translation: 使用澆水壺為作物澆水能夠讓它們的生長速度提升很多，下面那個任務的模組化路由器能夠自動幫你的作物澆水。\n\n不用擔心，在最後一個任務會提供教學影片的連結（英文）。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.lilypadpath.original: &aLilypad Farms&r use Lilypads of Fertility to make crops grow in less than a second, this option is faster for mass resource production but is laggier.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.lilypadpath.translation: &a蓮葉農場&r使用豐饒蓮葉來讓作物能夠在不到一秒的時間內成熟，這種方法對於大規模種植同種作物來說速度更快，但是會造成較高的卡頓。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.lilypads.original: It's time to craft the part of the farm that truly makes it the fastest. The video showcasing the true max farm has an additional bottom layer with &l289&r more lilypads... you can do this but I really don't recommend (it will take forever).
atm9.quest.ma.desc.lilypads.translation: 是時候來製作能夠讓你的農場蛻變為世界上最快的農場的那個物品了。教學影片中展示了一種在最下方額外增加一層總共 &l289&r 朵蓮葉的來讓你的農場達到頂速的方案...你可以學他那樣蓋，但我不太推薦（你要花上一輩子來收集這些掉落物）。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.mastercrys.original: The Master Infusion Crystal can be used to upgrade all tiers of essence, great for autocrafting higher tier essences.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.mastercrys.translation: 終極注魔水晶能夠用來合成所有等級的精華，很適合用來自動合成高等級精華。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.modelframe.original: Now you just need a Data Model for Creepers, Skeletons, and Slimes. Go get each one and then dabble in the &aHostile Neural Networks&r Quest Chapter until you have these bad boys fabricating the mob drops you need.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.modelframe.translation: 現在你只需要訓練出苦力怕、骷髏和史萊姆的資料模型。去拿到每一種資料模型，然後跟著&a《敵對生物神經網路》&r任務章節走，直到你能夠讓這些怪物製造出你需要的掉落物。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.modrouter.original: These will water your plants, harvest your crops, and pick up the crops!\n\nThe quests branching off from here are all the modules that will be responsible for your modular routers working.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.modrouter.translation: 它們能夠灌溉、採收並撿起你的作物！\n\n此任務的那些分支是所有負責讓你的模組化路由器運作的升級和模組。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.niterDust.original: Use this dust to create Saltpeter Seeds in an Infusion Altar.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.niterDust.translation: 使用硝石粉以在注魔祭壇中製造出硝石種子。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.opt.original: Mystical Agriculture can get insanely fast, and there are two options.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.opt.translation: 使用接下來的這兩種方法可以讓你的《神秘農業》農田快到非常瘋狂的速度。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.phyto.original: This is the Phyto, the thing that will be doing the farming. It uses Water and power to grow seeds.\n\nYou technically don't need the rest of this questline, but it will teach you how to design the fastest Phyto Farm.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.phyto.translation: 這是有機灌注器：能夠模擬種植過程的一台機器。它會消耗水和電力來使種子生長。\n\n理論上你不需要接下來的這些任務中的物品，但它們能夠幫助你更好的設計出一個最快速的有機灌注器農場。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.phytogro.original:
Congratulations on making Phyto-Gro! Now all your Phytos will output triple what they normally would.

Why did I have you make seeds for all of those? Well, you can now grow resources needed for Phyto-Gro, and have an infinite supply.

THE PHYTO INDUSTRY BEGINS.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.phytogro.translation:
恭喜你做出了植育一號！現在你的所有的有機灌注器都能產出三倍數量的產物了。

為什麼我剛剛要叫你製造出那些種子？嗯...你現在就可以將它們放進有機灌注器之中來為你提供無限的值育一號了。

有 機 灌 注 器 產 業 鏈 啟 動

atm9.quest.ma.desc.phytopath.original: &ePhytogenic Insolators&r use water, power, and fertilizers to grow crops really fast. These are faster per seed than a lilypad farm, but are a lot harder to automate and need augments to be fast.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.phytopath.translation: &e有機灌注器&r使用水、電力和肥料來讓作物能夠快速成熟。它們在單個種子的生長速度上比蓮葉農場更快，但也更難自動化，而且必須要幫它們裝上增強才有足夠的效率。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.phytosetup.original: If you chose AE2 or SFM you can automatically send in and out the stuff the Phytos need. If you went the lazy option then you should use a logistics mod like &bXnet&r to send power, water, fertilizer, and recieve the harvest all with one cable.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.phytosetup.translation: 如果你是使用 AE2 或 SFM 的話，你可以很方便的進行各種自動輸入及輸出。\n\n但如果你是使用懶人選項的話，你就要使用像是&bXnet&r之類的物流模組來同時在一條纜線內輸送電力、水、肥料、和作物。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.pulv.original: The pulverizer is necessary to get resources for phyto-gro, the fertilizer that will &lTRIPLE&r the output of your phytogenic insolators.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.pulv.translation: 磨粉機是你製造出植育一號的材料所要使用的必要機器，植育一號會將你的有機灌注器的產出提高&l三倍&r。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.redfert.original: Red Fertilizer can only be placed on normal Dirt, but it seriously increases growth speed. 160 will be needed for the MAX speed Lilypad Farm.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.redfert.translation: 紅色肥料能夠被施於一般的耕地之中，它會讓作物的生長速度顯著提升。你會需要 160 個紅色肥料來蓋出一個全速運轉的蓮葉農場。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.saltpseeds.original: These seeds grow Saltpeter Essence, which can be turned into Potassium Nitrate Dust.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.saltpseeds.translation: 硝石種子能夠產出硝石精華，我們會需要用到硝石精華來合成出硝酸鉀粉。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.sand.original: Dirt and Fire Essence combine to make Sand, make some seeds for these.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.sand.translation: 使用泥土精華和火焰精華能夠製作出沙子，製作一些這些種子。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.securityup.original: These aren't mentioned in the tutorial but are necessary for Modular Routers to work in Claimed Chunks.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.securityup.translation: 教學中沒有提到它，但如果你要在已認領的區塊中使用模組化路由器的話，就需要使用它。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.sfm.original: Super Factory Manager (SFM) is the best way to build a MASSIVE phyto farm, except you have to code.. seriously.\n\nIf you are determined then here is the tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pWWBxvNbogs
atm9.quest.ma.desc.sfm.translation:
超級工廠管理器（Super Factory Manager，簡稱 SFM）是建造一個巨型有機灌注器農場的最好方式，但你會需要編程...我講認真的。

如果你下定決心想要學習此模組的話，可以看看這個教學影片（英文）：
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pWWBxvNbogs

atm9.quest.ma.desc.simchamber.original: &aLilypads of Fertility&r need some really rare mob drops to be crafted, but thankfully, simulating these mobs inside a &bSimulation Chamber&r can produce these mob drops for you!
atm9.quest.ma.desc.simchamber.translation: &a豐饒蓮葉&r會需要使用一些非常稀有的怪物掉落物來合成，但謝天謝地，我們可以透過&b戰鬥模擬室&r來模擬這些怪物，並自動生產它們的掉落物！

atm9.quest.ma.desc.sink.original: Infinite Water to feed your thirsty phytos.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.sink.translation: 用來幫你的有機灌注器解渴的無限水源。

atm9.quest.ma.desc.slimegate.original: Creepers, Skeletons, and Slimes are needed to craft &aLilypads of Fertility&r. Creepers and Skeletons are easy with a vanilla mob farm, but slimes are not. The easiest way to get a bunch of slimes for your Data Model is through this Slime Gate.
atm9.quest.ma.desc.slimegate.translation: 我們會需要苦力怕、骷髏和史萊姆的稀有掉落物來合成&a豐饒蓮葉&r。原版的怪物農場能夠很容易的產出前兩種怪物，但史萊姆除外。\n\n最容易獲取用來訓練你的資料模型的大量史萊姆的方法就是這個：史萊姆傳送門。

atm9.quest.ma.elementalseeds.original: 'Long ago, these lived in harmony together'

atm9.quest.ma.subt.SSeeds.translation: 對篩靈魂砂感到厭煩了？

atm9.quest.mekanism.allInOneTool.translation: 通用機械的多合一工具

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.additionalMachi.original: We will need to add 3 more machines to our current setup.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.additionalMachi.translation: 我們會需要三台機器來升級礦物處理產線。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.additionalMachi.original: The first part of the process is the Chemical Dissolution Chamber.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.additionalMachi.translation: 第一台機器是化學溶解室。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.additionalMachi.original: This machine requires &aSulfuric Acid&r to break down raw ores into an \"Ore Slurry.\"
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.additionalMachi.translation: 化學溶解室用&a硫酸&r將原礦分解成「汙濁漿液」。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.additionalMachi.original: To get Sulfuric Acid, we'll need a new setup, which is explained further in the above quests.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.additionalMachi.translation: 在後面的任務中將會介紹如何製造硫酸。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.antimatterPelle.original: Now that we have some experience working with more advanced machinery, it's time to move towards making &dAntimatter Pellets&r.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.antimatterPelle.translation: 現在我們已經會用較為高階的機器了，現在讓我們更進一步，將目標放在&d反物質球&r上。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.antimatterPelle.original: These create several &5End Game&r items, including the &6ATM Star&r. To learn all about Reactors and more, head over to the &aMekanism&r: &dAdvanced&r questline!
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.antimatterPelle.translation: 反物質球能夠製作&5遊戲末期&r的物品，其中包括 &6ATM 之星&r。讓我們將目光轉向&a通用機械&r：&d進階版&r的任務線，學習如何搭建反應爐。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.basicAlloy.original: Infusing Iron with Redstone in a Metallurgic Infuser will get you one of these.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.basicAlloy.translation: 在冶金灌注機內將紅石注入鐵錠能夠得到富集合金。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.basicControlCir.original: Infusing Osmium with Redstone in a Metallurgic Infuser will create you one of these.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.basicControlCir.translation: 在冶金灌注機內將紅石注入鋨錠能夠得到基礎控制電路。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.bioFuel.original: The Crusher can also break down natural substances into Bio Fuel!
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.bioFuel.translation: 粉碎機也能將物質分解成生物燃料。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.bioFuelEnergy.original: This generator will burn Bio Fuel into energy. It produces around 140FE/t.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.bioFuelEnergy.translation: 這個發電機可以將生物燃料燃燒成能量。它大約可以產生 140FE/t 的能量。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.breakingWater.1.original: To start breaking down water, we'll need a water source. The Kitchen Sink provides infinite water, and can easily be set up to pump out water.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.breakingWater.1.translation: 要電解水，首先得從水源下手。廚房水槽有無限的水源，並且非常容易抽取。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.breakingWater.2.original: Alternatively, you can always just use the classic infinite water source with a Pump from Mekanism.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.breakingWater.2.translation: 或者也能用通用機械的電動泵從一般的無限水源抽水。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.breakingWater.3.original: Pump the water into your Electrolytic Separator to split the water into Hydrogen and Oxygen.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.breakingWater.3.translation: 將水注入電解分離機，就能夠產生氫氣和氧氣。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.chemicalCombine.original: This machine combines two gases to create a new gas.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.chemicalCombine.translation: 化學灌注器將兩種氣體混合成另一種新氣體。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.chemicalCombine.original: You'll need this to combine Chlorine with Hydrogen to create Hydrogen Chloride, which is then used in our Chemical Injection Chamber.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.chemicalCombine.translation: 你需要將氫氣和氯氣混合成氯化氫，使化學壓射室得以開始運作。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.configureItems.original: This item is used to configure many of the items in Mekanism, from changing pipes to \"Pull or Push\" or rotating machines.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.configureItems.translation: 調整器能用來設定通用機械中的物品，像是調整管道的輸入、輸出，或是旋轉機器。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.crushesThings.original: This machine crushes ores into their \"dirty\" dust forms. This is useful to convert clumps into dirty dust, which can go through an Enrichment Chamber to create the ore dust, which then can be smelted into an ingot.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.crushesThings.translation: 粉碎機將礦物碎塊粉碎成「汙濁」的礦粉，再將汙濁礦粉送至富集倉處理後即可得到礦粉，礦粉熔煉後就能得到金屬錠。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.crystals.1.original: This machine will be #3 in your Tier 4 Ore Processing Factory.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.crystals.1.translation: 這是 4 級礦物工廠的第三部分。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.crystals.2.original: It takes the Clean Ore Slurry from the Chemical Washer and turns it into Crystals, which the Chemical Injection Chamber can process after.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.crystals.2.translation: 化學結晶器將化學清洗機產出的純淨漿液轉換成礦物晶體，之後便可將晶體送至化學壓射室處理。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.customPortal.1.original: To create a custom Portal, place down a single Teleporter block. Connect power to the block.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.customPortal.1.translation: 要搭建一個自訂傳送門，首先要放置一個傳送機並為它提供電力。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.customPortal.2.original: Create a \"Portal Frame\" with the teleporter block being the base of the portal.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.customPortal.2.translation: 接下來為傳送機搭建一個「傳送門框架」。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.customPortal.3.original: The final product will be a 4x3 portal structure, with the two blocks in the middle creating the portal.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.customPortal.3.translation: 最後蓋出來會是一個 4x3 的傳送門結構，並且中間兩格是空心的。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.electrolyticSep.original: The Electrolytic Separator (big fancy name) is used to separate chemicals from certain liquids and gases.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.electrolyticSep.translation: 電解分離機（名字超酷）能夠將特定的液體或氣體分解成元素。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.electrolyticSep.original: You'll need a bunch of these if you plan on making an Ore Processing Factory.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.electrolyticSep.translation: 如果你要搭建礦物處理產線，你需要一堆這種機器。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.electrolyticSep.original: To start, make one of these and we'll break down the most basic fluid: Water.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.electrolyticSep.translation: 做出這台機器後，就先從分解水開始。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.endGameMaterial.original: Combines gases, solid items, and liquids to produce an item and by-product.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.endGameMaterial.translation: 將氣體、液體、還有固態物品混合，還會有一些副產物

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.endGameMaterial.original: This machine is needed to create end-game materials and armor.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.endGameMaterial.translation: 遊戲後期的材料和盔甲需要它來製作。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.enrichItems.1.original: Using the Enrichment Chamber, you can enrich items to convert them into Enriched variants.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.enrichItems.1.translation: 你能利用富集倉將物品轉換成富集型態。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.enrichItems.2.original: These \"Enriched\" items give 8x the amount of mb in a Metallurgic Infuser.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.enrichItems.2.translation: 「富集」型態的物品在冶金灌注機作為注入劑時，劑量為一般物品的八倍。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.enrichItems.3.original: If you plan on making a bunch of steel, Enrich your Charcoal first!
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.enrichItems.3.translation: 如果你想要大量製作鋼錠，可以先製作富集碳。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.factoryLayout.1.original: If you're like me, you probably got lost 55 times during these last few steps. This is a complicated system.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.factoryLayout.1.translation: 如果你像我一樣，你可能會在途中不只一次思考自己到底要蓋這個做甚麼，畢竟這套系統真的很複雜。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.factoryLayout.2.original: A basic layout of your factory should be:
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.factoryLayout.2.translation: 你的工廠現在看起來應該要像這樣：

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.factoryLayout.3.original: Raw ore goes into your Chemical Dissolution Chamber > pumps A GAS to Chemical Washer > pumps A GAS to Chemical Crystallizer >  outputs crystals to Chemical Injection Chamber > outputs shards to Purification Chamber > outputs clumps to Crusher > outputs dirty dusts to Enrichment Chamber > outputs clean dust to Smelter.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.factoryLayout.3.translation: 原礦送入化學溶解室→產生的氣體送入化學清洗機→輸出的氣體送入化學結晶器→製造出的晶體送入化學壓射室→做出的碎片送入淨化倉→製作出的碎塊送入粉碎機→磨出來的汙濁礦粉送入富集倉→最後將輸出的礦粉拿去燒。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.factorySetup.1.original: So now, you should have 5 machines ready to go to process your ores. Are you ready to make it even more complicated?
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.factorySetup.1.translation: 現在我們已經有五種機器用於處理礦物了，準備好讓這一切變得更複雜了嗎？

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.factorySetup.2.original: Your factory should be: Chemical Injection Chamber > Purifying Chamber > Crusher > Enrichment Chamber > Furnace/Smelter.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.factorySetup.2.translation: 現在的流程應該要是這樣：化學壓射室→淨化倉→粉碎機→富集倉→熔爐或充能冶煉爐

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.factorySetup.3.translation: 到現在都還很簡單對吧？

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.factorySetup.4.original: Well buckle up. It's about to get wild.

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.generator.1.original: This generator can burn both Hydrogen and Ethylene to produce power.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.generator.1.translation: 燃氣發電機能靠燃燒氫氣或乙烯來產生電力。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.generator.2.original: Note: Burning Hydrogen will not produce more power than it costs to run an Electrolytic Separator. Use for Ethylene instead.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.generator.2.translation: 註：用電解分離器產生的氫氣發電會得不償失，請改用乙烯。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hdpePellet.original: Combining Oxygen, Ethylene, and a Substrate in a &aPressurized Reaction Chamber&r will create an HDPE Pellet.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hdpePellet.translation: 基片、氧氣和乙烯在&a加壓反應室&r內混合過後能夠產出 HDPE 顆粒。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hdpeSheet.original: To get an HDPE Sheet, place 3 HDPE Pellets in an Enrichment Chamber.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hdpeSheet.translation: 要製作 HDPE 板片，只需要將三個 HDPE 顆粒放進富集倉內即可。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.heatGeneratorMo.original: The Heat Generator has 2 modes to generate power:
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.heatGeneratorMo.translation: 熱力發電機有兩種發電模式：

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.heatGeneratorMo.original: &9Passive:&r Surrounding the generator with lava source or flowing blocks creates passive power by creating heat. Place one lava source block on top, and let it flow over the sides. Make sure to connect pipes first!
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.heatGeneratorMo.translation: &9被動式發電&r：在發電機周圍有岩漿源或是流動的岩漿，能夠為發電機提供熱量來發電。在發電機頂部倒一桶岩漿，並讓它流過側面即可。在到岩漿之前請記得先鋪好管線。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.heatGeneratorMo.original: &9Active:&r Placing combustible materials such as coal or wood into the generator will burn the fuel to create power.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.heatGeneratorMo.translation: &9主動式發電&r：把煤炭、木材等可燃物放進發電機，透過燃燒燃料來產生能量。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hydrogenChlorid.original: To get Hydrogen Chloride for our machines, we'll need to first create &aBrine&r.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hydrogenChlorid.translation: 要製造氯化氫，我們得先生產&a鹽水&r。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hydrogenChlorid.original: To do this, we'll need a Thermal Evaporation Plant. This is a multi-block structure.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hydrogenChlorid.translation: 要製造鹽水，就需要熱力蒸餾塔，這是一個多方塊結構。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hydrogenChlorid.original: To start, create a 4x3x4 structure that is hollow in the middle, except for the base. You can replace any of the sides with a Controller or Valve.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hydrogenChlorid.translation: 一開始可以先蓋出 4x3x4 的結構，使內部為空心的。除了底部，你可以將任意方塊替換成控制器和閥門。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hydrogenChlorid.original: You'll need at least 1 controller, and at least 2  valves.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hydrogenChlorid.translation: 至少需要一個控制器和兩個閥門。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hydrogenChlorid.original: Pump in water, and you'll start collecting brine, which can be pumped into an &aElectrolytic Separator&r to extract &6Chlorine&r from the gas.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.hydrogenChlorid.translation: 之後將水注入熱力蒸餾塔集可產出鹽水，再將鹽水送入&a電解分離器&r就能夠提取氣體&6氯&r

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.liquidStorage.1.translation: 流體儲罐能夠儲存液體。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.liquidStorage.2.original: It has a bucket mode which can be toggled to scoop up liquids with it. Very useful for lava in the beginning!
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.liquidStorage.2.translation: 並且它還能切換成水桶模式，直接撈起液體，在生存前期非常方便。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.metallurgicInfu.original: The Metallurgic Infuser is used to craft core crafting components throughout Mekanism.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.metallurgicInfu.translation: 通用機械主要的合成材料需要用冶金灌注機來合成。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.metallurgicInfu.original: The machine works by infusing a material (middle-left slot) with an \"infuser\" (far-left slot).
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.metallurgicInfu.translation: 冶金灌注機將「注入劑」（放在左側的格子）灌注到材料中。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.metallurgicInfu.original: This is also how you get Steel Ingots.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.metallurgicInfu.translation: 這也是製作鋼錠的方法。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.miningMachine.1.original: This machine can mine for you!
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.miningMachine.1.translation: 數位採礦機能夠為你挖礦。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.miningMachine.2.original: It is completely configurable, and can even replace mined blocks with cobblestone, or whatever block you provide it with!
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.miningMachine.2.translation: 它可以調整很多設定，甚至可以將挖掉的方塊替換為鵝卵石（或是其他你提供的方塊）。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.modOverview.1.original: Mekanism is a tech mod that will change the way you play Minecraft.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.modOverview.1.translation: 通用機械是個科技模組，它將會改變你玩麥塊的方式。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.modOverview.2.original: The mod focuses on breaking down materials to their chemical makeup, and getting the best out of every material you come across.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.modOverview.2.translation: 這個模組著重於將材料分解為化學成分，並充分利用所得到的任何材料。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.modOverview.3.original: This mod features Hydrogen-Powered Jetpacks, a mini-robotic friend, reactors, a Digital Miner to automate mining, and much, much more.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.modOverview.3.translation: 這個模組包含了噴射背包、機器人、反應堆、自動採礦的數位採礦機，和更多、更多的東西。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreFactory.1.original: This machine works like a Macerator or Pulverizer, and will break ores down into dusts.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreFactory.1.translation: 富集倉和磨粉機類似，能夠將礦物磨成粉狀。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreFactory.2.original: This breaks 3 raw ores down into 4 dusts.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreFactory.2.translation: 富集倉將 3 個原礦分解成 4 個粉

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreFactory.3.original: This is the start of your Ore Factory. It can also be upgraded to a factory machine, increasing the slots of use.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreFactory.3.translation: 你可以由此開始搭建礦物處理產線。另外，富集倉可以升級為工廠機器，有更多欄位可以同時處理原礦。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreProcessing.1.original: This machine is the next step to your Ore Processing Factory. Add this to the left of your Purification Chamber to build on to your current ore factory!
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreProcessing.1.translation: 化學壓射室能夠升級你的礦物處理產線，只要安裝在淨化倉之前即可。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreProcessing.2.original: This machine requires &aHydrogen Chloride&r to operate. To find out how to create Hydrogen Chloride, follow the quest above!
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreProcessing.2.translation: 它需要&a氯化氫&r來運作，之後的任務會教你如何生產氯化氫。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreSlurry.1.original: This machine needs water to operate, and uses the water to clean \"Ore Slurry\" into \"Clean Ore Slurry.\"
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreSlurry.1.translation: 化學清洗機用水將「汙濁漿液」淨化為「純淨漿液」。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreSlurry.2.original: It will be part 2 of your Tier 4 Ore Processing Factory.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.oreSlurry.2.translation: 這是 4 級礦物工廠的第二部分。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.portableBattery.original: This item is used to store power, and functions like a portable battery pack.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.portableBattery.translation: 能量板能夠儲存能量，就像是一個行動電源。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.portableBattery.original: It is also an important crafting item in Mekanism.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.portableBattery.translation: 並且也是通用機械的合成材料之一。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.powerStorage.original: This block stores power, and can also be used to charge items.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.powerStorage.translation: 能量立方能夠儲存電力，也能為物品充能。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.poweredItemChar.original: Standing on this item will charge up any powered item from any mod.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.poweredItemChar.translation: 站在充電臺上會為任意模組的帶電物品充能。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.poweredItemChar.original: This is also needed for the Robit.

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.purification.1.original: This machine \"Purifies\" our ores. It turns 1 Raw Ore into 2 \"Clumps\", which can then be sent through a Crusher to be turned to dirty dusts, then through an Enrichment Chamber to get clean dust, then through a smelter to be turned to an ingot.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.purification.1.translation: 淨化倉能夠「淨化」礦物。原礦經過處理後能夠得到兩個「碎塊」，礦物碎塊經過粉碎機處理後能得到汙濁礦粉，再將汙濁礦粉經過富集倉處理後能得到礦粉，熔煉過後就能得到金屬錠。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.purification.2.original: This will double your ingot output.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.purification.2.translation: 如此即可使礦物雙倍化。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.purification.3.original: This machine requires &aOxygen&r to run, which is created by pumping water into an &6Electrolytic Separator&r.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.purification.3.translation: 對了，這台機器需要&a氧氣&r才能運作，這代表你需要用&6電解分離器&r將水電解。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.setupOverview.1.original: So far, to \"double\" our ingot output, your setup should look something like this:
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.setupOverview.1.translation: 目前為止，想要獲得「雙倍」的鋼錠輸出，你的生產線應該像這樣：

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.setupOverview.2.original: Raw Ore goes into your &aPurification Chamber&r, which is being fed &aOxygen&r from an &6Electrolytic Separator&r.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.setupOverview.2.translation: 原礦進入&a淨化倉&r，淨化倉需要的&a氧氣&r由&6電解分離器&r取得。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.setupOverview.3.original: It then outputs the product into the &aCrusher&r, which converts the ore clumps into \"dirty dusts\". This \"Dirty Dust\" is fed into an &aEnrichment Chamber&r, which converts the \"Dirty Dust\" into the appropriate \"Ore Dust.\"
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.setupOverview.3.translation: 然後，淨化倉將輸出的碎塊傳送到 &a粉碎機&r，將礦物碎塊轉換為「汙濁的粉塵」。這些「汙濁的粉塵」會輸入&a富集倉&r，將「汙濁的粉塵」轉換為相應的「礦粉」。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.setupOverview.4.original: The &aEnrichment Chamber&r then feeds into your preferred smelter of choice. You follow?
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.setupOverview.4.translation: 接著，&a富集倉&r會把礦粉送進你選擇的熔爐。你明白了嗎？

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.smelter.1.translation: 充能冶煉盧能夠熔煉物品。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.smelter.2.original: It can be upgraded into a Smelting Factory, increasing the total number of smelting slots up to a maximum of 9.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.smelter.2.translation: 充能冶煉爐能夠升級成熔煉工廠，最多能將熔煉的欄位增加至 9 個。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.steelCrafting.1.original: Infusing Iron with Coal or Charcoal in a Metallurgic Infuser will give you Enriched Iron.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.steelCrafting.1.translation: 在冶金灌注機內將煤炭或木炭注入鐵錠能夠得到富集鐵。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.steelCrafting.2.original: Infusing the Enriched Iron with more Coal or Charcoal will give you Steel Dust, which can be smelted into Steel.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.steelCrafting.2.translation: 再將煤炭或木炭注入富集鐵就能夠得到鋼粉，熔煉後即可得到鋼錠。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.steelCrafting.3.original: This is a major crafting component in a lot of recipes in Mekanism.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.steelCrafting.3.translation: 鋼錠是通用機械中主要的合成材料之一。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.strongIngots.1.original: The machine creates two really strong ingots: Refined Glowstone and Refined Obsidian.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.strongIngots.1.translation: 鋨壓縮機能製造兩種強力材料——強化螢光石和強化黑曜石。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.strongIngots.2.original: It infuses an item with Osmium to create a more powerful ingot.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.strongIngots.2.translation: 將物品注入鋨能製造更強的金屬

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.substrates.1.original: When Bio Fuel is combined with Water and Hydrogen in a &aPressurized Reaction Chamber&r it creates Substrates. It also creates Ethylene as a by-product.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.substrates.1.translation: 生物燃料、水和氫氣在&a加壓反應室&r內混合過後能夠產出基片和乙烯。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.substrates.2.original: These are needed to create HDPE pellets, which are used for end-game crafts like the Meka-suit.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.substrates.2.translation: 這些物質能用來製作 HDPE 顆粒，是製作 Meka 裝備等後期物品的材料。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.sulfurDioxide.1.original: Okay, let's start with making Sulfur Dioxide first.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.sulfurDioxide.1.translation: 好的，讓我們先從製造二氧化硫開始。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.sulfurDioxide.2.original: Start by placing Gunpowder in a separate &aChemical Injection Chamber&r with Hydrogen Chloride to create Sulfur Dust. OR you can just pulverize Sulfur from Thermal Series into Sulfur Dust, it's up to you.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.sulfurDioxide.2.translation: 將火藥送進&a化學壓射室&r處理後就能得到硫粉，或是將熱力系列模組的硫磺磨成硫粉。兩種方式，隨你喜好。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.sulfurDioxide.3.original: Feeding the Sulfur Dust into this machine, the &aChemical Oxidizer&r, will create Sulfur Dioxide. Now we need to create Sulfur Trioxide.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.sulfurDioxide.3.translation: 再將硫粉送進&a化學氧化機&r，就能夠製造二氧化硫了。之後我們還要來製造三氧化硫。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.sulfurDioxide.4.original: Send the Sulfur Dioxide into a Chemical Infuser to combine it with Oxygen to create Sulfur Trioxide. Send the Trioxide to another Chemical Infuser to combine it with Water Vapor to create Sulfuric Acid.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.sulfurDioxide.4.translation: 將二氧化硫和氧氣用化學灌注器混合即可得到三氧化硫，再用另一台化學灌注器將三氧化硫和水蒸氣混合就能夠得到硫酸。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.thermalEvaporat.original: The Thermal Evaporation Plant multi-block produces Brine based on the internal temperature.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.thermalEvaporat.translation: 熱力蒸餾塔生產鹽水的速度由內部溫度決定。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.thermalEvaporat.original: There are several methods to increase the temperature of the plant, including building them in a desert!
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.thermalEvaporat.translation: 有很多方式可以提升塔內的溫度，直接蓋在沙漠裡也不失為一種方式。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.thermalEvaporat.original: The &aFuelwood Heater&r burns buckets of Lava, which can then be piped in using a pipe that transfers heat.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.thermalEvaporat.translation: &a木料加熱器&r能夠透過岩漿產生熱量，並且能用可以傳輸熱量的管道輸出。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.thermalEvaporat.original: The &aResistive Heater&r uses RF/FE to produce heat, and can be set to use whatever RF/FE you want it to use.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.thermalEvaporat.translation: &a電阻加熱器&r消耗 RF 或 FE 產生熱量，並且還能設定要消耗多少電力。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.upgradeWorth.1.original: If you're wondering if it is worth making this upgrade, the answer is yes.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.upgradeWorth.1.translation: 如果你在考慮是否值得進行這次升級，答案是肯定的。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.upgradeWorth.2.original: This version produces 105.6FE/t. It also can be used to add extra heat to Thermal Evaporation Plants.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.upgradeWorth.2.translation: 這個版本的產能為 105.6FE/t。它還可以用來為熱力蒸餾塔增加額外的熱量。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.upgradingToFact.original: This item upgrades a base machine to a Basic Factory machine.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.upgradingToFact.translation: 能將機器升級為基礎工廠機器

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.waterVapor.1.original: To make Sulfuric Acid, you'll need to create &aWater Vapor&r.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.waterVapor.1.translation: 要製造硫酸，就得先製造&a水蒸氣&r。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.waterVapor.2.original: Pump some water into this machine and it'll convert it into vapor.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.waterVapor.2.translation: 將水注入迴旋式氣液轉換機能夠將其變成蒸氣。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.windPowerOption.original: This is a great option for generating power.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.windPowerOption.translation: 這是一個不錯的發電選擇。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.windPowerOption.original: This generates around 40FE/t, and increases based on how high you are. The higher the Y level, the more power it produces!
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.windPowerOption.translation: 它能產生大約 40FE/t 的能量，並且會根據你所放置的高度而增加。Y 軸的高度越高，它產生的能量就越多！

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.wirelessTransfe.original: This item is how you make Wireless Transfers possible.
atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.wirelessTransfe.translation: 有了它，無線傳輸就不再只是幻想了。

atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.wirelessTransfe.original: You can set specific channels, named by you, to transfer whatever you want from it.
