atm9.quest.mekanism.desc.wirelessTransfe.translation: 設定一個由你命名的頻道，就能夠運輸任何你想要的東西了。

atm9.quest.mekanism.startTier4.original: The Start of a Tier 4 Ore Factory

atm9.quest.mekanism.subt.basicAlloyCraft.original: The Basic Alloy for Crafting Items

atm9.quest.mekanism.subt.hotBrine.original: Hot Brine here. Get Your Hot Brine here.

atm9.quest.mekanism.subt.miniRobot.original: A Mini-Robot To Accompany You On Your Travels
atm9.quest.mekanism.subt.miniRobot.translation: 居家旅行的機器人好夥伴

atm9.quest.mekanism.subt.oreShards.original: Turns 3 Raw Ore into 8 Ore Shards
atm9.quest.mekanism.subt.oreShards.translation: 將三個原礦變成八個礦物碎片

atm9.quest.mekanism.subt.startFactory.original: The Start of Your Own Factory

atm9.quest.mekanism.subt.wirelessEveryth.translation: 無線傳輸能量、氣體、液體和各種有的沒的東西。

atm9.quest.mekanism.thisIsALotIKnow.original: This is a lot, I know.

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.completedSPS.translation: 觀察已完工的超臨界移相器

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.antimat.original: After zapping away trillions of power in the SPS, we can finally create &dAntimatter Pellets&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.antimat.translation: 在超臨界移相器消耗了好幾兆的電力後，我們終於能夠做出&d反物質球&r了。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.antimat.original: Run the Antimatter Gas you get from the SPS into a Chemical Crystallizer and you'll get 1 Antimatter Pellet for every 1,000mb you make.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.antimat.translation: 反物質氣體經過化學結晶器處理後就能夠製造反物質球了。每 1000 mb 反物質能做出一顆反物質球。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.buildSP.original: With all of the gathered blocks, it's time to build this thing. Below is a text guide, or you can watch the Ponder!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.buildSP.translation: 既然材料都集齊了，那就開始建造吧。以下是簡易的文字教學，你可以對超臨界移相器的材料按住 w 鍵來觀看動畫教學。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.buildSP.original: The SPS will be 7x7 when built, but it isn't a cube. It follows a simple pattern, which you can follow the images below as a build guide. The pattern looks like this:
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.buildSP.translation: 超臨界移相器是 7x7x7 的多方塊結構，但是它並非正方體。以下是簡易的蓋法，你可以照著圖片搭建。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.buildSP.original: Each side, including the bottom and top, will follow this pattern. The Supercharged Coils should be placed across from each other in the center of their respective sides, and the remaining two ports will be used to pump in Polonium, and pump out Antimatter Gas.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.buildSP.translation: 每一面都蓋得像上圖一樣，並在其中一面的中心放下增壓線圈（若有兩個則需面對面），接著預留兩個端口用來輸入釙和輸出反物質氣體。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.buildSP.original: Here is the completed structure below:

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.checkli.original: Let's go through the checklist &oone more time&r to ensure we have everything ready to go before we boot it up:
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.checkli.translation: 在啟動反應爐前，讓我們&o再檢查一次&r我們的設備是否有誤。
1. 生化防護服（為了保險起見）

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.checkli.original: 2. Water/coolant pumping into an input Port.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.checkli.translation: 2. 輸入水或其他冷卻劑的連接埠

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.checkli.original: 3. Fissile Fuel pumping into an input Port.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.checkli.translation: 3. 輸入易裂變燃料的連接埠

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.checkli.original: 4. A Port set to output the Heated Coolant, either to a trashcan or an Industrial Turbine.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.checkli.translation: 4. 輸出過熱冷卻劑的連接埠，看你要直接丟到垃圾桶或是要連接到工業渦輪都行。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.checkli.original: 5. A Port set to output Nuclear Waste leading to Radioactive Waste Barrels or machines to process it, or both!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.checkli.translation: 5. 輸出核廢料的連接埠，看你要輸出到放射性廢料桶放著或是其他機器加工都行。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.checkli.original: If you're ready to go, hit that &eActivate&r button! You can also adjust the &3Burn Rate&r to produce more Nuclear Waste, but start slow.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.checkli.translation: 如果都沒問題，那就按下&e啟動&r的按鈕吧。你可以調整&3燃燒速率&r來得到更多核廢料，不過剛開始就先慢慢來就好。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.circuit.original: Using some vanilla mechanics and 2 &aFission Reactor Logic Adapters&r, we can create a simple circuit breaker to trip and turn off the reactor &o&ein case things get a little crazy&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.circuit.translation: 使用兩個&a核分裂反應爐邏輯適配器&r和一些原版機關，就能夠製作一個簡單的斷路器，避免反應爐&o&e發生一些小事故&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.circuit.original: To do this, we'll need a single piece of Redstone, a Piston, a block of either sand or gravel, and an Observer.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.circuit.translation: 我們會需要一個紅石粉、活塞、礫石（或沙子）和偵測器。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.circuit.original: On one of the faces, we'll want to put a Logic Adapter down, then skip a block above it and then place another Adapter. Set the top Adapter to &9\"Activation\"&r, and the bottom Adapter to &c\"Damage Critical\"&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.circuit.translation: 首先先放一個邏輯適配器，然後隔一格方塊，在上面放另一個邏輯適配器。將上面的適配器設定為「&9啟動&r」，下面的適配器設定為「&c損壞嚴重&r」。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.circuit.original: Next, in front and underneath the bottom Adapter, place any building block and stick a piece of Redstone on it leading from the Adapter. We'll then place a Piston facing up in front of that Redstone, then place our piece of sand or gravel on that Piston.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.circuit.translation: 接著在下面的適配器面前鋪一格紅石粉，然後在紅石粉前面放一個面朝上的活塞，在活塞上面放沙子或礫石。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.circuit.original: For the final part of our breaker, place the Observer with the face pointing &boutwards towards the Piston setup&r. &9This is important&r!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.circuit.translation: 最後放一個偵測器在上面的適配器面前，並讓偵測器的臉部朝外。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.circuit.original: Whenever the Reactor has critical damage, it will then activate the bottom Adapter, causing the redstone to get a signal, which then activates the Piston and pushes up the Gravel/Sand. This will activate the Observer, which then turns off the Reactor.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.circuit.translation: 這樣當反應爐嚴重損壞時，下面的適配器就會啟動，接著觸發活塞，將沙子或礫石往上推來觸發偵測器，使反應爐關閉。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.deuteri.original: To fuel our Fusion Reactor, we'll need to create two different gases, this one being &cDeuterium&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.deuteri.translation: 要啟動核融合反應爐，我們需要兩種燃料，其中一種便是&c氘&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.deuteri.original: To make this, we'll need to make some Electric Pumps and give them a Filter Upgrade. Place them over a source block of water, give them some power, and they'll pump out &5Heavy Water&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.deuteri.translation: 要得到氘，我們要在電動泵中加入過濾升級，再將電動泵放到水源上，就能夠抽出&5重水&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.deuteri.original: Pump the Heavy Water into an Electrolytic Separator to get &cDeuterium&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.deuteri.translation: 在電解分離器中電解重水就能夠取得&c氘&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.electro.original: The &9Electromagnetic Coil&r is placed directly on top of the &aRotational Complex&r to convert the kinetic energy into power.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.electro.translation: &9電磁線圈&需要和&a旋轉裝置&r接著才能將動能轉換為電力。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.electro.original: You can use multiple, with 7 being the max with a Turbine using 28 blades. These must either touch another Coil, or the Rotational Complex.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.electro.translation: 線圈之間也需要接在一起，最多能用 7 個線圈承載 28 個葉片一起旋轉。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fissile.original: The Fission Reactor needs &3Fissile Fuel&r to run. If you look up Fissile Fuel right now in JEI, I bet you'll get overwhelmed with everything you need to make it. It's okay, you've got this. Let's take it one step at a time.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fissile.translation: 核分裂反應爐需要&3易裂變燃料&r才能運作，如果你在 JEI 看過配方的話，可能會被配方的複雜程度嚇一跳。但是沒關係，我們可以一口氣就搞定這一切。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fissile.original: It all boils down to creating &eUranium Hexafluoride&r. To do this, let's focus on making these two gases: &bHydrofluoric Acid&r, and &eUranium Oxide&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fissile.translation: 首先我們知道燃料是由&e六氟化鈾&r製成，因此我們將注意力放到六氟化鈾的兩個原料：&b氫氟酸&r和&e氧化鈾&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fission.original: To start our journey into the world of Mekanism Reactors, we'll start by making a &aFission Reactor&r. These are multiblock structures that generate massive amounts of heat by burning &3Fissile Fuel&r. This reactor does not produce power on its own, but the heat generated can be used to heat &bCoolant&r to be used to generate power in an &aIndustrial Turbine&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fission.translation: 首先我們要先來蓋一台&a核分裂反應爐&r，它透過消耗&3易裂變燃料&r產生大量熱量。它雖然不直接生產電力，但是加熱過後的冷卻劑能透過&a工業渦輪&r發電。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fission.original: The Fission Reactor can be very dangerous, as a meltdown can cause an &cexplosion&r as well as &2Radiation&r spreading over a 5 chunk radius, which lasts for several in-game weeks.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fission.translation: 核分裂反應爐非常危險，反應爐熔毀除了產生&c爆炸&r之外，在半徑五個區塊內還會產生&2輻射&r，需要幾個遊戲週才能消退。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fission.original: But we're going to be prepared for that. Let's make a Hazmat Suit, just in case... right?
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fission.translation: 雖然很危險，但我們可是準備好了...吧。以防萬一，還是先做一套生化防護服好了。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fission.original: For us to take anything in or out of the Fission Reactor, we'll need &aFission Reactor Ports&r. These can be configured to input or output by using the &9Configurator&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fission.translation: 若是要對核分裂反應爐進行輸入/輸出的動作，我們會需要&a核分裂反應爐連接埠&r。它能夠用&9調整器&r設定輸入/輸出。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fission.original: Every Fission Reactor &aneeds a minimum of 4 Ports&r:
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fission.translation: 每台核分裂反應爐&a需要至少四個連接埠&r：

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fission.original: For this starter build, let's put a port on each side like the image shown below. Make sure to configure them to match the list of inputs and outputs!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fission.translation: 若是剛開始試著蓋反應爐，可以像下圖一樣將四個連接埠個放在四個面，記得要調整一下連接埠的設定。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fuelInj.original: To kick start the Fusion Reactor, we'll need a quick shot of D-T fuel. This is made by combining &cDeuterium&r and &eTritium&r together in a Chemical Infuser.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fuelInj.translation: 要啟動核融合反應爐，需要先點燃一些氘-氚燃料，只要將&c氘&r和&e氚&r送入化學灌注機混合即可製得。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fuelInj.original: Start by making a &4Hohlraum&r and place it into the Infuser (where the plus symbol is) to fill it with D-T fuel. Now we're ready to jumpstart the Reactor!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fuelInj.translation: 做一個&4黑體輻射腔&r，注入氘-氚燃料（化學灌注器中 + 號的欄位），就能準備啟動反應爐了。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fuelReq.original: Fusion Reactors require a very special fuel: &dD-T Fuel&r to be exact.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fuelReq.translation: 核融合反應爐需要一種特殊的燃料：&d氘-氚燃料&r

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fuelReq.original: There are two ways to fuel the Reactor: Either by pumping in D-T Fuel directly into the Reactor at 1,000mb/t, or by pumping each of the two fuels in separately at controlled rates.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fuelReq.translation: 有兩種方式為反應爐添加燃料，直接將氘-氚燃料輸進反應堆（以 1000 mb/t 的速率消耗），或是將氘和氚以指定速率分別輸進反應堆。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fuelReq.original: For starters, let's pump them in separately. We probably need to know how to make them as well.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fuelReq.translation: 剛開始就先分別輸入就好，我們還得學習如何製造氘和氚。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.original: You've probably heard people talk about how the &cFusion Reactor&r is the best power source in the pack. They are right.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.translation: 你可能已經聽說&c核融合反應爐&r在這包是最好的發電機了，實際上也確實如此。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.original: Once activated, the Reactor can push out up to 200MRF/t with the right setup. It can also be cooled with water to produce steam, which can go into an &9Industrial Turbine&r to make even more power.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.translation: 核融合反應爐啟動過後，最多能夠生產近 200MRF/t 的電量。也能夠用水降溫，產生蒸氣，送進&9工業鍋爐&r產生更多的電力。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.original: To build the Fusion Reactor, we need to follow a simple pattern. Each face will look like this:
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.translation: 要搭建核融合反應爐，這裡有個簡單的蓋法。首先將每面蓋成這樣。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.original: For the top, we want to replace the middle block with the Fusion Reactor Controller.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.translation: 在上面，將中間的方塊替換為核融合反應爐控制器。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.original: For the ports, you can replace any of the Reactor Glass on the sides. For this setup, we'll need two ports to input &cDeuterium&r and &eTritium&r, then a port to output power.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.translation: 你可以將結構玻璃替換成連接埠，需要兩個連接埠用來輸入&c氘&r和&e氚&r和一個連接埠用來輸出能量。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.original: The &dFusion Reactor&r can produce up to 200MRF/t on its own, but first we need to understand some mechanics.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.translation: &d核融合反應爐&r最多能有 200M RF/t 的發電量，但是我們需要先了解反應爐的設定。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.original: The easiest way to produce power is by pumping in Deuterium and Tritium separately, then controlling how much fuel is burned using the &aInjection Rate&r in the &cFuel Tab&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.translation: 最簡單的發電方式是分別注入氘和氚，然後在&c燃料&r的標籤頁中控制&a輸入速率&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.original: This has to be an even number with a max of 98, as it combines the D-T fuel inside of the Reactor itself. The consumption of each fuel is equal to half of the Injection Rate per tick, meaning 49mb/t of each for the max.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.translation: 輸入速率能設定成最大為 98 的偶數，之後兩種燃料便會在反應爐內混合成氘-氚燃料，兩種燃料的消耗速率是輸入速率的一半，即氘和氚最大的消耗速率為 49 mb/t。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.original: However, you can directly inject &dD-T Fuel&r, but will not be able to control the Injection Rate. This will create massive amounts of power per tick, but at a much higher fuel consumption rate of 500mb/t of each fuel.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.translation: 你也能夠直接輸入&d氘-氚燃料&r，但是這樣就無法調整輸入速率了。雖然這樣會有更高的發電量，但是兩種燃料的消耗速率也會增加至 500 mb/t。
☑ 充滿氘-氚燃料的黑體輻射腔。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.original: Deuterium and Tritium ready to be pumped into the Reactor? &oCheck!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.translation: ☑ 氘和氚準備輸進反應爐。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.original: A Laser Amplifier with at least 400MRF ready to shoot into the Laser Focus Matrix? &oCheck!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.translation: ☑ 含有 400M RF，準備打入雷射聚焦矩陣的雷射增幅器

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.original: Once you are ready, place the &5Hohlraum&r into the &aFusion Reactor Controller&r, pump in the Fuel, then activate your Laser Amplifier.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.translation: 都準備好了之後，將&5黑體輻射腔&r放入&a核融合反應爐控制器&r，再輸入燃料，最後啟動雷射增幅器。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.original: If done right, &nyou'll see the Reactor activate!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.fusionR.translation: 如果沒有問題，&n反應堆應該會開始運作&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.hydrofl.original: Let's take our &2Sulfuric Acid&r and combine it with &bFluorite&r in a &9Chemical Dissolution Chamber&r to make &bHydrofluoric Acid&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.hydrofl.translation: 將&2硫酸&r和&b螢石&r放入&9化學溶解室&r後就能得到&b氫氟酸&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.original: Almost every Mekanism multiblock is built the same way.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.translation: 大多數通用機械多方塊結構的蓋法都很類似。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.original: You'll need to make a rectangular prism structure. The edges must be made out of &8Induction Casings&r. The faces can be made of either Casings, &aStructural Glass&r, or &cInduction Ports&r. It's best to have 2 Ports: one for input, and one for output. These can be changed using the &eConfigurator&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.translation: 你需要蓋出一個長方體的形狀，邊緣必須為&8輸導外殼&r，其他面可以是外殼、&a結構玻璃&r或是&c輸導端口&r，你需要至少兩個端口用來輸入/輸出能量，你能用&e調整器&r來調整端口設定。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.original: For this build, we'll be making a 5x5x5. This quest requires the exact amount of materials needed to build this. Need help? &nCheck out the Ponder!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.translation: 我們以 5x5x5 作為範例，任務給出了需要的材料量。對材料按住 w 鍵會有動畫教學。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.original: The Induction Matrix allows you to customize how much power you can store and transfer by adding Cells and Providers inside of the multiblock structure.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.translation: 輸導矩陣的容量和最大輸電功率取決於內部的元件和供應器。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.original: Induction Cells increase the total amount of power that can be stored.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.translation: 輸導元件能夠增加輸導矩陣的電力容量。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.original: Induction Providers increase the total transfer speed both in and out of the Matrix.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.translation: 輸導供應器能增加電力輸出/輸入的功率。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.original: You can customize how many you want of each inside of the multiblock, but you will need at least one of each. These also have higher tiers to increase your overall storage and transfer capacity.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.inducti.translation: 輸導元件和輸導供應器至少個要有一個，這些方塊也能升級，使單個方塊的效果更強。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.industr.original: The &9Industrial Turbine&r is a massive multiblock structure used to convert &cHeated Coolant&r into power. The minimum size is 5x5x5, with the maximum size being 17x17x18.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.industr.translation: &9工業渦輪&r是個龐大的多方塊結構，能將&c過熱冷卻劑&r轉換成電力，尺寸最小為 5x5x5，最大為 17x17x18。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.industr.original: To build the Turbine, we'll need several blocks so let's start with the basics.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.industr.translation: 要搭建渦輪，需要準備一些基本的方塊。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.industr.original: Just like most Mekanism multiblocks, the frame must be made out of &eTurbine Casings&r. However, instead of Reactor Glass, you can use &bStructural Glass&r or Casings for each face.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.industr.translation: 和其他通用機械的多方塊結構類似，邊緣必須得用&e渦輪外殼&r來蓋，而其他面可以用強化玻璃或&b結構玻璃&r代替。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.industr.original: We're going to build this Turbine, and the quest requires the exact materials needed.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.industr.translation: 要蓋出渦輪，還有一些材料是必要的，在後面的任務會提到。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.isotopi.original: Once we have an &9Isotopic Centrifuge&r, we can run our &2Uranium Hexafluoride&r in and create &3Fissile Fuel&r!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.isotopi.translation: 最後，&2六氟化鈾&r經&9同位素離心機&r處理過後，就能夠得到&3易裂變燃料&r了。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.isotopi.original: See, that wasn't so bad was it?
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.isotopi.translation: 是不是覺得做起來其實也沒那麼難？

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.laserFo.original: To see a visual, check out the Ponder by holding &aW&r while hovering over the Laser Focus Matrix.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.laserFo.translation: 對雷射聚焦矩陣按住 &aw 鍵&r能夠觀看動畫教學。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.laserFo.original: The goal is to aim each Laser into a Laser Amplifier. Using one is pretty slow, so we're going to make a few.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.laserFo.translation: 我們要將雷射導入雷射增幅器。一個可能會有點慢，我們需要做多一點。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.laserFo.original: In the image below, you can see an example of how this is set up. Sticking the Lasers directly on a power source like an Energy Cube works, or you can have them on pipes or cables. You want to give it a block of empty space between the lasers and the Laser Amplifier.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.laserFo.translation: 下圖為範例，將雷射直接接上能量立方之類的能量源或是線纜，並且要和雷射增幅器保留一格的距離。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.laserFo.original: The Laser Amplifier has a red dot on one of the faces. This is what you want to point towards the Laser Focus Matrix.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.laserFo.translation: 雷射增幅器上有一面帶有紅點，這一面要對著雷射聚焦矩陣。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.laserFo.original: Make sure to turn the Laser Amplifier off (or activate Redstone control) and wait for it to store &cat least 400MRF&r, then it'll be ready.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.laserFo.translation: 先將雷射增幅器關閉（或是開啟紅石偵測），然後等到&c至少有 400M RF&r 時就能準備啟動

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.matrixC.original: Once you've finished building your first &9Energized Induction Matrix&r, you'll see red particles all around the structure to show that it is complete.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.matrixC.translation: 當你蓋完&9輸導矩陣&r後，會有紅色的粒子效果提示你。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.matrixC.original: Don't be afraid to upgrade with higher tier Cells and Providers! Need more space for them? The maximum size the Induction Matrix can be is 18x18x18.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.matrixC.translation: 你可以隨時為輸導矩陣的內部元件升級。若是空間不夠，輸導矩陣最大能擴充至 18x18x18。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.nuclear.original: Pumping Nuclear Waste into a &9Solar Neutron Activator&r will give you &dPolonium&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.nuclear.translation: 將核廢料送入&9太陽能中子活化器&r中會產生&d釙&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.nuclear.original: Run the Polonium through a Pressurized Reaction Chamber with some Fluorite Dust and you'll get &9Polonium Pellets&r. You will need a good bit of these for the future.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.nuclear.translation: 將釙和&7螢石粉&r送進加壓反應室處理後，會輸出&9釙球&r。你之後會需要一堆。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.nuclear.original: Note: This will also create a byproduct of &7Spent Nuclear Waste&r, which needs to be pumped into a Waste Barrel for storage.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.nuclear.translation: 註：過程中會產生&7用盡的核廢料&r作為副產物，需要送入廢料桶中儲存。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.nuclear.original: &8Nuclear Waste&r can be sent into an Isotopic Centrifuge to create &9Plutonium&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.nuclear.translation: &8核廢料&r經過同位素離心機處理後會產生&9鈽&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.nuclear.original: Sending the Plutonium into a Pressurized Reaction Chamber with some water and &7Fluorite Dust&r will give you &9Plutonium Pellets&r. These are used to make end game materials!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.nuclear.translation: 將鈽、水和&7螢石粉&r送進加壓反應室處理後，會輸出&9鈽球&r。這是遊戲後期的材料之一。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.nuclear.original: Note: This will also create a byproduct of &7Spent Nuclear Waste&r, which needs to be pumped into a Waste Barrel for storage.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.nuclear.translation: 註：過程中會產生&7用盡的核廢料&r作為副產物，需要送入廢料桶中儲存。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.powerSt.original: If we want to create massive amounts of power, we'll need a way to store all of it, and those Energy Cubes just won't cut it.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.powerSt.translation: 如果要儲存大量的電力，只靠能量立方可能還不夠。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.powerSt.original: We're going to create a customizable multiblock used to store large amounts of power, but first, we need to make some Lithium Dust!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.powerSt.translation: 因此我們需要一個能夠自訂的多方塊結構來存放電力。在此之前，我們得先做一些鋰粉出來。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.powerSt.original: You should have some Brine being made from a previous quest using the &aThermal Evaporation Plants&r. Run the &eBrine&r through another &aThermal Evaporation Plant&r to get Lithium, then through a &9Chemical Crystallizer&r to get &aLithium Dust&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.powerSt.translation: 之前你應該有用&a熱力蒸餾塔&r來製造鹽水了。將&e鹽水&r送入另一台&a熱力蒸餾塔&r即可製得鋰，將鋰送入&9化學結晶器&r即可產出鋰粉。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: To create a reaction for the Reactor to turn on, we're going to need to inject it with a ton of power. &oAnd I mean a ton of power&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 要使反應爐啟動，需要先輸入大量電力。&o非常大量的電力&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: This requires you to set up several &9Lasers&r that all need to be powered, then shooting 400MFE directly into the Laser Focus Matrix.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 因此你需要準備幾台&9雷射&r，存滿 400M FE 的能量後，一次打入雷射聚焦矩陣。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: The Laser Focus Matrix is placed in the center of one face of the Fusion Reactor. We'll build the Lasers next.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 將反應爐其中一面的中心替換成雷射聚焦矩陣，稍後會介紹如何搭建雷射。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: The inside of the reactor is built up of pillars using several &aFission Fuel Assembly&r blocks, with a single &aControl Rod Assembly&r placed at the top of each pillar. These can be anywhere from 1 to 15 blocks in height, depending on the size of the reactor.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 反應爐內部需要搭建由&a核分裂燃料組件&r的柱子，柱子頂部要放上&a控制棒組件&r。根據反應爐尺寸，柱子高度能夠在 1 至 15 格之間。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: For this build, we'll put 2 of the Fission Fuel Assemblies in the center of our multiblock, and then put the Control Rod Assembly right on top of it.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 若是照我們的設計來蓋，我們需要兩個核分裂燃料組件堆在反應爐中央，頂部再放上一個控制棒組件。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: It's time to gather the materials we'll need to build the reactor.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 我們要準備開始建造反應爐了。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: Just like most Mekanism multiblocks, reactors can be a custom size depending on your needs. They must be cuboid, with the minimum outside size being 3 wide, 4 tall, and 3 blocks deep. The maximum size is 18x18x18. &aWe're going to build a 5x5 to start with&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 和通用機械大多數的多方塊結構一樣，反應爐能夠根據你的需求改變尺寸。它需要蓋成長方體，最小的尺寸是 3x4x3，最大的是 18x18x18。&a我們就先蓋 5x5x5 的大小就好&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: The edges of the outer shell &bmust&r be made out of &aFission Reactor Casings&r, while the faces can be either casings or &bReactor Glass&r, Reactor Ports, or Reactor Logic Adapters. We'll get to those later.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 反應爐外層的邊緣一定要是&a核分裂反應爐外殼&r，其他部分能夠改成&b強化玻璃&r、反應爐連接埠或是反應爐邏輯適配器，詳細的配置之後會介紹。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: For now, let's build a basic 5x5x5 Fission Reactor!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 現在，讓我們開始來蓋核分裂反應爐吧！

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: Need more help building it? Holding &dw&r while hovering over the Fission Reactor Casing will show you the Ponder that can help you build it.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 若還是不懂怎麼蓋，對著核分裂反應爐外殼按住 &dw 鍵&r，會有動畫教你如何搭建反應爐。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: Once you've finished placing in all of the required blocks to build the Reactor, it should give off red particles to show that it is complete.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 如果你該放的方塊都有放好，蓋完時就會有紅色的粒子效果提示你。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: Right clicking anywhere on the Reactor will open up the &aInterface&r. This will have all of the information you need to run the Reactor properly, as well as two buttons to turn on and off the Reactor.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 對著反應爐的任意一個方塊按下右鍵就能夠開啟&a介面&r，裡面有各種資訊能夠幫助你保持反應爐正常運作，以及控制反應爐開關的兩個按鈕。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: On the left, you have 2 tanks: One for &bCoolant&r and one for &3Fissile Fuel&r. On the right, you have one for &8Nuclear Waste&r, and one for &bHeated Coolant&r, which will most likely be &bSteam&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 在左側有兩個儲罐，分別是&b冷卻劑&r和&3易裂變燃料&r；在右側也有兩個儲罐，分別是&8核廢料&r和&b過熱的冷卻劑&r（通常是&b蒸氣&r）。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: The &cTemperature&r bar will show you how hot the Reactor is. After a certain temp, the Reactor will start taking &4Damage&r, which will eventually cause the Reactor to explode.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: &c溫度&r條表示反應爐內部有多熱。溫度超過特定值後，反應爐會開始損壞，最後爆炸。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: To adjust the &cBurn Rate&r of the Fissile Fuel and see more statistics, click on the (I) tab on the left side. Here, you can adjust the Rate Limit, which controls how much fuel the Reactor burns per tick.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 要調整易裂變燃料的&c燃燒速率&r的話，點下左側的「(I)」，就可以調整反應爐每 tick 消耗多少燃料了。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: When burning fuel, the Fission Reactor creates a massive amount of heat. To prevent the Reactor from converting into TNT, we need to make sure it is properly cooled.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 核分裂反應爐在消耗燃料後會產生大量熱量，要防止反應爐變成一顆超大號 TNT，我們要確保能夠對反應爐進行冷卻。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: The easiest way to do this is by giving the Reactor &9Water&r from a Sink. The Sink is an infinite water source, which is &oreally nice for a situation like this&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 最簡單的方式是抽水槽的&9水&r。水槽作為無限水源&o基本上算是最優解&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: Pump out the water into one of the Reactor's Ports that is set to &ainput&r to fill up the Reactor with water. This will be heated while the Reactor is running and get converted to &bSteam&r, which you can use to create power within an &9Industrial Turbine&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 將水注入&a輸入模式&r的連接埠來為反應爐補充水源。水被反應爐加熱後會變成&b蒸氣&r，這時可以將蒸氣導入&9工業渦輪&r來發電。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: &eSodium&r can also be used as a much more efficient coolant. This allows for higher burn rates and lower core temperatures.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: &e鈉&r也能作為冷卻劑，並且更加高效，使反應爐能夠以較低的溫度運行。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: Once we start burning up Fissile Fuel in the reactor, we'll get heated &bCoolant&r and &8Nuclear Waste&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 當反應爐啟動後，就會產生過熱的&b冷卻劑&r和&8核廢料&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: This is where the Radiation kicks in. As long as it stays &osafely in some container or machine&r, you won't have any spills....right?
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 我們需要將帶有輻射的&8核廢料&r存放在&o安全的容器或機器&r中。你也不希望它們灑出來，對吧？

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: The best way to store any Radioactive substance is using a &2Radioactive Waste Barrel&r. These will safely store the waste, while slowly decaying the gas without causing a Radiation spill. You don't want your Nuclear Waste sitting in your Reactor as it causes it to produce more heat, so set a port to &aoutput Waste&r and ship it to a barrel!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 存放核廢料最好的容器就是&2放射性廢料桶&r，核廢料在裡面會緩緩衰變，而不會使輻射洩漏。核廢料在反應爐內會產生額外的熱量，因此儘早將核廢料輸出到桶子裡。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: &9Important Note&r: Breaking &nany&r machine, barrel, pipe, or &oanything&r that has a Radioactive gas inside of it &cwill cause a Radiation leak&r. That includes the products of Nuclear Waste, like Polonium or Plutonium.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: &9重要備註&r：破壞&n任何&r帶有放射性氣體的機器、設備或管道&c將會造成輻射外洩&r。將核廢料處理過後產出的釙和鈽也是放射性氣體。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: Afraid of blowing up your Fission Reactor and causing a massive Radiation leak? Don't worry, we all are. &o*insert terrible flashback here*
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 你是否在擔心反應爐熔毀造成大量輻射洩漏嗎？別慌，我們也怕。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: So how can we prevent such a catastrophic disaster? By creating a redstone &aCircuit Breaker&r using &dFission Reactor Logic Adapters&r. Now these aren't 100% guaranteed to stop an explosion, but they are absolutely nice to have.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 我們當然有辦法能夠避免這場災難發生，可以利用&d核分裂反應爐邏輯適配器&r來製作一個紅石&a斷路器&r。雖然還是不能完全保證不會出事，但是你絕對該做一個。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: Essentially, these Adapters allow us to control the Reactor using &cRedstone&r. With just one, you can use a lever to turn on and off the reactor. However, we're going to use them for damage control.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 適配器能夠讓我們用&c紅石&r來操控反應爐，像是用控制桿開關反應爐。但我們現在要做的是損壞保護裝置。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: You can also set these to give off a Redstone Signal based on a certain condition within the Reactor, like &cDamage Critical&r or &8Insufficient Fuel&r. This is useful for setting up a circuit breaker to shut off the Reactor if those ever happen.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 在反應爐發生事故，像是&c嚴重損壞&r或是&8缺乏燃料&r時，適配器能夠輸出紅石信號。這對我們設計斷路器非常有幫助，使事故真的發生時能夠馬上關閉反應爐。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: As a recap, we've set up an advanced Ore Processing facility using several gases, machinery, and more.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 在上一章，我們已經蓋了一座高級的礦物工廠，了解了一部分機器的用途。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.original: In this chapter, we'll be using more of those to create powerful multiblock &aReactors&r, as well as advanced ways to create and store power. This will also lead to making &dAntimatter Pellets&r, which are used to make the &6ATM Star&r, as well as some of the strongest tools and weapons in the pack.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.reactor.translation: 在這一章，我們會蓋出更強力的多方塊結構，像是&a反應爐&r和更進階的儲電結構。\n這也是製作&d反物質球&r，也就是製作 &6ATM 之星&r，和模組包中一些最強大的工具與武器的必經之路。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.spsCons.original: The &dSupercritical Phase Shifter&r (SPS for short) is another multiblock structure used to infuse Polonium with large amounts of power to create &dAntimatter&r gas, which can be crystallized into pellets.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.spsCons.translation: &d超臨界移相器&r（簡稱 SPS）是個多方塊結構，利用大量電力將釙轉換為&d反物質&r氣體，經晶體化後可以得到反物質球。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.spsCons.original: To build the SPS, you'll need to make a total of 72 &9SPS Casings&r (60 for the build, 12 to make the ports), 3 &9SPS Ports&r, 122 Reactor Glass, and one other item we'll talk about in the next quest. Let's get the materials first!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.spsCons.translation: 要搭建超臨界移相器，要準備 72 個&9超臨界移相器外殼&r（60 個用來建造，12 個用來做端口）、三個&9超臨界移相器端口&r和 122 個結構玻璃。你先準備好材料，之後的任務會教你怎麼蓋。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.sulfuri.original: You should have already made &2Sulfuric Acid&r for your Tier 4 Ore Processing facility, but here is a reminder on how to get it.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.sulfuri.translation: 你已經在上一章學會如何製造&2硫酸&r了，我們這邊再來複習一下。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.sulfuri.original: Start by getting &eSulfur Dust&r either by crushing Sulfur from Thermal, or by mixing &bHydrogen Chloride&r with &3Gunpowder&r in a Chemical Dissolution Chamber.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.sulfuri.translation: 首先是&e硫粉&r，粉碎熱力系列的硫磺或是將&b氯化氫&r和&3火藥&r放入化學溶解室中混合都能夠獲得。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.sulfuri.original: Take the Sulfur Dust and run it through a &9Chemical Oxidizer&r to get &eSulfur Dioxide&r. Combine that with &bOxygen&r in a Chemical Infuser to get &eSulfur Trioxide&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.sulfuri.translation: 接著將硫粉送入&9化學氧化機&r後得到&e二氧化硫&r，再將&e二氧化硫&r和&b氧氣&r放入化學灌注器混合即可得到&e三氧化硫&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.sulfuri.original: Next, we'll combine &bWater Vapor&r with the Sulfur Trioxide to make &2Sulfuric Acid&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.sulfuri.translation: 接著將&b水蒸氣&r和三氧化硫混合就能得到&2硫酸&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.superch.original: The &9Supercharged Coil&r is placed on an SPS Port in the center of two faces, like the image below. When given power, these will supercharge Polonium into Antimatter. Only 1 is required, but you can use 2 if you want.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.superch.translation: 像下圖一樣將&9增壓線圈&r放在超臨界移相器的內部任兩面的中心（其實只需要一個就能夠運作了），並接上超臨界移相器端口。當輸入電力時，超臨界移相器就能將釙轉換成反物質。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.superch.original: To produce 1mb of Antimatter, you need 400MRF. If you haven't started making a &cFusion Reactor&r, now's a good time to make it!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.superch.translation: 產出 1 mb 的反物質，就需要消耗 400M RF。建議建造&c核融合反應爐&r來應付如此龐大的電力需求。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.tritium.original: By now, you're already making &aLithium&r. Pump that into a Solar Neutron Activator to create &eTritium&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.tritium.translation: 你已經能製造&a鋰&r了，將其導入太陽能中子活化器就能夠產出&e氚&r了。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.original: If you've built the Turbine properly, you will see red particles around the structure. Right clicking on the Turbine will open up the interface.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.translation: 如果你蓋成功了，周圍會有紅色的粒子效果提示你，對著渦輪按下右鍵就能開啟介面。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.original: This will tell you all of the information that you need to know, including the total Steam Flow Rate, as well as the total Steam inside of the Turbine.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.translation: 渦輪介面會顯示蒸氣流量和蒸氣儲存量等你需要知道的資料。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.original: On the right, you will have a bar that shows you the Power that is stored inside of the Turbine. If this gets full, the Turbine will turn off, unless you set it to Vent Overflow.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.translation: 在右側，有條顯示儲電量的計量條。除非你啟動了「排出過量」的開關，否則當計量條充滿後，渦輪就會停止運作。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.original: Once you have a fully functioning Fission Reactor, pump out the &bSteam&r directly into a Turbine Valve on your Turbine. Since we're using Saturating Condensers in this build, you can pump out water from a Turbine Vent back into your Reactor if you want.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.translation: 當你有台正在運作的核分裂反應爐，你可以將產生的&b蒸氣&r輸進渦輪內。在任務的範例中，我們有裝上飽和冷凝器，因此可以將渦輪產出的水輸回反應爐進行再利用。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.original: The &9Turbine Rotor&r is placed in the middle of the Turbine. For every Turbine Rotor, you will need 2 &aTurbine Blades&r. For this Turbine, we'll be using 3 Rotors.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.translation: &9渦輪轉子&r需要放在渦輪中央，每個轉子需要安裝兩個&a渦輪葉片&r。在任務的範例中，我們會用到三個渦輪轉子。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.original: While looking at the Rotor, right clicking with &aTurbine Blades&r will place them directly onto the Rotor. The taller the Rotor, the longer the Blades will become. For this build, we are using 6 total Blades. If you plan on building a bigger Turbine, you will need to increase the width of the Turbine depending on how many Blades you plan on using.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.translation: 手持&a渦輪葉片&r對著轉子按下右鍵，就能為轉子安裝葉片。需要注意的是，轉子越長，葉片也會越長，如果你要蓋更大台的渦輪，記得要給葉片留下足夠的空間。在任務的範例中，我們會用到六個葉片。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.original: The &9Rotational Complex&r must be placed at the top of the Turbine Rotor. This is then surrounded by &ePressure Dispersers&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.translation: &9旋轉裝置&r要放在渦輪轉子頂部，並在裝置周圍圍上&e分壓元件&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.original: The Dispersers must fill out the entire layer where the Rotational Complex sits.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.translation: 將含有旋轉裝置的那一層都要塞滿分壓元件。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.original: &9Turbine Valves&r are used to pump in &bSteam&r, as well as pumping out the power that the Turbine creates.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.translation: 工業渦輪透過&9渦輪閥門&r輸入&b蒸氣&r和輸出電力。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.original: &8Turbine Vents&r are used to pump out excess water when using &aSaturating Condensers&r. Otherwise, these help increase the overall flow of steam within the Turbine. The total number of Vents also limits the total Steam Flow Rate. Vents can also be used on the top face of the Turbine, but for this build, we'll just be using them on the outside faces.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.translation: &8渦輪排氣口&r用來排出&a跑和冷凝器&r生產的水。除此之外，工業渦輪的蒸氣流量也和排氣口數量有關。排氣口能夠放在頂面，但是在任務的範例中，我們只會將其擺在側面。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.original: &aSaturating Condensers&r are used to convert &bSteam&r back into water. These are placed on or above the layer containing the Electromagnetic Coils.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.turbine.translation: &a飽和冷凝器&r將&b蒸氣&r轉回水，進行循環再利用。放置&a飽和冷凝器&r的高度必須比電磁線圈還高。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.uranium.original: Using another &9Chemical Infuser&r, we want to combine our &bHydrofluoric Acid&r with &eUranium Oxide&r to make &2Uranium Hexafluoride&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.uranium.translation: 用另一台&9化學灌注器&r將&b氫氟酸&r和&e氧化鈾&r混合即可產出&2六氟化鈾&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.uranium.original: Every Reactor uses Uranium somewhere for fuel, right?
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.uranium.translation: 核分裂反應爐總會需要鈾對吧？

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.uranium.original: For starters, let's gather some &aUranium Ingots&r. We'll need to process these in an &9Enrichment Chamber&r to turn it into &eYellow Cake Uranium&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.uranium.translation: 因此，我們會需要一些&a鈾錠&r，並放入&9富集倉&r內，製造&e黃餅鈾&r。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.yellowC.original: Once we have our hands on &eYellow Cake Uranium&r, we can send it through a &aChemical Oxidizer&r to create the gas, &2Uranium Oxide&r.
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.desc.yellowC.translation: 做出&e黃餅鈾&r之後，將其送入&a化學氧化機&r即可製造&2氧化鈾&r氣體。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.fuelingTheFu.translation: 為&d核融合反應爐&r補充燃料

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.interactingW.translation: 核分裂反應爐的輸入/輸出

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.laserFocusAr.translation: 如何啟動反應爐：&d雷射聚焦陣列&r

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.observeCompl.translation: 觀察已完工的輸導矩陣

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.observeFissi.original: Observe Fissile Fuel in a Machine
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.observeFissi.translation: 在機器內觀察易裂變燃料

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.observeHydro.original: Observe Hydrofluoric Acid in a Machine

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.observeSulfu.original: Observe Sulfuric Acid in a Machine

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.observeUrani.original: Observe Uranium Hexafluoride in a Machine
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.observeUrani.translation: 在機器內觀察六氟化鈾

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.observeUrani.original: Observe Uranium Oxide in a Machine

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.subt.advance.original: &cRequires Quest \"Advanced Mekanism\" Completion from the Mekanism Chapter
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.subt.advance.translation: &c需要完成應用機械任務線的「應用機械：進階版」才能解鎖該任務。

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.subt.bestPow.original: The Best Power Source In The Pack

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.subt.blowUpR.original: Because We've All Blown Up A Reactor Before
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.subt.blowUpR.translation: 我們都有讓反應爐爆炸過

atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.subt.ponderV.original: Need a visual? Watch the Ponder!
atm9.quest.mekanismReactors.subt.ponderV.translation: 想看成果？模組有內建動畫。

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.activator.original:
Don't you hate Right Clicking everything? From Sheeps with Shears to Cows with Buckets? It's the 21st Century we should have Robots to everything! Or atleast Routers do everything. 

With Activator Module it will act as if it were you Right Clicking things. 

You can set what it will Right Click, if it will Attack or Use the Mob or Block, if you Shift Right Click, and how close they need to be in the Module.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.augment_c.original: When moving items Routers can get pretty greedy, taking every single item they can get their grubby antennas on! \n\nWith Regulator Augment you can limit how much is moved.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.augments..original: Augments are similar to Upgrades but for the individual Modules!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.blast_rou.original:
Sometimes a Router might be in a dangerous situation, like spawning a Wither. 

In order to protect it you'll need a Blast Upgrade. 

TNT won't break it, Wither won't break it, only you.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.breaker_m.original:
Did you play around with the Placer too much and need to Break those Blocks? 

Its Tier and Enchants are determined by the Pickaxe its Crafted with. 

Now set the area and hopefully put a Filter and let it run! 

Can be used with a Placer to do stuff like turning Ores into Items.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.bulk_item.original:
Modules only have so many slots for Filtered Items, if you need more than use this! Bulk Item Filter. 

You can put many more Items in to Whitelist or Blacklist in it. Then throw it in where normal Filters go! 

Will be needed to craft more unique Filters!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.camouflag.original:
This upgrade makes the Router similar to a Framed Block. 

Sneak Right Click a Block to change the Routers appearance to it. 

Just don't lose it!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.creative_.original:
HAHAHA did I scare you with the Creative Item in the Quests? 

Don't worry you won't need the item to finish this Quest page I just wanted to scare you. 


I can have fun sometimes...

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.delay_aug.original: Why wait? Oh you have valid reasons for waiting? Like items that might despawn. Huh wasn't thinking about those. \n\nWith Pickup Delay Augment the Vacuum Module will wait 10 ticks with every Augment in it to pick up dropped items!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.detector_.original:
Did you play around with the Placer too much and need to Break those Blocks? 

Its Tier and Enchants are determined by the Pickaxe its Crafted with. 

Now set the area and hopefully put a Filter and let it run! 

Can be used with a Placer to do stuff like turning Ores into Items.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.distribut.original:
The Distributer is the half siblings of the Sender Modules. (The MK3 to be exact, on the MK2 side). 

Instead of sending to 1 Inventory it will send to multiple that are selected. 

It can send in multiple modes: Round Robin, Random, Nearest First, or Farthest First. Round Robin does an even amount to each in a row, like a dealer in Poker. Random will randomly choose an inventory to feed. The others are determined by the distance from the Router.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.energy_di.original: Why set a location to where the Energy can go? Why not let it go free! \n\nLike freeing a bunch of Bees, the Energy will go everywhere almost instantly (with less buzzing). Any blocks needing Energy nearby will be charged wirelessly.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.energy_ou.original: Energy is something used by practically everything so you need to send it almost everywhere. Thankfully the Energy Module will help with that! \n\nThe Energy Module will move any Energy pushed into it, somewhere else! To wherever you set it to!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.energy_up.original: Takes more Energy with the Energy Modules!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.extruder_.original:
Extrude is such a prude word. 

The Extruder will place the blocks in the Router's Buffer in a line in front of the Router when given a Redstone Signal. When the Signal is disabled it will break all those blocks. 

Useful for Doors!
Similar to the Extruder MK1 but this one is more evolved! Can be used with Patterns so when Blocks are placed they will go in that pattern!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.farming.1.original: Routers can also be used for Farming! \nFirst start off with a simple Farm. Then you'll need an Activator Module and direct it toward the Crops. After that, put a Vacuum Module in your Router to collect the Crops. Finally put it all in the Router, Power it with Redstone, and let it farm!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.flinger_m.original:
Droppers drop,
Dispensers dispense, 
And Flingers fling! 

Instead of nicely setting down items from the Buffer, the Flinger Module will throw them? How far? You determine that!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.fluid_mod.original:
Water in. 
Water out. 

The Fluid Module will either take Liquid Sources from near the Router and put it into a Tank in the Buffer or take Liquid from a Tank in it's Buffer and place it in front of it. 

Only works for adjacent blocks to the Router, if you want bigger range you'll need...
The Fluid MK2! \n\nAny Liquid Source nearby can be used with this one, not just adjacent.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.fluid_upg.original: Fluid doesn't stack like Items do, so its upgrade is a little different. Still moves more just at a different rate.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.hopper_mo.original:
I wonder what Droppers do? 
I think they drop things... 

Any item in the Buffer will be dropped on the ground. 

Could be helpful with something like Botania!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.inspectio.original:
Durability, Fluid Level, Energy Level, Enchantment Level, and Food Value are all categories we can use with Inspection Filter. 

Then we select if we want it Greater than, Lesser than, Equal to, or a mix of those with the Numbered Amount. 

Next we give it a Numbered Amount and hit the Plus Button to add it to the Filter. 

This can be used to only keep Tools with high Durability or Food with high Food Value.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.intro.1.original:
&lModular Routers&r is a Logistics Mod. 

And it all starts with the Router! So make one! 

Also the Buffer is the single item slot in the Router where items will come and go through. And it will need Redstone Signal for most Modules to work.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.mimic_aug.original: Used with the Extruder MK2, blocks extruded will mimic the actual blocks. Redstone Blocks will emit Redstone, Glowstone will emit light, Grass will act transparent. But only with this Augment! \nDoesn't work with Block Entities like Furnaces or Enrichment Chambers.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.mining.1.original:
Don't feel like Mining a bunch of Ores you got? Why not let Routers do it for you? 

You can use a Placer to place down the Ores, then let an Enchanted Breaker Mine the Ores. Breaker needs the Pickaxe used to craft it to be Enchanted first, the Module itself can't be Enchanted. 

You might need another Router to pick up the dropped Ores.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.mob_farm..original:
Here's a good example of using Modular Routers to make a super easy organized Mob Farm. (Does not include way of killing mobs). 

For it I'll use a Wither Skeleton Farm as example. 

First, you want to get Items into the Buffer with a Vacuum Module. Next, get rid of the Stone Swords with a Void Module. To make sure it doesn't delete everything use a Whitelist Filter with the Stone Sword in it and not matching Damage. After, that you'll need a place to put the Loot, I recommend a Drawer System. Then, use a Sender Module to send the Loot to the Storage System. 

That's all you need!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.mod_filte.original: Filtering per Mod can be very helpful especially for Apotheosis. \n\nTo use it, put an item in from a certain Mod, then it will show the Mod name, and hit the Plus button to add it!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.modules.1.original:
Modules determine the action the Router preforms. 

They can make it so your Router pulls items from Chests, or put items into chests, or even both! And much more! 

Modules go into the Router themselves and multiple can be installed. 

Filtering and Upgrades go into the Modules themselves.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.muffler_u.original: Routers can be noisy, and noise definitely stacks when you have hundreds of them. \n\nMight be nice to invest in Muffer Upgrades then!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.pickup_au.original:
Why wait? Usually items dropped in Minecraft have a second they need to hit the ground to be picked up again. 

But why wait?

This upgrade lets the Vacuum Module not wait and immediately pick up the items. 

Very good for less lag!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.placer_mo.original: This one does as the name suggests, it places Blocks. \n\nSet the Direction you want the Block placed, preferably set the Filter, then throw the Module and Blocks into the Router! Once the Redstone is set the Blocks will be placed!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.player_mo.original:
The Router giveth and the Router taketh. 

This Module is helpful for Builders or even Miners! It can be set to send items from its Buffer to your Inventory or take items from your Inventory into its Buffer. 

Perfect for Strip-Mining, have it take all the Cobble and Deepslate from your Inventory and put it in a Trash Can.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.puller_mo.original:
Pull..! Pull..! Pull..! 

The Puller is the opposite of the Sender, it pulls items from Inventories into the Router's Buffer. 

The Inventory has to be adjacent to the Router.
Like the MK1 this pulls! Just not only from adjacent Inventories, but any Inventory nearby!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.pushing_a.original: The Extruder pushes blocks and entities by why not push it some more! \n\nThe entities not the blocks.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.range_dow.original: You don't want everything to do their actions at a larger range? You want your Vacuum to leave some room for dropping items in your World? Then I guess you can range down.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.range_up_.original: Just can't reach what you need to? Try Ranging Up! \n\nWith this everything will do their actions but farther. Vacuum has higher range for picking up items. Energy goes farther. Flinger flings with more strength!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.redstone_.original: Usually the Router commands the Modules but with this Augment the Module goes rouge! AWOl! Pure anarchy! \n\nIt will listen to it's own Redstone activation rather than the Routers.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.regex_fil.original: Is this code? I'm not paid to do coding!!??!?! I just wanted to make the Quests! \n\nHere you can type in a Regex into the Search Bar and click the Plus Button to add it to the Filter. Whenever that Regex comes up it will be filtered out.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.robin_aug.original: We've seen Filters and we've seen Round Robins, now we're seeing both! This is useful for keeping the Items in a select order like for when making Mystical Agriculture Seeds!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.security_.original: It's my stuff, no touchy. \n\nOnly you can use and mess with the Router after putting in the Upgrade.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.sender_mo.original: The Sender Modules will move Items in the Router's Buffer Slot into another Inventory. \n\nMK1 will only move items into Inventories on the same XYZ axis as the Router and with direct line of sight. If there is a block in the way, the MK1 Sender will not send.

Sender Module MK2 works similar to MK1 but with less restrictions. 

MK2 doesn't need direct line of sight or to be on same XYZ axis. 

Will have to be in the same Dimension though, unless you have...

MK3 doesn't worry about XYZ axis, line of sight, or Dimension. 

As long as the Inventory is in the same Minecraft World it can move items into it. 

Heck I'm not even sure if the Inventory has to be in the game of Minecraft to send to!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.speed_upg.original:
A Router does it's action every time it has one of it's ticks. 

Default is 20 Ticks or 1 Second. 

This can be made to less Ticks with the Speed Upgrade!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.stack_aug.original: Sometimes you don't want every Module to move multiple stacks at a time, so when you just want 1 Modules to do so use an Augment! This does not stack with Upgrades though... infact it overrides them.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.stack_upg.original: Normally the Router moves 1 item each of it's Ticks. This can be doubled and stacked! with the Stack Upgrade. \n\n1 Stack Upgrade is 2 Items, 2 Stacks 4 Items, and 6 Stacks is 64 Items a second.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.sync_upgr.original:
This one is unique as it's not used for just 1 Router but for multiple. 

If you want mutliple Routers working at the same time then each needs a Sync Upgrade. 

Will need to be tuned in its own GUI.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.tag_filte.original:
Tags are an essential part of Minecraft. 

For all who don't know they work as an organization tool to help choose similar items for the same task. Like Crafting Table being made with any Planks or Trees being Chopped down fastest with any Axe. 

To filter by Tag put an item in, then select the tag from the groups. Like Iron Ore for Ores.

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.upgrades..original: Upgrades go directly into the Router and the Router can hold 5 of them. Upgrades directly affect all Modules that they can and usually can stack!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.vacuum_mo.original:
Mean these Suck! Literally! 

Vacuum Module will suck up any items in the set area and move them to the Routers Buffer. Similar to the Absorption Hopper. 

Also can be used with Experience Augment!

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.void_modu.original:
If you are using Routers I hope you have some game knowledge. 

Just incase, to void an Item means to delete it. 

Any items that come into the Router, will be deleted forever! 

Recommend using Filters with this one...

atm9.quest.modular_router.desc.xp_vacuum.original: Now even more like the Absorption Hopper! \n\nVacuum Module will now pickup XP Orbs as well as Items. Whatever you do with the XP is up to you!

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.afritFeatures..original: &cAfrit Demons&r are Demons of &cFire&r. They are more advanced Demons, which some are friends and some are....not.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.afritFeatures..translation: &c火靈&r是&c火&r之惡魔。他們是高等惡魔，有些很友善，而有些...則不。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.afritFeatures..original: If we want to collect all of the Chalks, we'll need to summon a not-so friendly Ifrit. And kill it.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.afritFeatures..translation: 如果我們想要收集齊所有種類的粉筆的話，我們就會需要召喚不太友善的那種火靈。然後殺了他。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.afritFeatures..original: This specific Ritual will need a live sacrifice. Once you've placed all of the items needed and the Book of Binding into the Golden Sacrificial Bowl, the Ritual will not start until you sacrifice the living creature nearby it. In this instance, we'll be sacrificing a cow. Sorry again, Betsy.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.afritFeatures..translation: 這種特殊的儀式會需要一個活的獻祭物。當你將所有的物品和綁定之書都分別放到了獻祭之碗和黃金獻祭之碗之中之後，你會發現這次的儀式沒有開始。這是因為在這次儀式之中，我們會需要獻祭一頭牛來啟動它。（阿牛，這次我真的會永遠記得你的）

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.bookBinding.1.original: For us to specify which &c&mDemon&r &9Friend&r we want to summon, we'll need to make a specific &bBook of Binding&r.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.bookBinding.1.translation: 我們會需要使用特定的&b綁定之書&r，來讓我們能夠分辨出我們現在想要召喚的&c&m惡魔&r&9朋友&r是誰。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.bookBinding.2.original: To make this, you'll need to purify some Black Dye in &dSpiritfire&r to get Purified Ink. With this, we're going to make our first Book of Binding which will summon a &aFoliot&r Demon.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.bookBinding.2.translation: 你會需要在&d靈火&r之中淨化黑色染料，以獲得一些純淨墨水來將它製作出來。當我們製作出來之後，我們要綁定的第一種惡魔會是&a魔精&r。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.candles.2.original: For almost every Ritual to summon our friends, you'll need some Candles. You can create the &aButcher Knife&r and kill some pigs, cows, sheep, horses, or even the Trader Llamas to get some &aTallow&r to make them. Matter of fact, you should definitely find the Trader Llamas. I hear they make good candles. &mI totally didn't just make that up&r.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.candles.2.translation:
幾乎每種用來召喚我們的朋友的儀式都會需要使用到一些蠟燭。

你可以製作一把&a屠刀&r，就能夠用它來殺死一些豬、牛、羊、馬或甚至是商駝以取得一些&a動物油脂&r來製作本模組的蠟燭。

事實上，你完全應該找到一些商駝。我聽說用它們來製作的蠟燭品質非常的好。&m（這絕對不是我亂編的）&r

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.candles.3.original: Otherwise, Vanilla Candles can also work!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.candles.3.translation: 不然，你也可以使用原版的蠟燭！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.candles.4.original: &9Spirit Attuned Crystals&r are also used in several Rituals, so might as well make some now!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.candles.4.translation: &9魔靈同調水晶&r也被使用在一些高階儀式之中，所以你現在最好也製作一些！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.captureDemons.original: This item is used to capture Demons for transport or storage. It's also needed for the &6ATM Star&r.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.captureDemons.translation: 靈魂寶石（空）是用來將惡魔捕捉起來，並用來傳輸或儲存的一種物品。你也會需要用它來製作出&6ATM 之星&r。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonFruit.1.original: &cDemon's Dream Fruit&r is perfectly healthy for you. There might be some side effects you should know about.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonFruit.1.translation: &c魔鬼之夢果&r是一種非常健康的食物。但你需要知道它的一些副作用。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonFruit.2.original: When you consume one, you have a chance to get the effect of the &3Third Eye&r, allowing you to see into the &9The Otherworld&r. Certain items in the world might not be what they seem, and you'll need this \"vision\" to find certain items for progression.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonFruit.2.translation: 當你吃下它之後，你有機率會獲得&3第三隻眼&r效果：讓你能夠看到&9異界&r。異界中的某些物品可能會發生變化，你會需要利用這種「視野」來找到某些讓你能夠繼續發展下去的物品。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonFruit.3.original: Or you can set it on fire and skip finding most of them. That's up to you.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonFruit.3.translation: 或者你也可以將它丟到火中來跳過大多數的尋找過程。一切取決於你。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonMining.1.original: With our ability to harvest &cIesnium&r, we can call upon the Demons to do our bidding in the mines... I mean.... help us gather ores. Definitely not exploiting Demons or anything.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonMining.1.translation: 在我們取得了&c艾瑟金屬&r之後，我們就可以奴役...我是指...讓惡魔自願地幫我們挖礦了。我剛剛絕對沒有說什麼奇怪的話。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonMining.2.original: For this, we'll need to create a &dDimensional Mineshaft&r to access the Demon Mining World. You'll also need a Mining Demon confined to a lamp, which you'll place inside of the Mineshaft for it to work. While any tier will complete this quest, higher tiers work faster and have a higher chance at mining Iesnium for you.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonMining.2.translation: 要達成這點，我們會需要製造出一個&d維度礦井&r以通往「惡魔挖礦世界」。你也會需要一個寄宿著挖礦惡魔的神燈，並將它放入維度礦井來開始運作。\n\n就算所有階級的挖礦惡魔都能夠用來完成此任務，我還是推薦你使用更高階級的挖礦惡魔：它們工作的更快，也有更高的機率能夠挖出稀有礦物。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonMining.3.original: The Mineshafts do not auto-export on their own. You will need to extract the items out using either Hoppers, Transporting Demons, or some other method like Item Pipes. It will void any items over its storage limit.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonMining.3.translation: 維度礦井不會自動輸出它的內容物。你會需要使用像是漏斗、傳輸型的惡魔或是物品管線之類的方式來輸出物品。不然在它達到儲物上限之後，它會自動銷毀挖到的任何礦物。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonsAndFamil.original: Occultism provides more than just Demons to crush your ores!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonsAndFamil.translation: 《神祕學》模組中不是只有那些能夠粉碎你的礦物的惡魔！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonsAndFamil.original: There are Demons that can move stuff for you, chop down wood, and more!!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonsAndFamil.translation: 本模組中有著能夠幫你搬東西、砍樹...等的各種惡魔！！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonsAndFamil.original: There are also ways to summon cool friends known as &dFamiliars&r that give special buffs and even fight for you! Make sure to check out the &dFamiliar Rituals&r in your guide book!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.demonsAndFamil.translation: 也能夠召喚一些被稱為&d使魔&r的好朋友：它們能夠給予你特別的增益效果，甚至是為你戰鬥！請去查看模組手冊中的&d使魔儀式&r以了解更多資訊！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dictionary.1.original: The &aDictionary Of Spirits&r serves as the Guide Book for &dOccultism&r. You'll absolutely need to make this if you want to continue with the mod!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dictionary.1.translation: &a魔靈全典&r是&d《神祕學》&r的模組手冊。你如果想要在這個模組中發展下去的話，你一定會需要它。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dictionary.2.original: The Dictionary has a quest-style guide inside of it if you'd rather read it instead of doing these quests!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dictionary.2.translation: 魔靈全典的風格很像是任務書，但你不需要完成任務也能夠不斷閱讀新的內容。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dictionary.3.original: You'll also need the book to craft several things in the pack, so you kind of have to make it. :)
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dictionary.3.translation: 你也會需要使用這本全典來合成模組中的某些物品，所以你基本上一定要製作一本。:)

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dimensionalSto.original: You're bound to have too many items playing this modpack. It's just it works, and if you haven't figured out your storage situation yet, &dDimensional Storage&r might just be right for you!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dimensionalSto.translation: 你在遊玩本模組包時肯定會發生下面這種情況：「我有太多的物品要存了」。這就是&d維度儲存&r要處理的問題：如果你還沒想好要用何種儲存方式的話，這一定會是你的其中一個好選擇！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dimensionalSto.original: To get started with this magical storage solution, you'll need to craft the &dDimensional Storage Actuator&r and place it down into the world. This acts just like a Shulker Box, meaning if you break it, it won't lose any of the items stored inside.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dimensionalSto.translation: 你會需要合成出一個&d維度儲存促動器&r，並將它放置出來作為你的開始。它的功能有點類似於界伏盒：當你破壞它時，裡面的物品都會保存在它的儲物空間之中。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dimensionalSto.original: By default, this has 128 storage slots with each slot holding up to 16 stacks of an item, except for items with &5NBT&r data. These will not stack and will take up an entire slot, so make sure to leave those items out!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dimensionalSto.translation: 預設情況下，裡面會有能夠容納 16 組同種物品的 128 個不同的槽位；除了擁有 &5NBT&r 數據的那些物品：它們無法疊加並且會占用一整個槽位，所以記得不要將這種物品放進去！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dimensionalSto.original: If you aren't sure what items have NBT data on them, you can always check out the quest \"NBT and You\" in the Storage questline for more info on NBT!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.dimensionalSto.translation: 如果你不知道什麼叫做「NBT 數據」的話，你可以去查看《基本儲存》任務線之中的「NBT 與你！」任務來了解更多資訊！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.divinationRods.original: While you can get most of the &dOtherworld&r materials using Spiritfire, you can also use &9Divination Rods&r to locate these materials.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.divinationRods.translation: 就算你能夠透過靈火來取得大多數的&d異界&r材料，你也能夠使用&9探測杖&r來尋找這些材料。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.divinationRods.original: First, you'll need to attune the Rod to the material you are looking for. For example, if you are on the hunt for &8Otherstone&r, you can use the Rod on &aAndesite&r to help locate the Otherstone in the world.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.divinationRods.translation: 首先，你會需要讓你的探測杖與你想要尋找的材料進行同調。舉例來說：如果你想尋找&8異界石&r的話，你可以對著&a安山岩&r使用探測杖來幫助你找到這世界上的異界石。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.divinationRods.original: Once attuned to a material, you can hold right click with the Rod in hand, and a particle will shoot off in the direction of the nearest material it is attuned to.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.divinationRods.translation: 當它與一個材料同調時，你就能夠手持它並按住右鍵，然後它就會讓世界上離你最近的同調材料獲得發光效果。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.divinationRods.original: You will still need to be under the effects of the &3Third Eye&r to be able to harvest the Otherworld block.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.divinationRods.translation: 但你還是會需要處於&3第三隻眼&r狀態下才能夠採下那些異界方塊。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.findIesnium.1.original: The next step in your journey will be to get some Raw &eIesnium Ore&r.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.findIesnium.1.translation: 你會需要獲得一些&e粗艾瑟金屬&r來繼續你的神祕學之旅。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.findIesnium.2.original: Since this is a skyblock and of course the Nether is a void dimension, you will get this by sieving Blackstone!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.findIesnium.2.translation: 我們現在位於空島上：地獄是個全空的維度，所以你會需要透過篩黑石來獲得此礦物！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.firstRitual.1.original: For our first Ritual, we want to summon a &aFoliot Crusher&r Demon. This Demon will crush items for us, which is something we'll need to make some of the higher level Chalks!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.firstRitual.1.translation: 我們舉行的第一個儀式會是「召喚&a魔精碎礦者&r」。這隻惡魔會為我們粉粹物品：能夠粉碎出更高等級的粉筆的所需材料！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.firstRitual.2.original: To start with, combine your Unbound Book with your &aDictionary of Spirits&r in a crafting table. This will bind a Demon to the book, which is what we'll need for the Ritual.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.firstRitual.2.translation: 讓我們先從「綁定之書：魔精」開始：當它剛被製作出來的時候，它會是未綁定的狀態；所以我們會需要將它與&a魔靈全典&r結合來將惡魔綁定到此書中。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.firstRitual.3.original: Speaking of your Dictionary of Spirits, it's time to open it up! On the left, click on the &dPentacles&r tab and click on &bAviar's Circle&r. You might have to advance through it by reading a little bit. There is also a way to click \"Mark All As Read\" so it unlocks everything in the book.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.firstRitual.3.translation: 說到你的魔靈全典，是時候用它來查詢一些資料了！點開左邊的&d五芒星&r頁面，然後找到&b阿維亞之環&r。您可能會需要閱讀一點書中的其他內容來開啟它。不然你也可以點擊右上角的「將所有內容標記為已讀」來解鎖書中的全部內容。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.firstRitual.4.original: This is what we're going to use to summon our new Friend. On the right side, you can click the eye in the bottom-left corner of the image to build an outline of the Ritual for you in the world. This is super helpful!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.firstRitual.4.translation: 我們將會使用上述的儀式來召喚出一位新朋友。你可以點擊右邊那頁的眼睛以直接在世界上看到該如何建造出你的儀式場景。這是一個非常有幫助的功能！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.firstRitual.5.original: Once you've completed the multi-block Ritual, place down 4 Sacrificial Bowls and use the required items on them. Once you place your Bound Book in the Golden Sacrificial Bowl, the Ritual will start!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.firstRitual.5.translation: 當你建造完你的儀式之後，在附近的空地放下 4 個獻祭之碗，並將儀式所需物品放在它們上面。最後，當你將你的綁定之書放進黃金獻祭之碗後，儀式便會開始！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.firstRitual.6.original: This is what the Ritual will look like. The rods are just there for lighting.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.firstRitual.6.translation: 下圖是儀式的樣子。（那四根桿子只是為了照明）

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.flammableFruit.original: What if I told you that the Demon's Fruit is flammable?
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.flammableFruit.translation: 如果我告訴你惡魔之夢果是可以燃燒的呢？

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.flammableFruit.original: Throwing our &cDemon's Dream Fruit&r down and setting it on fire will create &dSpiritfire&r. This is how we'll convert some overworld items into &9Otherworld&r materials.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.flammableFruit.translation: 丟出&c魔鬼之夢果&r並點火會製造出&d靈火&r。這是把主世界的物品轉換為&9異界&r材料的方法。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.foliotCrusher.original: Now that we have a Foliot Crusher, we can &muse&r politely ask it to crush down some &eEnd Stone&r and &9Obsidian&r for us. We'll use these to make some new Chalk!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.foliotCrusher.translation: 現在我們得到了一隻魔精碎礦者，我們可以&m禮貌地&r請他幫我們粉碎一些&e終界石&r和&9黑曜石&r。這些是用來製作新的粉筆的材料！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.foliotDemonFea.translation: 看吧，惡魔並不都是壞的！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.foliotDemonFea.original: If you've completed the Ritual properly, you'll now have your very own &cFoliot Crusher Demon&r. These Demons are great at crushing down items for you!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.foliotDemonFea.translation: 如果你已經完成的上面的儀式的話，你現在就會擁有你的專屬&c魔精粉粹者&r了。他們很擅於幫你粉粹物品！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.foliotDemonFea.original: To give it an item to crush, just throw it nearby and it will pick up the item and crush it. You can also sneak-right click the Demon to open up the inventory.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.foliotDemonFea.translation: 只要將要讓他粉碎的物品丟給他，他就會撿起那些物品並開始粉碎它們了。你也可以潛行+右鍵點擊他來開啟他的物品欄。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.foliotDemonFea.original: This is a starter Demon, so it won't last very long. This one can also double your ore output for you!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.foliotDemonFea.translation: 他是一隻低級惡魔，所以他無法在我們的世界中待太久。你能夠利用他來雙倍化你的礦物產出！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.maridCrusher.1.original: That first Foliot Demon was cool, but what if I told you that you could summon a demon that gives you 6 dusts per raw ore it crushes?
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.maridCrusher.1.translation: 第一隻魔精是很酷。但是如果我告訴你，你可以召喚一隻每破壞一個一個原礦就給妳六個粉末的惡魔呢？

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.maridCrusher.2.original: The &5Marid Crusher&r does exactly that. To summon them, you'll need to use the &cFatma's Incentivized Attraction&r pentacle. This is an advanced ritual, requiring Red, White, and Gold Chalk as well as a lot of space.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.maridCrusher.2.translation: &5魔王碎礦者&r 恰好就是這樣做的。為了召喚魔王，你需要使用 &c費德曼的正向吸引力&r 五芒星。這是一個高級的儀式，需要紅色、白色、金色粉筆以及大面積的空間。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.otherworldItem.original: There are more Otherworld items you will need to gather, and eating &cDemon's Dream Fruit&r every time you need the &7Third Eye&r effect gets annoying.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.otherworldItem.translation: 你會需要收集很多的異界物品，但每次都需要透過食用&c魔鬼之夢果&r來獲得&7第三隻眼&r的話很麻煩。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.otherworldItem.original: This is what the &dOtherworld Goggles&r are for! When equipped (even in your Curios slot), it gives the Third Eye effect!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.otherworldItem.translation: 這就是為什麼會出現&d異界眼鏡&r這件飾品！當你將它裝備在裝備欄或飾品欄時，它會為你提供「第三隻眼」效果！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.remoteAccess.1.original: Want to access your storage remotely? This can be done with either the &eStable Wormhole&r or the &aStorage Accessor&r.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.remoteAccess.1.translation: 想要遠程存取你的儲存系統嗎？你可以使用&e穩定蟲洞&r或是&a儲存存取器&r來完成這點。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.remoteAccess.2.original: To use the &eStable Wormhole&r, shift-click a &dStorage Actuator&r to link it. You can then place the Wormhole to act as another storage location.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.remoteAccess.2.translation: 你會需要先手持&e穩定蟲洞&r對著&d維度儲存促動器&r潛行+右鍵來為他們建立連結。然後你就能夠將它放在任何地方來進行遠程存取了。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.remoteAccess.3.original: The &aStorage Accessor&r is linked in the same way, but acts as a wireless remote that can even work across dimensions!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.remoteAccess.3.translation: &a儲存存取器&r也是使用相同的方式來建立連接，但是它的作用更像是一個能夠跨維度工作的無線遙控器！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.ritualChalk.1.original: Before we start enlisting the help of our Demon friends, we will need to create the most important item needed for Rituals: &aChalk&r.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.ritualChalk.1.translation: 在我們開始尋求惡魔朋友的幫助之前，我們會會需要製造出儀式所需的最重要的物品：&a粉筆&r。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.ritualChalk.2.original: There are several colors of chalk needed, with higher level Rituals requiring several to activate. To start with, &bWhite Chalk&r is the easiest to get.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.ritualChalk.2.translation: 粉筆有很多種顏色：越高等級的祭壇所需要的顏色就越多。我們會先從最容易取得的&b白色粉筆&r開始。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.ritualChalk.3.original: Start by tossing Otherstone in a furnace, and tossing Otherworld Logs into &dSpiritfire&r. With the items you create, you'll be able to make the Impure White Chalk.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.ritualChalk.3.translation: 讓我們將一些異界石丟到熔爐之中，再將一些異界原木丟到&d靈火&r之中。你就能夠利用這兩種物品來製作出含雜白色粉筆了。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.ritualChalk.4.original: To purify any piece of Chalk, simply throw it into &dSpiritfire&r to cleanse it. Using the Purified Chalk on the ground will draw &mdemonic&r pretty symbols on the ground. These are a pain to remove, unless of course, you make yourself the &aChalk Brush&r. Do it, it's worth it.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.ritualChalk.4.translation: 只要簡單地將它丟進&d靈火&r之中，就能去除粉筆之中的雜質了。使用無雜質的粉筆能夠在地板上畫出&m惡魔般的&r漂亮的符號。\n\n要清除掉這些符號並不是一件容易的事情，所以，你也可以製作一把&a粉筆擦&r。來吧，它真的很有用。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.sacrifice.1.original: What is a Demonic Ritual without a &cSacrifice&r! :D
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.sacrifice.1.translation: 沒有獻祭的話怎麼能夠稱作惡魔儀式呢！:D

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.sacrifice.2.original: Most of the time, Demons just like items so don't be too afraid yet. However, if you have a favorite Cow, you might need to be worried. Sorry Betsy.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.sacrifice.2.translation: 大多數時候，這些惡魔只對那些物品有興趣，所以別感到太害怕。然而，如果你有一頭非常喜愛的牛，那你可能會需要擔心。（阿牛我會永遠記得你的）

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.sacrifice.3.original: &aSacrifical Bowls&r are used to place items needed for Rituals. These can be placed anywhere within the Ritual, as long as it isn't convering up any of the required Chalk.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.sacrifice.3.translation: &a獻祭之碗&r是用來放置儀式所需物品的地方。它們能夠被放在儀式之中的任何空位：只要確保不要覆蓋掉任何的粉筆符號就行。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.sacrifice.4.original: The &6Golden Sacrificial Bowl&r is used in the middle of the Ritual to activate it, and also usually needs a Book of Binding for the Ritual in it.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.sacrifice.4.translation: &6黃金獻祭之碗&r會被放在儀式的正中間：它是儀式的啟動開關，同時也是大部分儀式中用來放置綁定之書的地方。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.soulGemFeature.original: While there are other methods to move Demons around, you can create an &dEmpty Soul Gem&r to capture a Demon and place it somewhere else. This is also needed for the ATM Star.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.soulGemFeature.translation: 就算有很多種不同的方式來移動你的惡魔，你也可以創造一塊&d靈魂寶石（空）&r來捕捉這些惡魔並將他們放在別處。你也會需要使用它來製作 ATM 之星。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.soulGemFeature.original: To make this, we'll need to do a more advanced Ritual called &aStrigeor's Higher Binding&r. For this, you'll need &a8 Sacrificial Bowls&r as well as the items required for this quest.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.soulGemFeature.translation: 你會需要使用被稱作「&a斯特里格高等束縛&r」的一種高等儀式來製作它。在這個儀式中，你會需要使用到這個任務的任務目標物品和總共 &a8 個獻祭之碗&r。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.soulGemFeature.original: Remember, you can always use the multi-block preview by finding the Pentacle in the &bDictionary of Spirits&r to help you build the structure.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.soulGemFeature.translation: 記住，你永遠都可以使用&b魔靈全典&r中的多方塊預覽來幫助你建造出這些儀式。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.spiritfireUse..original: Using &dSpiritfire&r, we can convert several Overworld mats into their Otherworld variants. You can also find several Otherworld mats by going under the effects of the &bThird Eye&r. There are crafting recipes for the basic materials by throwing them into &dSpiritfire&r.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.spiritfireUse..translation: 我們可以用&d靈火&r將一些主世界的材料轉換為它們的異界變種。你也可以在&b第三隻眼&r效果下找到數種異界材料。這裡有一些一些基本材料的合成表，將材料丟進&d靈火&r來製作。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.spiritfireUse..original: &bAndesite&r converts to &3Otherstone&r, which can be used to light a permanent &dSpiritfire&r.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.spiritfireUse..translation: &b安山岩&r能夠被轉換成&3異界石&r，利用異界石可以讓你的&d靈火&r永不熄滅。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.spiritfireUse..original: &aOak Saplings&r convert to &9Oak Saplings&r but they are not the same. When grown, these will look exactly like a regular Oak tree. However, under the effects of the &bThird Eye&r, you will be able to harvest the Otherworld variant.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.spiritfireUse..translation: &a橡木樹苗&r能夠被轉換成&9橡木樹苗&r，等等，它們其實是不同的物品：當它長大時，它長得跟普通的橡木完全一模一樣；然而，當你在&b第三隻眼&r狀態下時，你就能夠採下它的異界變種。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.spiritfireUse..original: &eDiamonds&r will turn into &dSpirit Attuned Gems&r which are used in several recipes we'll need later down the road.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.spiritfireUse..translation: &e鑽石&r能夠被轉換成&d魔靈同調寶石&r，它被廣泛使用在本模組的各種合成配方之中。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.storageStabili.original: To upgrade the amount of stacks your magical storage can hold, you'll need to make &dStorage Stabilizers&r.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.storageStabili.translation: 你會需要&d維度儲存穩定器&r來增加你的魔法儲存能夠容納的物品組數。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.storageStabili.original: Once made, these must point directly at the Dimensional Matrix part of your Storage Actuator, not the base. These can be up to 5 blocks away, but must have a clear line of sight to the Matrix.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.storageStabili.translation: 當你將它們做出來之後，必須要將它們對著維度水晶矩陣（不是基座）放置。最多能放在離矩陣 5 格方塊遠的地方，但不能在它們之間放置任何方塊。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.storageStabili.original: Whenever you want to upgrade to a higher tier Stabilizer, breaking it won't destroy the items inside. However, you will not be able to add any more items to your storage until it is either replaced or upgraded.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.storageStabili.translation: 如果你想要將你的穩定器升級，直接將它破壞不會讓任何物品消失。但是，直到你將它放回去之前，你都沒辦法再將更多物品加入到你的儲存系統之中。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.storageStabili.original: Below is an example of a simple setup!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.storageStabili.translation: 下圖是一種簡易設置方式的範例圖！

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.useIesnium.1.original: Once you've gathered a few &aRaw Iesnium Ores&r, you'll probably want to use the first few ingots to make an &dIesnium Pickaxe&r. This pickaxe is not only pretty nifty, but will be important to get the demons to do your biddings in the mines.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.useIesnium.1.translation: 當你獲得了一些&a艾瑟金屬原礦&r之後，你可能會想要使用你的前幾個艾瑟金屬錠來製作出一把&d艾瑟金屬鎬&r。這把鎬的外觀不僅非常華麗，而且你也會需要使用它以驅使惡魔為你挖礦。

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.useIesnium.2.original: Do yourself a favor and make one of these!
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.useIesnium.2.translation: 幫自己一個忙：做出一把艾瑟金屬鎬吧！
