atm9.quest.occultism.desc.welcome.2.original: This mod aimes to help the player in many different ways by enlisting the help of &c&mDemons&r &bSpirits&r! Don't worry, they are friendly. &oMostly&r.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.welcome.2.translation: 本模組旨在藉由尋求各式各樣的&c&m惡魔&r&b魔靈&r的幫助，來讓玩家的生活更便利！不用擔心，他們非常的友善。（&o大多數情況下&r）

atm9.quest.occultism.desc.welcome.3.original: To get started, you'll need to get some &aDemon's Fruit Seeds&r.
atm9.quest.occultism.desc.welcome.3.translation: 你會需要先獲得一些&a魔鬼之夢種子&r來開始本模組。

atm9.quest.occultism.observeFoliot.translation: 觀察 魔精類型的惡魔

atm9.quest.occultism.preparingRitualCrys.translation: 儀式前的準備：&8獻祭之碗&r

atm9.quest.occultism.subt.fastestCrushin.original: The Fastest Crushing On This Side of the Mississippi

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.aluminum.original: I'm more of a Milk Chocolate kind of guy myself.

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.autoJuicing.1.original: You can automate the use of vats very easily. All you will need is a Hopper, a Chest and a trapped mob.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.autoJuicing.1.translation: 你能夠很輕鬆的對木盆進行自動化。你只需要一個漏斗、一個儲物箱，並困住一個生物。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.autoJuicing.2.original: This works by having your trapped mob (a Zombie, not all mobs work) stuck in the Vat, causing it to automatically jump and squish your Berries. Remember to Name Tag it so it doesn't despawn.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.autoJuicing.2.translation: 你只需要將生物（最好是用殭屍，並非所有的生物都能用）困在木盆上，讓牠開始自動跳躍，以幫你擠壓這些礦莓。記得要對牠使用命名牌，以確保牠不會消失。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.automated.original: If you set up a farm that funnels items into your automated juicing setup you can fully automate the production of Oreberries.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.automated.translation: 如果你已經搭建出了一個自動化礦莓農場的話，你可以將它產出的礦莓輸出到自動榨汁裝置之中，就能夠完成一個全自動化的礦莓產線。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.click.original: An incredibly easy and simple way of automating Oreberries can be done using a Click Machine as shown in this image. No this isn't the best automation, but it is probably one of the simplest.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.click.translation: 你能夠使用一個非常簡單的方式來自動採收礦莓：像下圖的方式放置「自動點擊器」。這不是最好的自動化方式，但它是最簡單的方式。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.copper.original: Scientists are still trying to figure out why it tastes like metal.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.copper.translation: 叩叩叩，先生你的外送到了。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.essence.original: Technically not an 'Oreberry' however I will still refer to it as an Oreberry in these quests.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.essence.translation: 技術上來說這不是「礦莓」，但在這章節的任務裡，我仍然將其稱為礦莓。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.farmingBerrie.original: Oreberry Bushes can be placed as closely next to each other as you wish, meaning you could recreate the image below if you wished.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.farmingBerrie.translation: 礦莓灌木叢能夠隨你想要的方式進行並排放置，這代表你能夠製造出像是下圖中的礦莓農場：

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.farmingBerrie.original: Note: Oreberries grow at the same speed no matter the light level at where they are placed.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.farmingBerrie.translation: 註：與《匠魂》模組不同，本模組中的礦莓不會因為不同的照明等級而有不同的生長速度。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.gold.original: Piglins don't even accept these. Such a scam.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.gold.translation: 實際上豬布林不接受這東西，這是一場騙局。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.growingBerrie.original:
To grow the actual Oreberries simply place down your Oreberry Bush and wait. After a while it will start growing like Sweet Berries do and you will be able to harvest them.

You can now smelt your Oreberries for one Metal Nugget each. If you grew Essence Berries simply right-click to gain some experience.

Note: Smelting Oreberries in a Restone Furnace will always give you Iron Nuggets, no matter what Oreberry you're smelting...Magic.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.growingBerrie.translation:
要讓你的礦莓生長的話，你只要將它放置出來，然後慢慢等待。過了一段時間之後，它就會像甜莓一樣開始生長，接下來你就能夠採收了。

你可以透過熔煉礦莓來獲得一個對應的「金屬粒」。但如果是經驗莓的話，只要點擊右鍵就能消耗它來獲得經驗。

註：在通量熔煉爐中熔煉任何一種礦莓都只會產出鐵粒。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.iron.original: It's Ironic that this pun is from the mod and not even from me.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.iron.translation: 愛的教育，鐵的紀律。\n\n沒有什麼哏，但我已經盡力了。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.juice.original: Oreberry Juice can be picked up with a Bucket and stored in Tanks!

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.lead.original: Unfortunately just like the rest of the Oreberries, they aren't edible.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.lead.translation: 請改用無鉛水龍頭。\n\n《海廷頓》無鉛水龍頭。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.makingBushes..original: All Oreberry Bushes are made the same way, by using the Summoning Alter. The recipe will be:
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.makingBushes..translation: 所有的礦莓都是使用相同的方式來製造：透過「召喚祭壇」。它們的製造方式會像是下列這樣：

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.makingBushes..original: Then put in an Emerald as the catalyst to craft your Oreberry Bushes.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.makingBushes..translation: 然後放入一顆綠寶石當作催化劑來合成出你的礦莓。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.nickel.original: If i have a Nickel for every time I had to copy puns into these quests I would have 12 Nickels. Which isn't a lot but it's weird that I still have a soul.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.nickel.translation: 我究竟造了什麼孽，才必須在這邊想 12 個雙關諧音笑話。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.oreberries.original: Oreberries Replanted adds a new way to generate common ores by growing them on bushes. It is intended for use in the early game. The mod is inspired by Oreberry Bushes from Tinker's Construct.\n\nTo get started you will need Oreberry Bushes, obtained via the Summoning Alter. Each recipe will require an Emerald.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.oreberries.translation: 《礦莓：重製版》模組中加入了一種取得常見礦物的新方法：用灌木叢種出它們。本模組旨在幫助前期玩家更好的過渡。本模組的靈感來自《匠魂》模組中的「礦莓灌木叢」。\n\n你會需要從召喚祭壇取得「礦莓灌木叢」來開始本模組。它們都會需要使用一顆綠寶石來製造。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.osmium.original: I bet you're singing now, am I right?
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.osmium.translation: 兒子養著養著就變成女兒了。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.pottedBerries.original: Oreberry Bushes can be placed into pots and used for decoration.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.pottedBerries.translation: 你能夠將礦莓灌木叢放入花盆中，以將它們當作裝飾品使用。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.silver.original: Use something less pure if you want your Vampire friends back.

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.tin.original: Tin Man is just Iron Man without the heart. Prove me wrong.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.tin.translation: 當你用華為手機給你的朋友發送一張哏圖時，會有 3 個人在笑。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.uranium.original: I think Uranium might be radioactive... just a hunch though.

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.vats.1.original:
Instead of smelting Oreberries, you can squish them for more Nuggets!

Start by making a Vat and placing it down. Now put some Oreberries in it and walk in the middle of it, you should start automatically jumping. Jumping on the berries will turn them into Oreberry Juice (Each berry = 150-200mb). You will notice the juice starts evaporating and leaving behind Nuggets (1 Nugget = 100mb of Juice). This doesn't work with Essence Berries.

Note: You can use a Time in a Bottle to speed up this process.
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.vats.1.translation:
除了直接熔煉礦莓之外，你也可以透過擠壓它們來獲得更多的金屬粒！

首先，製作一個木盆並放置它。再來，將一些礦莓放進去，然後走到它上面，你會自動開始跳躍：在木盆上跳躍會將礦莓轉化為礦莓果汁（每個莓果大約為 150~200mb 左右）。最後，你會發現這些果汁開始蒸發，並留下金屬粒在盆中（1 個金屬粒為 100mb 的果汁）。（經驗莓無法放入木盆中）


註：你可以使用「時間之瓶」來加速此過程。

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.vats.2.original: Congratulations, you've almost doubled your output!
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.vats.2.translation: 恭喜，你現在的產出大約變成了雙倍！

atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.zinc.original: I swear these aren't even my puns...
atm9.quest.oreberries.desc.zinc.translation: 我知道這很沒哏，但請有點同理心，不然你來想 12 個雙關諧音笑話。

atm9.quest.oreberries.subt.automated.translation: 不需要更多的體力勞動了！（對你來說）

atm9.quest.oreberries.subt.growingBerrie.translation: 不，它們不可食用...（我親自測試過了）

atm9.quest.oreberries.subt.lead.original: Would not eat, may be poisonous

atm9.quest.oreberries.subt.nickel.original: If I had a Nickel for every...

atm9.quest.oreberries.subt.osmium.original: I am blue Da ba dee da ba di

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.armor.original:
Pickle Tweaks adds a few new armor types:

Emerald Armor: Better than Diamond Armor but worse than Netherite.
Flint Armor: Better than Chainmail Armor but worse than Iron.
Night Vision Goggles: Allows you to see in the dark.
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.armor.translation:
泡菜調整增加了一些新的裝備類型：

綠寶石裝備：比鑽石裝備好，但比獄髓裝備差。

燧石裝備：比鎖鏈裝備好，但比鐵裝備差。

夜視鏡：讓你能在黑暗中看得見。

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.coalPieces.original: Coal Pieces can be crafted to save Coal. Each Coal Piece can smelt one item.
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.coalPieces.translation: 小煤塊可合成以節省煤炭。每個煤炭碎片可以熔煉一個物品。

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.coloredCobb.original: Colored Cobblestone are blocks specifically for decoration, other than their color, they are the same as regular cobblestone.
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.coloredCobb.translation: 彩色鵝卵石是專門用於裝飾的方塊，除了顏色之外，它們與普通的鵝卵石相同。

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.diamondAppl.original:
Diamond Apples grants the following potion effects:

 - Regeneration II (0:20)
 - Absorption III (4:10)
 - Fire Resistance I (4:10)
 - Resistance I (4:10)
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.diamondAppl.translation:
鑽石蘋果賦予以下藥水效果：

 -回復 II (0:20)

 - 吸收 III (4:10)

 - 抗火 I (4:10)

 - 抗性 I (4:10)

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.emeraldAppl.original:
Emerald Apples grants the following potion effects:

 - Strength I (4:10)
 - Regeneration III (0:20)
 - Absorption IV (4:10)
 - Fire Resistance I (4:10)
 - Resistance II (4:10)
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.emeraldAppl.translation:
綠寶石蘋果賦予以下藥水效果：

 - 力量 I  (4:10)
 - 回復 III (0:20)
 - 吸收 IV (4:10)
 - 抗火 I (4:10)
 - 抗性 II (4:10)

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.flintShears.original: Flint Shears work the same as Shears only they have less durability.
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.flintShears.translation: 燧石剪刀的功能與普通剪刀相同，除了有較少的耐久度外。

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.gameplay.original:
Pickle Tweaks also adds some general gamplay changes, a few main ones are listed below:

- Right-click Harvesting: Allows you to right-click on a fully grown crop to harvest and replant it.
- Crafting Tool Repairs: Allows you to repair a tool in a crafting grid like you would with an Anvil by adding the material it's made out of. Planks for Wooden Tools, etc.
- Additional Tool Tooltips: Adds some more information about tools to tooltips.
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.gameplay.translation:
泡菜調整還增加了一些通用的遊戲機制改動，以下列出幾個主要的：

 - 右鍵採收：允許你對完全成熟的農作物點擊右鍵來收割並自動重新種植。

- 工作台工具修理：允許你在工作台中像使用鐵砧一樣修理工具，方法是加入工具的製作材料。例如，木製工具加入木材等等。

- 額外物品提示：在物品的提示訊息中增加更多相關資訊。

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.grassMesh.original: To make the Grass Fiber Mesh you will need Grass Fiber. Grass Fiber can be crafted with Grass.
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.grassMesh.translation: 要製作草纖維篩網，你需要草纖維。草纖維可以用草合成。

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.magnet.original: The Magnet is an item that will attract items and Experience Orbs to you that are within 7 blocks. It can also be equiped in your Charm slot.\n\nRight-click with it in your hand or right-click on the item in your inventory to toggle it on or off.
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.magnet.translation: 磁鐵是一種可以將 7 格內的物品和經驗球吸引到你身邊的物品。它也可以裝備在你的飾品欄中。\n\n手持磁鐵右鍵，或在物品欄中對它右鍵，即可切換開關。

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.meshes.original: Meshes can be used to craft Gravel into Flint by placing them together in a crafting grid at the expense of the Gravel and some durability. Different Meshes have different amounts of durability.
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.meshes.translation: 篩網可以用於將礫石合成燧石，方法是將它們放在工作台中一起合成，這會消耗礫石和篩網的一些耐久度。不同的篩網有不同的耐久度。

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.pickleTweak.original: Pickle Tweaks is a Vanilla+ mod that adds some useful features to the game, such as Paxels, Scythes, Sickles, Emerald and Flint Armor/Tools and much more! This quest chapter is to help show you what the mod has to offer.
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.pickleTweak.translation: 泡菜調整是一個原版體驗強化的模組，為遊戲增加了一些有用的功能，例如鎬尖斧、大鐮刀、鐮刀、綠寶石和燧石盔甲/工具等等！這個任務章節旨在向你展示這個模組提供的內容。

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.reinforcedV.original: Let's you see in the dark and gives you some defence while worn.
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.reinforcedV.translation: 穿戴時讓你能在黑暗中看得見，並給予些許的防護。

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.smoothGlows.original: Smooth Glowstone is a decorative block that can be obtained by smelting Glowstone.
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.smoothGlows.translation: 平滑螢光石是一種裝飾性方塊，可以透過熔煉螢光石獲得。

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.tools.original:
Pickle Tweaks adds a large amount of new tools:

Flint Tools: Better than Stone tools but worse than Iron.
Emerald Tools: Better than Diamond tools but worse than Netherite.
Paxels: An Axe, Pickaxe and Shovel all in one tool.
Sickles: Tools for mining plant material blocks in an AOE.
Scythes: Tools for harvesting and replanting crops in an area.
Watering Cans: Increases crop growth speed in the area its used.
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.tools.translation:
泡菜調整增加了大量的全新工具：

燧石工具：比石製工具好，但比鐵製工具差。

綠寶石工具：比鑽石工具好，但比獄髓工具差。

鎬尖斧：一把工具包含斧、鎬和鏟的功能。

鐮刀：用於在一個範圍內挖掘植物性方塊的工具。

大鐮刀：用於在一個區域內收割並重新種植農作物的工具。

澆水壺：增加使用範圍內農作物的生長速度。

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.vision.original: Let's you see in the dark while worn.
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.desc.vision.translation: 穿戴時讓你能在黑暗中看得見。

atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.subt.reinforcedV.original: Seeing and being safe in the Dark
atm9.quest.pickleTweaks.subt.reinforcedV.translation: 看穿並更安全地待在黑暗中

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.CoordinateTrac.original: Right-click somewhere and you will be able to pathfind your way back. If you're close enough and have a direct route, a path will appear.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.CoordinateTrac.translation: 在某處點擊右鍵，你就能夠尋路返回。如果你夠靠近且有直接的路徑，就會出現一條路線。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.acid.original: &3Etching Acid&r is made in the Pressure Chamber with Molten Plastic...and some other stuff. Used in the Etching Tank.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.acid.translation: &3蝕刻酸&r是用熔融塑膠...和一些其他的東西，在壓力室中製作。用於蝕刻器中。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.advancedCompre.original: The &3Advanced Air Compressor&r works the same way as the Air Compressor, only way better!
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.advancedCompre.translation: &3高級空氣壓縮機&r的運作方式與空氣壓縮機相同，只是性能更好！

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.advancedLiquid.original: Using a Laser Assembly Program you can speed up the production of &3Unassembled PCBs&r. Just put an Empty PCB in the input Chest, pump in some pressure and wait.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.advancedLiquid.translation: &3高級液體壓縮機&r的運作方式與液體壓縮機相同，只是性能更好！

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.advancedTube.original: &3Advanced Pressure Tubes&r are the best Pressure Tubes available, being able to hold 20 bars of pressure!\n\nAlthough these are really cool on their own, they can also be used in some even cooler recipes.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.advancedTube.translation: &3高級壓力管道&r是目前最好的壓力管道，能夠承受 20 bar 的壓力！\n\n雖然它們本身就很厲害，但也可以用於一些更酷的配方中。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.aerial.original: The &3Aerial Interface&r can be used to refill your pressurizable things with pressure. Now you can use your Pneumatic Armor without needing to recharge!
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.aerial.translation: &3空氣介面&r可用於為你的可充氣物品補充壓力。現在你可以使用你的氣動裝備而無需另外充氣了！

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.amadron.original: We will need to order some stuff off of &3Amadron&r using the &3Amadron Tablet&r in order to continue progression. To use it, shift-right click a Chest and a Fluid tank, put your currency in a linked container (Emeralds, etc) and order something. You'll see an Amadrone come down to take your money and another Amadrone come to drop off what you ordered.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.amadron.translation: 為了繼續發展，我們需要使用&3亞馬龍平板電腦&r向&3亞馬龍&r採購一些東西。要使用它，按住 Shift 右鍵一個箱子和一個流體儲罐，將你的貨幣（例如綠寶石等）放入一個已綁定的容器中，然後下訂單。你會看到一個亞馬龍無人機下來收錢，然後另一個亞馬龍無人機下來送達你訂購的物品。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.armor.original: Each upgrade adds +0.5 Armor Defence and +1 Armor Toughness.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.armor.translation: 每個升級增加 +0.5 盔甲和 +1 盔甲強度。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.assembly.original: Although not every recipe requires the same components, you can set up your &3Assembly Lines&r with everything installed. A simple &3Assembly Line&r setup that can be used for everything is shown in the image below. Read the quests for each component for some important information about them.\n\nSpeed Upgrades make this process a lot quicker!
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.assembly.translation: 雖然並非每個配方都需要相同的組件，但你可以為你的&3組裝線&r安裝所有可能的組件。下圖展示了一個簡單的&3組裝線&r 設定，可以用於所有配方。閱讀每個組件的任務說明，取得關於它們的重要資訊。\n\n速度升級能讓這個過程快得多！

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.autoCompressed.original: Is that even possible?\n\nIf you wish to automate this process you can use &aMystical Agriculture&r or &eProductive Bees&r. Or I guess you could automate it, with...explosions.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.autoCompressed.translation: 那有可能嗎？\n\n如果你希望自動化這個過程，你可以使用&a神秘農業&r或&e生產蜜蜂&r。或者我想你也可以用…爆炸來自動化它。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.autoPCBs.original: Using a Laser Assembly Program you can speed up the production of &3Unassembled PCBs&r. Just put an Empty PCB in the input Chest, pump in some pressure and wait.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.autoPCBs.translation: 使用雷射裝配程式可以加快&3未組裝的印刷電路板&r的生產速度。只需將空印刷電路板放入輸入箱，輸入一些壓力，然後等待。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.autoPlastic.original: Making Plastic can take a while, if you wish to automate this process you can use &eProductive Bees&r. Or I guess you could automate it using these previous quests.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.autoPlastic.translation: 製作塑膠可能需要一段時間，如果你希望自動化這個過程，你可以使用&e生產蜜蜂&r。或者我想你也可以利用之前的任務的方法將它自動化。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.betterHeat.original: To increase your heat production, place a &3Heat Sink&r on the cold side of your Vortex Tube.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.betterHeat.translation: 要增加你的產出的熱，將一個&3散熱片&r放在你的渦流管的冷空氣輸出端。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.biodiesel.original: &3Biodiesel&r can be used to make &3Lubricant&r and &3Molten Plastic&r.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.biodiesel.translation: &3生物柴油&r可以用來製作&3潤滑油&r和&3熔融塑膠&r。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.blockTracker.original: Allows you to see details about certain blocks/fluid, even through walls.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.blockTracker.translation: 使你能看到特定方塊/流體的詳細資訊，甚至能穿牆顯示。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.blueprint.original: &3PCB Blueprints&r On SALE NOW for 8 Emeralds. (For a limited time only).
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.blueprint.translation: &3印刷電路板藍圖&r現在只要 8 顆綠寶石。（期間限定。）

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.camouflage.original: The &3Camouflage Applicator&r can be used to hide PneumaticCraft machinery inside of other blocks.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.camouflage.translation: &3偽裝塗覆器&r可以用來將氣動工藝的機械隱藏在其他方塊內部。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.chamber.original:
The &3Pressure Chamber&r is an important multiblock structure made up of &3Pressure Chamber Walls&r (The faces can be replaced with &3Pressure Chamber Glass&r). While the Pressure Chamber can be as small as a 3x3x3 multiblock, the one we'll be making will be 5x5x5. The blocks required for this are what's needed for the quest. 4.9 bars of pressure are required for the &dPulsating Black Hole.&d

To use the Pressure Chamber you will need to pipe pressure into a &3Pressure Chamber Valve&r using the &3Pressure Tubes&r you made earlier, remember to put a Security Upgrade into the Pressure Valve. &lDifferent recipes require different amounts of pressure&r.

You'll need to be able to input and output items to and from the &3Pressure Chamber&r, this is where &3Pressure Chamber Interfaces&r come into it. Blue on the outside means it's for importing items, while if gold is on the outside it's for outputing items, place one of each on any face.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.chamber.translation:
&3壓力室&r是一個重要的多方塊結構，由&3壓力室牆壁&r組成（面的部份可替換為&3壓力室玻璃&r）。雖然壓力室最小可以是 3x3x3 的多方塊結構，但我們將製作的是 5x5x5 的。任務所需的方塊就是製作這個結構所需的材料。

要使用壓力室，你需要使用你之前製作的&3壓力管道&r將壓力導入&3壓力室氣閥&r。記得在壓力室氣閥中放入安全升級。&l不同的配方需要不同的壓力值&r。

你需要能夠將物品輸入和輸出&3壓力室&r，這就是 &3壓力室介面&r的作用。外部藍色表示用於導入物品，而外部金色則表示用於輸出物品，在任何一個面上各放一個。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.charging.original: Place your Empty PCBs in a &3UV Light Box&r to charge them. Needs pressure and access to sunlight.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.charging.translation: 將空印刷電路板放入&3紫外線燈箱&r中將其充能。需要壓力並接觸日光。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.chargingModule.original: The &3Charging Module&r depressurizes any pressurizable things in containers it points at.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.chargingModule.translation: &3充氣管道模組&r會向其指向的容器中，任何的壓力物品充氣。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.chargingU.original: Charges other pressurizable items in your inventory from the chestplate's storage.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.chargingU.translation: 從胸甲儲存的壓力，為你身上其他可充氣的物品充氣。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.compressedArmo.original: Compressed Iron can be used to craft &3Compressed Iron Armor&r, it's the same as Iron Armor but with better Armor Toughness and Knockback Resistance.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.compressedArmo.translation: 壓縮鐵可以用來製作&3壓縮鐵裝備&r，它與鐵裝備盔甲相同，但具有更高的盔甲和擊退抗性。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.constructionBr.original: &3Construction Bricks&r are cool building blocks, be careful they hurt. Craft them again to make them smooth.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.constructionBr.translation: &3塑膠磚&r是很酷的建築方塊，但小心他們有點痛。再合成一次讓他們變平整。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.controller.original: The next stage of this mod requires you to set up &3Assembly Lines&r. The main component of an &3Assembly Line&r is the &3Assembly Controller&r.\n\nThis is where the pressure will go.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.controller.translation: 這個模組的下一個階段需要你設置&3裝配線&r。&3裝配線&r的主要組件是&3裝配台&r。\n\n這裡將會是壓力的輸入端。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.desert.original: If you're planning on using the Fluid Laser Drill, you'll need a certain biome. If you need something close by, this tablet will make the biome of the area into desert, which is perfect for the Fluid Laser Drill! If you're unsure how to use this, check the &eArs Nouveau&r questline!
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.desert.translation: 如果你打算使用流體雷射鑽，你需要特定的生態域。如果你想就近處理，這個板會將該區域的生態域變成沙漠，這非常適合流體雷射鑽！如果你不確定如何使用它，請查看&e新生魔藝&r的任務線！

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.diamondBit.original: &3Drill Bits&r can be used in a Pneumatic Jackhammer.

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.diesel.original: &3Diesel&r can be used to make more Kerosene or to make Lubricant..
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.diesel.translation: &3柴油&r可以用來製造更多的煤油，或者用來製作潤滑油...

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.directionHoppe.original: Thie &3Omnidirectional Hopper&r can input items from any side, plus it can be upgraded to be way faster than a regular Hopper! Nice for when Pipes aren't needed.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.directionHoppe.translation: &3全方位漏斗&r可以從任何側面輸入物品，而且還可以升級，比普通的漏斗快得多！在不需要管道時非常方便。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.dispenser.original: Makes things able to dispense items.

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.door.original: The &3Pneumatic Door&r acts as automatic door that can be made to only open for you!
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.door.translation: &3氣動門&r是個自動門，可以設為只為你而開啟！

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.drones.original: Although these quests won't go over Drones, they are amazing! Look into using them if you want to.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.drones.translation: 雖然任務不會介紹到無人機，但它們很令人驚艷！如果願意的話，可以考慮使用看看。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.electrostaticC.original: The &3Electrostatic Compressor&r generates a lot of pressure from Lightning Strikes.\n\nFor more info check out the 'Information' tab in JEI or check the PNC:R.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.electrostaticC.translation: &3靜電壓縮機&r透過閃電產生大量壓力。\n\n更多資訊，請查看 JEI 中的「資訊」頁籤或 PNC:R 手冊。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.elevators.original: With these 3 components you can create some amazing &3Elevators&r.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.elevators.translation: 靠這 3 種部件你能打造令人驚豔的&3電梯&r。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.elytra.original: Allows you to use an Elytra while still having your Pneumatic Chestplate on.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.elytra.translation: 讓你使用鞘翅的同時，仍保有氣動胸甲的能力。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.empty.original: Now that we have Plastic, the next step is getting some Finished PCBs, first make some &3Empty PCBs&r in the Pressure Chamber.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.empty.translation: 現在我們有了塑膠，下一步是取得組裝好的電路板，首先在壓力室中製作一些&3空印刷電路板&r。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.entityTracker.original: Living creatures nearby will be automatically tracked, even through walls. If it's an aggressive mob you'll get a warning when it targets you.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.entityTracker.translation: 附近的生物會被自動追蹤，即使隔著牆壁也能偵測到。如果是敵對生物，當它將你設為目標時，你會收到警告。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.ethanol.original: &3Ethanol&r can be used to make Biodiesel.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.ethanol.translation: &3乙醇&r可以用來製作生物柴油。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.expansionCard.original: The &3Module Expansion Card&r makes the Charging Module even better.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.expansionCard.translation: &3模組拓展卡&r讓充氣管道模組變得更好用。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.explosions.original: Did I forget to mention everything can blow up...\n\n Luckily there's an easy solution! The &3Security Upgrade&r when placed in a machine makes sure they don't explode, put these into any machines they can go into.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.explosions.translation: 我是否忘了提到所有東西都可能爆炸…\n\n幸好有一個簡單的解決方案！將&3安全升級&r放入機器中可以確保它們不會爆炸，請將這些放入任何可以裝入的機器中。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.export.original: This will drop the finished product into your output chest.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.export.translation: 這能將完成的產物放入你的輸出箱中。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.finished.original: Craft together your Unassmbled PCB with 2 Capacitors and 2 Transistors to get yourself a &3Finished PCB&r.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.finished.translation: 將為組裝的印刷電路板加上 2 個電容器和 2 個電晶體，做成&3組裝好的印刷電路板&r。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.fishNChips.original: Could I get that with some Mashed Peas with a side of Beans on Toast please Governor?
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.fishNChips.translation: 長官，可以幫我加一些馬鈴薯泥和一份焗豆吐司嗎？

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.fluidTank.original: When a &3Fluid Tank&r is put on top of another &3Fluid Tank&r and wrenched together they become one big tank.\n\nThese can be used in recipes using the bucketed version of PneumaticCraft liquids.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.fluidTank.translation: 當一個&3流體儲罐&r放在另一個&3流體儲罐&r的上方並用扳手固定在一起時，它們會變成一個更大的儲罐。\n\n這些裝有流體的儲罐，可以替代氣動工藝流體桶的配方。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.fluxCompressor.original: The &3Flux Compressor&r can create a ton of pressure using power. Simply pump some FE in and it will start generating some. If you have enough FE to spare, this is probably the easiest way to generate pressure.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.fluxCompressor.translation: &3通量壓縮機&r可以利用能量產生大量的壓力。只需輸入一些 FE，它就會開始產生壓力。如果你有多餘的 FE，這可能是產生壓力的最簡單方法。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.gasoline.original: &3Gasoline&r can be used to make LPG.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.gasoline.translation: &3汽油&r可用來製造液化石油氣。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.generating.original: The &3Air Compressor&r is an easy way of making pressure, simply put some burnable items into it, and watch the magic happen! (I recommend making at least 3 of these to start off with).
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.generating.translation: &3空氣壓縮機&r是一種簡單的製造壓力的方法，只需將一些可燃燒的物品放入其中，然後見證奇蹟發生！（我建議一開始至少製作 3 個）。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.gilded.original: Makes Piglins Passive (same as wearing Gold Armor), you only need to put the Upgrade on one piece.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.gilded.translation: 使豬布靈變中立（就像穿了黃金裝備），你只需要在一件裝備上安裝此升級即可。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.heat.original: The &3Vortex Tube&r seperates pressure into hot and cold air. The cold air goes to the blue side and the hot air goes to the red side.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.heat.translation: &3渦流管&r將壓力分離成熱空氣和冷空氣。冷空氣會從藍色端輸出，熱空氣會從紅色端輸出。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.heatFrame.original:
When the &3Heat Frame&r is placed on a container containing certain fluids and made cold enough, it will turn said fluids into items.

Turns Molten Plastic into Plastic.
Turns Water into Ice.
Turns Lava into Obsidian.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.heatFrame.translation:
當&3導熱框架&r放置容器上，容器內有特定流體桶且溫度夠低時，它會將這些流體轉變成物品。

將熔融塑膠轉變成塑膠。

將水轉變成冰。

將熔岩轉變成黑曜石。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.import.original: This will take the items out of your input chest.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.import.translation: 這能將物品從你的輸入箱中取出。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.itemSearch.original: Select an item an this upgrade will search fo it nearby in chests or on the floor. To find it in chests it will need the Block Tracker Upgrade and to find it on the floor it will need the Entity Tracker Upgrade.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.itemSearch.translation: 選擇一個物品，這個升級將會在附近的箱子或地面上搜尋它。若要在箱子中尋找，需要方塊追蹤器升級；若要在地面上尋找，則需要實體追蹤器升級。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jackhammer.original: The &3Pneumatic Jackhammer&r uses pressure to mine, it can be upgraded to be amazing!
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jackhammer.translation: &3氣動鑿岩錘&r使用壓力挖掘，升級後功能強大！

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jetBoots.original: You will only see this quest if you have used Jet Boots.\n\nThere's no way of using Jet Boots without taking damage, don't even try...
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jetBoots.translation: 只有在你使用過噴射靴之後，你才會看到這個任務。\n\n不可能在使用噴射靴後不受到任何傷害，想都別想…

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jetBootsI.original:
Allows you to fly like Iron Man.

You can only have one level of these Upgrades in the Boots at a time. Each level will use more pressure than the previous.

Use these upgrades, don't just craft them.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jetBootsI.translation:
讓你像鋼鐵人一樣飛行。

你的靴子只能同時安裝一個此類升級。每個等級都會比前一個等級消耗更多的壓力。

使用這些升級，不要只是製作出來。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jetBootsII.original: Allows you to travel faster than with Tier I.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jetBootsII.translation: 讓你比使用 I 級時移動得更快。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jetBootsIII.original: Allows you to travel even faster than Tier II.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jetBootsIII.translation: 讓你比使用 II 級時移動得更快。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jetBootsIV.original: Maybe a little too fast even.

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jetBootsV.original: 100% way too fast! Try not to die!

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jumpingI.original: Allows you to jump higher than usual and makes you springy, making for faster travel.\n\nYou can only have one level of these Upgrades in the Leggings at a time.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jumpingI.translation: 讓你跳得比平常更高，並且富有彈性，進而實現更快的移動。\n\n你的護腿只能同時安裝一個此類升級。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jumpingII.original: Allows you to jump higher than with Tier I.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jumpingII.translation: 讓你比使用 I 級時跳得更高。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jumpingIII.original: Allows you to jump higher than with Tier II.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jumpingIII.translation: 讓你比使用 II 級時跳得更高。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.jumpingIV.original: Allows you to jump VERY high.

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.junction.original: The &3Tube Junction&r gives you more control over the transportation of your pressure by allowing you to move your Pressure Tubes in more directions.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.junction.translation: &3管道跨接點&r讓你更能掌控壓力的傳輸，它允許你將壓力管道連接到更多方向。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.kerosene.original: &3Kerosene&r can be used to make Gasoline or it can be used as fuel in a Kerosene Lamp.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.kerosene.translation: &3煤油&r可以用來製造汽油，或者可以用作煤油燈的燃料。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.lamp.original: The &3Kerosene Lamp&r is a great light source that uses fuel (Kerosene being the best) to produce light.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.lamp.translation: &3煤油燈&r是一個很棒的光源，它使用燃料（煤油是最好的）來發光。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.liquidCompress.original: The &3Liquid Compressor&r creates pressure using certain liquids. You can put the fuel in by right-clicking the bucket onto the machine, pumping in the fluid, or by putting a bucket in the top slot in the GUI.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.liquidCompress.translation: &3液體壓縮機&r利用特定的液體來產生壓力。你可以透過對機器右鍵點擊流體桶、導入液體，或將流體桶放入介面頂部的欄位來加入燃料。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.liquidHopper.original: The &3Liquid Hopper&r is a Hopper, but for liquids. Not a replacement for pipes.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.liquidHopper.translation: &3液體漏斗&r是一個漏斗，但用於液體。不是管道的替代品。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.logistics.original: To start with Logistics craft a &3Logistics Core&r, I recommend reading the PNC:R Manual for a full tutorial on how to use these items.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.logistics.translation: 要開始物流系統，先製作一個&3物流核心&r，我建議閱讀 PNC:R 手冊以獲得關於如何使用這些物品的完整教學。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.logisticsConfi.original: The &3Logistics Configurator&r can be used to configure Logistic Frames and Transfer Gadgets.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.logisticsConfi.translation: &3物流設定器&r可以用來設定物流框架和傳輸裝置。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.logisticsFrame.original: Each &3Logistics Frame&r can be used for different types of automation.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.logisticsFrame.translation: 每個&3物流框架&r都可以用於不同類型的自動化。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.logisticsModul.original: The Logistic Frames need to connect to a &3Logistics Module&r to work.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.logisticsModul.translation: 物流框架需要連接到一個&3物流管道模組&r才能運作。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.lpg.original: &3LPG&r can be used to make Molten Plastic.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.lpg.translation: &3液化石油氣&r可用來製作熔融塑膠。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.lubricant.original: &3Lubricant&r can be used to make Drill Bits.

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.magnet.original: Allows you to pickup items and experience from furthur away.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.magnet.translation: 讓你從遠處能拾取物品與經驗。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.manometer.original: The &3Manometer&r is used to show extra information about a machine.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.manometer.translation: &3壓力計&r用於顯示關於機器的額外資訊。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.matrix.original: Only use 1 Lapis for an Upgrade instead of 4.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.matrix.translation: 只需要 1 個青金石製作升級，不用 4 個。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.mechanic.original: I suppose I need to let you know that you can buy stuff off of Villagers...\n\nThe &3Pressure Machanic's&r workstation is a Charging Station. They have some very useful trades.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.mechanic.translation: 我想我應該告訴你，你可以向村民購買東西…\n\n&3壓力技工&r的工作站就是一個充氣站。他們有一些非常有用的交易。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.micromissiles.original: &3Micromissiles&r allow you to fire explosions to places far away.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.micromissiles.translation: &3微型導彈&r讓你能向遠處發射爆炸。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.minigun.original: The &3Minigun&r is a gun that needs pressure and ammo to work. Read the tooltip for more info.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.minigun.translation: &3轉管機槍&r是一把需要壓力與彈藥才能運作的槍。請閱讀物品提示取得更多資訊。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.minigunAmmo.original: Load up your Minigun with this &3Minigun Ammo&r to use it.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.minigunAmmo.translation: 用&3機槍彈藥&r裝填你的轉管機槍才能使用。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.moving.original: To move pressure you will need to obtain &3Pressure Tubes&r. What pressure you may be asking? Continue the questline to see what these are used for.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.moving.translation: 要傳輸壓力，你需要獲得&3壓力管道&r。你可能會問什麼壓力？繼續這個任務線以了解它們的用途。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.movingHeat.original: To move the heat being made by the Vortex Tube, make some &3Heat Pipes&r.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.movingHeat.translation: 要傳輸渦流管產生的熱能，製作一些&3熱管&r。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.netheriteBit.original: The &3Netherite Drill Bit&r is the best Drill Bit, it's even better than the Diamond Drill Bit.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.netheriteBit.translation: &3獄髓鑽頭&r是最棒的鑽頭，比鑽石鑽頭更好。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.oil.original: The next stage of the mod requires the collection of &3Crude Oil&r. This Oil can be obtained by using a Laser Drill and Fluid Laser Base with a Black Laser Lense in it. Check JEI for more info.\n\n&dHint:&r Check what biome the laser drill needs to be in!
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.oil.translation: 這個模組的下一個階段需要收集&3石油&r。這種油可以透過使用雷射鑽和流體雷射基座，並在其中裝上黑色雷射透鏡來獲得。查看 JEI 獲取更多資訊。\n\n&d提示：&r查看雷射鑽需要在什麼生態域中運作！

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.plastic.original: Place your Liquid Plastic onto the ground or store some in a Chest with a Heat Frame attached and there's your &3Plastic&r!
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.plastic.translation: 將你的熔融塑膠倒在地上，或將一些儲存在附有導熱框架的箱子裡，你的&3塑膠&r就完成了！

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.platform.original: The item will need to be placed here before getting picked back up.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.platform.translation: 物品需要先放在這，之後才能被再次撿起。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.pneumatic.original:
PneumaticCraft is all about Pressure! These quests won't go over everything the mod has, but will still go over a lot! Please remember to check JEI, read the tooltips and read the PCB:R, they are all very useful.

To get started, you'll need to craft some &3Compressed Iron Ingots&r! The easiest way to do this is to make a hole in the ground, throw in some iron ingots (or blocks) and then blow it up with some TNT!

Some might get lost in the explosion, but that's a risk we'll have to take!
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.pneumatic.translation:
氣動工藝是個關於壓力的模組！這些任務不會涵蓋模組的所有內容，但仍然會介紹很多！請務必查看 JEI，閱讀物品提示和 PCB:R 手冊，它們都非常有用。

要開始，你需要製作一些 &3壓縮鐵錠&r！最簡單的方法是在地上挖一個洞，丟入一些鐵錠（或鐵塊），然後用 TNT 炸掉它！

 有些可能會在爆炸中遺失，但這是我們必須承擔的風險！

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.pneumaticArmor.original:
The &3Pneumatic Armor&r by itself is pretty great, however if you want to make this armor amazing, you'll need to install upgrades. Press 'U' by default to open the Upgrade GUI, some upgrades use pressure, some don't.

Just like upgrading other tools in PneumaticCraft, to upgrade &3Pneumatic Armor&r you will need a Charging Station with pressure.

Note: The subtitle will tell you the max amount of that upgrade that can be put in something.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.pneumaticArmor.translation:
&3氣動裝備&r本身就很棒了，但是如果你想讓這套裝更厲害，你需要安裝升級。預設按「U」 鍵可以打開升級介面，有些升級會使用壓力，有些則不會。

就像升級氣動工藝中的其他工具一樣，要升級&3氣動裝備&r，你需要一個有壓力的充氣站。

注意：副標題會告訴你該升級的最大安裝數量。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.power.original: Whoever told you PneumaticCraft wasn't about generating power?\n\nThe &3Pneumatic Dynamo&r allows you to turn your pressure in FE. Read the tooltip or read about it to learn how it works.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.power.translation: 是誰告訴你氣動工藝不是關於發電的？\n\n&3氣動能源爐&r讓你能夠將壓力轉換為 FE。閱讀物品提示或相關說明學習其運作方式。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.processing.original: The &3Thermopneumatic Processing Plant&r will be used to make Molten Plastic, simply pump in some LPG, Coal and some heat.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.processing.translation: &3熱氣動加工機&r將用於製造熔融塑膠，只需輸入一些液化石油氣、煤炭和一些熱。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.radiation.translation: 保護你免於受到「通用機械」的輻射。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.range.original: Increases range, does different things when used in different things.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.range.translation: 增加範圍，在不同的物品中使用時會有不同的效果。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.refinery.original: The &3Oil Refinery&r we'll be making is a 1x1x5 multiblock made up of 1 &3Refinery Controller&r (at the bottom) and four &3Refinery Outputs&r (on top). You will need to input Oil and heat for this to work. This will produce Diesel, Kerosene, Gasoline and LPG. Putting &3Thermal Laggings&r on the sides helps keep it warm.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.refinery.translation: 我們將製作的&3煉油廠&r是一個 1x1x5 的多方塊結構，由 1 個&3精煉廠控制器&r（在底部）和四個 &3精煉廠輸出端&r（在頂部）組成。你需要輸入石油和熱才能使其運作。它將生產柴油、煤油、汽油和液化石油氣。在側面放置&3隔熱板&r有助於保持其溫度。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.reinforcedChes.original: The &3Reinforced Chest&r is a blast-proof Chest with 36 slots. Not Double Chest-able. Also works like a Shulker Box.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.reinforcedChes.translation: &3強化儲物箱&r是一個防爆的箱子，擁有 36 個欄位。無法合併成大箱子。同時功能與界伏盒相同。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.reinforcedSton.original: One of the most important materials you'll be needing is &3Reinforced Stone&r, start by making 32 using Compressed Iron and some regular stone.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.reinforcedSton.translation: 你最需要的材料之一是&3強化石&r，首先用壓縮鐵和一些普通的石頭製作 32 個。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.reinforcedTube.original: &3Reinforced Pressure Tubes&r Just like regular Pressure Tubes. only these can hold 10 bars of pressure.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.reinforcedTube.translation: &3強化壓力管道&r和普通的壓力管道類似。差別是它們能乘載 10 bar 的壓力。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.scuba.original: Keep your breathing underwater, once your bubbles go down to 5 they will be refilled! It also allows you to see much more easily underwater!
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.scuba.translation: 保持你在水下的呼吸，一旦你的氣泡降到 5，它們就會被重新充滿！這也能讓你更容易在水下看清楚！

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.sentry.original: The &3Sentry Turret&r can be placed somewhere and set to attack mobs or players when they are in range. It just needs some Minigun Ammo.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.sentry.translation: &3哨戒砲&r可以放置在某個地方，並設定為當生物或玩家進入射程時進行攻擊。它只需要一些機槍彈藥。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.smartChest.original: The &3Smart Chest&r is a blast-proof Chest with 72 slots, includes a built in, fully configuarble Omnidirectional Hopper and has upgrade slots. Not Double Chest-able. Also works like a Shulker Box.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.smartChest.translation: &3智慧儲物箱&r是一個防爆的箱子，擁有 72 個欄位，內建一個完全可自訂的全方位漏斗，並有升級插槽。無法合併成大箱子。同時功能與界伏盒相同。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.solarCells.original: &3Solar Cells&r are used to make Solar Compressors.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.solarCells.translation: &3Solar Cells&r 用於製作 Solar Compressors。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.solarCompresso.original: The &3Solar Compressor&r generates Pressure by using sunlight, the warmer it gets, the more Prssure it will produce. However. be careful, if it gets too hot it will malfunction and you will need to repair it.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.solarCompresso.translation: &3Solar Compressor&r 透過使用陽光產生壓力，越溫暖它產生的壓力就越多。然而，要小心，如果它變得太熱，它會故障，需要修理它。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.sourdough.original: Made with &3Wheat Flour&r. Can be used to make Salmon Tempura and Sourdough Bread.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.sourdough.translation: 以&3小麥粉&r製成。可用於製作鮭魚天婦羅和酵母麵包。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.station.original: The &3Charging Station&r is used to charge various tools and gadgets in &aPneumaticCraft&r using pressure.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.station.translation: &3充氣站&r用於使用壓力為&a氣動工藝&r中的各種工具和小工具充氣。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.stomp.original: Any damage you take when falling (ignoring armor) will also be dealt to nearby mobs.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.stomp.translation: 當你墜落時受到的任何傷害（忽略盔甲值），也會對附近的怪物造成相同的傷害。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.support.original: &3Crop Supports&r can be placed over your crops to make them grow faster.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.support.translation: &3作物架&r可以放在你的農作物上方，使其生長得更快。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.tank.original: The next step of making PCBs involves using the &3Etching Tank&r with Etching Acid. Requires heat to run.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.tank.translation: 製作印刷電路板的下一步涉及使用&3蝕刻器&r及蝕刻酸。需要熱才能運作。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.thermalCompres.original: The &3Thermal Compressor&r creates pressure using heat! Place somthing hot on one side and something cold on the other to create pressure.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.thermalCompres.translation: &3溫差壓縮機&r利用熱能來產生壓力！在一側放置高溫的東西，另一側放置低溫的東西即可產生壓力。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.tile.original: A smart Sign which can store and display arbitrary amounts of text, scaled so the text always fits.\n\nRight-click with any Dye to recolor the tile, you can color the border and the background independentrly.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.tile.translation: 一個智慧告示牌，可以儲存和顯示任意數量的文字，並自動縮放以適應空間。\n\n使用任何染料右鍵可重新著色，你可以獨立地為邊框和背景著色。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.transfer.original: PneumaticCraft is all The &3Transfer Gadget&r acts like a Hopper that can be placed inbetween blocks.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.transfer.translation: 氣動工藝是個完全基於壓力的模組！而&3傳輸裝置&r的作用就像一個可以放置在方塊之間的漏斗。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.unassembled.original: Put a Charged Empty PCB into the Etching Tank with some Etching Acid and some heat and you'll get an &3Unassembled PCBs&r.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.unassembled.translation: 將照射過紫外線的空印刷電路板，放入蝕刻器中，並加入蝕刻酸和一些熱，就能取得&3未組裝的印刷電路板&r。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.understand.original: When making pressure in an Air Compressor, if you don't have anywhere for the pressure to go. it will just disappear. Make sure you have somewhere for the pressure to go before making some.\n\nThe 'Pressure' I refer to can also be called 'Pressurized Air'.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.understand.translation: 當你在空氣壓縮機中產生壓力時，如果沒有地方讓壓力釋放，它就會直接消失。在製造壓力之前，請確保壓力有去處。\n\n我提到的「壓力」也可以稱為「壓縮空氣」。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.upgrades.original: Below are some &3Upgrades&r you can use early on in this mod. Shift while hovering over an &3Upgrade&r to see what it can be used in, or shift while hovering over something to see what upgrades it can use.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.upgrades.translation: 以下是一些你可以在這個模組早期使用的&3升級&r。將滑鼠移至&3升級&r上並按住 Shift，可以查看它可以用於哪些物品；或者將滑鼠移至某個物品上並按住 Shift，可以查看它可以使用哪些升級。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.vegetableOil.original: &3Vegetable Oil&r can be made by putting either crops or seeds into a &3Thermopneumatic Processing Plant&r.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.vegetableOil.translation: &3植物油&r可以透過將農作物或種子放入&3熱氣動加工機&r中來製作。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.vision.original: Grants the player Night Vision when worn.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.vision.translation: 穿戴時賦予玩家夜視能力。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.visor.original: Makes Endermen not get angry at you, the same way Carved Pumpkins would, only this way you can actually see.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.visor.translation: 使終界使者不會對你生氣，就像戴上雕刻過的南瓜一樣，但使用這升級你能看得更清楚。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.volume.original: Increases how much pressure things can hold.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.volume.translation: 增加能儲存的最大壓力。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.wrench.original: The &3Pneumatic Wrench&r is used to move around or break your machines and tubes.
atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.wrench.translation: &3氣動扳手&r用於移動或拆除你的機器和管道。

atm9.quest.pneumatic.desc.yeast.original: Why doesn't regular Bread need Yeast?

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.advancedCompre.original: No need for boring old Air Compressors now!
atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.advancedCompre.translation: 現在起不需要那無聊的空氣壓縮機了！

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.amadron.original: I wonder if they have 1 day delivery?
atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.amadron.translation: 我想知道它們是隔日到貨的嗎？

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.camouflage.original: Want to make things look cool?
atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.camouflage.translation: 想讓東西看起來酷酷的嗎？

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.charging.original: I hope you have some Sunglasses!

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.constructionBr.original: There's no pain worse than stepping on these
atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.constructionBr.translation: 沒有比踩在這上面更痛的了

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.desert.original: There be oil in them there hills!

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.dispenser.original: Dispense her? I hardly know her!
atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.dispenser.translation: 放她走？我幾乎不認識她！

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.explosions.original: If only there was an easy solution...
atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.explosions.translation: 如果有個簡單的解決方案...

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.jetBoots.original: You thought using an Elytra was hard?
atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.jetBoots.translation: 你覺得鞘翅飛行很難嗎？

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.movingHeat.original: We have the heat to move :)

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.needed.translation: 組裝好的印刷電路板的必需品

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.processing.original: The longer the name, the better

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.reinforcedChes.translation: 比你日常使用的儲物箱更好

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.reinforcedSton.original: You'll need a lot of this

atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.understand.original: What happened to RF or FE?
atm9.quest.pneumatic.subt.understand.translation: RF 或 FE 發生了什麼事？

atm9.quest.powah.desc.basicCables.original: The basic cables for transferring power.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.basicCables.translation: 用來傳輸電力的基本線纜。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.dielectricMats.1.original: Almost every single machine you can make in the mod will require a &9Dielectric Casing&r.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.dielectricMats.1.translation: 本模組中幾乎所有的機器都會需要使用&9絕緣外殼&r來製作。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.dielectricMats.2.original: You'll need to make the &bPaste&r first, as well as some &aRods&r to progress!
atm9.quest.powah.desc.dielectricMats.2.translation: 你會需要先製作一些&b絕緣膏&r，然後製作一些&a絕緣桿&r才能繼續下去！

atm9.quest.powah.desc.enderCell.original: The &5Ender Cell&r will store power for a channel in your &7Ender Network&r. To increase the power capacity of the network, right click on the Ender Cell to open up the interface, then add either a &aBattery&r or an &9Energy Cell&r to increase the overall capacity.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.enderCell.translation: &5終界單元&r能夠為你的&7終界網路&r的其中一個頻道儲存電力。要增加網路的電力上限的話，只要使用右鍵點開終界單元的介面，並向裡面添加&a電池&r或&9能量單元&r就能增加網路的整體上限。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.enderGates.1.original: &5Ender Gates&r are used to transfer power wirelessly to and from an adjacent block into the &7Ender Network&r.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.enderGates.1.translation: &5終界門&r是用來從&7終界網路&r對附近的方塊進行電力輸入或輸出的一種裝置。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.enderGates.2.original: Think of these like wireless access points to your wireless network of power.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.enderGates.2.translation: 它們就像是你的無線電力網路的無線接入點。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.enderGates.3.original: Note: You can only add &apower storage capacity&r using an Ender Cell.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.enderGates.3.translation: 註：你只能透過終界單元來增加&a儲電上限&r。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.energizingOrb.original: Used to energize items using the Energizing Orb.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.energizingOrb.translation: 用以在充能室中為物品充能。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.energizingOrb.1.original: In the beginning, you can get by with creating the &7Starter&r and &bBasic&r tier machines using Iron, but you'll eventually need to create energized mats using the &9Energizing Orb&r.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.energizingOrb.1.translation: 剛開始時，你可以利用鐵錠來製作&7起始&r和&b基礎&r階級的機器，但你之後會需要利用&9充能室&r來製造一些充能材料。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.energizingOrb.2.original: The &9Energizing Orb&r will energize items using nearby &aEnergizing Rods&r within a 9x9 area around it, creating better materials for you to use to progress through the &eTiers&r in Powah.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.energizingOrb.2.translation: &9充能室&r會自動尋找周圍9x9區域內的&a充能桿&r來進行充能，並為你製造出波瓦科技模組中更高&e階級&r的材料。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.energizingOrb.3.original: To power the orb, you'll need to attach Energizing Rods to energy cables that are being supplied with energy. If you want the Orb to energize faster, either make more rods, upgrade to higher tier rods, or both! To see if the Rods are connected, set your &aWrench&r to link mode and you can link any Rod to the Orb.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.energizingOrb.3.translation: 你必須要讓內含能量的能量線纜接上充能桿來為充能室注入電力。如果你想要獲得更快的充能速度，你可以製作更多的充能桿、使用更高階級的充能桿，或是結合兩者！可以將你的&a扳手&r切換到連結模式來檢查充能桿是否有連結到充能室之中，並能夠利用扳手來為它們建立連結。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.energyHopper.original: The &9Energy Hopper&r will charge any chargeable item inside of the inventory of the block it is pointed to, like a chest.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.energyHopper.translation: &9能量漏斗&r會自動幫它所指向的儲物方塊（像是箱子）中的任何需要充電的物品進行充電。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.feDrain.original: This block will drain FE from any charged item.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.feDrain.translation: 此方塊會從任何充能過的物品中吸取 FE 。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.furnator.original: The &7Furnator&r will burn items like coal and wood to produce FE.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.furnator.translation: &7熔爐發電機&r能夠透過燃燒像是煤炭或木頭之類的物品來產出 FE 。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.intro.1.original: &9Powah&r is a tech mod that's all about generating, storing, and transmitting &dPower&r. Ranging from basic FE generation to &aReactors&r that produce &b250k FE/t&r, Powah has you covered!
atm9.quest.powah.desc.intro.1.translation: &9波瓦科技（Powah）&r是一個專注於生產、儲存以及傳輸&d電力&r的科技模組。從最基本的 FE 發電方式到能夠產出 &b250K FE/t&r 的反應爐，波瓦科技滿足了你的所有需求！

atm9.quest.powah.desc.intro.2.original: To get started, go out and Energize some Uranium into &aUraninite&r!
atm9.quest.powah.desc.intro.2.translation: 如何開始，出去將一些鈾充能成&a精質鈾燃料&r！

atm9.quest.powah.desc.itemCharging.original: These can be used to charge items in your inventory, or can be used to increase the overall power capacity of an &7Ender Network&r channel.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.itemCharging.translation: 可以利用它們來為物品欄內的物品充能，也能夠用來增加&7終界網路&r頻道的整體電力上限。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.magmator.original: The &cMagmator&r will generate FE when supplied with Lava.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.magmator.translation: &c熔岩發電機&r能夠使用熔岩來產出 FE 。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.playerTransmitter..original: The &9Player Transmitter&r will charge a player's items wirelessly. You must first bind this to a player using a &9Binding Card&r. This is the basic card which allows the transmitter to only work in the same dimension. You can upgrade this by using a &dBinding Card (Dimensional)&r instead.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.playerTransmitter..translation: &9玩家發射器&r能夠無線充能一位玩家身上的物品。你必須要先使用&9綁定卡&r來將它與一位特定的玩家綁定。\n\n綁定卡是一種只能讓處於同個維度中的玩家接收到電力的基礎型卡片。你能夠使用&d綁定卡（維度）&r來打破這項限制。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.playerTransmitter..original: Note: To get a Player Aerial Pearl, use an Aerial Pearl on a Zombie or Husk.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.playerTransmitter..translation: 註：對著殭屍或屍殼使用天線珍珠來取得玩家天線珍珠。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.powerBankFeatures..original: These can also be used to upgrade the total power storage capacity of your wireless &7Ender Networks&r.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.powerBankFeatures..translation: 它們也能夠用來增加你的無線&7終界網路&r的整體電力上限。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.reactor.1.original: The &9Reactor&r is a 3x4x3 multiblock generator that burns &aUrananite&r as fuel to produce FE.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.reactor.1.translation: &9反應爐&r是一個能夠藉由燃燒&a晶質鈾&r做為燃料來產出 FE 的 3x4x3 多方塊結構。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.reactor.2.original: To build it, you'll need to make a total of 36 Reactor Blocks. While holding 36 in hand, placing one block will auto-build the reactor. Make sure to clear out some room first!
atm9.quest.powah.desc.reactor.2.translation: 你總共會需要 36 個反應爐方塊來建造它。當你一次手持 36 個反應爐方塊時，放下其中一個方塊就會自動幫你蓋好整個反應爐。記得要先清出一些空間！

atm9.quest.powah.desc.reactor.3.original: You'll want to cool the reactor down for it to create more FE, and you can do this with either solid or liquid &bcoolant&r. To use a solid coolant, you'll also need to give it some liquid coolant as well. &bDry Ice&r makes for a great solid coolant! (Note: 1 Water Bucket will do)
atm9.quest.powah.desc.reactor.3.translation: 你可以使用固體或流體的&b冷卻劑/液&r來冷卻反應爐以產出更多的 FE 。在使用固體冷卻劑之前，你也會需要先注入一些流體冷卻液（1桶水就行）。&b乾冰&r是最棒的固體冷卻劑！

atm9.quest.powah.desc.reactor.4.original: You can also increase the FE generation by keeping the fuel buffer full, as well as adding both Coal and Redstone to the Reactor. Using Blocks of either will also work!
atm9.quest.powah.desc.reactor.4.translation: 你可以透過讓燃料條保持滿載或是在反應爐中添加煤炭和紅石來提升產出的 FE 量。也可以放入煤炭方塊和紅石方塊！

atm9.quest.powah.desc.solarPanel.original: The Solar Panel generates FE when given direct access to the sun. However, you can use a &7Lens of Ender&r to ignore blocks in its way.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.solarPanel.translation: 太陽能發電機會在上方能夠直達太陽的情況下產出 FE 。但你也可以使用&7終界透鏡&r來使它能夠忽略上方的方塊。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.thermalGenerator.1.original: One of the best options for \"Passive Power\", the &9Thermal Generator&r will produce FE when placed over a &cHeat Source&r and given a steady supply of Water.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.thermalGenerator.1.translation: 「被動式發電」是其中一種優秀的發電方案，&9熱力發電機&r會在供給穩定的水源並放置於&c熱源&r上方時產出 FE 。

atm9.quest.powah.desc.thermalGenerator.2.original: There are 5 blocks you can place this over: a Magma Block which produces the lowest, a Lava Source Block which is a little better, a &cBlock of Blazing Crystal&r, which provides a lot more, a Dark Matter Block which produces loads of power and finally a Red Matter Block which produces even more!
atm9.quest.powah.desc.thermalGenerator.2.translation: 你可以將它放在 5 種熱源上方：岩漿塊會產出最低的電量；熔岩源會稍微更好一點；&c烈焰電晶塊&r則能夠產出更多；而暗物質方塊能夠產出大量能量；最後的紅物質方塊甚至還能夠產出更多！

atm9.quest.powah.desc.uraninite.original: Since we are in the sky we can't mine Uraninite we have to make it. First get Uranium from Sieving Deepslate. Then use the Energizing we learned from last quest to Energize Uranium into Uraninite! Now your Reactor Fuel is ready.
atm9.quest.powah.desc.uraninite.translation: 因為我們在空中無法挖到晶質鈾，所以我們必須要製作它。首先透過篩深板岩來獲得鈾。然後利用我們從上個任務學到的方式來將鈾充能為晶質鈾！現在你的反應爐燃料已經準備就緒了。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.advancedB.original: Place some empty &eAdvanced Beehives&r in an unlit area. The bees will move in over time.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.advancedB.translation: 將一些空的&e進階蜂箱&r放在沒有照明的區域。該蜜蜂會隨著時間的推移而搬進來。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.allthemod.original: To get the Allthemodium Bee, breed a Withered Bee with an Ancient Bee.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.allthemod.translation: 利用凋零蜜蜂和遠古蜜蜂來配種出 ATM金屬蜜蜂！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.ashyMinin.original: The Ashy Mining Bee is spawned from a Dirt, Gravel, or Sand Nest.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.ashyMinin.translation: 灰色採礦蜜蜂生成自泥土蜂窩、礫石蜂窩或沙蜂窩。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.ashyMinin.original: If you want one of these, you'll need an Ashy Mining Bee first.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.ashyMinin.translation: 如果你想要獲得該蜜蜂，你需要先擁有一隻灰色採礦蜜蜂

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.ashyMinin.original: Once the Ashy Mining Bee is cozy in its nest, there is a chance for a Nomad Bee to take it over.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.ashyMinin.translation: 當灰色採礦蜜蜂待在牠舒服的蜂窩中時，游牧蜜蜂有機率會搶下牠的蜂窩。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.atmBees.1.original: If you want the ATM Bees, it takes a lot of capturing and breeding and feeding.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.atmBees.1.translation: 若你想養出 ATM 蜜蜂，會需要大量的捕捉，配種與餵養。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.atmBees.2.original: The following part of the questline outlines which Bees you'll need to move forward.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.atmBees.2.translation: 以下的任務線框出那些蜜蜂是你必須發展的。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.atmBees.3.original: Make sure to check JEI and the &9Big Book of Bees&r for more info!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.atmBees.3.translation: 確保隨時查看 JEI 以及 &9Big Book of Bees&r 取得更多資訊！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeCatche.original: Used to catch Bees that are flying around it.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeCatche.translation: 用來將飛來飛去的蜜蜂抓起來。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeCatche.original: You can use a Filter Upgrade to filter out which Bees you want to catch, as well as a BaBee Upgrade to only catch baby Bees.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeCatche.translation: 可使用篩選升級來過濾那些蜜蜂是你想抓的，同時幼蜂升級是只捕捉幼蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeCreati.original: Aside from luring bees in with nests, most bees require either &eBreeding&r or &9Conversion&r to bee created. (No, that isn't a typo.)
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeCreati.translation: 除了利用蜂窩來馴服蜜蜂之外，大多數蜜蜂會需要透過&e配種&r或&9轉換&r來創造。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeCreati.original: &eBee Breeding&r requires 2 bees and specific items fed to them to cause them to mate.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeCreati.translation: &e蜜蜂配種&r需要餵給兩種蜜蜂特定的物品來讓牠們生出新種蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeCreati.original: &9Bee Conversion&r requires you to feed a bee a specific item to convert it into a new bee.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeCreati.translation: &9蜜蜂轉換&r需要餵給一隻蜜蜂特定的物品來將牠轉換為新種蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeDaycar.original: This can be used to speed up the growth rate of baby Bees, or to create new spawn eggs.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeDaycar.translation: 這能用來加速幼蜂的生長，或用來製作生怪蛋。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeDaycar.original: Place a caged baby bee with 20 Honey Treats to turn it into an adult.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeDaycar.translation: 放入裝籠的幼蜂，以及 20 個蜜蜂點心，將它轉換為成年蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeDaycar.original: To create Spawn Eggs, you'll need to combine the gene of the bee you want with a honey treat, then use that honey treat in this machine with an egg to create the new spawn egg.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeDaycar.translation: 製作生怪蛋，你會需要將你需要的蜜蜂基因和蜂蜜點心合在一起，然後用機器裏面的蜂蜜點心和雞蛋去製作新生怪蛋

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeDaycar.original: Genes can be combined for a maximum of 100% purity, which will give you a 100% chance to convert an egg to a bee spawn egg.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeDaycar.translation: 基因能組合為最高 100% 的純度，使你能以 100% 的機率將雞蛋轉換為生怪蛋。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeFarmFa.original: If you want to turn your Bee Farm into a factory for resources, you'll need to start by spawning in Bees with &6Nests&r.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeFarmFa.translation: 如果你想把你的養蜂場變成一個資源工廠，你需要先用&6蜂窩&r生成蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeFarmFa.original: The nests must be placed in specific biomes, which you can find in the JEI for it (look for the I icon at the top).
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeFarmFa.translation: 蜂窩必須放置在特定的生態域中，你可以在 JEI 中找到相關資訊（尋找頂部的 I 圖示）。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeFarmFa.original: To lure in a Bee to the nest, right click on it with a &9Honey Treat&r. Nests will not work without the treats!!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeFarmFa.translation: 要吸引蜜蜂進入蜂窩，請用&9蜂蜜點心&r右鍵點擊它。沒有點心，蜂窩將無法運作！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeFarmFa.original: &9Important Note&r: Certain Bees will only live in Nests and will not go into Advanced Hives. If they don't produce a honeycomb, they need to live in a nest instead.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.beeFarmFa.translation: &9重要提示&r：某些蜜蜂只會在蜂窩中生存，不會進入進階蜂箱。如果牠們不生產蜂巢，則需要住在蜂窩裡。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.bottlerUs.original: The Bottler has two uses: Bottling honey and squshing Bees for genes.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.bottlerUs.translation: 裝瓶機有兩種用途：將蜂蜜裝罐以及擠壓蜜蜂取得基因。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.bottlerUs.original: To get genes from Bees, place a piston above the Bottler with a block of space between them.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.bottlerUs.translation: 要從蜜蜂身上取得基因，在裝瓶機上方空一格高的地方放個活塞。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.bottlerUs.original: Place the bee on top of the Bottler, and activate the piston to squish the bee into genes. The resulting squished bottle can be then placed in a Centrifuge.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.bottlerUs.translation: 在裝瓶機上方的空格處放出蜜蜂，然後啟動活塞將蜜蜂擠壓成基因。擠出的基因瓶可隨後放入離心機中。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.bottlerUs.original: Note: Make sure to have bottles in the Bottler.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.bottlerUs.translation: 注意：確保裝瓶機中有玻璃瓶。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.centrifug.original: The &9Centrifuge&r is used to process Combs from Bees into useful items and honey! While you can definitely just use a regular &9Centrifuge&r in the beginning, getting a &6Powered Centrifuge&r soon after is a must. This is a faster Centrifuge that runs off of power!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.centrifug.translation: &9離心機&r用於將蜂巢處理成有用的物品和蜂蜜！雖然一開始你絕對可以使用普通的&9離心機&r，但之後盡快取得一台&6能量型分離機&r 是必須的。這是一種更快速的分離機，需要電力才能運作！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.centrifug.original: If you're looking for the best way to process your Combs, the &cHeated Centrifuge&r is even faster and can even process &aComb Blocks&r!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.centrifug.translation: 如果你正在尋找處理蜂巢的最佳方式，&c加熱型離心機&r甚至更快，而且還可以處理&a蜂巢塊&r！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.centrifug.original: These can all be made faster by using Speed Upgrades.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.centrifug.translation: 這些都可以透過使用升級：速度來加快速度。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.collectin.original: When collecting genes, you'll get a percentage of a trait. You can combine them in a crafting table to add them together, or place them in a Gene Indexer to auto-combine.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.collectin.translation: 當你收集基因時，你會獲得某項屬性的百分比。你可以在工作台中將它們組合起來相加，或者將它們放置在基因整合機中自動組合。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.crystalli.original: The Crystalline Bee is spawned from a Quartz Nest.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.crystalli.translation: 石英蜜蜂生成自地獄石英蜂窩。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.crystalli.original: This bee is needed to make many of the other metal bees, like Iron and Copper.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.crystalli.translation: 該蜜蜂是其他金屬蜜蜂的前置，像是鐵蜜蜂或銅蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.crystalli.original: This nest attracts &eCrystalline Bees&r. You'll need Nether Quartz instead of using Honey Treats to attract the Bee.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.crystalli.translation: 地獄石英蜂窩能夠引誘到石英蜜蜂。你會需要使用地獄石英而非蜂蜜點心來引誘到此蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.crystalli.original: The easiest way to get a quartz block is by mining it with a Silk Touch pick.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.crystalli.translation: 最好獲得石英方塊的方法就是使用絲綢之觸鎬來挖掘它。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.crystalli.original: Tip: Brass has the Silk Touch trait when making a Silent Gear tool.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.crystalli.translation: 提示：《寂靜裝備》中的黃銅鎬自帶絲綢之觸。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.diamondBe.original: Breed the Ender Bee with a Lapis Bee to create a Diamond Bee!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.diamondBe.translation: 利用終界蜜蜂和青金石蜜蜂來配種出鑽石蜜蜂！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.dirtNest..original: It can lure the Ashy Mining Bee, Chocolate Mining Bee, and the Leafcutter Bee.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.dirtNest..translation: 它能夠引誘到灰色採礦蜜蜂、巧克力採礦蜜蜂和切葉蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.eccentric.original: You can find this in the Eccentric Tome you start with, but if you somehow lost it, craft one!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.eccentric.translation: 你能在初入遊戲時的怪奇寶典中找到，若你已經找不到了，就做一本吧！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.eccentric.original: This guidebook will help you learn everything about Bees.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.eccentric.translation: 這本指南書能幫助你學習關於蜜蜂的所有知識。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.emeraldBe.original: Once you have a Diamond Bee, breed it with the Slimy Bee to create an Emerald Bee!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.emeraldBe.translation: 利用鑽石蜜蜂和史萊姆蜜蜂來配種出綠寶石蜜蜂！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.endStoneN.original: Create yourself an &5End Stone Nest&r and head to the End to capture one of these bees!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.endStoneN.translation: 合成一個&5終界石蜂窩&r並前往終界來獲得此蜜蜂！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.enderBees.original: You'll need these for Ender Bees.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.enderBees.translation: 為了終界蜜蜂你會需要這個。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.enderNest.original: To attract Bees to this nest, you'll need Popped Chorus Fruit instead of Honey Treats.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.enderNest.translation: 要將蜜蜂引誘到此蜂窩中的話，你會需要使用爆開的歌萊果，而非蜂蜜點心。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.expansion.original: Expansion boxes are placed on top of your Advanced Beehives to increase the amount of Bees that can be in the hive to a total of 5 slots.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.expansion.translation: 擴充箱放置在你的進階蜂箱頂部，以增加蜂箱可容納的蜜蜂數量，總共可達 5 格。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.flyBee.1.original: Have you ever wanted to fly on a Bee?
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.flyBee.1.translation: 你曾想過在蜜蜂身上飛行嗎？

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.flyBee.2.original: Bumble Bees naturally spawn in the world, and they can be used as mounts!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.flyBee.2.translation: 大黃蜂會自然生成在世界上，牠們可以當作坐騎！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.flyBee.3.original: Make yourself a &6Treat on a Stick&r, slap a Saddle on a Bumble Bee, and take To The Sky!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.flyBee.3.translation: 製作一個&6點心釣竿&r，並讓大黃蜂裝備上鞍，翱翔天際！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.glowstone.original: When placed in the Nether and given Glowstone, the Glowstone Nest will lure in a Glowing Bee.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.glowstone.translation: 如果你將螢光石蜂窩放置在地獄，並給予它一些螢光石的話，它就能夠引誘到螢光蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.glowstone.original: You'll need to grab yourself a &6Glowstone Nest&r and head to the Nether to capture this bee!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.glowstone.translation: 合成一個&6螢光石蜂窩&r並前往地獄來獲得此蜜蜂！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.gravelNes.original: It lures in the Ashy Mining Bee, Chocolate Mining Bee, and the Digger Bee.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.gravelNes.translation: 它能夠引誘灰色採礦蜜蜂、巧克力採礦蜜蜂和挖掘蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.hiveCatch.original: When installed in a hive, it gives a 5% chance for a new baby bee to be spawned every time honey is delivered.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.hiveCatch.translation: 安裝在蜂箱時，每次蜂蜜被送達時，有 5% 的機率生成一隻新的幼蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.hiveCatch.original: When placed in a Catcher, it only allows the catcher to catch baby bees.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.hiveCatch.translation: 放入捕蜂機時，能使捕蜂機只捕捉幼蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.hiveCatch.original: You can stack these for a greater chance.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.hiveCatch.translation: 疊加使用能有更高的機率。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.hiveCentr.original: Can be placed in a hive or centrifuge.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.hiveCentr.translation: 能放入蜂箱或離心機中。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.hiveCentr.original: When in a hive, it decreases the amount of time bees spend in the hive by 20%.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.hiveCentr.translation: 當放入蜂箱時，減少蜜蜂待在蜂箱的時間 20%。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.hiveCentr.original: When placed in a Centrifuge, it increases the processing speed.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.hiveCentr.translation: 當放入離心機時，增加處理速度。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.itemColle.original: Collects items on the ground and brings it back to its nest.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.itemColle.translation: 收集地上的物品並帶回它的蜂箱中。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.itemPicku.original: Will pick up items and bring them back to its hive.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.itemPicku.translation: 牠會撿起物品並將它們帶回牠的蜂箱之中。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.itemPicku.original: Not as good as a Hoarder Bee.

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.lapisBeeC.original: Breed a Redstone Bee with a Blue Banded Bee to get a Lapis Bee!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.lapisBeeC.translation: 利用紅石蜜蜂和藍帶蜜蜂來配種出青金石蜜蜂！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.luresGold.original: Instead of using Honey Treats, this hive requires Gold Ingots to attract Bees.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.luresGold.translation: 不是使用蜜蜂點心，這個蜂巢需要金錠來吸引蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.nestDirec.original: Right-clicking on a Nest of the type you are looking for will point you in the direction of another!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.nestDirec.translation: 右鍵點擊你正在尋找的那種蜂窩，它會指引你前往另一個的方向！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.nests.1.original: Wood Nests are used to lure Carpenter Bees and the Blue Banded Bee.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.nests.1.translation: 木蜂窩用來引誘木匠蜜蜂和藍帶蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.nests.2.original: Dark Oak Nests lures 3 different bees.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.nests.2.translation: 黑橡木蜂窩能引誘 3 種不同的蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.netherBri.original: Placing the Nether Brick Nest in the Nether will lure in a Magmatic Bee when given Magma Cream.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.netherBri.translation: 如果你將地獄磚蜂窩放置在地獄，並給予它一些岩漿球的話，它就能夠引誘到岩漿蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.obsidianN.original: The Obsidian Nest will lure in Draconic Bees when placed in the End.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.obsidianN.translation: 如果你將黑曜石蜂窩放置在終界的話，它就能夠引誘到龍族蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.obsidianN.original: These do not accept Honey Treats, but instead use Dragon's Breath.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.obsidianN.translation: 它不是使用蜜蜂點心，而是使用龍之吐息。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.obsidianN.original: Place an Obsidian Nest in the End to lure this bee.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.obsidianN.translation: 透過在終界使用黑曜石蜂窩來馴服該蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.productiv.original: In Productive Bees, you don't spend most of your time flying around trying to find certain bees.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.productiv.translation: 在生產蜜蜂模組中，你不需要花費大部分時間四處飛行尋找特定的蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.productiv.original: Instead, you spawn them using Nests with &6Honey Treats&r.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.productiv.translation: 相反地，是以&6蜂蜜點心&r對蜂窩使用來生成牠們。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.productiv.original: With these, you'll create yourself some Nests and right click them with the treats to lure Bees in. Some Nests require special items instead of Honey Treats, so make sure to check JEI for more info!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.productiv.translation: 有了這些，你將製作一些蜂窩，然後用蜜蜂點心右鍵點擊它們來吸引蜜蜂。有些蜂窩需要特殊的物品而不是蜂蜜點心，所以請務必查看 JEI 以獲取更多資訊！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.productiv.original: Make sure to check out which biome you need to be in to lure in the right bees!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.productiv.translation: 請務必確認你需要身處哪個生態域才能吸引到正確的蜜蜂！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.redstoneB.original: With the Glowing Bee, breed it with the Chocolate Mining Bee to get a Redstone Bee!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.redstoneB.translation: 利用螢石蜜蜂和巧克力採礦蜜蜂來配種出紅石蜜蜂！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.showingOf.original: Proud of the Bees you have?
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.showingOf.translation: 為你擁有的蜜蜂感到自豪嗎？

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.showingOf.original: Wanna put them into a jar to show it off?
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.showingOf.translation: 想把它們放進罐子裡炫耀嗎？

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.showingOf.original: Place a Bee Jar down and use a pipe or hopper to insert the caged bee into the jar.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.showingOf.translation: 放出蜜蜂罐並使用管道或漏斗將蜜蜂籠輸入罐中。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.tinBees.original: Tin Bees are made by breeding a Crystalline Bee with an Ashy Mining Bee.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.tinBees.translation: 利用石英蜜蜂和灰色採礦蜜蜂來配種出錫蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.unobtaini.original: Once you have the Allthemodium and Vibranium Bees, breed them together to get an Unobtainium Bee.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.unobtaini.translation: 獲得 ATM 金屬蜜蜂和汎金屬蜜蜂後，讓牠們繁殖，之後就能獲得難得素蜜蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.unobtaini.original: To breed: Feed the Allthemodium Bee 4 ingots of Vibranium, then feed the Vibranium Bee 4 ingots of Unobtainium.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.unobtaini.translation: 繁殖方法:餵給 ATM 金屬蜜蜂 4 個汎金屬錠，再餵給汎金屬蜜蜂 4 個難得素錠。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.upgradeBa.original: The Upgrade Base is used to craft the various Upgrades in Productive Bees.
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.upgradeBa.translation: 空白升級用於製作生產蜜蜂模組中的各種升級。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.vibranium.original: Breed a Draconic Bee with an Ancient Bee to get a Vibranium Bee!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.desc.vibranium.translation: 利用龍族蜜蜂和遠古蜜蜂來配種出汎金屬蜂！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.feedDiamondBee.translation: 餵給鑽石蜜蜂一個紫水晶方塊

atm9.quest.productiveBees.feedShroombeeB.original: Feed a Shroombee a Brown Mushroom!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.feedShroombeeB.translation: 餵給任意蘑菇蜜蜂一個棕色蘑菇！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.gravelStoneNes.original: Spawned using a Gravel or Stone Nest
atm9.quest.productiveBees.gravelStoneNes.translation: 生成自礫石蜂窩或石蜂窩

atm9.quest.productiveBees.overworldBumbl.original: Spawns in the Overworld from Bumble Bee Nests
atm9.quest.productiveBees.overworldBumbl.translation: 利用主世界的大黃蜂巢生成

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.advancedB.original: Spawns in empty Advanced Beehives in a dark place
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.advancedB.translation: 生成自黑暗中的空的進階蜂箱

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.ashyCryst.translation: 灰色採礦 + 地獄石英

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.ashyMinin.original: Spawns in a nest that has an Ashy Mining Bee
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.ashyMinin.translation: 生成自有灰色採礦蜜蜂的蜂窩之中

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.beeFilter.original: Used to add Bees to a Filter

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.blueBande.original: Spawns in a nest that has a Blue Banded Bee
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.blueBande.translation: 生成自有藍帶蜂的蜂窩之中

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.cocoaPods.original: Chance to Spawn when breaking Cocoa Pods
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.cocoaPods.translation: 在破壞可可豆時機率生成

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.crystalli.original: Lures Crystalline Bees in the Nether
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.crystalli.translation: 在地獄引誘地獄石英蜜蜂

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.draconicE.original: Lures a Draconic Bee in the End

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.enderEnd.original: Lures in Ender Bees when placed in the End

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedCrims.original: Feed a Shroombee a Crimson Fungus!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedCrims.translation: 餵給任意蘑菇蜜蜂一個緋紅蕈菇！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedDiamo.original: Feed Diamond Bee a Block of Netherite
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedDiamo.translation: 餵給鑽石蜂一個獄髓方塊

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedFluix.original: Feed a Spatial Bee a Fluix Pearl!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedFluix.translation: 餵給空間蜜蜂一個福魯伊克斯珍珠！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedHoppe.original: Feed a Vanilla Bee a Hopper!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedHoppe.translation: 餵給原版蜜蜂一個漏斗！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedPerid.translation: 餵給鑽石蜜蜂一個橄欖石方塊！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedProsp.original: Feed a Crystalline Bee a Prosperity Block!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedProsp.translation: 餵給石英蜜蜂一個活化水晶方塊！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedRedMu.original: Feed a Shroombee a Red Mushroom!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedRedMu.translation: 餵給任意蘑菇蜜蜂一個紅色蘑菇！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedRuby.original: Feed a Diamond Bee a Ruby!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedRuby.translation: 餵給鑽石蜜蜂一個紅寶石方塊！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedSapph.original: Feed a Diamond Bee a Sapphire!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedSapph.translation: 餵給鑽石蜜蜂一個藍寶石方塊！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedShulk.original: Feed a Collector Bee a Shulker Shell!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedShulk.translation: 餵給收集器蜜蜂一個界伏殼！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedSkele.original: Feed a Skeletal Bee a Withered Rose
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedSkele.translation: 餵給骷髏蜜蜂一個凋零玫瑰

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedSouli.original: Feed a Ghostly Bee a Soulium Dagger!
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedSouli.translation: 餵給幽靈蜜蜂一個靈魂匕首！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.feedWarpe.translation: 餵給任意蘑菇蜜蜂一個扭曲蕈菇！

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.geneExtra.original: Extracts Genes from Bees in Hives
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.geneExtra.translation: 從蜂箱中的蜜蜂提取基因

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.ghostlyBe.original: Lures in Ghostly Bees when placed in the Nether and given Ghast Tears
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.ghostlyBe.translation: 如果你將靈魂砂蜂窩放置在地獄，並給予它一些幽靈之淚的話，它就能夠引誘到幽靈蜂。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.honeyISqu.translation: 親愛的我把蜜蜂壓死了

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.lumberQua.original: Lumber and Quarry Bees will give Blocks instead of Chips
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.lumberQua.translation: 伐木蜜蜂與採石蜜蜂會產出方塊而非碎屑。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.luresGold.original: Lures a Gold Bee in the Nether

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.machineRa.original: Increases the Range of a Machine

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.magmaticN.original: Lures in a Magmatic Bee when placed in the Nether

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.netherGlo.original: Lures a Glowing Bee in the Nether

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.preventTe.original: Prevents Bees from Teleporting in a Hive
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.preventTe.translation: 防止蜂箱中的蜜蜂傳送。

atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.spawnedEm.original: Spawned with empty Beehives in the Dark
atm9.quest.productiveBees.subt.spawnedEm.translation: 生成自黑暗中的空蜂箱

atm9.quest.productivetrees.desc.intro.1.original:
&lProductive Trees&r is a sister mod to &lProductive Bees&r.

In order to get the different trees you will need Pollinated Leaves. To get Pollinated Leaves you need Pollen. For Pollen you need Bees.

Bees flowering near the trees will automatically pollinate Leaves, or you can use a Pollen Sieve Upgrade in the Hive to get and use Pollen yourself! Have one on the house!

atm9.quest.productivetrees.desc.sawing.1.original:
The Sawmill cuts Logs into Sawdust and more Planks than you would get from crafting. Sawdust can be used to make Paper.

- Fustic Logs will also give you Fustic.
- Brazilwood Logs and Logwood Logs will also give you Haematoxylin.

atm9.quest.productivetrees.desc.strippin.original: The (Log) Stripper strips Logs automatically using Axes put in the machine.

atm9.quest.proje.desc.CL.original: Similar to the Construction Catalyst only this one can go down 64 blocks instead of 16 when fully charged.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.CL.translation: 與毀滅催化石類似，但是在滿充能時的最大長度為 64 格方塊，而非 16 格。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.DC.original: The Desreuction Catalyst can be used to mine a 3 by 3 square just by right-clicking with it. When charged it will continue going down the 3x3 (up to 16 blocks) making for easy to create tunnels.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.DC.translation: 毀滅催化石能夠挖下 3x3 區域的方塊。將它充能過後能夠增加它的挖掘長度（最多 16 格方塊），讓你能夠快速的製造出一條隧道。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.DM.original: Dark matter is also summoned using the Summoning Altar. You will need lots of this, so preferably make a bunch of each ingredient and go ham!
atm9.quest.proje.desc.DM.translation: 暗物質是要透過召喚祭壇來召喚出來的。你會需要大量的暗物質，所以最好將所有原料準備各一些，然後進行批量生產！

atm9.quest.proje.desc.DMblock.original: The Dark Matter block can be used to make Crucibles 100x faster, or even better, have Thermo Generators making up to &c45k fe/t&r.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.DMblock.translation: 暗物質方塊能夠讓坩堝的加熱速率變為 100x，並使讓熱力發電機最多能夠產出 &c45K FE/t&r。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.HL.original: Right-click to summon a ball of energy that creates a fairly large explosion when it makes contact with a block. The cool part is that all the blocks it breaks will teleport to you, no matter where you are.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.HL.translation: 右鍵使用它能夠召喚一個能量球：當它接觸到方塊時，會造成一次大型爆炸。最棒的地方是它所破壞的所有方塊都會直接傳送到你的物品欄之中，無論你身處何地。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.Pstone.original:
The Philosopher's Stone is obtained by using a Summoning Altar. It doesn't get used up in crafting recipes.

This stone can do quite a bit. It can be used as a portable crafting table when you press 'c'.
