It can turn mobs from one to another when you press 'r', it can turn in-world blocks from one to another if you right click, and it can be charged when you press 'v' in order to transform more in-world blocks! Shift+V to uncharge.

&lCheck JEI for what it can transform!
atm9.quest.proje.desc.Pstone.translation:
賢者之石能透過召喚祭壇獲得，不會在合成配方中被消耗。

這塊石頭功能強大。按下「C 鍵」時，可以當成攜帶式工作台使用。按下「R 鍵」時，可以將一種生物轉變為其他生物。右鍵點擊時，可以將世界中的一種方塊轉換成其他方塊。按下「V 鍵」時，可以充能以便更多世界方塊轉換！潛行時按「V 鍵」 可以取消充能。

&l查看 JEI 以了解它能夠進行哪些轉換！&r

atm9.quest.proje.desc.RM.original: A catalyst for the &6&lATM Star.&r&r\n\nThis can also be used to make several OP endgame items from ProjectE!
atm9.quest.proje.desc.RM.translation: 用來召喚出 &6&lATM 之星&r的催化劑！\n\n它也能夠用來製作《等價交換》模組中的強力後期道具！

atm9.quest.proje.desc.RMuse.original: Red Matter can be used for the same purposes as Dark Matter, except better in every way! You can make an &bEnergy Condenser MK2&r which does instant item conversion, make an Energy CondensorMK2 even or you can make a &bRing of Arcana&r, which is effectively an all-in-one ring! Very OP!
atm9.quest.proje.desc.RMuse.translation: 紅物質的用途基本上與暗物質無異，但都更加強大！例如：你能夠用它來製作出能夠立即轉換物品的&b能量聚集器 MK2&r；或是擁有所有戒指效果的&b奧術戒指&r！

atm9.quest.proje.desc.aefuelblock.original: The catalyst for summoning Dark Matter, remember to add it last.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.aefuelblock.translation: 用來召喚出暗物質的催化劑，記得要最後再將它放上召喚祭壇。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.alchbag.original: Alchemical Bags are portable Alchemical Chests, basically just big backpacks!
atm9.quest.proje.desc.alchbag.translation: 煉金術提袋是隨身版的鍊金術儲物箱，基本上就是個大背包！

atm9.quest.proje.desc.alchchest.original: The Alchemical Chest is a bigger chest.. but most importantly, it will be used for some important crafting recipes.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.alchchest.translation: 鍊金術儲物箱是一個更大的箱子...但最重要的是，它將被用於一些重要的合成配方。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.alchcoal.original: Basically just coal, but better. This will be an important crafting recipe.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.alchcoal.translation: 基本上就是煤炭，同時也是一個很重要的合成材料。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.anti.original: The Anti-Matter relay will turn items with an EMC value into raw EMC.\n\nAuto feed it covalence dust and you get free EMC :)
atm9.quest.proje.desc.anti.translation: 反物質轉繼器會將具有 EMC 的物品轉換為純粹的 EMC。\n\n自動餵給它共價粉你就能得到免費的 EMC 了。:)

atm9.quest.proje.desc.covdust.original: Covalence dusts have &lhigh&r EMC values and trade in for lots of items. You can use these to trade early on.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.covdust.translation: 共價粉具有 &l高&rEMC，可以用來換取許多物品。在遊戲前期可以用它進行交易。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.crafting.original: An ingredient for summoning Dark Matter.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.crafting.translation: 用來召喚暗物質的原料之一。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.dmfurnace.original: It can use coal or EMC (from a Klein Star) to smelt items! Why is this good? Well, it has a chance to double your ores!
atm9.quest.proje.desc.dmfurnace.translation: 它能夠使用煤炭或來自卡萊恩能量之星的 EMC 來熔煉物品！它好在哪裡？嗯...它有機率會將你的礦物雙倍化！

atm9.quest.proje.desc.dmpedestal.original: This is used in combination with several rings and stones in order to get effects such as regeneration, saturation, and even crop growth! Place the ring/stone on top, then shift+right click the pedestal.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.dmpedestal.translation: 將戒指或寶石放在暗物質臺座上，然後對它潛行+右鍵來獲得回復、飽食，甚至是植物生長速度...等加成！

atm9.quest.proje.desc.dmtools.original:
Stronger tools than usual. Make sure to check keybinds, but the default ones are:

V to charge.

Shift+V to uncharge.

C for extra function.

G to switch modes.

R to fire projectile.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.dmtools.translation:
比一般的工具更好。請記得檢查你的按鍵綁定，下列為一些預設按鍵：

V：充能

Shift + V：解除充能

C：額外功能

G：切換模式

R：發射寶珠

atm9.quest.proje.desc.echo.original: Summon the Deep Dark, this is outlined in Getting Started: 2.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.echo.translation: 召喚出深淵，在&l&5《由此開始：第二部分》&r任務章節中有提到具體方法。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.energycondenser.original: The Energy Condenser is what actually transforms items from one into the other. First, put the item you want to trade for in to the &ltop left slot&r. Then, place any items with an EMC value (like covalence dusts) into the main inventory of the energy condenser, and they will be converted!
atm9.quest.proje.desc.energycondenser.translation:
能量聚集器是一個能夠將一個物品真的轉換為其他物品的裝置。

首先，先將你要交換出來的物品放入&l左上角的格子&r之中。

然後，將具有 EMC 的物品（像是共價粉）放入能量聚集器的儲物空間內，它們就會開始進行轉換了！

atm9.quest.proje.desc.energycondenserMK2.original: This upgrade to the Energy Condensor makes it insanely fast, along with adding on to it's UI by having a section for you to put EMC in and a seperate section for the item you are trying to make.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.energycondenserMK2.translation: 這個強化版的能量聚集器能夠以非常快的速度進行轉換，並額外附加了一個專門放置轉換物的區域。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.gen.original: The Energy Collector will passively generate EMC when it has sunlight.\n\nPut glowstone on top and it will always generate EMC :)
atm9.quest.proje.desc.gen.translation: 能量收集器會在接收到陽光時被動產出 EMC 。\n\n在它的頂部放置一塊螢光石來讓它不斷地產出 EMC。:)

atm9.quest.proje.desc.insanium.original: Go through &aMystical Agriculture&r to get this.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.insanium.translation: 跟著&a《神秘農業》&r任務章節來獲得此物品。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.inttorch.original: The Interdiction Torch pushes all hostile mobs away within a 5 block radius!
atm9.quest.proje.desc.inttorch.translation: 禁制火把可以把半徑 5 格的怪物都推開！

atm9.quest.proje.desc.klein.original: Klein Stars work as a battery, but they store EMC.\n\nWhen placed in an Energy Collecter or Anti-Matter Relay it will take the energy from them. When placed in a &dTransmutation Table&r in one of the &lleft side slots&r, the EMC stored inside of it can be used to convert items from one to another.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.klein.translation:
卡萊恩能量之星就像是一個電池，但它儲存的是 EMC。

當你將它放入能量收集器或是反物質轉繼器時，它會自動吸收裡面的 EMC。

而當你將它放入&d轉換桌&r&l左邊的格子&r內時，你就能夠使用它儲存的 EMC 來轉換物品。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.kleinomega.original: Stores the most EMC out of all the Klein Stars.\n\nThese are needed to make the ATM Star.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.kleinomega.translation: 能夠儲存最多 EMC 的卡萊恩之星。\n\n是製造「ATM 之星」的必要材料之一。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.klientier.original: Stores more EMC than the last
atm9.quest.proje.desc.klientier.translation: 比上一級能儲存更多 EMC

atm9.quest.proje.desc.mana.original: To get the Manasteel Ingots needed for the Philosopher's Stone, you will need some mana. Go a little bit through the &aBotania&r Quest chapter to get these ingots.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.mana.translation: 要獲得製作賢者之石所需的魔力鋼錠，你需要一些魔力。稍微進行一下植物魔法任務章節來獲取這些錠。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.mobius.original: Even better coal, check JEI for uses.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.mobius.translation: 更加好的煤炭，查看 JEI 來了解它的用途。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.nova.original: The Nova Catalyst would be pretty good for mining... unfortunatley this is a skyblock. There is nothing to mine. Maybe the end?\n\nIn that case the Nova Catalyst can be used to create various mining tools, or it can be blown up to mine a bunch of blocks (Doesn't deal any damage).
atm9.quest.proje.desc.nova.translation: 催化炸藥是一個非常好的挖礦手段...但不幸的是我們現在在空島上。沒有任何礦物給你挖。或許能在終界挖？\n\n在現在這種情況下，它的用途只剩下用來合成一些挖掘工具，還有拿來炸毀大量方塊（且不會造成任何傷害）。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.nova2.original: Basically just the Nova Catalyst, but a whole lot bigger.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.nova2.translation: 基本上就是催化炸藥，但擁有更大爆炸的範圍。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.obbyiron.original: Obsidian with Iron is really easy to craft, and when smelted, will give you an &5Obsidian Ingot&r, these are needed for the dark nether star.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.obbyiron.translation: 含鐵的黑曜石很容易就能合成出來，當你將它拿去熔煉時，你就能得到&5黑曜石錠&r，你會需要用到這些黑曜石錠來合成暗黑地獄之星。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.plutonium.translation: 跟著&a《通用機械：&d進階版&r&a》&r任務章節來獲得此物品。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.tip.original: Place an Energy Condenser next to an Energy Collector or antimatter relay and it will use the EMC from them to create items out of thin air!
atm9.quest.proje.desc.tip.translation: 將能量聚集器放在能量收集器或是反物質轉繼器的旁邊，前者就能使用後兩者之中的 EMC 來憑空創造出物品了！

atm9.quest.proje.desc.tnt.original: When summoning a Philosopher's Stone in the &eSummoning Altar&r, you will need TNT as the catalyst.\n\n&lAdd it last.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.tnt.translation: 在召喚祭壇中召喚賢者之石時，你需要使用 TNT 作為催化劑。\n\n&l最後再加入&r

atm9.quest.proje.desc.trans.original: The Transmutation Table will forever remember the items you put in, and you won't constantly have to put the item you want into that top left slot!\n\nExample usage: Add in a Blaze Rod. Add in a stack of High Covalence Dust. Click the Blaze Rod that shows up on the right side of the Transmutation Table and it will convert all the EMC stored from the High Covalence Dust into the Blaze Rod.
atm9.quest.proje.desc.trans.translation: 轉換桌會永久性的記住你已經放入過的物品，而且你不用再將你想要轉換出來的物品放在左上角的那個格子了！\n\n使用範例：放入一個烈焰桿→放入一組高等共價粉→點擊出現在轉換桌右邊的烈焰桿→接下來它就會將你剛剛放入的高等共價粉的 EMC 全部轉換為烈焰桿了。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.transtablet.original: A portable Transmutation Table, why not make one?
atm9.quest.proje.desc.transtablet.translation: 一個攜帶式轉換桌，有任何理由不做一個出來嗎？

atm9.quest.proje.desc.unobtainium.original: Unobtainium can be found in the End highlands
atm9.quest.proje.desc.unobtainium.translation: 難得素能在終界高地挖到。

atm9.quest.proje.desc.welcome.original: ProjectE is all about trading in EMC for items. This can be done via trading items that have an EMC from one to another, or trading pure EMC for items!
atm9.quest.proje.desc.welcome.translation: 《等價交換》是一個能夠將物品以 EMC 當作單位來進行轉換的模組。你能夠將具有 EMC 的物品轉換為 EMC，然後再用這些 EMC 來轉換成其他的物品！

atm9.quest.proje.subt.nova.translation: 讓 TNT 看起來更壞！

atm9.quest.proje.subt.nova2.original: You thought the Catalyst was bad...
atm9.quest.proje.subt.nova2.translation: 你覺得催化炸藥夠壞了嗎？

atm9.quest.pylons.desc.explusion.1.original: The Explusion Pylon pushes players out of the area, but what if you want &lsome&r players nearby! Then you'll need a Player Filter. Right Click a Player with it to set them in it, and then put it into the Pylon to Whitelist them! So when everyone else is pushed out, your friend won't be! Also by default the Owner of the Pylon won't get expuled.

atm9.quest.pylons.desc.expulsion.1.original: The Expulsion Pylon works as a way of keeping people off your lawn. When placed down it will keep any Players who aren't whitelisted from a set amount of Chunks around it. The Chunks are set in it's GUI in the top left from 1x1, 3x3, or 5x5 Chunks. Also no it can't be set too close to Spawn. We know what you trolls want and we ain't giving it! To Whitelist players check the Player Filter Quest!

atm9.quest.pylons.desc.harvester.1.original: Harvester Pylons work as a very simple Auto-Farm. Put the Pylon on or in the Water Source and it will automatically harvest and replant Crops that are fully grown in the set area around it. The area can be set to 3x3, 5x5, 7x7, or 9x9 Blocks around the Pylon. It will need a Hoe to use on the Plants and will need an Inventory like a chest above it to put the Crops. Do all that and if it's turned On it will start farming! \n \n(Careful when using a lot of modifiers with it like Lilypads or fertilizer as when it goes very fast farming it can be a TPS eater).

atm9.quest.pylons.desc.harvesterex.1.original: The Harvester Pylon needs a Hoe to work. (Hoes without Durability or are Indestructible will work forever, Hoes that aren't will need to be replaced).

atm9.quest.pylons.desc.infusion.1.original: The Infusion Pylon works similar as a Beacon just much better and cheaper! When a Potion Effect is put in by a Potion Filter, it will continuously give you the Potion Effect while you're in the set Chunk area.

atm9.quest.pylons.desc.interdiction.1.original: Do you just hate when Zombies spawn at your base? Or when Creepers do? Or when Pandas do? Or literally any mob you can find! Then you want the Interdiction Pylon. When a Mob Filter is put into it, it'll disable spawns of that mob in the set Chunk area (you can set the Chunks in the top left of the GUI). You can put as many Mob Filters as it can hold.

atm9.quest.pylons.desc.mobfilter.1.original: To set the Mob Filter you just have to click the Mob you never want to see again, with the Mob Filter. Each Filter can only hold 1 Mob so if you want Zombies, Skeletons, Spiders, Creepers, and Endermen to no longer spawn you'll need 5 Mob Filters. You can exchange the Mob in it by simplying clicking a different Mob with it.

atm9.quest.pylons.desc.potionfilter.1.original: In order to put Potion Effects into you'll need to fill a Potion Filter. To do so: have a Potion Effect on you, then right click with the Potion Filter to remove it from you and add it to the Filter, and repeat until it's filled and active. This also works with modded Potion Effects or ones you can't usually get through Potions like Haste or Resistance.

atm9.quest.pylons.desc.pylonsintro.1.original:
Pylons is a wonderful mod made by our very own Mutant Gumdrop!

Don't let the size of the mod make you underestimate it! It provides many Pylons which can be used for many things to help make playing Minecraft easier. 
 
To get started you'll need some Polished Blackstone to make them.

atm9.quest.rs.desc.1024kfluid.original: The 1024k Fluid Storage Part is used to craft the 1024k Fluid Storage Disk.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.1024kfluid.translation: 1024k 流體儲存組件可以用來合成 1024k 流體儲存磁碟。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.1024kstorage.original: The 1024k Storage Disk can store 1024000 items.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.1024kstorage.translation: 1024k 儲存磁碟可以存放 1024000 個物品。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.1048576kfluid.original: The 1048576k Fluid Storage Part is used to craft the 1048576k Fluid Storage Disk.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.1048576kfluid.translation: 1048576k 流體儲存組件可以用來合成 1048576k 流體儲存磁碟。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.16384kfluid.original: The 16384k Fluid Storage Part is used to craft the 16384k Fluid Storage Disk.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.16384kfluid.translation: 16384k 流體儲存組件可以用來合成 16384k 流體儲存磁碟。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.16384kstorage.original: The 16384k Storage Disk can store 16384000 items.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.16384kstorage.translation: 16384k 儲存磁碟可以存放 16384000 個物品。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.16kstorage.original: The 16k Storage Disk can store 16000 items.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.16kstorage.translation: 16k 儲存磁碟可以存放 16000 個物品。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.1kstorage.original: The 1k Storage Disk can store 1000 items.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.1kstorage.translation: 1k 儲存磁碟可以存放 1000 個物品。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.256kfluid.original: The 64k Fluid Storage Part is used to craft the 64k Fluid Storage Disk.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.256kfluid.translation: 256k 流體儲存組件可以用來合成 256k 流體儲存磁碟。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.256kstorage.original: The 256k Storage Disk can store 256000 items.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.256kstorage.translation: 256k 儲存磁碟可以存放 256000 個物品。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.262144kfluid.original: The 262144k Fluid Storage Part is used to craft the 262144k Fluid Storage Disk.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.262144kfluid.translation: 262144k 流體儲存組件可以用來合成 262144k 流體儲存磁碟。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.4096kfluid.original: The 4096k Fluid Storage Part is used to craft the 4096k Fluid Storage Disk.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.4096kfluid.translation: 4096k 流體儲存組件可以用來合成 4096k 流體儲存磁碟。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.4096kstorage.original: The 4096k Storage Disk can store 4096000 items.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.4096kstorage.translation: 4096k 儲存磁碟可以存放 4096000 個物品。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.4kstorage.original: The 4k Storage Disk can store 4000 items.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.4kstorage.translation: 4k 儲存磁碟可以存放 4000 個物品。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.64kfluid.original: The 64k Fluid Storage Part is used to craft the 64k Fluid Storage Disk.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.64kfluid.translation: 64k 流體儲存組件可以用來合成 64k 流體儲存磁碟。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.64kstorage.original: The 64k Storage Disk can store 64000 items.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.64kstorage.translation: 64k 儲存磁碟可以存放 64000 個物品。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.65536kfluid.original: The 65536k Fluid Storage Part is used to craft the 65536k Fluid Storage Disk.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.65536kfluid.translation: 65536k 流體儲存組件可以用來合成 65536k 流體儲存磁碟。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.WCG.original: Allows you to access your grid wirelessly but with a crafting table built-in.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.WCG.translation: 讓你能夠無線存取你的終端機，並內含一個合成台。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.WFG.original: Allows you to access your fluid grid wirelessly.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.WFG.translation: 讓你能夠無線存取你的流體終端機。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.WG.original: Allows you to access your storage wirelessly.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.WG.translation: 讓你能夠無線存取你的終端機。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.advancedE.original: Has 9 more filter slots and is 2x faster than the regular Exporter.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.advancedE.translation: 有多9個過濾欄位和比原本的輸出匯流排快兩倍

atm9.quest.rs.desc.advancedI.original: Has 9 more filter slots and is 2x faster than the regular Importer.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.advancedI.translation: 有多9個過濾欄位和比原本的輸入匯流排快兩倍

atm9.quest.rs.desc.advanced_housing.original: It's like the regular one but ADVANCED.\n\nThese are used to house the larger Disk Drives.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.advanced_housing.translation: 跟普通的一樣但更高級。\n\n這是安裝更大的磁碟驅動器用的。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.autocrafting.original: &9Patterns&r are the bread and butter of autocrafting. These store recipes to let your RS network know how to craft items.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.autocrafting.translation: &9樣板&r是自動合成的核心。這些樣板儲存了配方，讓你的精緻儲存網路知道要如何合成物品。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.cables.original: &9Cables&r are used to connect blocks and items to your system.\n\nIn the beginning, you can get by with placing blocks next to each other to connect them to your system, but Cables allow you to extend out! This is a staple for any Refined Storage Network.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.cables.translation: &9線纜&r能將方塊和物品連接到你的系統。\n\n最一開始，你將方塊放在彼此隔壁就可以連結進系統了，但線纜可以讓你將系統延伸出去！這是任何精緻儲存網路的基礎。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.constructor.original: This interface will place the designated block in the direction it is pointed.\n\nYou can designate the block within the GUI. This is useful for automation!
atm9.quest.rs.desc.constructor.translation: 這種介面會將指定的方塊放置在它朝向的地方。\n\n你可以在界面中指定放置的方塊。這對於自動化非常幫助！

atm9.quest.rs.desc.crafter.original: The &9Crafter&r is how we store patterns for our Network to know how to craft items. Once a recipe is placed into the crafter, you'll be able to 'Request' an item to be crafted from your Grid. You can do this by hitting CTRL+Shift when clicking on the item you have a recipe for to bring up the crafting GUI.\n\nThis block can also be placed facing a machine to use &6Processing Patterns&r. For example, if you point the Crafter at a Furnace, you can put a recipe inside for a recipe you need a furnace for, like smelting raw processors. As long as the crafter is attached to your system and the Furnace has an importer attached to it, the Crafter will allow you to request the smelted version of the Processor!
atm9.quest.rs.desc.crafter.translation: &9合成器&r是一個能夠放入合成樣板來讓我們的系統知道物品的合成方式的機器。當一個合成配方被放入合成器之後，你就能向終端機「請求」合成該物品。你可以在同時按下 Ctrl + Shift 時點擊已放入合成配方的物品來打開合成介面。\n\n也可以面對機器放置此方塊來使用&6處理樣板&r。舉例來說，如果你讓合成器面對熔爐，你可以將熔爐熔煉的配方放入該合成器之中，像是熔煉「未經處理的處理器」。只要你有將合成器連接到你的系統之中，並將輸入匯流排接在熔爐旁邊，合成器就會讓你請求那些「熔煉過的處理器」了。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.crafter_manager.original: The Crafter Manager allows you to easily access all of the crafters in your network, all from one block. Simply right-click on it to open the gui and you can move your patterns in and out of any crafter you wish.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.crafter_manager.translation: 你能夠透過合成管理器來輕鬆地透過單一方塊存取到你的系統中的所有合成器。右鍵點開它的介面就能夠輕鬆地移動你的合成器中的任何模板。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.crafting_grid.original: This lets you access your storage, but with a crafting table!\n\nLet's be honest, no one just uses regular Grids.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.crafting_grid.translation: 它也可以讓你存取你的系統，但多了一個工作台！\n\n說實在的，沒人在用普通的終端機。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.crafting_monitor.original: When attached to your system, the &9Crafting Monitor&r allows you to see what items are currently in your crafting queue.\n\nYou'll need one of these if you want to be able to cancel crafts that aren't working or are bugged.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.crafting_monitor.translation: 當你將&9合成監控器&r與你的系統連接時，你能夠透過它來看到你現在正在合成哪些物品的合成佇列。\n\n你會需要一台來幫助你取消失效或出錯的合成行為。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.destructor.original: This interface will automatically break the block it is attached to.\n\nYou can also set it to whitelist blocks, which is useful for automating certain processes, like making casings in Create.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.destructor.translation: 這種介面會自動破壞它面對的方塊。\n\n你也可以設置它的白名單，這對自動化特定流程會非常有用，比如在動力機械模組中製造機殼。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.destructor_upgrades.original: These upgrades add enchantments to your Destructor.\n\nWondering why you would use this? Imagine having a Builder or Quarry pump Silk-Touched Ores into your system. You can have a Constructor place these ores, then a Destructor with Fortune on it to break it for even more raw ores.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.destructor_upgrades.translation: 這些升級會為你的破壞面板加上附魔。\n\n你問我為什麼要使用它們嗎？假設你的系統中擁有大量的原礦，你可以使用成形面板將它們放置出來，然後使用加裝了幸運升級的破壞面板來破壞它們，以取得更多的礦物。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.diamond.original: An upgraded crafter that holds more patterns and has an increased crafting speed.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.diamond.translation: 一個可以容納更多模板並擁有更快的合成速度的升級版合成器。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.dimension.original: But this one does!\n\nThis allows your RS system to be accessed wirelessly from any dimension.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.dimension.translation: 但跨維度增幅升級可以！\n\n這讓你從任何維度都可以無線存取你的儲存系統。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.disk_manipulator.original: Allows you to take items and fluids from one disk into another grid's disks.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.disk_manipulator.translation: 能夠幫你將一個磁碟的物品或流體轉移至其他的磁碟之中。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.exporter.original:
The &9Exporter&r is used to push items from your system into a block from your Network storage.

This can be used to fill Furnaces with ores or fuel, push materials into designated chests, etc.

You can also filter what items are pushed. Need more filter slots? Upgrade it!
atm9.quest.rs.desc.exporter.translation:
&9輸出匯流排&r會將你的網路儲存中的物品，從你的系統輸出出去。

這可以用來將礦物或燃料填充到熔爐中，或將材料輸出到指定的箱子中等等。

你還可以篩選要輸出的物品。需要更多篩選欄嗎？升級它！

atm9.quest.rs.desc.external.original:
This type of cable interface is probably the most important item one can make in their Refined Storage journey.

This type of cable interface connects an external storage to your Refined Storage Network. It basically lets RS look into the storage container to let you access it within your grid!

This works on many things, including but not limited to: Chests, Barrels, Drawers, Drawer Controllers, and more!

If you can't make drives and have a bunch of chests everywhere, this is your best bet in creating a storage Network!
atm9.quest.rs.desc.external.translation:
這種線纜介面可能是你在精緻儲存旅程中可以製作的最重要的物品。

這種線纜介面將外部的儲存連接到你的精緻儲存網路。它基本上讓RS可以存取儲存容器，讓你能在終端機中訪問它！

你可以用在許多容器上，包括但不限於：儲物箱、木桶、抽屜、抽屜的儲存控制器等等！

如果你製作不了硬碟，而且箱子放的到處都是的話，這是你建立儲存網路的最佳選擇！

atm9.quest.rs.desc.filter.original: The &9Filter&r is an item used in a Grid to specify which items or fluids can be visible.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.filter.translation: &9篩選卡&r是一種在終端機中使用的物品，用於指定它可以顯示哪些物品或流體。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.fluid_grid.original: Plan on storing Liquids? You'll need a &9Fluid Grid&r to be able to see what fluids you have in your Fluid Disks.\n\nPro Tip: If you want to store gases from Mekanism, see if you can turn it into a liquid first using a Rotary Condensentrator.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.fluid_grid.translation: 打算儲存液體嗎？你會需要一個&9流體終端機&r來查看你在流體儲存磁碟中有哪些流體。\n\n專業提示：如果你想儲存通用機械的氣體，看看能否先用回旋式氣液轉換機將其變為流體。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.gold.original: An upgraded crafter that holds more patterns and has an increased crafting speed.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.gold.translation: 一個可以容納更多模板並擁有更快的合成速度的升級版合成器。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.grid.original:
Because of the Controller limit, you'll probably end up wanting to connect different systems to your main hub without a billion cables connecting them.

This is done using &6Network Transmitters&r and &6Receivers&r.

&9Transmitters&r should be connected to your main system, wherever your Controller is.

The &9Receiver&r should go wherever you want your external network to be. For example, this can be a separate part of your base where you have Bees, a mob farm, etc.

To connect the Receiver to your main network, you'll need to use a &eNetwork Card&r. To bind the Network Card, right-click on the Network Receiver, and then place the Network Card into the Network Transmitter that is attached to your main system.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.grid.translation:
由於控制器的限制，你可能會想將其他的系統連接到你的主系統，而不是用數不清的線纜將它們連接在一起。

這可以通過使用&6網路訊號發射器&r和&6網路訊號接收器&r來實現。

&9發射器&r要連接到你的主系統，即控制器所在的位置。

&9接收器&r要放置在你希望網路所在的位置。例如你的基地中的另一部分，像是蜜蜂，怪物農場等。

要將接收器連接到你的主網路，你需要使用&e網路卡&r。拿著網路卡，並右鍵點擊網路接收器以綁定它，再將網路卡放入連接到主系統的網路發射器中。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.housing.original: It's time to create the 'Hard Drives' of Refined Storage. To do this, we'll need a &9Storage Housing&r that we'll combine with a &aStorage Part&r to create a &dStorage Disk&r. Just simply make the desired size of the part, then combine with the housing to create a disk.\n\nThe Storage Disk is used to store your items virtually once placed inside of the Disk Drive. It has to be put in a Disk Drive. The Storage Disk won’t despawn when dropped in the world.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.housing.translation: 是時候來製造一些精緻儲存模組的「硬碟」了。我們需要將&9儲存外殼&r和&a儲存組件&r組合在一起來製造出&d儲存磁碟&r。你只需要製作一個你所需容量的組件，然後拿去和外殼合成來製造出你想要的磁碟。\n\n儲存磁碟能夠用來將你的物品存在磁碟驅動器內部的虛擬空間。它必須要放入磁碟驅動器之中才能運作。當儲存磁碟作為掉落物存在於世界上時不會自然消失。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.importer.original:
The &9Importer&r is used to pull items from a connected block.

For example, you can use these on Furnaces to pull the finished product out into your system.

Make sure to grab some &6Speed&r or &6Stack&r upgrades for them!

You can also filter what items are pulled. Need more filter slots? Upgrade it!
atm9.quest.rs.desc.importer.translation:
&9輸入匯流排&r會將連接的方塊中抽取物品。

例如，你可以在熔爐上使用這些輸入匯流排，將完成的產品拉進你的系統。

記得為它們配備一些&6速度升級&r或&6堆疊升級&r！

你還可以篩選要抽取的物品。需要更多篩選欄嗎？升級它！

atm9.quest.rs.desc.infiniterange.original:
'I need more RANGE!!!'

Well, slap one of these bad boys in your Wireless Transmitter and you'll be able to access your network storage with infinite range.

This, however, does not extend to other dimensions.....
atm9.quest.rs.desc.infiniterange.translation:
「我需要更大的範圍！！！」

嗯...只要將一張無限範圍增幅升級放入你的無線訊號發射器之中，接下來你就可以在任何地方地方存取到你的儲存系統了。

這張升級沒辦法讓你進行跨維度存取...

atm9.quest.rs.desc.iron.original: An upgraded crafter that holds more patterns and has an increased crafting speed.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.iron.translation: 一個可以容納更多模板並擁有更快的合成速度的升級版合成器。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.monitor.original: When connected to your system, this block will display the current number of an item within your network.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.monitor.translation: 當你將儲存監控器連接進系統後，它會顯示一個物品目前在系統內的數量。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.netherite.original: An upgraded crafter that holds more patterns and has an increased crafting speed.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.netherite.translation: 一個可以容納更多模板並擁有更快的合成速度的升級版合成器。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.network.original: Great! We can store items virtually, but how do we see what is on the network?\n\nTo access the system, you'll need to create a &9Grid&r. The Grid is the most basic form of 'Display' for the items in your inventory.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.network.translation: 太棒了！我們現在可以虛擬儲存物品了，但要怎麼查看網路中有什麼呢？\n\n要存取系統內的物品，你需要製造一個&9終端機&r。終端機是顯示你儲存物品的最基礎形態。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.pattern_grid.original:
This grid allows you to imprint recipes onto patterns for your network.

The easiest way to create a recipe for a pattern is to look up the item in JEI, then click the '+' button in the bottom right of the recipe. This will then place the recipe into the grid.

On the right side, the top slot is used for storing blank Patterns. With a blank Pattern inside, you should be able to click the Arrow underneath to imprint the recipe onto the pattern.

You'll then want to put the Pattern into a crafter!
atm9.quest.rs.desc.pattern_grid.translation:
這個終端機讓你能將配方編寫到樣板上，讓你的網路能夠使用。

最簡單編寫配方的方法是先在JEI中查詢物品，然後點擊配方右下角的「+」號按鈕。這會將配方放入終端機中。

在介面右側，上面欄位是用來存放空白樣板的。放入空白樣板後，你可以點擊下方的箭頭將配方編寫到樣板上。

然後你需要把樣板放進合成器中！

atm9.quest.rs.desc.portable_grid.original: The Portable Grid is a portable storage that isn’t connected to a network. It allows you to interact with a Storage Disk while not being connected to a network.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.portable_grid.translation: 攜帶式終端機是一個沒有連接到網路的攜帶式儲存裝置。它讓你在未連接到網路時，能與磁碟互動。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.range.original: To increase the range of your wireless connection to your system, you'll need to craft &9Range Upgrades&r.\n\nThe Wireless Transmitter can only hold 4 total. Here's one on the house.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.range.translation: 如果你想要增加你系統的無線連接範圍，你就需要合成一些&9範圍升級&r。\n\n無線訊號發射器最多可以容納 4 個範圍升級。喔對了，我在這邊找到了一個。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.refined.original:
&9Refined Storage&r is a mass storage mod that offers a network-based storage system.

To get started with the mod, you'll want to make the &6Controller&r.

The Controller is the 'Core' of your storage network. When provided with power, it gives life to all RS components connected. Each network can only have one Controller.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.refined.translation:
&9精緻儲存&r是一個有提供網路化儲存系統的大規模儲存模組。

你需要製作一個&6控制器&r來開始遊玩這個模組。

控制器是你的儲存網路的「核心」。當你給它電力時，它會提供動力給所有連接的RS零件。一個網路只能有一個控制器。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.security.original:
The &9Security Manager&r allows you to grant access and permissions to users within your network.

When placed in your system, you'll need to create a &9Security Card&r for each player you'd like to configure permissions for. When no cards are present, everyone has access to all permissions.

To restrict permissions and access to all unconfigured players, configure a card that isn't bound to a player and put it into the manager. The person who placed the Security Manager will always have access to it.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.security.translation:
&9安全管理器&r可以讓你授予各用戶在網路內的各樣存取及使用權限。

當你將安全管理器放置在系統裡時，你需要為每個你想授予權限的玩家創建一張&9安全卡&r。當沒有安全卡時，任何人都有全部的權限。

若要限制沒有綁定安全卡的玩家的權限和訪問，將一張未綁定玩家的卡放入安全管理器即可。放置安全管理器的人始終可以存取安全管理器。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.speeding.original: The &9Speed Upgrade&r does exactly what it says it does. It will increase the speed at which the interface/block works. Need an importer to pull faster? Want your crafters to work faster? This is the upgrade!\n\nThe &6Stack Upgrade&r increases the speed of transfer by a stack of items rather than just one. Combine with Speed Upgrades!
atm9.quest.rs.desc.speeding.translation: &9速度升級&r人如其名。它會加快介面/方塊的工作速度。需要讓輸入匯流排更快地吸走物品嗎？想要讓你的合成器工作得更快嗎？這就是你需要的升級！\n\n&6堆疊升級&r會將轉移量提高到一整組物品，而不再是一個物品。可以跟速度升級一起用！

atm9.quest.rs.desc.storage_blocks.original:
Don't like storing things in drives?

You can create storage &9Blocks&r instead and just slap the block down somewhere in your system.

Whatever items end up in the block will be stored inside whenever you break it as well.

If you want to un-craft it, you can sneak right click while holding it.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.storage_blocks.translation:
不想要用硬碟來儲存東西嗎？

那你可以製作一些儲存&9方塊&r，然後直接將它們裝在你系統上的任何一個地方。

當你破壞掉儲存方塊時，內部的物品依舊會被存在於方塊之中。

你可以在手持它時潛行 + 右鍵來分解它。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.upgrades.original:
The &9Regulator Upgrade&r allows you to maintain a certain amount of items within a block or machine. A great example of this is telling your network that you want to keep 64 Coal within a Furnace. You'd place the upgrade in the exporter attached to the furnace, and set it to 64. Your system will then try to keep the furnace full of fuel!

But what if you need an item that is crafted? The &9Crafting Upgrade&r does exactly this. If you have the recipe learned inside of a crafter, adding this upgrade to an interface will let it know to craft it if you run out.

Using our example from before, let's say we have a Mystical Ag farm going and have Coal Essence. We can then put the Coal recipe in a crafter connected to our system, then place this upgrade in the same exporter that is keeping the Furnace fueled. If you run out of Coal in your system, the crafting upgrade allows your system to craft some more!
atm9.quest.rs.desc.upgrades.translation:
使用了&9調節升級&r之後，它能夠讓你在一個方塊或機器中讓某物品保持在特定的數量。舉例來說：如果你想要告訴你的網路去讓一個熔爐一直處在擁有 64 個煤炭的狀態。你只要在指向該熔爐的輸出匯流排中放入此升級，並將它的數量設定為 64 。你的系統就會一直讓該熔爐保持滿燃料的狀態了！

但如果你想要一個需合成的物品呢？&9合成升級&r能夠解決你的需求。如果你已經讓合成器學習過該物品的合成配方了，將此升級添加到介面中會讓它能夠在物品耗盡時自動發送合成請求。

再次使用上面的例子，如果我們現在已經有了一個神祕農業的農場，並能夠穩定產出煤炭精華了。我們就可以將煤炭的合成配方放入連接在我們的系統的合成器之中，然後將此升級放到剛剛指向熔爐的那個輸出匯流排之中。如果你的系統中的煤炭用完了，合成升級就會讓你的系統去合成它。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.virtual_storage.original: To store your items, you'll need to create disks that are stored in a &aDisk Drive&r. You can attach this to your network by placing it beside your Controller, or by using pipes.\n\nThese have 8 slots for Storage Drives.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.virtual_storage.translation: 你會需要在&a磁碟驅動器&r裡面放入磁碟才能開始儲存你的物品。你可以將它放在你的控制器旁邊或是透過線纜來將它與你的網路進行連接。\n\n每個磁碟驅動器都可以放入 8 個磁碟。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.wireless.original: If you want to access your Refined Storage network wirelessly, you'll need to start by creating a &9Wireless Transmitter&r.\n\nYou can attach this anywhere on your system. This is needed to use wireless grids.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.wireless.translation: 你會需要製造一個&9無線訊號發射器&r來讓你能夠無線存取你的精緻儲存網路。\n\n你可以將它接在你系統內的任何位置。必須要靠它才能開始使用無線終端機。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.wireless_monitor.original: Allows you to access your Crafting Monitor wirelessly.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.wireless_monitor.translation: 讓你能夠無線存取你的合成監控器。

atm9.quest.rs.desc.wrench.original:
The Wrench is a tool that can do two things:
-> Rotate blocks
-> Break Refined Storage covers.

Simply sneak and right click when using the Wrench.
atm9.quest.rs.desc.wrench.translation:
扳手是一個能夠做到下列兩件事的工具：
1. 旋轉方塊
2. 破壞《精緻儲存》模組中的遮擋板

只需要使用扳手「潛行 + 右鍵點擊」。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.agitator.original: Spawner Agitators are different from the other listed Spawners, this one is used on a Spawner. Without Apotheosis mod being in the Modpack, having an Agitator on a Spawner will make it spawn mobs no matter where the Player is. With Apotheosis, which yes we do have, it won't change that but rather will keep spawned mobs from despawning incase you leave the chunks.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.agitator.translation:
生怪磚啟用器的用法，與其他列舉的生怪磚有所不同，它必須安裝在普通生怪磚上使用。

若模組包沒有安裝《神化》模組，無論玩家在哪裡，安裝啟用器的生怪磚都會持續生成生物。

當模組包中包含《神化》模組時，沒錯你現在正在玩的模組包就有，它不會像上述那樣無視玩家生成生物，但會在你離開生怪磚所在的區塊時，防止其生成的生物消失。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.anvil.original: Some of the items changed with Apotheosis is Enchantments for Anvils and Shears. Shears can now use the normal enchants but now including fortune and new enchants. Shears can get Growth Serum, Chromatic Aberation, and Workers Explotiation. You can discover what they do yourself. The Anvils can now be enchanted with Unbreaking and new enchants as well! Splitting and Obleritation. Both are used on the anvil then use the Enchanted Anvil to drop it on an Enchanted Book.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.anvil.translation: 《神化》模組對一些物品進行了改動，像是鐵砧和剪刀的附魔。剪刀現在可以使用原版的附魔，包括幸運及新增的附魔。剪刀可以附上生長血清、染色、剝削等附魔。你可以自行查找這些附魔的功能。鐵砧現在可以附上耐久及新增的附魔，像是拆分和分裂。這兩個附魔可以附在鐵砧上然後使用附魔過的鐵砧掉落砸在附魔書上

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.apotheosis.original: Apotheosis is quite a big mod so I'm dividing it in 3 quests chapters. The Enchanting and Affixes will be separate. This one is for normal game changes.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.apotheosis.translation: 神化是一個相當大的模組，所以我將其分為三個任務章節。附魔和詞綴將會分開。這個章節是針對原版遊戲的變更。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.apple.original: By using a Golden Apple on a Spawner you suck the souls out the mobs that will be spawned, only leaving a hollow husk of what they used to be. The mobs will lose all AI so they will do basically what an armor stand does. They can't hit you, can't teleport, can't move on their own. They sit there ready to be killed, how exciting!
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.apple.translation: 用金蘋果改造生怪磚，生成的生物會失去靈魂，沒有了 AI 的生物不會動、不會傳送、不會攻擊你，和盔甲座沒兩樣，就傻傻地站在原地任你處置。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.atm.original: To determine when the Spawner will spawn it picks a random number between maximum and minimum spawn delay. The Minimum can be as low as 100 to as high as 32,767. Each Ingot goes up or down by 10.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.atm.translation: 生怪磚在每次生怪前，會從最短生成延遲和最長生成延遲之間選一個數字，作為實際的生成時間。最短生怪延遲的範圍是 100 至 32767，每個 ATM 金屬錠能夠增加或減少 10 最短延遲時間。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.book.original: Capturing is an Enchantment for Swords to make Mobs rarely drop their Eggs. It's a rare one so keep looking for one and check out Apotheosis Enchanting to help. Every level gives you a 0.4%% chance at getting an Egg each kill and the highest level is VII (7).
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.book.translation:
「捕捉」是劍的獨有附魔，使用帶有該附魔的劍沙死生物時，低機率會掉落它們的生怪蛋。

這種附魔相當罕見，查閱《神化附魔》章節來取得幫助。

每級附魔會在你殺死生物時，給予你額外 0.4% 機率取得生怪蛋。

附魔等級最高是 VII（7）。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.cactus.original: You ever get bored of the 'normal' heights for cacti, bamboo, and sugarcane? You ever wish to see skyscrapers of Bamboo? Apotheosis can bring you your croppy Skyscrapers! Now height limits for Cacti, Bamboo, and Sugarcane have been increased! To how much? IDK, how tall is world height limit?
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.cactus.translation: 你是否厭倦了仙人掌、竹子和甘蔗的「原版」高度？你是否希望看到竹子的摩天大樓？《神化》模組可以實現你的這個夢想！現在仙人掌、竹子和甘蔗的高度限制都被提高了！提高到多少？我也不知道，世界高度限制有多高呢？

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.changes.original: Apotheosis adds some small changes to Minecraft, don't worry all are good and helpful!
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.changes.translation: 《神化》模組在原版遊戲中增加了一些小變動，別擔心，這些變動都是有益且有幫助的！

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.charm.original: Charm Fragments can be made either into Charms or Spawn Eggs. They are from Reliquary and rarely drop from their respective mobs. Some can even be crafted! Take 2 and a normal Egg and you can craft a Spawn Egg.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.charm.translation:
護符碎片能用來製作護符或生怪蛋。

這些碎片來自《聖遺物》模組，殺死它們對應的生物時，有低機率掉落。有些護符碎片甚至能直接透過合成取得！

使用 2 個護符碎片和普通的雞蛋，便能合成出對應的生怪蛋。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.conduit.original: The Conduit will do what the Prismarine Shards do but much better. Players no longer need to be near the spawner. As long as its chunk-loaded it will spawn.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.conduit.translation: 海靈核心比海靈晶體還要強，這項改造使生怪磚直接忽略玩家必須在附近的限制，但是生怪磚所在區塊需要被載入才能正常運作。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.dragon.original: The must-need for all Spawners. When it says ignores all conditions, it means most. Ignores light levels, blocks needing for spawning, and biomes. Space conditions are still needed though, like slimes needing 3x3 area to spawn, and same goes with players needing to be nearby.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.dragon.translation: 能夠使生怪磚忽略絕大多數的生成限制，像是亮度、方塊、生態域等條件，但是還是要有足夠的空間，以及玩家必須在生怪磚周圍才能運作。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.egg.original: This one might be new to ones returning from earlier versions. By using a turtle egg on a spawner, it will only spawn in baby versions of the mobs in it. This only works with Vanilla baby versions of mobs, not modded.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.egg.translation: 對於早期版本轉來的人來說，這可能是新的功能。在生怪磚上使用海龜蛋，會使生成的生物只能生成嬰兒版本。這項功能只會作用在原版有嬰兒版的生物上，不會作用到其他模組。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.entity.original: Mob Grinding Utils is all about Mob Farming so of course it has a Spawner! The Entity Spawner! It'll need 3 things to work though: a Spawn Egg, XP Jelly Babies, and a Redstone signal. XP Jelly Babies are made by processing XP through a XP Solidifier with the XP Mould Jelly Baby. They can be eaten or used as Fuel in the second slot. Once you have the Spawn Egg in the top slot, XP Jelly Babies in the Second, and a Redstone signal it'll start spawning the mobs!
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.entity.translation:
《刷怪塔實用設備》的一切，都與生物農場有關，想當然地它也提供生怪途徑 —「實體生成器」！

這台機器必須滿足 3 種條件才能運作：在機器裡放入生怪蛋、經驗軟糖，以及使用紅石訊號啟動。

經驗軟糖能透過經驗固化器，和經驗軟糖模具處理經驗來取得。

經驗軟糖能用來食用，或作為實體生成器的燃料，放入介面中第二個欄位中。

當你將生怪蛋放入生成器的第一個欄位，經驗軟糖放入第二個欄位，並使用紅石訊號啟動，就會開始生成生物！

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.fletcher.original: The Fletching Table has been here since 1.14 and still is only used for a villager job! What about the players job?!?! Instead of making arrows with potion effects in a crafting table you can now use the Fletching Table. It's just cooler and more professional to use the designated table for it.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.fletcher.translation: 製箭台自從 1.14 加入至遊戲到現在唯一的用途是改變村民的職業！那玩家的部分呢？！？！除了利用合成台來製作藥水箭之外，你現在可以使用製箭台來完成這件事了。使用指定的製作站感覺上更酷也更專業。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.ghast.original: Max entities is the amount of mobs that can be spawned by a spawner and kept. If it's only 6 max entities when 6 mobs are already spawned no more will spawned until they're dead or moved. Each Ghast Tear brings it up or down 2 Entities. Max of 16 Entities and Minimum of 1.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.ghast.translation: 實體數量上限指的是生怪磚最多可以生成出的生物數量。如果實體數量上限為 6，且附近已經有生成出來的 6 隻生物了，則在將牠們移走或死亡前不會再生成更多的生物。每個幽靈之淚可以讓上限 +2 或 -2。最大為 16 個實體，最小為 1 個實體。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.lantern.original: Some mobs (mostly monsters) need certain Light Levels to spawn. Hostile ones needing lower levels and passive needing higher ones. Using a Soul Lantern makes it so you never have to worry about Light Levels as it ignores them! This does not ignore other requirements for spawning like livestock animals needing Grass. It's another one that gets ignored by Dragon Egg.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.lantern.translation: 絕大多數的生物需要在特定的亮度條件下生成，用靈魂燈籠改造能夠使生怪磚忽視亮度條件。注意這項改造不會忽視其他生成條件（像是牲畜需要在草地上生成），這需要用龍蛋來改造。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.piglich.original: The Piglich Heart is dropped by... well the Piglich. It can be used to increase the amount of mobs that CAN spawn from a spawner. The Mobs spawned is random with a Maximum amount determined by the Piglich Hearts. It goes up or down by 1 for each heart to a maximum of 8.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.piglich.translation: 顧名思義，豬布靈巫妖之心是從豬布靈巫妖身上獲得的。每個豬布靈巫妖之心能夠調整 1 個每次生成的最大數量，此值範圍為 1 - 8。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.power.original: Powered Spawner is the Mob Spawner made using EnderIO. First, you'll need a filled Soul Vial and a Broken Spawner. (Technically you only need the Soul Vial to change the Spawner but that's whatever). Once you have a Broken Spawner you like, craft the Powered Spawner with it! Then, place it down, give it a Capacitor, and power it. Boom! now you are spawning mobs with EnderIO.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.power.translation:
電動生怪磚是來自《EnderIO》模組的生怪磚。

首先你需要一個裝有生物的靈魂瓶，以及一個損壞的生怪磚。（技術上來講，靈魂瓶只是用來變更生怪磚的生成目標，不過隨便啦~）

一旦你有了一個喜歡的損壞的生怪磚，就拿它來合成電動生怪磚！

將它放在地上，安裝電容器，然後向其供應能量。碰！你現在成功使用《EnderIO》來生成生物了。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.pressurized.original: Another one from PneumaticCraft? Oh this one is the actual Spawner I see. Like the Draconic Stabilized Spawner you'll need a Vanilla Spawner first. Once you have one, place a Spawner Extrator above the Spawner and give it below -0.5 Bars to get it to work. Once it's done it'll give you a Spawner Core filled with whatever mob was in it and it will leave you with an Empty Spawner. Then use the Empty Spawner to craft a Pressurized Spawner and then put the Spawner Core into it. (To upgrade the Core use a Vacuum Trap to suck up the mobs that will go into the Spawner Core). Once you do that the Spawner will now need Pressure to work, ignores Light Level, and is Redstone Activated.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.pressurized.translation:
另一個生怪途徑來自《氣動工程》？哦！這次是個真正的生怪磚。

與《龍族進化》的穩定化生怪磚一樣，你需要先取得一個原版的生怪磚。當你擁有了一個之後，將一個生怪磚抽取器放在生怪磚上方，並將壓力調整至低於 -0.5 Bar 來使其運作。

抽取完成後，你會得到一個生怪磚核心，裡面會裝滿著原本生怪磚中的生物，並留下空生怪磚。

接下來使用空生怪磚合成一個氣動生怪磚，並將生怪磚核心放入其中。（要升級核心，你需要使用真空陷阱，吸取要放入生怪磚核心的生物）。

一切就緒後，生怪磚現在需要壓力才能運作，其運作將會無視環境亮度，且必須使用紅石啟動。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.prismarine.original: Activation Range is how close the Player (You) must be to the Spawner for it to work. The lowest it can be is 1 block away and the highest is 48 blocks away. They go in a circle around the spawner instead of direct blocks. The Condiut and Dragon Egg will ignore these.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.prismarine.translation: 啟動範圍指的是玩家（你）必須離生怪磚多近，它才會運作。啟動範圍可以從最近 1 格方塊到最遠 48 格方塊。這範圍是以生怪磚為圓心的一個球型範圍，而非實際上的方塊長度。放入海靈核心和龍蛋會忽略此條件。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.quartz.original: The Quartz makes whatever the other item does, it does the opposite for the Spawner. With Quartz in your offhand and the other Spawner Modification item in your main it will do the opposite of its role. With Quartz and Blaze Rods instead of increasing Spawn Range it will decrease it. With Quartz and Ghast Tears it'll decrease Max Entities.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.quartz.translation: 將石英放在副手，改造材料放在主手，能夠反轉生怪磚改造的功能。舉例來說，石英 + 烈焰桿會減少生成範圍；石英 + 幽靈之淚會減少實體數量上限。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.redstone.original: Redstone Activation gives your spawner an on/off switch. Without Redstone Power it will not spawn.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.redstone.translation: 此項改造使生怪磚能用紅石控制，在沒有紅石啟動的情況下不會生怪。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.rods.original: The Spawn Range is the area of where mobs can spawn. The bigger the area, the more room for them to spawn in. The smaller the area the cheaper the factory.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.rods.translation: 生成範圍決定了生物可能生成的位置，範圍越大，刷怪塔的空間就要越大。越小的範圍對蓋刷怪塔可能會越有利。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.soulium.original: The Soulium Spawner is the Spawner gifted to us by Mystical Agriculture. It uses Mob Essense and Energy to spawn the mobs. Mob Essense is gotten through harvesting Mob Plants, made by Soul Jars. So you'll have to kill the mobs first.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.soulium.translation:
靈魂生怪磚是《神秘農業》贈與我們的大禮。它透過消耗生物精華與能量來生成生物。

生物精華能透過種植生物作物來取得，至於生物種子則必須使用靈魂罐來製作。

由此得知，我們必須先殺死一些生物。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.spawn.original: Usually you can't get Spawn Eggs, but that's the same with Spawners and here we are! There's a few ways of obtaining Spawn Eggs but once you do, right click it on a Spawner to change the mobs it spawns.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.spawn.translation: 通常你無法取得生怪蛋，但生怪磚也是如此！\n\n這裡提供幾種取得生怪蛋的方法，當你有了之後，拿它對著生怪磚點擊右鍵，改變其生成的生物。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.spawner.original: Another game change Apotheosis brings is to Spawners. Remember being able to mine Spawners with Silk Touch? Well it's back thanks to Apotheosis! There's also many new Modifications you can add to Spawners by right clicking any of these items.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.spawner.translation: 《神化》模組帶來的另一個遊戲變更是關於生怪磚的。還記得以前可以用絲綢之觸挖掘生怪磚嗎？現在它又回來了，這都要感謝《神化》模組！此外，你還可以用這些物品右鍵點擊生怪磚來進行許多新的改造。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.stabilized.original: Stabilized Spawner is Draconic Evolutions version of the Spawner. When you use one of the Cores on a Spawner it will become a Stabilized Spawner. You can swap the Cores but you won't be able to change the stats as now they are set by the Cores. The better the Core the more mobs spawn and at a faster rate.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.stabilized.translation:
穩定化生怪磚是《龍族進化》版本的生怪磚。當你對著普通生怪磚使用任一種核心，它就會變成穩定化生怪磚。

你可以更換生怪磚上使用的核心，但不能調整其生怪數量、頻率等數據，因為這是由套用在生怪磚上的核心所設定的。

使用的核心越好，生怪數量就越多，生怪速度就越快。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.swab.original: Swabs are my favorite way of getting Eggs, you'll need to use Mob Grinding Utils for it. Simply right click a mob with the Swab then craft Chicken Feed with it. Once you have that, feed a Chicken it. Unfortunately the Chicken won't survive the procedure but hey, Spawn Eggs!
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.swab.translation:
棉花棒是我最喜歡的生怪蛋取得方式，你會需要使用到《刷怪塔實用設施》。

拿著棉花棒，簡單地對著生物點擊右鍵沾取 DNA，然後將其製作成雞飼料。正如其名稱一樣，將飼料拿去餵食雞。

很遺憾地，雞在食用飼料後將會喪命，但誰管牠的，現在有我們想要的生怪蛋了！

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.unob.original: The Maximum Spawn Delay is how long it could take to spawn mobs. Just like the Minimum it can be as low as 100 to as high as 32,767. Each Ingot gives 10. The numbers are Minecraft ticks, 20 ticks equals 1 second. So quickest spawn delay would be 5 seconds between each.
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.unob.translation: 最長生成延遲的範圍也是 100 至 32767，每個難得素錠能增加或減少此數值。單位為 tick（1/20 秒），意味著生怪延遲最小為 5 秒。

atm9.quest.spawner.desc.wool.original: Wool only does one thing to the spawner and that's to shut it up. Don't like hearing the stupid Spawner noises? Then use Wool! Any color, thread count, or design!
atm9.quest.spawner.desc.wool.translation: 羊毛能夠使生怪磚生出來的生物變得安靜，任意顏色和圖案的羊毛都可以，生怪磚沒那麼挑食。

atm9.quest.spawner.subt.agitator.original: You're not leaving on my watch!
atm9.quest.spawner.subt.agitator.translation: 別想從我眼皮底下離開!

atm9.quest.spawner.wool.original: Quiet down you'll wake up the mobs!
atm9.quest.spawner.wool.translation: 安靜點，你會吵醒這些生物！

atm9.quest.start1.crook.original: Is that crooked, or are my eyes funny?
atm9.quest.start1.crook.translation: 這是歪了還是我眼睛壞了？

atm9.quest.start1.desc.barrel.original:
The barrel is one of the most important ways to get materials in this pack, second only to the sieve.

These can make clay using water, soul sand using witch water, and even create dirt from saplings and leaves.

Note: These will fill with water when it rains.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.barrel.translation:
木桶是這包取得資源最重要的方式之一，僅次於篩礦。

這能用水製作黏土，用巫水做靈魂砂，甚至用樹苗樹葉做泥土。

注意：下雨時會被雨水灌滿。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.bigsieve.original: Compress 9 of a block into its compressed form, then run it through this sieve.. It's 9x faster after all
atm9.quest.start1.desc.bigsieve.translation: 將 9 個方塊壓縮成 1 個壓縮方塊，然後改用這個來篩... 基本上就是 9 倍速的篩礦。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.bone.original: Throw dust in a sieve to get some bone meal.

atm9.quest.start1.desc.checkjei.original: Again, check JEI on the Witch Water Bucket.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.checkjei.translation: 又一次，在 JEI 查看巫水桶。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.clay.original: Fill a barrel with water and right-click it with Dust to get Clay.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.clay.translation: 對灌水的木桶右鍵使用塵土取得黏土。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.cobble1.original:
If you don't want to be right-clicking the ground for the rest of eternity, make yourself one of these.

You'll need to make lava in your crucible, and you'll need enough iron to make 2 buckets.

Trust me, it's worth it. It auto-generates Cobblestone, and will automatically export to an attached inventory, like an Oak Drawer from Functional Storage.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.cobble1.translation:
若你不想把餘生浪費在對地板右鍵，做一個吧。

你需要在坩堝中製作熔岩，且有足夠的鐵錠做兩個鐵桶。

信我一把，這很值得。它能自動生產鵝卵石，且能自動輸出至連接的容器，像是功能性儲存模組的橡木抽屜。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.compression.original:
In Skyblock you'll be getting a lot of basic items for processing like cobble, sand, and dust.

To save room you can compress them by combining 9 in a crafting table.

If you want to hammer them in bulk you'll need...
atm9.quest.start1.desc.compression.translation:
在空島中，你會獲得許多需要處理的基本物品，像是鵝卵石，沙和塵土。

為了節省空間，你能在工作台中將 9 個物品合成
為 1 個壓縮版的物品。 

若你想要大量捶打這些物品，你會需要...

atm9.quest.start1.desc.crook.original: Crooks will give you a much better chance of getting saplings and apples from leaves, but is also how to get silkworms. You will need these to get string for further progression.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.crook.translation: 曲柄杖讓你從樹葉中，有更高的機率取得樹苗和蘋果，也是取得蠶寶寶的方法。為了發展你需要蠶寶寶才能取得線。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.crucible.original: I mean, it's a skyblock. No matter how many different power generation methods we try to show you in these quests, you will ultimately end up with 20 of these in your base...\n\nThese convert cobblestone and other stone types into lava when a heat source is placed underneath it. You can use a torch to start with, even though it is slow.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.crucible.translation: 我說因為這是空島，無論我們試著在任務中介紹了多少種不同發電方式，你終究會在基地裡放了至少 20 個這東西...\n\n當其正下方放置熱源時，會將鵝卵石或其他種類的石頭轉換成熔岩。初期可以使用火把，雖然很慢。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.dank.original: The Dank is like a mini Shulker Box, and it can automatically store certain types of items in it.\n\nSieving drops lots of annoying Pebbles, but have no fear! You can store over a thousand of them in the first-tier Dank! Right click to open up the dank GUI, place the Pebbles inside it, and click the 'P' at the top to set it to Filtered Pickup. This will now pick up all of the Pebbles and stop them from cluttering your inventory!
atm9.quest.start1.desc.dank.translation:
百寶盒像是個迷你的界伏盒，能自動儲存特定物品。

篩礦會掉落大量煩人的石子，但別怕！第一階的百寶盒就能儲存超過一千個物品！

右鍵開啟它的介面，放入石子，然後點擊上方的
「P 鍵」設定過濾拾取。

現在它就會自動撿起所有的石子，且防止這些石子塞爆你身上的物品欄！

atm9.quest.start1.desc.dirt.original: You can make more Dirt using Gravel and Dirt to make Coarse Dirt, then tilling it with &ba hoe&r to make Farmland. Mine that farmland and get &edouble the Dirt&r you started with (by sacrificing Gravel).
atm9.quest.start1.desc.dirt.translation: 你能用礫石和泥土製作粗泥，然後用&b鋤&r耕它變成泥土。挖下泥土後比起初始材料就能取得&e兩倍的泥土&r（消耗礫石）。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.drawer.original: Place this thing on top of your Cobble Gen and it'll automatically compress everything it recieves, left click to extract!\n\n&lRight click it with an item before trying to pipe into it!
atm9.quest.start1.desc.drawer.translation: 把它放在鵝卵石製造機上，它能自動壓縮所有接收到的物品，左鍵取出！\n\n&l先對它右鍵保存一個物品後，才能開始自動輸入該物品！&r

atm9.quest.start1.desc.drops.original: Sometimes, lower tier meshes drop certain loot more than higher tier meshes! Make sure to check drop rates in JEI.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.drops.translation: 有時，較低階的篩網比起高階的，會有較高特定物品的掉落率！務必在 JEI 中查看物品掉落率。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.emergency.original: Ran out of saplings? You can get some emergency saplings at the top right of the quest menu! It's repeatable too: no need to restart your world if something bad happens!
atm9.quest.start1.desc.emergency.translation: 樹苗用光了？你可以在任務選單右上角取得應急物品樹苗！而且它還是可重複完成的任務：即使發生不好的事情，也不需要重新開始你的世界！

atm9.quest.start1.desc.farm.original: Use Dirt in a Sieve to get Seeds, then spam sneak to grow your crops quickly!
atm9.quest.start1.desc.farm.translation: 篩泥土取得種子，然後蹲下跳舞加速作物成長！

atm9.quest.start1.desc.flintmesh.original: With the Flint Mesh, you'll start getting some actual resources.\n\nIf you are wondering what each mesh drops when sieving, you can always hit 'U' in JEI on the mesh to check out the list.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.flintmesh.translation: 有了燧石篩網，才能取得一些真正有用的資源。\n\n若你想知道各種篩網能篩出什麼東西，隨時在 JEI 中對著篩網按「U 鍵」查看掉落清單。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.food.original: Learn about all things food by checking out the &aFood and Farming&r chapter.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.food.translation: 查看&a農作與食物&r章節，習得更多食物的知識。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.furnace.original: Once you have a Flint Mesh, you will start to get basic materials from sieving, like Iron!\n\nCombine your ore pieces into proper ores, then throw them in your furnace to smelt them!
atm9.quest.start1.desc.furnace.translation: 一旦有了燧石篩網後，你能篩出一些基礎資源，像是鐵！\n\n把礦塊組合成礦，然後丟到熔爐熔煉！

atm9.quest.start1.desc.gen.original: There are plenty of ways to generate your first bits of power.\n\nThe RFTools Coal Generator is one of the easiest.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.gen.translation: 有很多方法能產出你的第一點點電力。\n\nRF 工具模組的煤炭發電機是當中最簡單的。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.gravel.original: Most of the starting journey will be getting materials via sieving. We'll learn more about that in the next quest.\n\nDon't be afraid to make a ton of gravel. Sieving gravel is how you progress!
atm9.quest.start1.desc.gravel.translation: 大部分旅程的開始都是透過篩礦來取得材料。在下一個任務中會學到更多知識。\n\n別怕製作大量的礫石。篩礫石正是你推進度的方式！

atm9.quest.start1.desc.hammer.original: To get resources, we'll need to bust up our cobblestone into something we can sieve.\n\nThis is where the hammer comes in. Place down the block you want to hammer, and... well... hammer it.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.hammer.translation: 為了取得資源，我們需要將鵝卵石分解成可以過篩的東西。\n\n這就是為什麼需要鎚子。把想要搥打的方塊放出來，然後... 嗯... 搥它。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.hammersss.original: A faster way of hammering for Gravel or Sand is by hammering compressed blocks. Normal hammers won't work though, so you'll need a Compressed Hammer!
atm9.quest.start1.desc.hammersss.translation: 捶打壓縮版方塊，是一種快速的方式取得礫石或沙。普通的鎚是無法使用的，因此你需要壓縮鎚！

atm9.quest.start1.desc.headstart.original: For those who want to fast-track the start, this gives you an 'easy-mode' start. You do not have to complete this quest, and it is optional for progression.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.headstart.translation: 對那些想要快速開始的人來說，這裡提供了一個「簡單開始」的方法。你也可以選擇不完成這個任務，對發展而言這是可選的。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.heat.original:
Crucible heat sources are important as they make your lava production faster! This modpack has a few changes to the norm, so I thought I would add a list to show you the options:

Blaze Mesh: 8
Uranium Block: 20
Mekanism Superheating Element: 60
Dark matter block: 100
atm9.quest.start1.desc.heat.translation:
坩堝熱源是很重要的，因為能加速生產熔岩！這包改了一些東西，這邊列舉一些供你選擇：

植物魔法的烈焰網：x8
鈾方塊：x20
通用機械的導熱元件：x60
暗物質方塊：x100

atm9.quest.start1.desc.ironfurnace.original: If you surround a furnace with Iron in a crafting table, you can upgrade your furnace to an Iron Furnace.\n\nThese smelt faster and can also be configured to be automated with the cogwheel in the top left of the GUI.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.ironfurnace.translation: 在工作台中，把熔爐繞一圈鐵錠，就能將熔爐升級為鐵熔爐。\n\n這台燒得更快，且能在介面中左上角的齒輪設定自動化。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.lava.original: Add Cobblestone to a Crucible, heat source underneath, and you get "free" lava!\n\nConnect a Hopper to the Crucible to pump in Cobblestone automatically. A Crucible can hold up to 4 buckets of lava.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.lava.translation: 在坩堝中放入鵝卵石，正下方放熱源，就能取得免費的熔岩！\n\n用漏斗接上坩堝來自動輸入鵝卵石，一個坩堝中能容納最多 4 桶熔岩。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.leaves.original: Get ready to make free water with these!
atm9.quest.start1.desc.leaves.translation: 準備好用這個製作免費的水！

atm9.quest.start1.desc.log.original: Chop down the tree.\n\n&9IMPORTANT&r: Yes, being a modded skyblock pack, you can spam crouch to make anything, including your trees and crops, grow faster.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.log.translation: 把樹砍倒。 \n\n&9重要&r：沒有錯，這是空島模組包，你可以不斷重複蹲下來加速任何東西的生長，包含樹苗和作物。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.ma.original: &aMystical Agriculture&r is an easy way to get a ton of resources and loot, without even needing power! Go check it out.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.ma.translation: &a神秘農業&r是個取得大量資源的簡單方法，甚至不需要電！快去看看吧。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.mesh.original: Sieving is your most common method of gathering resources in this modpack, and countless useful materials can be acquired this way!\n\nYou can also sieve blocks 25 at a time by making 25 Oak Sieves, and placing them in a 5x5 square. Right-clicking the middle Sieve with the item you want to sieve will use 25 instead of 1. Each Sieve in the group needs its own mesh, and all meshes should be the same tier.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.mesh.translation:
篩礦是這個模組包中最常見的資源收集方式，無數有用的材料都可以透過這種方式獲得！ 

你也可以製作 25 個橡木篩網架，以 5x5 放置。

然後對正中間的篩網架右鍵要篩的方塊，就能同時篩 25 個方塊。

每個篩網架都需要篩網，且所有篩網的等級都得相同。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.part2.original: If we want to get started with automation in ATM9:TTS, we'll need to dip our toes further into power.\n\nTo continue our progression, check out the &aGetting Started: Part 2&r to keep moving forward!
atm9.quest.start1.desc.part2.translation:
若想在 ATM9 翱翔天際中真正開始自動化作業，
那我們就必須繼續探索未來的發電方案。

繼續我們發展的旅程，查看&a由此開始：第二部分&r來繼續前進！

atm9.quest.start1.desc.ready.original: You are about to be sieving a lot of blocks. Use Ultimine for fast mining with a hammer and perhaps get an autoclicker ready!\n\nYou can set up multiple sieves like this to sieve up to 25 blocks at once.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.ready.translation: 差不多是時候要篩大量的方塊。用鎚連鎖挖掘來快速搥打大量方塊，或許也需要準備個滑鼠連點器！\n\n你可以像這樣設置多個篩網架，最多能同時篩 25 個方塊。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.shears.original: Shears, no iron required. Use this to collect leaves from your trees.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.shears.translation: 剪刀但是不需要鐵。用這來從樹上蒐集樹葉。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.slime.original: This one has been changed, the recipe is now adding Milk to Water in a barrel.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.slime.translation: 這個配方改變了，現在是對灌水的木桶使用牛奶。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.soulsand.original: Using &bBulk Haunting&r from Create, you can convert Sand to Soul Sand. Use an Encased Fan to blow air through Soul Fire (Flint and Steel on Soul Sand), and it'll convert Sand to Soul Sand on the other side.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.soulsand.translation: 使用動力機械模組的&b批次喚魂&r，就能將沙轉換成靈魂砂。使用鼓風機吹風穿過靈魂火（打火石對靈魂砂點火），在另一側被風吹到的沙會轉換成靈魂砂。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.squeezer.original: Place an ore inside this thing and jump on it to squeeze the ore into 2 raw ore (sometimes). Give it a Redstone signal to reset it after you squeeze.\n\nHint: Place some Armor Stands on top :)
atm9.quest.start1.desc.squeezer.translation:
把礦放入其中，然後在上方跳躍擠壓這個原礦，變成 2 個原礦（有機率）。

給予紅石訊號可以重設擠壓機狀態。

提示：在上方放一些盔甲座 :)

atm9.quest.start1.desc.start.original:
Welcome to All The Mods 9: To the Sky!

If you've played the original (or any skyblock ever), most of what you have to do should be self-explanatory up until the ATM metals.

If not, don't fear! These quests are here to guide you through the start.

Some of the quests in this chapter have in-game video-style Ponder tutorials! They will be given as rewards. Click the reward to watch a Ponder video to teach you all about the item!
atm9.quest.start1.desc.start.translation:
歡迎來到  All The Mods 9 － 翱翔天際！ 

若你曾玩過原版（或任何空島生存），在取得 ATM 金屬前，要做的一推事應該是不言可喻的。 

若沒玩過也別怕！這些任務會引導你開始遊玩。

這章節中有些任務有遊戲內的教學思索動畫！作為任務獎勵的方式呈現。點擊領取獎勵來觀看思索動畫來教你關於這個物品的知識！

atm9.quest.start1.desc.stone.original: Just like other skyblocks, you can get pebbles from shift-right-clicking grass, but here it works a little differently.\n\nYou have a 50%% chance for cobblestone pebbles, and a 50%% chance to get any of the other pebble variants.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.stone.translation:
和其他空島包一樣，你能對泥土或草地，蹲下右鍵來取得石子，但這包的機制略有不同。\n\n有 50%% 的機率取得鵝卵石石子，50%% 的機率
取得其他種類的石子。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.stonebarrel.original: The Stone Barrel can hold Lava, unlike the wooden ones. With this, you can make Blackstone and whatnot.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.stonebarrel.translation: 石桶與木桶不同，能放入熔岩。有了這個，你就可以製作黑石等等之類的東西了。

atm9.quest.start1.desc.string.original: To get string in a skyblock, some might say it is easier than it used to be... you will want to grow a tree, add a silkworm to one of the leaves, and watch the infestation spread across all the leaves! Once done, harvest these with your crook!
atm9.quest.start1.desc.string.translation: 在空島中要取得線，有些人可能會說這比以前更容易... 種下一棵樹，對一個樹葉使用蠶寶寶，然後看著它蔓延到所有葉子上！完成後，用你的曲柄杖收割這些葉子！

atm9.quest.start1.desc.toast.original: Cook some Bread to get Toast... Nearly as good as steak!
atm9.quest.start1.desc.toast.translation: 燒一些麵包來取得吐司...幾乎跟牛排一樣好吃！

atm9.quest.start1.desc.usefulseeds.original: Right clicking Dirt with these seeds will cause it to turn into Grass/Mycelium. This will spread to surrounding Dirt!
atm9.quest.start1.desc.usefulseeds.translation: 拿著這些種子對泥土右鍵，能將它轉換成草地或菌絲土。這能擴散至周圍的泥土上！

atm9.quest.start1.desc.witchwater.original: When placing a barrel on top of mycellium and filling it with water, it produces witch water. This can be used to make soul sand, netherrack, and blackstone.\n\n&lCheck JEI on this bucket&r.
atm9.quest.start1.desc.witchwater.translation: 當木桶放在菌絲土上，並灌水在其中，水會變成巫水。這能用來製作靈魂砂，地獄石和黑石。\n\n&l在 JEI 中查看巫水桶&r。

atm9.quest.start1.shears.translation: 燧石剪刀，比鐵製的便宜！

atm9.quest.start1.subt.compression.original: It just saves space and time!

atm9.quest.start1.subt.hammer.translation: 完全就是過度使用的笑話

atm9.quest.start1.subt.hammersss.original: Compressed hammering is still a thing!

atm9.quest.start1.subt.headstart.original: For Those Who Want To Skip Forward

atm9.quest.start1.subt.ironfurnace.original: Does everything get an upgrade in this pack?
atm9.quest.start1.subt.ironfurnace.translation: 這包每個東西都有升級版嗎？

atm9.quest.start2.atm.translation: 是時候製作 ATM 金屬了！

atm9.quest.start2.automated.translation: 使用通用機械模組自動燒礦

atm9.quest.start2.desc.Ars.original: These saplings are necessary to grow Archwood Trees, the magical wood that Ars Nouveau uses in most of its crafting recipes. You can turn saplings from one into the other using a &6Manipulation Essence&r. Go check out the questline if you haven't yet.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.Ars.translation: 這些樹苗是用來種植至高木樹，至高木是新生魔藝中大部分合成配方的必需品。你能使用&6操縱之精華&r將樹苗在這幾種類型中轉換。若你還沒的話，查看該章節的任務線。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.BlazeGate.original: Spawns a bunch of Blazes. Make sure you have ranged weapons!\n\nNote: Hundreds of Blaze Rods.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.BlazeGate.translation: 生成一堆烈焰使者。確保你有遠程武器！\n\n注意：數百個烈焰桿。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.EnderGate.original: Spawns a bunch of Endermen. Build a roof over your head!\n\nNote: Hundreds of Ender Pearls.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.EnderGate.translation: 生成一堆終界使者。在你頭上蓋個屋頂！\n\n注意：數百個終界珍珠。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.Fisher.original: The Marine Fisher is the best way to get access to the sea... with no sea. Go visit the &bIndustrial Foregoing&r quest chapter to help you make this. It needs a pool that's at least 5 blocks wide to work, and if it somehow doesn't, make it bigger. It needs power to operate.\n\nThis can give you enchanted books, ink sacs, fish, and more, seriously worth it.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.Fisher.translation:
自動釣魚機是在沒有海的情況下，獲取海洋資源的最佳方式。查看&b工業先鋒&r章節，引導你製作它。

它需要至少 5 格寬的池子才能工作，
還是不行的話，蓋更大的池子。需要電力才能運作。

能釣到附魔書，墨囊，魚和更多東西，相當值得。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.Moss.original: 4 Grass Seeds can be used to make moss. Moss is going to be used to begin &dArs Nouveau&r, which is a very powerful magic mod. In our case we will use it to make villagers.\n\nPhytogenic Insolators can be used to duplicate moss, or you can get them in an &aEnergy Condenser&r.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.Moss.translation: 四個草種子能合成苔癬方塊。苔癬方塊是用來發展&d新生魔藝&r的，這是個相當強大的魔法模組。在此我們會使用它來製作村民。\n\n有機灌注器能用來複製苔癬方塊，或是你也能使用&a能量聚集器&r來複製。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.NTemplate.original:
The Possessed Hoglin drops a Netherite Smithing Template. To summon one, you need to do the Abras' Commanding Conjure ritual. First go through the &aOccultism&r questline, and come back when you've done the &aChalking It Up&r quest.

Once you're done, go find the Abras' Commanding Conjure ritual in the Dictionary Of Spirits under the Pentacles tab. Open it in the book and click the little eye at the bottom left of the display window to show a schematic of the ritual. After all of the items are in, kill a pig close to the golden sacrificial bowl to start the ritual.

Hint: Use a mob swab on the possessed hoglin to make a spawn egg.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.NTemplate.translation:
被附身的豬布獸會掉落獄髓升級鍛造模板。要召喚一隻，你需要進行阿巴拉斯強令召喚術。先發展一些&a神祕學&r的任務線，完成&a用粉筆畫地板&r任務時再回來。

完成後，在魔靈全典中五芒星章節中，找到阿巴拉斯強令召喚術。點開它並點擊儀式圖示左下角的小眼睛，能在世界上顯示儀式的擺法。放好各種所需的物品後，靠近黃金獻祭之碗擊殺一隻豬來啟動儀式。

提示：對被附身的豬布獸使用生物棉花棒，製作它的生怪蛋。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.SummoningAltar.original: The Summoning Altar can be used from making stuff as simple as a Cow, all the way up to the &6&lATM Star&r&r\n\nCheck JEI for its uses.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.SummoningAltar.translation: 召喚祭壇能用來召喚簡單的東西像是牛，複雜的像 &6&lATM 之星&r&r。\n\n用 JEI 查看它的用途。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.UniPipe.original: The Universal pipe can carry everything. Energy, fluids, gases, and items!\n\nNote: Lots of pipes get laggy so I recommend using other mods, such as Applied Energistcs 2, to transfer items in the future.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.UniPipe.translation: 通用管道能傳輸各種東西。能量，流體，氣體和物品！\n\n注意：過多的管道會讓你的世界卡頓，因此推薦其他模組，例如應用能源 2，作為未來的傳輸物品的手段。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.angelring.original: The Angel Ring lets you fly as if you were in Creative Mode.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.angelring.translation: 天使戒指能讓你像創造模式般的飛行。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.applied.original: This is definitely the preferred storage system in this pack as it has compatibilities with &aProjectE&r and has &bApplied Flux&r for amazing power storage.\n\nIt is an advanced storage system. It allows for the best automation and autocrafting, but it is harder to learn than Refined Storage.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.applied.translation:
在這包中絕對是首選的儲存系統，因為他能相容&a等價交換&r，並有《&bApplied Flux&r》模組能作為
驚人的電力儲存方式。

一種高級的儲存系統。它能進行最棒的自動化與自動合成，但比起精緻儲存來說，學習相對困難。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.augmentb.original: If you combine this with the Generator Augment, you can smelt Lapis, Iron, Diamonds, and more into energy. This produces A LOT more energy, and can provide a nice boost.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.augmentb.translation: 若將此升級套件與發電機升級套件合併使用，你能使用青金石，鐵，鑽石和更多其他東西來發電。這能產出「遠多於」先前的發電量，並提供不錯的加速。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.augmentf.original: The Factory Augment makes Iron Furnaces use power instead of fuel.\n\n&lThis makes them way better&r.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.augmentf.translation: 工業化升級套件使得鐵熔爐使用電而非燃料運作。\n\n&l這使得它們更好用&r。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.augmentg.original: The Generator Augment turns the Furnace into a power generator, this makes it almost the same as your Coal Generator from earlier, just not as good yet.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.augmentg.translation: 發電機升級套件將熔爐轉換成發電機，這使它幾乎和先前的煤炭發電機相同，只是還沒那麼好用。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.automated.original:
To set up automated ore smelting from Mekanism, place the Enrichment Chamber to the left of your Iron Furnace, and place a Chest on top of both.

In the Enrichment Chamber, use the 'Side Config' settings to output to the right. Make sure to press the 'Auto Eject' button.

To get items into the Enrichment Chamber, you'll need a pipe connecting the chest on top to the machine. This can be done using an Item Pipe from &aPipez&r, or a Basic Logistical Transporter pipe from &9Mekanism&r.

In the Iron Furnace, you'll set it to Input from the left and Output to the top. Make sure to select the auto-input and output buttons.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.automated.translation:
要使用通用機械模組的方法打造自動熔煉系統，將富集倉放在鐵熔爐的左邊，並在兩者的上方放置儲物箱。 

點開富集倉的介面，使用「側面配置」設定物品朝右邊輸出。務必開啟「自動彈射」按鈕。 

要把物品輸入至富集倉，你需要使用管道，將物品從上方的儲物箱連接至富集倉。可以使用 &aPipez&r 的物品管道，或是&9通用機械&r的基礎物流管道。 

在鐵熔爐內，設定從左方輸入且從頂部輸出。記得開啟自動輸入與輸出按鈕。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.biofuel.original: Potatoes are great to be turned into this, check &eMystical Agriculture&r for a good early farm design.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.biofuel.translation: 馬鈴薯是做個東西不錯的原料，查看&e神秘農業&r模組設計一個好用的初期農場。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.blazing.original: The Block of Blazing Crystal has Thermo Gens making 280% more power.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.blazing.translation: 烈焰電晶塊能使熱力發電機生產 280%% 的電力。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.building.original: This chargeable item can place blocks for you.\n\nTo use, make sure you find the 'settings' keybind in your keybind settings, under the Building Gadget category.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.building.translation: 這個需要電的工具能幫你放置方塊。\n\n使用前，記得確認按鍵綁定，在建築小幫手的分類中。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.cables.original: These cables are really cheap for the amount of power they can transfer, really worth making.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.cables.translation: 這些線纜相當划算因為它的傳輸量很不錯，相當值得製作。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.cake.original: Since you're in an endless expanse of void, there is no End Portal for you to search for. All you have to do is taste the (slightly sour) End Cake and be on your merry little way!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.cake.translation: 在虛空世界之中找不到任何的終界傳送門，你只需要嘗上一口（有點酸的）終界蛋糕就能前往終界了！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.chance.original:
The Pulverizer is a basic Thermal Expansion machine used to process 1 raw ore into 1 dust, with a 25%% chance to create another dust. This usually means about 25%% more ingots.

Make sure to connect power to it!

Note: These can also be upgraded.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.chance.translation:
磨粉機是熱力模組的基礎機器，用來將一個原礦處理成一個粉，有 25%% 機率能獲得額外的一個粉。意思就是大概 1.25 倍的產率。

記得要供電！

注意：這台機器也能升級。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.compact.original: This will compact EVERYTHING in a Chest or Backpack. Ore chunks will become ores, and Diamonds and Emeralds and whatnot will be compacted into blocks. Be aware, not all compacting recipes can be easily reversed, such as Nether Quartz and Amethyst!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.compact.translation: 這會打包儲物箱或背包內的所有東西。礦塊會打包成原礦，而鑽石和綠寶石之類的會被打包成方塊。但請注意，並非所有打包配方可以反合成回去，像是地獄石英與紫水晶！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.compactor.original: Compacts all ore chunks into ores. Just like the sieve, this machine auto outputs to the bottom!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.compactor.translation: 將礦塊壓縮成礦。和篩網一樣，這台機器會在底部自動輸出產物！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.connection.original:
First off, there is a better way to transfer power with Mekanism, but if you don't yet have steel here's what you need to know: we'll need a way to transfer our power from our Wind Generator.

Go ahead and make yourself some Energy Pipez and a Pipe Wrench. You'll need the pipe wrench to get the pipe to extract power.

Note: To tell the pipe to 'extract' the power, shift right click on the pipe connected to the Wind Generator.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.connection.translation:
我先說，《通用機械》有更好的傳電管道，但若你還沒有鋼的話，你需要知道的是：我們必須要有個方法將風力發電機產的電傳輸出來。

做個能量管道和管道扳手。你需要管道扳手讓管道輸出能量。

注意：要讓管道「輸出」能量，對連接風力發電機的管道連接處蹲下右鍵。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.covdust.original: Covalence dusts are turned into other resources with the use of &aProjectE&r. These are going to be used soon...
atm9.quest.start2.desc.covdust.translation: 共價粉需使用&a等價交換&r模組來轉換成其他資源。這些很快就會派上用場了...

atm9.quest.start2.desc.crafter.original: This is easier to craft than the Flux Compacter, and it is faster. Set the crafting recipes to automatically make ores, and give the machine some power.\n\n&lClick the little snail icon at the bottom and the crafter will become way faster&r.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.crafter.translation: 比起通量自動壓縮機更簡單使用，且更高速。設定合成配方能自動合成礦，並對這台機器供電。\n\n&l在介面下方點擊小蝸牛的圖示，能使機器運作得更快&r。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.crusher.original: The Crusher can crush organic products, like Potatoes, into Biofuel. Needed for Biofuel power generation (very good).
atm9.quest.start2.desc.crusher.translation: 粉碎機能粉碎有機物（像是馬鈴薯）變成生物燃料。用來作為生物能發電機的發電材料（很不錯的發電）。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.demonseeds.original: Bonemeal some dirt and break grass to get these seeds. These are necessary for &aOccultism&r, which you will have to use in order to get your first Netherite Smithing Template.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.demonseeds.translation: 對草地灑骨粉打草取得這個種子。這是發展&a神祕學&r的必要物品，發展神祕學是你取得第一個獄髓升級鍛造模板的方法。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.edragon.original: Head to the End and kill the Ender Dragon!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.edragon.translation: 直搗終界並擊殺終界龍！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.elytra.original: Somewhere in the End, you'll find a floating ship.\n\nDefeat the enemies there and make your way to the loot room, and you'll find yourself your first Elytra.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.elytra.translation: 在終界的某個地方，你會找到一艘浮空的船。\n\n擊敗裡頭的敵人並進入寶藏室中，你將找到你的第一個鞘翅。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.emerald.original: You can use Emeralds to make tools and armor, just as you would with Diamonds (except these are better).
atm9.quest.start2.desc.emerald.translation: 你能使用綠寶石製作工具和裝備，就像你做鑽石版本的一樣（除了綠寶石版本的更好用）。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.end.original: If you didn't know, there is more to the End than just killing the dragon.\n\nOnce the dragon has been slain, you will find a weird 'structure' with a portal between 3 blocks. Take an Ender Pearl and throw it into the portal.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.end.translation: 若你不知道，終界還有除了屠龍以外能做的事。\n\n當終界龍死亡後，你會發現一個奇怪的「結構」，帶有一格夾在三個方塊內的傳送門。拿顆終界珍珠丟入傳送門。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.energycondenser.original: The Energy Condenser is a very simple converter, which can turn items with an EMC value from one to another, just place it in the top left slot and add in some Covalence Dust.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.energycondenser.translation: 能量聚集器是個簡單的轉換器，使用 EMC 將一個物品轉換成其他的，在左上角的欄位中放入想要的物品，然後放進一些共價粉。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.enrichment.original:
The Enrichment Chamber can enrich ores, like Redstone or Coal, to last longer inside of a Metallurgic Infuser.

If you want easier Steel, enrich some Coal to get Carbon, then use Carbon and an Iron Ingot inside of the Metallurgic Infuser to get Enriched Iron, and then use the Enriched Iron AGAIN with Carbon to get Steel.

Note: Right now, if you put in an ore you can double it by getting dust, but later on this machine can be used to make a serious ore factory.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.enrichment.translation:
富集倉能富集礦物，像是紅石或煤炭，讓它們在冶金灌注機中能維持得更久。

若你想要更容易地取得鋼，富集一些煤炭取得富集碳，然後在冶金灌注機中放入富集碳和鐵製作富集鐵，然後把富集鐵和富集碳再次放入冶金灌注機，即可取得鋼。

 注意：現在，若你放入礦物，你能兩倍化取得粉，但之後這台機器能用來打造真正的礦物處理工廠。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.final.original: With the basics done, it's time to see what we need to do to get the &6&lATM Star&r&r. This won't be easy...
atm9.quest.start2.desc.final.translation: 基礎都打好了之後，是時候看看製作 &6&lATM 之星&r&r需要些什麼了。這不是件容易的事...

atm9.quest.start2.desc.flux.original:
Flux Networks are the most overpowered mod for power transfer. Start by getting Flux Dust by doing the following:

1. Create a 1x compressed Obsidian block by crafting 9 Obsidian together, and place it in the world.

2. Throw a stack of &cRedstone&r onto the compressed Obsidian.

3. Place a piece of regular Obsidian one block above and left click it, crushing the Redstone into Flux Dust. If your island has a piece of Bedrock at its core, you can alternatively use that. Once you have a Flux Block, you can use that instead.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.flux.translation:
通量網路是最 OP 的能量傳輸模組。

首先先取得一些通量粉，做法如下：

1. 將 9 個黑曜石合成在一起，製作出
「黑曜石 1x」，然後放到世界上。

2. 丟一組&c紅石&r在「黑曜石 1x」上。

3. 在上方空一格處放置黑曜石，然後左鍵點它，
這會將紅石壓成通量粉。若你的島嶼核心有基岩的話，你也可以改用它。一旦有了通量方塊後，也能改用它。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.fluxuse.original:
&lPlease read to see how flux Networks work&r.

&bFlux Plugs&r pull power from a system. Place a Flux Plug, open it, click the plus at the top right to create a new network.

&bFlux Points&r send power that Flux Plugs pull. You can have multiple Flux Plugs and Points. To use the Flux Point: place it, right click it, in menu icon (second button on top) select the network of your Flux Plug. If you happen to need more power transfer greater than the (configurable) limit, enable "bypass limit" on &lBOTH&r the Flux Plug and Point.

The &bFlux Controller&r can provide infinite wireless power transfer to the player (so long as the chunk is loaded). Select the third tab in the menu on top, click all of the slots you can, then enable the wireless charging!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.fluxuse.translation:
&l請閱讀這些關於通量網路如何使用的資訊&r。

&b通量網路輸入點&r從一個系統中提取能量。放置一個通量網路輸入點，點開它，點擊上方最右邊加號的圖標，建立一個新網路。

&b通量網路存取點&r將通量網路輸入點處輸入的能量輸出。你可以同時使用多個輸入點與存取點。如何使用通量網路存取點：放下它，右鍵點開，在選單的圖示中（上方第二個）選擇通量網路輸入點的網路。若你想要更大的電力傳輸率，在輸入點和存取點&l兩側&r打開「不限速度」，。

&b通量網路控制器&r能提供玩家無限的無線充電（只要區塊有載入）。選擇上方第三個頁籤，點開能點的所有欄位，然後開啟無線充能！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.furnace.original: The Iron Furnace can be upgraded all the way to Unobtainium.\n\nIt's time for an upgrade!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.furnace.translation: 鐵熔爐能一直升級至難得素版本。\n\n是時候升級了！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.gold.original: Gold and Diamond upgrades stack to 3, hover over the upgrade to see the numbers for each!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.gold.translation: 金和鑽石升級能堆疊三個，滑鼠移到升級上方查看每個堆疊數量時的數值！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.ice.original: You can get Ice by mixing a Snowball and Water in a Barrel. Alternatively, you can use the easiest method, Alchemistry (pump Water into Atomizer for H2O, then use a Compactor), or go through a little bit of &aBotania&r.\n\nIf you chose Snowballs, I suggest the &bEntropy Manipulator&r from &bApplied Energistics 2&r.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.ice.translation:
在橡木桶中可混和雪球和水製作冰。

或者你也可以使用最簡單的方法，煉金化學
（把水灌入原子化機取得 H2O，然後用封壓機
製作冰），

又或是發展一點《&a植物魔法&r》。 

若你要的是雪球，我推薦使用&b應用能源 2&r 的&b熵變機械手臂&r。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.igneous.original: Just before you get auto Sieves, you should know about this! The Igneous Extruder can generate many useful stones for crushing. You must physically place the blocks on the sides/below it, so if you place this between Lava and Water it will make Cobble.\n\nAs always, check JEI to see what you can make with this machine.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.igneous.translation:
在你真的開始自動篩礦前，你應該知道這個！岩石擠壓機能生產許多有用的石頭種類。你必須把方塊物理放置在機器的側面或底部，當你將其放在熔岩和水之間，它會生產鵝卵石。

和往常一樣，到 JEI 查看這台機器還能生產些
什麼東西。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.infinitywand.original: The Infinity Wand is unbreakable and can place over a stack of blocks, very nice for building large platforms.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.infinitywand.translation: 無盡手杖是無法破壞的，且能一次放置超過一組的方塊，蓋大平台的神器。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.infuser.original:
Let's make a Metallurgic Infuser.

This machine allows us to make several materials that can be used for power and more machines in the future.

Put Redstone in the yellow slot and Iron in the blue slot to make Infused Alloy. There will always be a catalyst, like Redstone, and then the actual item being infused. Iron in this case.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.infuser.translation:
來做個冶金灌注機吧。
 
這台機器讓我們能製作許多材料，之後發電或是其他機器會使用到的。
 
黃色欄位中放入紅石，藍色欄位放入鐵錠製作富集合金。這台機器必定需要灌注的材料，像是紅石，才能真正的灌注物品。這邊我們用紅石灌注鐵。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.ironfurnaces.original: The Iron Furnace can be used to generate power, and smelt using power. On top of that, it's just faster in general. Very useful.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.ironfurnaces.translation: 鐵熔爐能用來發電，或是用電來熔煉物品。最重要的是，它比原版熔爐快得多。相當實用。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.jetpack.original: This is the first Jetpack we'll make. It doesn't hold a charge for very long though. Mekanism energy cubes can be used to charge it.\n\nWireless power can be gotten later with Flux Networks or Powah player transmitters.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.jetpack.translation: 這是我們將製作的第一個噴氣背包，即使它沒有太多的電容量能飛太久。通用機械的能量立方能用來幫它充電。\n\n無線傳電之後能使用通量網路或玩家發射器達成。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.laserbase.original: Alright, now you CAN make a Laser Base as was suggested in the &6Allthemodium&r chapter. This will be helpful for getting certain ores, and just those. Place a Laser Base in the middle, and then Laser Drills around it facing the Laser Base (this makes them point down).\n\nYou can put many more Drills than the example below, but you can do this too.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.laserbase.translation: 好的，現在你可以打造一套雷射基座，如同 &6ATM 金屬&r章節中建議的那樣。這對於取得某些礦石相當有幫助，僅此而已。將雷射基座放在中間，然後四周放上雷射鑽（雷射鑽面向基座）。 \n\n你能放置比下圖中更多的雷射鑽，但也可以只放一台。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.laserlens.original: Placing this in the left slot of the &6Ore Laser Base&r will make it mine! At least for the ores that the white laser lens sees. Check JEI to see what ores are found with which lenses.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.laserlens.translation: 放入&6礦物雷射基座&r左側的欄位中就能讓它開始虛空挖礦！至少挖的到白色雷射透鏡看的到的礦。至 JEI 查看白色雷射透鏡能找到些什麼礦。
