atm9.quest.start2.desc.magmator.original: The Thermo Gen starts off better, but as you upgrade this thing, it becomes MUCH better. All this needs is a constant source of lava, and with a Superheating Element, this should be no problem!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.magmator.translation: 熔岩發電機是個好的開始，但你可以升級這個東西，使其更加強大。這只需要源源不絕的熔岩，靠著導熱元件，應該是沒問題！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.mekanism.original: To get started with Mekanism, check out the &aMekanism&r chapter in the &6Technology&r Group.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.mekanism.translation: 要如何開始發展通用機械，查看&6科技模組&r底下的&a通用機械&r章節。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.mobfarm.original: A lot of resources come from mobs in a skyblock world: most importantly, Bone Meal and Ender Pearls.\n\nStart by either making an unlit platform around 30 blocks away from you, or making a standard vanilla mob farm.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.mobfarm.translation:
在空島世界中，有一大部分的資源來自於怪物掉落物，最重要的是骨粉以及終界珍珠。

初期可以在 30 格遠的地方，打造一個黑暗的
大平台，或是弄個原版的生怪場。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.more.original:
Being a skyblock, everybody knows about lava power, it's always going to happen, and some people will even use it till the very end.

Make sure your wire is connected to the red part to extract power.

Tip: You can use an ore hammer from AlltheOres to make your ingots into dusts and get yourself invar blend until you have a machine that can do so.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.more.translation:
對空島而言，每個人都知道熔岩發電，就像是命中注定一樣，總會發生，有些人甚至到大後期還在使用。

務必將電線連接到紅色端才能輸出電力。

提示：你可以使用《AlltheOres》模組的礦鎚把碇變成粉，然後製作不變鋼粉，直到你有能做出不變鋼的機器。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.morepower.original: A single Wind Generator doesn't provide a lot of power, so here are some ways to make even more!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.morepower.translation: 一台風力發電機並不能發出大量的電力，這裡介紹一些能發更多電的方法！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.netherstar.original: Go slay the Wither and obtain your first Nether Star, these are going to be very useful as you progress.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.netherstar.translation: 幹掉凋零取得你的第一顆地獄之星，對進度發展而言是相當有用的。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.netherstarseeds.original: Nether Star Seeds are the easiest way to make an infinite Nether Star farm. Phytos for the win!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.netherstarseeds.translation: 地獄之星種子是最容易取得無限地獄之星的方法。有機灌注機太神啦！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.ore.original:
To set up automated Ore Smelting with Thermal Series, place your Pulverizer directly to the left of your Iron Furnace.

You'll place a chest on both, and then use the cogwheel in the Pulverizer to configure input and output. Turn the top face Blue (input) and the right face Red (Output). Make sure to press the 'Auto Eject' and 'Auto Input' buttons.

In the Iron Furnace, you'll do the same thing, except Input from the left and Output to the top.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.ore.translation:
使用熱力系列打造自動礦物熔煉產線，將磨粉機直接放在鐵熔爐的左邊。

在兩台機器上方放置儲物箱，點開磨粉機中的齒輪圖標設定輸入輸出。將頂部面設為藍色（輸入），右側面設為紅色（輸出）。務必按下「自動輸入」和「自動輸出」按鈕。

在鐵熔爐中，也需要做相同的事，不過是從左方輸入並從頂部輸出。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.orehammer.original: This hammer can be used to turn ores into dusts, at a rate of 1 to 2! You can now double all your ores with this hammer, and even make steel dust.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.orehammer.translation: 這個鎚子能將礦變成粉，一比二！你現在能用這個鎚子將礦物倍化，甚至能做鋼粉。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.passivemobs.original: Cows, sheep, chickens, all need grass to spawn. Either build a dirt platform far away and use grass seeds in the center, or make this gate which will spawn these animals for you!\n\nNote: There's a small explosion when you spawn it.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.passivemobs.translation: 牛，羊，雞等生物都需要草地才會生成。看是要在遠處打造一個泥土平台，然後使用草種子弄一片人工草原，或是做這個傳送門，為你召喚這些動物！\n\n注意：召喚時會有小小的爆炸。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.phyto.original: Given Water, power, and sometimes Fertilizer, this will automatically farm whatever seed you put in there.\n\nCheck &eMystical Agriculture&r for more info.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.phyto.translation: 提供水，電和一些肥料，它會自動種植你放入的任何種子。\n\n查看&e神秘農業&r章節取得更多資訊。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.piglich.original: You can summon one of these in order to get a &ePiglich Heart&r needed for the star. This is extremely expensive though, so don't worry about it now.\n\nOr, if you really want to know now, you'll need a few items: Red Matter, Treasure Core, 3 Unobtainium Ingots, and a Frank'N'Zombie as the Catalyst. You'll need to go mining for Unobtanium, have to use the Summoning Altar for Red Matter, and you'll need to get through EnderIO and ForceCraft for the other items. Once you have it all, place the Red Matter, Treasure Core, 3 Unobtainium Ingots, and lastly the Frank'N'Zombie. Once you do that, the legendary Piglich will be summoned!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.piglich.translation: 你能召喚一隻豬布林巫妖來取得&e豬布林巫妖之心&r，這是 ATM 之星的必需品。召喚成本相當昂貴，所以現在先不急著處理它。\n\n若你現在非得知道不可，你需要幾樣物品：紅物質、寶藏核心、3 個難得素錠，以及作為催化劑的人造殭屍。你需要使用召喚祭壇來獲得難得素錠和紅物質，並透過 EnderIO 和力量工藝來獲得其他物品。一旦你擁有了這些物品，依序放置紅物質、寶藏核心、3 個難得素錠，最後放上人造殭屍。完成後，傳說中的豬布林巫妖將被召喚出來！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.pipe.original: All Pipez pipes can be upgraded with Pipe Upgrades. In addition to speeding up the transfer, higher-level upgrades allow filtering.\n\nTo add the pipe upgrade, shift-right-click on the pipe that is currently set to extract.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.pipe.translation: 所有《Pipez》模組的管道能用管道升級強化。除了提高傳輸率外，高級管道升級能有過濾功能。\n\n要為管道升級，對著已經是輸出模式的管道端，蹲下右鍵管道升級。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.projecte.original: Go visit the &aProjectE&r questline to see how this mod can be used to get tons of resources!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.projecte.translation: 前往&a等價交換&r章節，查看關於這個模組是如何取得大量資源的！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.refined.original: A more simple storage system. Allows for good autocrafting and lots of item storage, but watch out when using disks with no type limits, throw in too many different items and your world won't like it.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.refined.translation: 一個更簡單的儲存系統。能進行不錯的自動合成與大量的物品儲存，但請注意，當使用無類型限制的磁碟，放入太多不同種類的物品時，你的世界不喜歡這樣。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.sieve.original:
Welcome to the custom auto sieve mod! It's slow without upgrades.

These machines have an output inventory: the sieve outputs to the bottom, and the hammers output to the front, both auto output so you can have an entire system built without any pipes

Note: these machines will NOT run without space in the output inventory, and the diagram below uses Pipez as an example for item transfer, it &c&lWILL NOT&r&r work if built like the diagram without the proper filtering.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.sieve.translation:
歡迎來到自訂的自動篩礦模組！沒有升級的話是相當慢的。

這些機器沒有產物的容器，篩網輸出至底部，鎚輸出至前方，兩者都能自動輸出，因此你能不用任何管道打造整個系統。

注意：若輸出面沒有容器，這些機器不會運作，下圖所示為使用管道傳輸的範例，若如圖建置的話，沒有用適當的過濾的話，這&c&l不會&r&r運作。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.speedup.original: Mekanism machines are not really fast, but if you give them some speed cards, they can be up to 10x faster.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.speedup.translation: 通用機械模組機器的運作並不是非常快，但若你安裝一些速度升級，最高能 10 倍快。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.steel.original: Steel is a very important crafting ingredient for lots of machines, get some by making steel dust.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.steel.translation: 鋼是個非常重要的材料，用來製作許多機器，用鋼粉來製作一些。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.steeld.original: An ore hammer, 4 coal, and iron dust. Not a pretty recipe, but you will need this...
atm9.quest.start2.desc.steeld.translation: 一個礦鎚，4 個煤炭和一個鐵粉。\n這不是個漂亮的配方，但你會需要的...

atm9.quest.start2.desc.storage.original:
The Basic Energy Cube acts as a power bank.

You can also put chargeable items on the right slot to charge them up!

That means it's time for flight!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.storage.translation:
基礎能量立方就是個電力銀行。

你也能在右邊欄位處，放入可充電的物品為它充電！

意思就是該飛了吧！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.summon.original: If you're on a server where the Ender Dragon is already killed, you'll need to resummon it.\n\nTake 4 End Crystals and place 1 on each side of the exit portal.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.summon.translation: 若你在伺服器上遊玩且終界龍已被擊殺，你需要重新召喚它。\n\n準備四個終界水晶，並在終界的返回傳送門四邊上各放一個。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.superheat.original: In case you're about to use lava for power, Crucibles make lava 60x faster when you place them on top of this.\n\nYou should probably be piping in Cobble at this point.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.superheat.translation: 以防萬一你打算使用熔岩發電。把坩堝放在這個上面，提供 60 倍快的速度生產熔岩。\n\n此時或許你該使用管道輸入鵝卵石了。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.tank.original: This can store all your lava! well, 32 buckets of it at least.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.tank.translation: 這能儲存你全部的熔岩！好吧，至少 32 桶啦。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.teleport.original: Two waystones can be used to teleport to one another. After you eat the cake, it's gone... but you can always go back if you have a waystone set up.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.teleport.translation: 有兩個方法能往返終界。吃下終界蛋糕後，就沒了... 但若你有傳送石碑，就能隨時回家。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.thermal.original: Thermal Expansion is a simple power mod! Check out the &6Thermal Series&r chapter to get started!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.thermal.translation: 熱力膨脹是個簡單的發電模組！查看&6熱力系列&r章節開始發展！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.thermogen.original: The Thermo Generator just needs a heat source and some Water to produce power. Place it on top of lava and pipe in Water, and ta-dah: free energy.\n\nI recommend checking out the &ePowah&r questline for this.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.thermogen.translation: 熱力發電機只需要熱源和水就能發電。將它放在熔岩上方並灌水進去，就是個免費的能源。\n\n推薦查看&e波瓦科技&r章節。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.tiab.original: Shift-right-click with this item to speed up machines, in fact, speed up anything! Accumulates time as it sits in your inventory, so craft it as soon as possible, and keep it with you!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.tiab.translation: 手持此物品蹲下右鍵即可加速機器，事實上可以加速任何東西！放在物品欄中會累積時間，所以請盡快製作出來並隨身攜帶！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.tier.original: Tier installers can increase the amount of slots that the machine has. You can infuse or enrich much more ores this way.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.tier.translation: 工廠安裝器能增加原本機器的欄位數。藉此你能灌注或富集更多礦。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.totem.original: Some mobs have particles around them, and when you kill them, they drop an &eAbility Totem&r. Right click to open them, then select the ability, then click the left button to add them to your character.\n\nYou can use multiple to level up the potion effect, example: &bSpeed I&r -> &bSpeed II&r. &eSaturation&r can make it so you never have to eat again! To remove them, use an &eAbility Bottle&r.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.totem.translation: 有些生物會圍繞著粒子效果，而當你擊殺後，會掉落一個&e能力圖騰&r。右鍵開啟圖騰，然後選擇能力，然後點擊左箭頭將能力加入你的角色。\n\n你能使用多個升級這些藥水效果，例如：&b速度 I&r -> &b速度 II&r。 &e飽食&r能讓你永遠不用再吃東西！要移除這些效果，使用&e能力罐&r。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.village.original: Place a Source Jar near a Ritual Brazier and use the tablet on it, then right click the Brazier with your hand.\n\nNote: Do this around 20 blocks away from your other structures.
atm9.quest.start2.desc.village.translation: 在儀式火盆旁放個魔源罐，然後右鍵啟動火盆。\n\n注意：遠離你的建築 20 格遠的地方使用。

atm9.quest.start2.desc.wind.original: A Wind Generator is really handy, since all you need to do to get it to work is to just place it down.\n\nPlace it high up in the sky for it to make more power!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.wind.translation: 風力發電機相當不錯，因為只需要把它放出來它就能運作。\n \n放的位置越高能發更多電！

atm9.quest.start2.desc.wireless.original: Hook the Wireless Heat Transmitter block up to your power system. Place the receiver into the transmitter to link them, then place the receiver into your furnace as fuel.\n\nThis will give you wireless power for your furnace!
atm9.quest.start2.desc.wireless.translation: 把無線熱能供應器接上你的電力系統。將接收器放入供應器中連接綁定，然後將接收器作為燃料放到熔爐內。\n\n這能為熔爐提供無線的電力來源！

atm9.quest.start2.ore.original: Automated Ore Smelting with Thermal Expansion
atm9.quest.start2.ore.translation: 使用熱力模組自動燒礦

atm9.quest.start2.subt.chance.original: Throwback to the Macerator from IC2
atm9.quest.start2.subt.chance.translation: 夢迴 IC2 的磨粉機

atm9.quest.start2.subt.filterdest.original: Pipe Upgrades allow for filtering the items wherever you're inputting from, but not where you're outputting to.\n\nUse this tool to select an output, then inside the filter GUI of a pipe upgrade, do the filtering.
atm9.quest.start2.subt.filterdest.translation: 管道升級能讓你過濾輸出端，但無法過濾目的地的輸入端。\n\n使用這個工具來選定輸出目的地的容器，然後在管道升級終設定過濾的介面，設定目的地的過濾。

atm9.quest.start2.subt.storage.translation: 通用機械能做到這一切！

atm9.quest.start2.subt.summon.original: In case someone has already killed it...
atm9.quest.start2.subt.summon.translation: 以防萬一有人已經殺了它...

atm9.quest.start2.usingpower.translation: 是時候使用我們的電了...

atm9.quest.start3.desc.AE2.original: A storage and logistics mod, it's easier to ask what AE2 can't do than what it can. From storage to autocrafting, it's a must!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.AE2.translation: 一個儲存和物流的模組，問 AE2 不能做什麼會比問 AE2 能做什麼來的容易回答。從儲存系統到自動合成，都是它必備的。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.IF.original: Industrial Foregoing is a machine mod. You'll start out making Rubber, but by the end you'll be doing a whole lot more. Be ready to make lots of machines, and don't ignore the ore drills!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.IF.translation: 工業先鋒是個機器模組。剛開始由生產乳膠，到最後你使用到的不僅是乳膠。準備好製作超多機器，但千萬別忘了礦物雷射鑽！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.advanced.original: Advanced Generator mod is for crafting custom nuclear reactors and turbines.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.advanced.translation: 模組化發電機是打造客製化核能反應爐與渦輪發電的模組。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.aeternalis.original: Aeternalis Fuel Block comes from 9 Aeternalis Fuel, which is crafted from 4 Mobius Fuel, which is made of 4 Alchemical Coal, which is created by 4 Coal. 576 Coal to be exact!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.aeternalis.translation: 永恆燃料方塊是由九個永恆燃料組成，永恆燃料是由四個莫比烏斯燃料製成，莫比烏斯燃料是由四個煉金煤炭製成，煉金燃料是由四個煤炭製成。準確地說你需要 576 個煤炭！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.altar.original: We aren't using Create this time, we're using Summoning Rituals. Place down the Altar above a Nether Star Block and gather the items. Place all the items in, have a warden in the sacrifice area (check JEI), and then place the Red Matter in last. Then...
atm9.quest.start3.desc.altar.translation: 這次我們不使用動力機械的方式來製作它，改用召喚祭壇。將召喚祭壇放在地獄之星方塊之上，並準備好所需的物品。將物品放入後，弄一隻伏守者在獻祭的範圍內（查看 JEI ），最後放上紅物質。然後...

atm9.quest.start3.desc.antimatter.original: Basically the reward for beating Mekanism. To get it, first you need Polonium, which is made from the Fission Reactor. Then the Polonium gets turned into gaseous Antimatter in a SPS. Then put that into a Chemical Crystallizer to make Antimatter Pellets.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.antimatter.translation: 基本上，這是通用機械畢業的最終物品。你需要弄一套核分裂系統，將核廢料處理成釙。然後將釙輸入超臨界移相器中轉換成氣體反物質。然後將它輸入化學結晶器中製作成反物質球。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.arm.original: Again no, we are not using Create to actually build the Star this time. We do need the Mechanical Arm to make one of its parts though! It requires getting some Create machines with Deploying to make.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.arm.translation: 再次說明，這次我們不會使用動力機械的機制來製作那顆星。但我們還是需要機械臂當作那顆星的材料！它需要一些動力機械的機器，還有機械手才能製作。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.ars.original: Ars Nouveau is a magic mod based around source. It can be used for things like spellbooks, familiars, and many other items.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.ars.translation: 新生魔藝是個基於「魔源」的魔法模組。能做到許多事情，像是法術書，使魔以及許多其他物品。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.awakened.original: Mystical Agriculture isn't just seeds, it's also what's made from those seeds. Insanium is highest tier of normal essence, and that can be combined with coal to make a block of Insanium Coal. While Awakened Supremium is arguably even higher, it requires an Awakening Ritual (see JEI for info).
atm9.quest.start3.desc.awakened.translation: 神秘農業不只是種子，還有這些種子所製成的東西。究極精華是所有精華中最高階的，和煤炭合成後製作究極精華煤炭方塊。但覺醒精華可以說是更高階的！需要終極精華版的物品進行覺醒儀式。（查看 JEI）

atm9.quest.start3.desc.bank.original: The Vibrant Capacitor Bank is the largest storage from EnderIO for... I don't really know what the amount is. But it requires many more Banks before it or Capacitors.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.bank.translation: 振動電容庫是 EnderIO 中容量最大的電池... 能存多少窩不知道。但它需要許多前一階的電容庫或電容。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.bees.original: Productive Bees is for those who like to farm everything, but also like to see their farms move around and make buzzing noises.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.bees.translation: 生產蜜蜂是為了那些喜歡農作，但同時也喜歡看到農場有東西跑來跑去，並嗡嗡作響的...

atm9.quest.start3.desc.blackhole.original: Made from a LOT of blocks!!!

atm9.quest.start3.desc.blood.original: Blood Magic is a mod based off of... well, blood from creatures slain by you. You use this blood for Life Essence which can be used to make many items.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.blood.translation: 血魔法是個基於...「血」的模組，由你擊殺的生物所流的血。用這些血成為生命精華，用來製作許多物品。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.botania.original: Botania is mod based around Mystical and Magical Flowers. The Flowers can be made to do many things but all either make or use Mana. Their abilities include autosmelting, to block breaking, to even Redstone logic.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.botania.translation: 植物魔法是基於「神秘」和「魔法」花的模組。這些花能用來製作許多事情但都會需要「魔力」。能做到的事從自動熔煉，破壞方塊甚至是紅石邏輯。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.builder.original: Industrial Foregoing has lots of machines, but we want the Wither Builder. Usually used for Ether Gas but instead we're using it to make the Star. It requires a Supreme Machine Frame which funnily enough needs Ether Gas.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.builder.translation: 工業先鋒有許多機器，但我們需要的是凋零生成器。通常用來幫你自動召喚凋零，但在此我們只想要做那顆星。它需要終極機械框架，有趣的是你需要乙醚氣體。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.capacitor.original: The HDPC (High Density Power Capacitor) is the best you can get from Advanced Generators. It's also needed for the Star, but power is cool too!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.capacitor.translation: HDPC （高密度電力電容器）是你能在此模組中拿到最好的一個。它也是那顆星的必要材料，但拿來發電也很酷！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.create.original: Create is a tech mod based around rotational power. The shafts move, the fans move, the contraptions move... heck, even the pumps move something!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.create.translation: 動力機械是個基於「轉動能」的科技模組。傳動軸會動，風扇會動，結構會動...我的天啊甚至連泵都能移動一些東西！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.dark.original: Dark Matter needs to be summoned in with Aeternalis Fuel as Catalyst with Netherite Scrap, Sky Steel Ingot, Enderium Ingot, and Allthemodium Ingot.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.dark.translation: 暗物質是由召喚祭壇召喚來的，需要永恆燃料方塊當催化劑，一個獄髓碎片，隕石鋼錠，終界合金錠和 ATM 金屬錠。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.deorum.original: Deorum is smelted from Deorum Dust, which is crafted from some basic Minecraft materials, Mundabitur Dust, and Arcane Crystal Dust. You'll need 9 for the whole block!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.deorum.translation: 聖金是個能製作的錠，需要一些基礎的麥塊資源，潔淨粉和神秘水晶粉。你需要合成九個錠才能製作一個方塊！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.dragonegg.original: The Inactive Dragon Egg is made from Draconic Chunks, which are made from Draconic Dust, which is in turn made from Draconic Combs. To get Draconic Combs you need Draconic Bees, which come from using Dragon's Breath on an Obsidian Nest in the End.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.dragonegg.translation: 無氣息的龍蛋是由龍質片所製成的，而龍質片是由龍質粉製成，而龍質粉是由龍族蜂蜂巢製成的。要拿到龍族蜂蜂巢你需要養龍族蜂，龍族蜂是在終界對黑曜石巢使用龍之吐息引誘出來的。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.ender.original: EnderIO is a logistics mod based off mobs and alloys. Very helpful for those who know how the spawners work.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.ender.translation: EnderIO 是個基於「生物」和「合金」的物流模組。對於那些知道生怪磚如何工作的人相當實用。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.endergen.original: Not the best, but still a very cool generator!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.endergen.translation: 不是最棒的但仍是相當酷的發電機！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.flight.original: Module would be used in an Environmental Controller to give you creative flight, but we just want the Star today. No flight, only Star!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.flight.translation: 這個模組需要放在環境控制器中，讓你能創造飛行。但我們現在只想要做那顆星。不飛了，只想做星！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.focus.original: Focus of Summoning is made through the Enchanting Apparatus. You will need Wilden Tribute which is dropped from the Wilden Chimera. To learn how to summon and fight him, check quests!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.focus.translation: 召喚之核心是透過附魔裝置製作的。你會需要荒野供物，這是荒野奇美拉的掉落物。查看任務學習如何召喚並擊敗它！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.forbidden.original: Forbidden and Arcanus is different from the other Magic mods, it's used more for tools and gear.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.forbidden.translation: 禁忌與奧秘與其他魔法模組不太一樣，最常用的是製作工具與裝備。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.force.original: ForceCraft is another different magic mod. In fact, some might say it's not even one! This one is mostly used for the items and blocks it gives.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.force.translation: 力量工藝是另一個不一樣的魔法模組。事實上有些人認為甚至不是魔法模組！最常用的是該模組的物品和方塊。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.gaia.original: The Gaia Spirit is a drop of the Gaia Guardian. You'll need to do the ritual with the Gaia pylons to summon and fight him. Check the book and quests to learn more.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.gaia.translation: 蓋亞之魂是蓋亞守護者的掉落物。需要使用蓋亞水晶打造儀式，召喚並擊敗它。查看植物魔法辭典及任務了解更多。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.gale.original: Dark Matter and Feathers make a great ring that lets you fly!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.gale.translation: 暗物質和羽毛做成一個很棒的戒指，讓你能飛！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.galore.original: Generator Galore is like Iron Furnaces but for power!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.galore.translation: 豐富的發電機是個類似鐵熔爐但是用來發電的模組！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.gravitational.original: This would be used with MekaSuit for flight but we want the Star more. It requires Antimatter, Atomic Alloys, a Nether Star, and an Ultimate Induction Provider. The latter would be used with Induction Matrix to hold more Energy than the Sun, but you know what we want instead. It's crafted with previous Induction Providers, Energy Cube, and Control Circuit.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.gravitational.translation: 這能用在 MekaSuit 中讓你能創造飛行，但我們更想要做那顆星。它需要反物質，原子合金，地獄之星和終極疏導供應器。終極疏導供應器能用在疏導矩陣中，讓疏導矩陣能保存比太陽還多的能量。但你知道我們要什麼。這是由前一階的疏導矩陣，與能量立方和控制電路套娃而成。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.heat.original: The Heat Core is a Tier 6 Infusion item. Infusion with ForceCraft involves a few things: Liquid Force, Power, an item to Infuse, and an item to be Infused with. You'll also need what determines the Tier: the Upgrade Tome. The Upgrade Tome gets Force Points from every Infusion and Tiers up from it. So get it to Tier 6 and Infuse that Heat Core!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.heat.translation: 高溫核心是等級 6 的灌注物品。力量工藝模組的灌注需要一些東西：1. 流體力量 2. 電 3. 一個灌注物品以及被灌注的物品。你也需要一本決定灌注等級，稱為升級寶典的書。升級寶典透過灌注物品取得力量點數，藉此升級。因此將它升至等級 6，並灌注出高溫核心！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.hnn.original: Hostile Neural Networks (HNN) is a great mod for farming Mob Drops. You start with making Data Models then upgrading them with mob kills. Then you can put it through a Simulation to get...
atm9.quest.start3.desc.hnn.translation: 敵對生物神經網路（HNN）是農生物掉落物的強大模組。製作生物的資料模型，然後擊殺該生物使其升級。然後丟到戰鬥模擬室取得...

atm9.quest.start3.desc.ingots.original: These Thermal alloys can be made two ways: dust crafting or Induction Smelter. You can get the dust of all the items with a hammer, combine it, then smelt it. Or smelt them all together in Induction Smelter.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.ingots.translation: 這些熱力的合金由兩種方式製成，合成粉或感應精煉爐。你能將所有材料用鎚敲成粉，組合這些粉，然後燒成錠。或直接在感應精煉爐中將材料燒成錠。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.meka.original: Mekanism is another machine mod that is more focused on multiblocks and lots of power. Be ready to build a Fission and Fusion Reactor and more. There's 2 pages of Mekanism quests and you'll probably need to go through both.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.meka.translation: 通用機械是另一個機器模組，但這個更著重於多方塊結構和大量的發電。準備好打造核分裂，核融合以及其他多方塊結構。關於通用機械的任務有兩個章節，且你應該兩章都會需要完成。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.mystical.original: Mystical Agriculture is for those who like to farm... everything.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.mystical.translation: 神秘農業是為了那些喜歡種田的玩家設計的，什麼都種的那種...

atm9.quest.start3.desc.nether.original: Generator Galore adds tons of generators, but only one is best. Of course, it's the Netherstar Generator. You'll need two of them!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.nether.translation: 豐富的發電機模組新增了大量的發電機，而只有一種最好用。當然是地獄之星發電機。你需要兩個！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.nitro.original: Nitro Tier is the highest tier of Powah. It's very expensive to make, especially power-wise. Energizing a Netherstar, 2 Redstone Blocks, and a block of Blazing Crystal with 20M FE will get you Nitro Crystals. The Nitro Battery is one of the biggest handheld sources of energy you can get.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.nitro.translation: 地獄之星是波瓦科技的最高等級。製作成本相當高，特別是相當耗電。一個地獄之星，兩個紅石方塊和一個烈焰電晶塊放入充能室中，然後給它兩千萬 FE 後，就能取得地獄之星電晶。地獄之星電池是你能帶在身上的電池中，容量最大的。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.occult.original: Occultism is all about using Demons for automation. Could be automating mob farming or ore duping; whatever the demons can do, you make them do!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.occult.translation: 神祕學是個關於使喚「惡魔」進行自動化。能用來自動化怪物農場或礦物倍化。惡魔能做什麼，你就使喚它做什麼！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.omega.original: This is basically coal to the power of 4 many many times. You need a Philosopher's Stone, bunches of Coal, many Diamonds, and a will to craft. Red Matter needs to be summoned in, check JEI for the ritual.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.omega.translation: 基本上就是 4 的很多很多次方量的煤炭。你需要賢者之石，一大堆煤炭，一大堆鑽石才能做得出來。而紅物質是由召喚祭壇中召喚的，在 JEI 中查看召喚祭壇。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.player.original: The Player Transmitter, when powered, will power any items on the Player nearby. You'll need the highest tier to make the Star.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.player.translation: 玩家發射器，當供電時，能為附近玩家身上的物品充電。你需最高等級的版本來製作那顆星。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.powah.original: Powah gives you unique ways of generating power at different tiers.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.powah.translation: 波瓦科技提供了獨特的發電的方式，並有不同的等級。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.prediction.original: Predictions are what you get from simulating mob deaths. They can be used in a Loot Fabricator to get the loot of your choice. You'll need a Wither Prediction to make the Wither Compass.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.prediction.translation: 預測產物是由戰鬥模擬室模擬殺怪的產物。能在戰利品製造機中使用，讓你選擇想要的掉落物。你需要凋零怪預測產物來製作凋零羅盤。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.projectE.original: Everything has a price, and with ProjectE, it's EMC. Isn't that a tongue twister!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.projectE.translation: 每個東西都有價格的，在等價交換中我們稱為 EMC。是不是很饒口！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.reliquary.original: Reliquary is based entirely off mob drops. You can use these rare drops to craft common drops, or combine them together to make unique tools and charms.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.reliquary.translation: 聖遺物是完全基於「生物掉落物」的模組。你能使用這些稀有的掉落物合成為普通的掉落物，或將它們組合製作獨特的工具和護符。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.rf.original: RFTools is less of a mod and more like a series. Lots of mods fall under it, from quarries to Xnet. Obviously, quarries aren't super useful in a skyblock, but maybe you can find a use for them anyway!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.rf.translation: RF 工具比較不像單一的模組，而是一個系列。許多模組都包含在其中，從採石場到 Xnet。顯而易見的，採石場在這個世界是無關緊要的，但或許你能找到其他的用途！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.ring.original: The ultimate Ring! You need 5 Red Matter and 4 other specific Rings from ProjectE: Zero Ring (&anot consumed for this craft)&r, Ignition Ring, Harvest Goddess Band, and Swiftwolf's Rending Gale. \n\n&aThis ring is NOT consumed when crafting Philosopher's Fuel&r
atm9.quest.start3.desc.ring.translation: 這是個終極戒指！你需要五個紅物質和四個等價交換中特定的戒指：零度戒指，烈焰戒指，豐收戒指和烈風戒指。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.rune.original: You'll need to craft a few Acceleration Runes. To do that you'll need 4 buckets, 2 gold, a Blood Orb, Demonic Slate, and a Speed Rune.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.rune.translation: 你需要製作一些加速符文。需要四個鐵桶，兩個金錠，一個血寶珠，一個惡魔石板以及一個速度符文。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.seeds.original: You'll need the best seeds for Dimensional Seed. Gaia, Nether Star, Dragon, and Nitro to be exact!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.seeds.translation: 你需要最棒的種子才能製作維度種子。準確的說是蓋亞，地獄之星，龍蛋，和地獄之星電晶種子！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.sentient.original: Sentient Ender is the end goal of the EnderIO farm section. Not farming like wheat, farming like souls.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.sentient.translation: 意識終界諧振器是 EnderIO 農場部分的最終目標。但你要收割的不是小麥，而是靈魂。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.singularity.original: Make an infinitely dense and small item, even smaller and denser?
atm9.quest.start3.desc.singularity.translation: 做一個體積無限小，然後更小，更緊湊的東西？

atm9.quest.start3.desc.soulgem.original: With the Ritual of Craft Soul Gem, you can make a rocketship. No, clearly it's to craft Soul Gems. A few vanilla items and a Book of Binding to Djinni and BOOM, Empty Soul Gem!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.soulgem.translation: 靠著儀式：合成靈魂寶石，你就能製作一艘火箭飛船。才怪，是靈魂寶石。一些原版的物品和巨靈綁定之書，然後看，是靈魂寶石（空）！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.start.original: Sorry bud, you wanna get to the Star? You gotta go through me. Me, as in Chapter 2.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.start.translation: 抱歉了捧油，想要得到那顆星你得先過我這關。就是第二章最後的那個任務。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.storage.original: AE2 is for storage and the 16M MEGA Storage Component (while not being the largest) really shows it. That M stands for Million, 16,000,000 approximately. It can be used for storage, upgraded for even more storage, or to make the Star, your choice. Don't like AE2? Then try getting the 16384k Part then, a similar amount of storage as its AE2 counterpart but from Refined Storage instead!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.storage.translation: AE2 是儲存系統，而 16M MEGA 儲存元件（雖然不是最大的）進一步向我們展示了這一點。那個 M 代表百萬，即大約 16,000,000。你可以將其用於儲存，或拿去升級成更大的儲存元件，又或是拿去做成 ATM 之星，隨你選擇。不喜歡 AE2？那麼試試 16384k 儲存組件，與 AE2 差不多的儲存空間的替代品，但是用於精緻儲存的！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.terminal.original: For our Star to be imbued with creative power, it needs to reach the entire universe. A Universal Terminal and Singularity should help with that! The Terminal can be crafted from other Terminals, but the Singularity is different. Using a Matter Condenser you can condense Storage Components in hopes of it being a Singularity. The Storage Components may need to be full though...
atm9.quest.start3.desc.terminal.translation: 為了讓那顆星取得無盡的宇宙之力，它必須更靠近整個宇宙。通用終端機和奇點應該有幫助！終端機能由其他終端機組合而成，但奇點不一樣。使用物質聚合器並放入儲存元件，然後祈禱他變成奇點。但儲存元件可能需要灌滿東西，所以...

atm9.quest.start3.desc.thermal.original: Thermal Series is another machine mod, but all we care about for the ATM Star is its special alloys. Sorry, Thermal.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.thermal.translation: 熱力系列是另一個機器模組，但對於ATM之星，我們只在意它的合金。抱歉了熱力模組。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.warden.original: To make the Star you need a Warden sacrifice. To get that, you need a Warden. You can get Sculk Shriekers from sieving Endstone, and use a Sculk Core on them to summon the Warden.\n\nNote: The Warden Charm makes it so he can't see you or smell you.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.warden.translation: 製作那顆星你需要獻祭伏守者。因此你需要弄一隻伏守者出來。你可以篩終界石取得伏聆嘯口，然後對它使用伏聆核心來召喚伏守者。\n\n提示：配戴伏守者護符，能使伏守者看不到且聞不到你。

atm9.quest.start3.desc.wireless.original: Xnet is a great logistics mod! But all we need is the Wifi-- I mean, the Router. Craft it!
atm9.quest.start3.desc.wireless.translation: Xnet 是個強大的物流模組！但我們只需要 Wifi，我的意思是路由器。做一個！

atm9.quest.start3.desc.witherless.original: Witherless Rose is an inventory charm that will protect you from the Withering effect. It's made of skeleton, creeper, and slime drops along with a few Nether Stars.
atm9.quest.start3.desc.witherless.translation: 不凋玫瑰是個放在身上物品欄的護符，能保護你免受凋零效果的傷害。由骷髏，苦力怕，史萊姆的掉落物，和一些地獄之星所製成。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.NBT.original:
Looking to create virtual storage using &9Refined Storage&r or &9Applied Energistics 2&r?

These are both great ways to upgrade your storage, but it is important to talk about &eNBT Items&r and the best way to store them.

NBT items are items with extra tags attached to them. Enchanted items, items with durability, Apotheosis gems... these are all items with NBT tags attached to them. Because of this, they don't usually stack.

When you store a lot of these into a storage system like RS or AE2, you run the chance of creating issues for your save or server.

Because of this, it is best to store them in chests or bags!
atm9.quest.storage.desc.NBT.translation:
想要使用&9精緻儲存&r或&9應用能源 2&r的數位儲存方案嗎？

這兩者都是不錯的儲存方案，但告訴你關於 &eNBT 物品&r，以及儲存這些東西的最好方式是更重要的。

NBT 物品是指有額外標籤標記的物品。像是附魔物品，有耐久的物品，神化寶石...，這些都是有額外 NBT 的物品。也因為這樣，它們通常不能堆疊。

當你將大量的這些物品存在 RS 或 AE2 時，你的存檔或伺服器檔案可能會遇到一些問題。

正因如此，最好是將這類物品存在儲物箱或背包裡！

atm9.quest.storage.desc.adv_compacting.original: This item can convert items placed inside to their nugget or block forms.\n\nFor example: An Iron Ingot placed in this will allow you to pull out 9 nuggets, or if more Iron is placed in, will covert it to Iron Blocks.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.adv_compacting.translation: 壓縮抽屜能夠將放入裡面的物品轉換成它的「粒」或「方塊」型態。\n\n舉例來說：如果你放入了一塊鐵錠，你就能從此抽屜取出 9 個鐵粒；如果你再加入更多的鐵錠的話，你也可以從此抽屜取出鐵方塊。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.backpack.original: Sophisticated Backpacks offer upgradable backpacks that can also use filters to add nifty features!
atm9.quest.storage.desc.backpack.translation: 精巧背包提供了可升級的背包，也能使用升級增加一些有趣的特性！

atm9.quest.storage.desc.basic.original: Welcome to the Basic Storage Chapter!\n\nYou'll find all of the basic ways to store items without power, as well as useful items for your storage needs!
atm9.quest.storage.desc.basic.translation: 歡迎來到基本儲存章節！\n\n在這裡會介紹一些不需要耗電的基礎儲存方式，同時也會介紹一些儲存相關的實用物品！

atm9.quest.storage.desc.chest.original: Just like a vanilla chest, but has a slot for a Storage Upgrade!
atm9.quest.storage.desc.chest.translation: 和原版儲物箱一樣的空間，但多一個欄位能放升級！

atm9.quest.storage.desc.collector.original: This upgrade will make the drawer vaccum items in from one of the sides.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.collector.translation: 收集升級可以讓抽屜能夠吸取某一面的物品，就像漏斗那樣。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.configurator.original: The Configuration Tool is used to lock drawers for them to remember the item it has inside.\n\nThis is useful whenever you set up a system to pull and push from drawers. The locked drawer will not replace the item that was locked on it!
atm9.quest.storage.desc.configurator.translation: 設定工具是用來將抽屜上鎖，讓它記住已存入的物品。\n\n無論是由抽屜系統取出或存入物品都相當實用。已上鎖的抽屜不會被其他物品取代存放！

atm9.quest.storage.desc.downgrade.original: This upgrade will downgrade the drawer max space to a stack. This can be usefull for keeping items on stock, but not too many.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.downgrade.translation: 鐵製降級會將抽屜的容納上限降至一組物品。這能夠用來讓某些合成物自動保持一定的庫存量，但也不至於一口氣製作太多。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.drawer.original: Craft yourself a 1x1 drawer. This item holds a ton of stacks of 1 item.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.drawer.translation: 製作你第一個 1x1 的抽屜。這能存放好幾組的單一物品。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.ender.original:
Chests that work across dimensions.

Can be color coded for security! (Right click on the block with the desired dye).

Note: If someone else uses your color combination, they can get the contents!
atm9.quest.storage.desc.ender.translation:
能跨維度存取的儲物箱。

為了安全性能上色碼！（拿染料對它右鍵。）

注意：若同時有人使用相同的色碼，他們也能存取內容物！

atm9.quest.storage.desc.enderdrawer.original:
Using a &aLinking Tool&r, you can link 2 Ender Drawers to sync up the contents.

This works just like an Ender Chest, but for Drawers.

To link, Right click the first Ender Drawer with the &aLinking Tool&r, then left click the second Ender Drawer to sync.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.enderdrawer.translation:
使用&a連結工具&r，你能連結兩個終界抽屜使它們同步內容物。

和終界箱的功能一樣，但這是抽屜。

連結時，先拿著&a連結工具&r對第一個終界抽屜右鍵，然後對第二個終界抽屜左鍵使兩者同步。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.f_controller.original: When placed and connected with the &aLinking Tool&r to other drawers, this block acts as a 'Hub.'\n\nIf you double right-click this, all items within the Storage Drawers 'Network' will be pulled from your inventory.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.f_controller.translation: 當你放下儲存控制器，並利用&a連接工具&r將它連接至其他的抽屜時，它的作用就像是一個「大廳」。\n\n當你對它雙擊右鍵時，你背包中所有與儲存抽屜「網路」相符的物品都會被送進抽屜之中。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.f_upgrades.original: Aside from the storage upgrades, there is also other usefull upgrades.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.f_upgrades.translation: 除了儲存升級之外，這邊還有其他的功能性升級。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.f_void.original: This upgrade will void extra items that come when the drawer is full. This is usefull to prevent overflow or to prevent a setup from backing up due to the storage being full.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.f_void.translation: 虛空升級會在抽屜裝滿時自動將多出來的物品銷毀。這對於用來防止物品溢出，或是讓機器能夠在抽屜滿載時還能夠正常運作來說很有用。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.filter.original: The filter module has many uses, one of which being limiting what items can enter a Modular Storage, be it by you, or by external sources, like hoppers or pipes.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.filter.translation: 儲存過濾模組有許多種用途，其中一種就是用來限制哪些來自於玩家或外部來源（像是漏斗或管道）的物品無法進到模組化儲存器。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.fluid_drawers.original: If you though this mod only stored items, you would be wrong, there are also Fluid Drawers.\nThey work the same way as regular drawers, but store fluids instead.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.fluid_drawers.translation: 如果你覺得本模組只能儲存物品，那你大錯特錯，本模組還有流體抽屜。\n\n它的運作方式與一般的抽屜無異，但它能夠用來儲存流體。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.framed.original: Want to have custom drawers? Look no further, these can mimic a block's texture on the outside, and a different one in the front.\n\nFollow the tooltip on how to do it.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.framed.translation: 想要自定抽屜外觀？別再猶豫了，你可以使用鑲框抽屜以在非存取面使用一種方塊的材質，然後在存取面使用另一種方塊的材質。\n\n請查看工具提示來了解要如何操作它。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.functional.original: Functional Storage is a mod for storing stacks of the same items.\n\nThis is useful for items like Cobblestone, Dirt, etc.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.functional.translation: 功能性儲存是個保存大量相同物品的模組。\n\n用來存放鵝卵石，泥土之類的相當實用。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.iron.original: Note: To upgrade an already placed vanilla chest to an Iron Sophisticated Chest, you will first need to convert the chest with a 'Basic Tier Upgrade.'
atm9.quest.storage.desc.iron.translation: 注意：若要將一個已經放有東西的原版儲物箱，升級成精巧儲存的儲物箱，你必須先對這個箱子使用「基礎升級」。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.link.original:
Used to link Drawers to a controller and to link up Ender Drawers.

To link Drawers to the Controller, right click the Controller block to start configuration. Right clicking Drawers will add them to the network.

Holding the tool will show you what Drawers are connected to the Controller.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.link.translation:
用來將抽屜連結至控制器，或是將終界抽屜連結在一起。

要連接控制器，先拿它對控制器右鍵設定。然後在對想要連結的抽屜，右鍵新增至整個控制器網路。

手持連結工具會顯示那些抽屜已經連結上控制器。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.modular.original:
Modular Storage is the main storage component in RFTools, it stores the items in digital form, and as the name suggests, you can have multiple of them working as one. 

 How much it stores will depend on the Storage Module tier you have. 

 Digital systems are more sensitive to trash and high NBT items. What's that? Look for the "NBT and you" quest in the middle of this chapter.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.modular.translation:
模組化儲存器是《RF 工具》中的主要儲存元件，它能夠以數位方式來儲存物品，顧名思義，你能夠將這些物品當作一個整體來進行處理。

它能夠存入的物品數取決於它的儲存模組的階級。

數位系統對於垃圾和高度 NBT 物品更加的敏感。那是什麼？查看此任務章節中間的「NBT 與你！」任務來了解更多。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.module1.original:
Storage Modules are the disks of Modular Storage, each tier has a different quantity of stacks it can fit inside.

 This one, the first one, has 100 stacks capacity. Keep in mind that that can be either 100 stacks of stone, or 100 pieces or armor/tools, as they dont stack, so be carefull with putting trash in your system.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.module1.translation: 儲存模組是模組化儲存器之中的磁碟，每個階級能夠容納的物品組數都不相同。\n\n這一個，是一階儲存模組：具有 100 組的空間。請注意：這個組數可能是 100 組石頭，或是 100 件不可堆疊的盔甲和工具。所以在將垃圾放進你的儲物系統的時候請小心。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.netherite.original: Even MORE slots for storage and upgrades.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.netherite.translation: 有更多的儲物空間與升級欄位。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.puller.original: This upgrade allows the drawer to pull in items from any side.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.puller.translation: 提取升級可以讓抽屜能夠從任何一個方向的方塊自動輸入物品進到抽屜內。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.pusher.original: This upgrade allows the drawer to push out items into any side.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.pusher.translation: 發送升級可以讓抽屜能夠向任何一個方向的方塊自動輸出物品。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.redstone.original:
This upgrade will make the drawer output a Redstone signal on all sides, signal strenght saying how full/empty it is.
For multi-slot drawers, the upgrade can be configured to which slot to monitor.

0 - means empty
15 - means full.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.redstone.translation:
紅石升級可以讓抽屜的每個面能夠輸出一個紅石訊號，紅石訊號的強度代表了該抽屜有多滿/空。
你可以對多格的抽屜進行設定，以選擇要偵測哪一格物品的容量。

0 - 代表空
15 - 代表滿

atm9.quest.storage.desc.rftools.original: RFTools is a powerful mod with tons of usefull machines/blocks in many different categories. Storage is one of them.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.rftools.translation: 《RF 工具》是一個有著一大堆不同類別的有用機器/方塊的強大模組。而其中一種類別就是儲存。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.s_controller.original:
The Controller allows to work with multiple storages as if they were one big storage multiblock.

This allows for a very large storage network, which can be combined with mods like Applied Energistics, Refined Storage or Integrated Dynamics, as the controller acts as a in/out point for all storages attached to it.

Connecting either can be done by simply putting storages next to controller or next to others that are already connected to controller (works up to 14 blocks away from controller in all directions)
atm9.quest.storage.desc.s_controller.translation:
儲存控制器能夠將多個不同的容器整合成一個大型的多方塊儲物結構。

因為儲存控制器能夠當作連接到的所有容器的輸入/輸出口，這讓它能夠製造一個非常大型的儲存網路，同時也能夠與《應用能源 2》、《精緻儲存》或是《動態聯合》模組中的儲存網路相結合。

只要將容器放在儲存控制器旁邊，或是將容器放在已經連接到控制器的容器旁就能為它們建立連接。這些容器最多只能距離儲存控制器（所有方向上） 14 格方塊遠。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.scanner.original:
The Storage Scanner is a very powerful early-game storage "system", it uses energy to wirelessly read and access inventories in a area up to 20 blocks.

 It allows you to store items through it and craft using the items in all of the inventories as well.


  &oNote and recomendation:&r It doesnt deal well with double-chests(it reads them as 2 different chests, showing 2 times the items), either find the duplicates, and click the star icon in one of them, or just dont have double-chests.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.scanner.translation:
儲存檢測器是前期的一個非常強力的儲存「系統」，將它通電以讓它能夠無線存取 20 格方塊之內的所有儲存容器。

你能夠透過它來儲存物品或是使用所有容器裡面的物品來進行合成。


&o註記及推薦：&r它與雙重儲物箱的相容性很低：它會將雙重儲物箱讀取為兩個不同的儲物箱，然後讓這些物品重複出現兩次。你可以找到其中一個相連的儲物箱，並對它點擊星形圖標，或是完全不要放置雙重儲物箱。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.simple_compactin.original: This drawer will auto convert the item placed inside to its compacted form.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.simple_compactin.translation: 簡易壓縮抽屜會自動將放入裡面的物品壓縮成能夠再分解回來的 2x2 或 3x3 配方。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.sophisticated.original: Sophisticated Chests allows you to upgrade your chests and barrels with metals to increase storage! You can also add upgrade filters to increase the functionality of the chest.\n\nNo more vanilla double-chest rooms!
atm9.quest.storage.desc.sophisticated.translation: 精巧儲物箱讓你能用金屬升級儲物箱和木桶來增加更多儲物空間！你也能放入升級來增加該儲物箱的功能性。\n\n不要再用原版的大箱子了！

atm9.quest.storage.desc.storage_link.original:
Storage link allows you to connect multiple storages that are not attached to controller or any blocks that are connected to it.

So it's a way to wirelessly connect a "multiblock" of storages without needing to right click each one of them.

14 blocks of range still applies.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.storage_link.translation:
與儲存鏈路建立連接之後，你的抽屜管理器就能夠連接上與儲存鏈路相連的所有容器。

所以這是一種能夠一次為多個方塊建立連結的方法，而不需要對每個容器分別點一次右鍵。

這同樣具有 14 格的方塊限制。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.storage_tool.original: The controller is also able to connect to other storages wirelessly, this is possible using the Storage Tool, just right click the controller to bind it, and right click the storages to link them.\n\nThe range for wireless linking is the same as regular, 14 blocks of space.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.storage_tool.translation:
透過儲存工具就能讓儲存控制器與其他的容器建立無線連接。

只要先右鍵點擊儲存控制器來進行綁定，然後右鍵點擊容器就能為它們建立連接。

無線連接的範圍與原本的範圍相同，都是 14 格方塊遠。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.trash.original: A way to destroy unwanted items, liquid, and power.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.trash.translation: 一種銷毀不想要的物品，流體和電力的方式。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.upgrade.original: To save you from having this &oentire quest section&r covered with filter upgrades, take a look at the Sophisticated Backpack upgrades.\n\nYou'll need to make the Sophisticated Storage equivalent, but they function about the same.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.upgrade.translation: 為了避免&o整章任務&r都是升級的東西，相同的升級在精巧背包中也都有。\n\n你只需要做精巧背包的升級就好，但基本上功能是相同的。

atm9.quest.storage.desc.upgrade_base.original: You will need these to make backpack filter upgrades.
atm9.quest.storage.desc.upgrade_base.translation: 你需要這個才能製作其他各種的升級。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.Acompacting.original: Compacts items in the backpack to their 3x3 recipe.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.Acompacting.translation: 將背包內的物品以 3x3 的配方打包。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.Asmelting.translation: 自動熔煉背包內的物品。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.PU.original: Adds the ability to pump liquids from the tank upgrade.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.PU.translation: 為儲罐升級新增泵浦功能。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.battery.original: Adds a battery to the backpack.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.battery.translation: 為背包增加電池的功能。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.blasting.original: Adds a blasting GUI to the backpack.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.blasting.translation: 在背包中增加高爐的介面。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.bpcompacting.original: Compacts items in the backpack to their 2x2 recipe.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.bpcompacting.translation: 將背包內的物品以 2x2 的配方打包。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.crafting.original: Adds a Crafting Table GUI to the backpack.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.crafting.translation: 在背包中增加工作台的介面。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.deposit.original: Allows the backpack to be emptied.

atm9.quest.storage.subt.enderdrawer.translation: 跨維度的抽屜...如果你想要的話。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.feeding.original: Auto-feed with food in the backpack.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.feeding.translation: 用背包內的食物自動餵食玩家。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.filter.original: Adds a filter for items being pumped in or out of the backpack.

atm9.quest.storage.subt.inception.original: I heard you like backpacks in your backpacks.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.inception.translation: 聽你喜歡在背包裡面放背包。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.iron.original: A single chest/barrel the size of 2.

atm9.quest.storage.subt.pickup.original: Allows the backpack to pick up items.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.pickup.translation: 使背包能自動拾取物品。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.refill.original: Keeps the player's inventory stacked up from items in the backpack.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.refill.translation: 為玩家身上永遠保持一組背包內的物品。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.scanner.original: No need to run around to find a item anymore.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.scanner.translation: 不需要再翻箱倒櫃尋找某樣物品了。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.smelting.original: Adds a Smelting Tab to Backpack
atm9.quest.storage.subt.smelting.translation: 在背包中增加鍛造台的介面。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.smoking.original: Adds a smoker GUI to the backpack.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.smoking.translation: 在背包中增加煙燻爐的介面。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.sophisticated.translation: 可升級的儲物箱和木桶！

atm9.quest.storage.subt.stack1.original: Increases stack size in the backpack.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.stack1.translation: 增加背包內物品能堆疊的大小。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.stonecutting.original: Adds a Stonecutting GUI to the backpack.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.stonecutting.translation: 在背包中增加切石機的介面。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.tank.original: Adds a tank to the backpack.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.tank.translation: 為背包增加儲罐的功能。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.tool.original: Auto-Swap to the tool that is most effective for the block you are looking at.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.tool.translation: 依據你看到的方塊自動切換最有效破壞的工具。

atm9.quest.storage.subt.trash.translation: 受夠這些多餘的東西了

atm9.quest.storage.subt.upgrade.translation: 儲物箱和木桶的實用設備

atm9.quest.storage.subt.void.original: Adds a filter for items you want to auto-delete in the backpack.
atm9.quest.storage.subt.void.translation: 在背包增加一個篩選選項過濾你想自動刪除的物品。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.baseUpg.original: This is a base upgrade for all machines and items.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.baseUpg.translation: 這是所有機器和工具的基礎升級。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.baseUpg.original: Note: While you can put several base upgrades into a machine, only the highest tier takes effect.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.baseUpg.translation: 註：當你同時將多個不同的整合元件安裝在同個機器之中時，只有最高等級的那一個會有效果。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.chargeI.original: Can be used to charge items, augment machines, or fill up items with liquid.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.chargeI.translation: 工匠工作台能夠幫機器增強、為物品充能或是將液體裝填進物品之中。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.combine.translation: 流體灌裝機能夠將物品與流體結合。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.convert.original: Can convert certain blocks into liquids.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.convert.translation: 熔岩爐可以將某些方塊轉換成流體。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.convert.original: This is useful for generating lava from Cobblestone, Netherrack, etc.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.convert.translation: 它的其中一個好用途就是用來將鵝卵石或地獄石之類的方塊轉換為熔岩。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.convert.original: Converts items from a liquid to a solid, some requiring casts.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.convert.translation: 急速冷凝機能夠將流體轉換為固體，有些物品會需要使用到鑄模。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.convert.original: There is also a bee spawn egg recipe it can create.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.convert.translation: 它也能夠用來製造出其中一種蜜蜂的生怪蛋。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.convert.original: Can convert liquids into items or other useful liquids.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.convert.translation: 流體精煉機能夠將流體轉換成物品或/和其他更有用的流體。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.createL.original: Can Create \"Liquid\" Potions that can be bottled into Potions.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.createL.translation: 藥水釀造機可以製造出能被裝進玻璃瓶之中的「流體」藥水。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.createP.translation: 多驅衝壓機會使用模具來進行「衝壓」。
用來生產金屬板、齒輪...等。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.earlyGa.original: It's more like a pickaxe that uses RF/FE.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.earlyGa.translation: 它就像是一把需要使用 RF/FE 的鎬。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.enchant.original: Pro Tip: You can enchant these with &9Capacity&r to increase the storage!
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.enchant.translation: 高手小妙招：你能夠幫它附上&9擴容&r來提升它的容量！

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.extract.original: This machine is mostly for extracting dyes from flowers, or ore blends back into their components.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.extract.translation: 離心分離機室大部分是用來從花中提取染料的，或是將礦物分解回它們的原料。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.inducti.original: The Induction Furnace combines materials into new alloys.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.inducti.translation: 感應精煉爐能夠將輸入的材料結合成新的合金。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.inducti.original: This is also useful when smelting Ancient Debris into Netherite Scraps.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.inducti.translation: 你也能用它來從遠古遺骸之中熔煉出更多的獄髓碎片。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.infinit.original: Creates an infinite water source when placed between two water source blocks.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.infinit.translation: 當蓄水器被放置於兩桶水中間時能夠充當無限水源。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.itemCha.original: This machine charges the items placed inside.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.itemCha.translation: 能量灌注機能夠為放入的物品進行充能。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.liquidF.original: Note: This accepts Tree Oil, Creosote Oil, and Refined Fuel.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.liquidF.translation: 註：它所能接受的液體包含了樹油、雜酚油和精煉油。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.machine.original: The Machine Frame is needed to craft various machines in Thermal Series.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.machine.translation: 《熱力系列》模組中的各種機器都需要透過機器框架來合成。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.machine.original: This machine works like a Botany Pot, Garden Cloche, etc.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.machine.translation: 有機灌注器與《植物盆栽》模組中的植物盆栽或是《沉浸工程》模組中的園藝玻璃罩類似。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.machine.original: When given water and a seed, it will grow the seed inside of the machine and auto-output the products into the machine.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.machine.translation: 當你為它提供一些水和一顆種子，它就會使裡面的種子慢慢成熟，並自動將產物放在它的輸出欄之中。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.modIntr.original: Thermal Series is a modular series of mods that adds a content-rich blend of magic and technology to your Minecraft experience!
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.modIntr.translation: 《熱力系列》是將魔法與科技結合，並擁有豐富內容的一系列模塊化的模組！

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.pulveri.original: The Pulverizer breaks raw ores into dusts, and also has a 25% chance to create an extra dust.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.pulveri.translation: 磨粉機能夠將原礦磨製成粉末，並有 25%% 的機率能夠製造出一個額外的粉末。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.redston.original: The Redstone Furnace uses RF/FE instead of Coal to smelt items.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.redston.translation: 通量熔煉爐使用 RF/FE 而非煤炭來熔煉物品。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.redston.original: Like all machines in the Thermal Series, this machine can be upgraded with augments to increase the speed of each process.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.redston.translation: 就像熱力系列中的其他所有機器一樣，此機器能夠使用增強來提升它的處理速度。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.spreadE.original: Spreads Potion Effects to an area.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.spreadE.translation: 藥水霧化器能夠將藥水效果傳播到一個區域之中。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.stonePr.original: This machine can produce several types of stone.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.stonePr.translation: 岩石擠製機能夠產出多種不同的石頭。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.stonePr.original: Place 1 lava source block on one side, and 1 water source block on the other, and it will generate cobblestone. Check the recipes to see the other kinds of stone you can create!
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.stonePr.translation: 將一桶熔岩放在它的其中一邊，再將一桶水放在另外一邊，它就會開始產出鵝卵石。查看合成配方來看看你能夠製造出哪些石頭。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.tier2Up.original: This is a tier 2 upgrade for Thermal Series items and machines.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.tier2Up.translation: 這是所有《熱力系列》模組中的機器和工具的等級 2 升級。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.tier2Up.original: Note: While you can put several base upgrades into a machine, only the highest tier takes effect.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.tier2Up.translation: 註：當你同時將多個不同的整合元件安裝在同個機器之中時，只有最高等級的那一個會有效果。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.tier3Up.original: Note: While you can put several base upgrades into a machine, only the highest tier takes effect.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.tier3Up.translation: 註：當你同時將多個不同的整合元件安裝在同個機器之中時，只有最高等級的那一個會有效果。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.workLik.original: Works like a Coke Oven, but simplified.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.workLik.translation: 熱力裂解爐就像是《沉浸工程》模組中的焦爐的簡化版。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.workLik.original: Insert \"fuel\" like Coal and it'll produce Coal Coke and a by-product.
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.desc.workLik.translation: 放入煤炭之類的「燃料」，然後它就會開始產出焦炭和其他的副產物。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.autoCra.translation: 序列裝配機是一台自動合成器！

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.generat.translation: 透過燃燒物品來產生電力！
使用附魔過的物品來產生電力！
使用流體燃料來產生電力！

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.increas.original: Increases Efficiency at the cost of Speed
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.increas.translation: 將處理耗能降低，但同時也會使處理速度減慢
提升能源爐的燃料產能

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.increas.original: Increases Generation Rate at the Cost of Efficiency
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.increas.translation: 將最大輸出提升，但同時也會使燃料產能降低
增加藥水效果的持續時間

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.increas.original: Increases RF Capacity and Transfer Rate
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.increas.translation: 提升 RF 容量和傳輸效率

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.increas.original: Increases RF Capacity, and slightly increases the RF Transfer
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.increas.translation: 提升 RF 容量，並稍稍提升 RF 傳輸效率。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.increas.original: Increases RF Transfer, and slightly increases the Capacity
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.increas.translation: 提升 RF 傳輸效率，並稍稍提升 RF 容量。

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.increas.original: Increases Processing Speed, but Reduces Efficiency
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.increas.translation: 將處理速度加快，但同時也會使處理耗能增加

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.rfPower.translation: RF 驅動版的《CB Multipart》手鋸！

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.separat.original: Separates Items into their Crafting Components
atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.separat.translation: 將物品分離成它們的合成原料

atm9.quest.thermalExpansion.subt.storeXP.translation: 讓機器能夠儲存經驗值

atm9.quest.tips.desc.build.original: Some useful gadgets for building.\n\n&cDestruction Gadget voids blocks!
atm9.quest.tips.desc.build.translation: 一些對建築實用的小幫手。\n\n&c破壞小幫手會直接清除方塊！&r

atm9.quest.tips.desc.gale.original: The Rending Gale, if you are unfamiliar, is a method of creative flight! It requires small amounts of EMC to run.\n\nFor EMC before a Transmutation Table, we recommend Redstone/Glowstone. A Klein Star is also a good option: it's like an EMC battery that you can fill in a ProjectE Relay!
atm9.quest.tips.desc.gale.translation: 若你不熟悉烈風戒指，它是一種創造飛行的方法！它需要少量的 EMC 來運作。 \n\n至於在取得轉換桌前如何取得 EMC，推薦使用紅石或螢光石；或是這個模組的 EMC 電池，卡萊恩能量之星。你可以在反物質轉繼器中將卡萊恩能量之星使用 EMC 充能！

atm9.quest.tips.desc.gateway.original: Gateways are great ways of getting materials early on. When used they'll spawn waves of enemies and feature penalties or buffs. After all waves are defeated it'll drop rewards! Good way of getting Sheep, Cows, Pigs, and Chickens early on!
atm9.quest.tips.desc.gateway.translation: 在前期能夠用傳送門獲得某些材料。開啟傳送門後會生出幾波帶有強化的生物，全部打敗之後能夠得到獎勵。要得到豬牛羊雞的話可以試試這個。

atm9.quest.tips.desc.hyperbox.original: It's an entire room in one block!\n\nOne size fits all! Not enough space? Make more!
atm9.quest.tips.desc.hyperbox.translation: 整個空間塞在一格方塊內！\n\n更高等級的有更大的內部空間。

atm9.quest.tips.desc.magnet.original: This is a Simple Magnet!\n\nTip: You can set a keybind to toggle this on and off!
atm9.quest.tips.desc.magnet.translation: 就是一個簡便磁鐵！\n\n提示：可以設定按鍵綁定來切換磁鐵開關！

atm9.quest.tips.desc.repair.original:
This thing is extremely cheap, and repairs the tools in your inventory!

If you have inventory space to spare, make several to speed up the repair process.
atm9.quest.tips.desc.repair.translation: 這東西超級便宜，會自動修復你身上的物品！\n\n若你的背包有多餘空間，可以多製作幾個以加速修復過程。

atm9.quest.tips.desc.shrink.original: Ever wanted to be taller? Or shorter? Or make mobs taller or shorter? Then the Personal Shrinking Device is perfect for you!\n\nRight Click to change the device configs for size. Shift Right Click to effect yourself and Left Click mobs to effect them.
atm9.quest.tips.desc.shrink.translation: 想要變高嗎？或是變矮？還是想改變生物的身高嗎？那麼這個個人縮放裝置很適合你！\n\n右鍵改變裝置的尺寸設置，潛行右鍵作用於自己，左鍵作用於生物。

atm9.quest.tips.desc.sink.original: Easy item to automate infinite Water. Need more water? Make another!
atm9.quest.tips.desc.sink.translation: 一個簡單自動化無限水源的物品。需要更多的水嗎？再做一台！

atm9.quest.tips.desc.sleepcharm.original: Are you tired of all those annoying Phantoms forcing you to sleep? If so, the Sleep Charm is for you!\n\nThe Sleep Charm can be equipped to make sure no more Phantoms spawn, without ever needing to sleep.
atm9.quest.tips.desc.sleepcharm.translation: 覺得夜魅讓你沒辦法睡覺很煩嗎？你該試試看戴上睡眠護符！\n\n戴上睡眠護符後能夠阻止夜魅生成，你甚至不用再睡覺了。

atm9.quest.tips.desc.torch.original: Torchmaster brings a bunch of new useful blocks and items. The Mega Torch prevents hostile mobs from spawning in a large area, while the Dreadful Lamp does the same but for friendly mobs. When placed down, the Feral Flare Lantern will randomly spawn light sources around it, and the Frozen Pearl can be used to get rid of those.
atm9.quest.tips.desc.torch.translation: 火把大師有一些很有用的東西能用。超級火把能大範圍阻止敵對生物生成，顫慄燈能阻止被動生物生成，野焰燈籠能在周圍放置光源，凍寒珍珠能夠移除光源。

atm9.quest.tips.desc.tricks.original: On this page, you'll find some useful items and info to help you on your journey!
atm9.quest.tips.desc.tricks.translation: 本章中，你能找到一些實用的物品和資訊，在遊玩的旅途中幫助你！

atm9.quest.tips.desc.wand.original: The mod &9Construction Wand&r adds helpful wands that are used when building.\n\nWhen right-clicking a face of a block with the wand, it will extend that face out as long as you have the blocks in your inventory.
atm9.quest.tips.desc.wand.translation: &9建築手杖&r模組新增了一些在建築很有用的手杖。\n\n手持手杖對著方塊右鍵，只要身上有足夠的相同方塊，就能在該面上向外延伸放置方塊。

atm9.quest.tips.subt.hyperbox.original: When an infinite world is too small
atm9.quest.tips.subt.hyperbox.translation: 當一個無限的世界太小了

atm9.quest.tips.subt.shrink.translation: 親愛的，我把自己縮小了

atm9.quest.tips.subt.sink.original: Can be used as Reactor Coolant
atm9.quest.tips.subt.sink.translation: 能作為反應爐的冷卻劑

atm9.quest.welcome.desc.translations.original:
Our Quests have been translated by the following volunteer translators.

atm9.quest.welcome.desc.welcome.original:
Welcome to ATM9... Now With less flooring!

 To get started with questing, check out the tabs on the left to jump in!

 If you are new to AllTheMods, make sure to check out the &eAllthemodium&r Chapter!

 If you are new to Skyblock packs or modded MC, check out the &6Main Questline&r to help you get started.

 Note: Mods are not gated by quests. Quests are optional.
atm9.quest.welcome.desc.welcome.translation:
歡迎來到 ATM9... 翱翔天際！

旅程開始前，查看左側各個任務章節開始遊玩！

若你是 ATM 系列模組包的新手玩家，務必查看 &aATM 金屬&r章節！

若你是空島類型模組包或麥塊模組的新手，請查看&6主線任務&r了解如何開始。

注意：所有的模組發展不受任務限制。任務也是選擇性遊玩的，不是非得全部解完的唷！

atm9.quest.welcome.welcome.original: Welcome to All The Mods 9, now in the sky!
atm9.quest.welcome.welcome.translation: 歡迎來到 ATM9 翱翔天際！

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.balloon.original: Balloon-On-A-Stick is an early and restrictive source of Creative Flight. Place down the stick and you'll be attached to a balloon! Double touch space to start Flying just not too far. Go too far and you'll get detached, then you'll fall.
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.balloon.translation: 棍子上的氣球是個遊戲初期一個有限制的創造飛行方法。將它放出來，你就會被氣球綁住！雙擊空白鍵就能開始飛行，只是距離不遠。離太遠的話線會斷掉，然後你就會摔下來。

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.box.original: The Soaryn Box (Soaryn is the name of the Creator of XyCraft) is the chest of XyCraft. It will not hold items off breaking the block! I wonder what those Squares on it does...
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.box.translation: Soaryn 之箱（Soaryn 是 Xy 工藝的作者名）是 Xy 工藝模組的儲物箱。破壞時並不會保留內容物，而會噴出！我也想知道上面的正方形框框是幹啥用的...

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.collector.original: The Collector works as a very cheap Absorption Hopper. It will pick up all items within a 3 block radius and put it in the inventory below or it's own. It can be turned off with Redstone!
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.collector.translation: 收集器就是個非常便宜的吸收漏斗。它會自動撿起半徑三格內的所有物品，放入下方的容器或保存於自身中。能用紅石關閉！

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.container.original: The Void Container makes any inventory a Trash Can. Put it on top of the inventory and BOOM, no more items!
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.container.translation: 虛空容器能讓任何容器都變成垃圾桶。將它放在容器的正上方，然後看哪！東西都不見了呢！

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.dust.original:
&lWelcome to XyCraft!&r

This series of mods is mostly dedicated to XyCraft: World and Machines!
World gives us the Gems which can be obtained from sieving Dust.
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.dust.translation:
&l歡迎來到 Xy 工藝！&r

這章主要會針對 Xy 工藝：世界與機器這兩個模組作介紹！
世界這模組主要加入了寶石，能透過篩塵土來取得。

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.extrator.original: Extrator works like the Ingeous Extruder but for more! It will 'grow' the block or item beneath it and move it to an inventory above it. This can be used like for a cobble gen, any other stone gen, amethyst gen, or even Dragon Egg gen!
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.extrator.translation: 提取器的作用和岩石擠製機類似，但能做到更多事！它能從下方的方塊或物品中，「長」出東西，並將它移至上方的容器中。能用於生產鵝卵石，或其他種類的石頭，紫水晶，甚至是龍蛋！

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.fabricator.original: Fabricator is the Auto-Crafter. It will take items from the inventory below and make a set recipe. You can lock recipes with CTRL Click. It will need to pipe out the created items though.
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.fabricator.translation: 裝配機就是個自動合成器。他能自動從下方的容器中取出物品，並合成指定的配方。編寫好配方後，可在在介面中 Ctrl 左鍵點擊鎖定配方。但合成好的物品需要靠管道輸出就是了。

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.field.original: Light Field doesn't actually show much light... but it does work like a Mega Torch. Mobs won't spawn in a set area of it. How big is that area? Around 32 block radius from it (Estimated, not exact).
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.field.translation: 光場本身雖然不發光... 但它的功能類似超級火把。生物不會在它的指定區域內生成。有多大範圍呢？大概以它為中心半徑 32 格。（大概大概。）

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.fire.original: The Ignition Plate spawns fire infront of it when given a Redstone Signal. It will put out the fire when the Signal is stopped.
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.fire.translation: 點火板，當給予紅石訊號時，能在它面對的方向點火。當訊號停止石會將火熄滅。

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.fluid.original: XyCraft gives us a great Fluid Tank mulitblock!
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.fluid.translation: Xy 工藝提供了一種很棒的多方塊結構的流體儲罐！

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.growth.original: The Accelerated Planter works similar to normal Farmland but with some changes. It's automatIically watered and it's faster than normal Farmland. How much faster? Idk!
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.growth.translation: 加速種植器和普通的耕地類似，但略有不同。它會自動變濕且作物生長比普通的耕地更快。快多少呢？窩不知道！

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.igneous.original: The Igneous Extruder is a Thermal Machine but is the only way of getting Kivi without having Kivi. Place the Ingeous Extruder down, put Obsidian below it, and Water and Lava on its sides. It will start spawning items into its inventory, it doesn't need power.
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.igneous.translation: 岩石擠製機是熱力模組的機器，但是在取得第一個奇石前，唯一取得奇石的方法。將岩石擠製機放出來，下方放黑曜石，然後兩側分別放水和熔岩。擠製機內就能開始生產奇石，且不需要電。

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.io.original: Item IOs (IO stands for Input Output) give us the ability to transport items in and out of the Tank. Like buckets to be filled with Water. They can be toggled for Output and Input.
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.io.translation: 物品 IO（IO 的意思是輸入和輸出）使我們能透過它，將物品傳輸至多方塊儲罐中。像是放入鐵桶能自動裝填為水桶。物品 IO 能切換輸入或輸出模式。

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.item.original: XyCraft has some item storage and manipulation. Not much, but still some!
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.item.translation: Xy 工藝有一些物品儲存與操作的機制。不多，但有一些！

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.kivi.original: Kivi can be used for a couple of things, mainly decoration or machines. You'll need Kivi for Machine Frames and the other Machines with XyCraft. It can also be used with Xy Gems and stonecutting for Deco.
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.kivi.translation: 奇石能用來做一些事情，主要是裝飾方塊和機器。你需要奇石製作 Xy 工藝模組的機器基座以及其他的機器。也能和幻晶寶石組合或切石機切石製作一些裝飾方塊。

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.machine.original: Reinforce the Kivi with Aluminum and you'll get Machine Frames which are needed for all the Machines.
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.machine.translation: 用鋁強化奇石能做出機器基座，這是所有 Xy 機器的必需品。

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.pipez.original: To actually get Water or other Fluids into the Tank you'll need some sort of Pipe. Luckily they are all called Pipe(s/z) which helps us not to be confused.\n\nThe Hydro Pump can automatically put Water into them at a slow rate but also for free!
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.pipez.translation: 要真的將水或其他流體導入儲罐中，你需要某種類型的管道。幸運的是這些全部都叫做「管道」，這使我們不會太過困擾。\n\n水泵能自動將水導入儲罐中，速率雖慢但是免費的！

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.tank.original: Now we get to actually making the Tank! First off you need Building Blocks and at least 1 Valve. Glass and Item IOs are optional. The Tank must be made of a frame of building blocks. Building blocks are anything that isn't transparent, gravity influenced, or natural dirt and grass. Can'ts: Gravel, Grass, and Glass. Items like stone, wood, or metal must make the frame; the edges. Glass, Valve, and Item IOs must be placed in the walls and the inside must be hollow. It can only be 13x13x13 big. Once you done all that, right click the Valve and it will either say 'Formed' or will tell you the problem.
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.tank.translation: 現在我們要來真正的打造這個儲罐！首先你需要一些建築方塊以及至少一個閥門。玻璃或物品 IO 可有可無。儲罐的邊框必須是建築方塊。建築方塊不能是透明方塊，受重力影響的方塊，或泥土及草地。也就是不能是礫石，草地和玻璃。石頭，木頭或是金屬等方塊都可以用在框架上，也就是邊。玻璃，閥門和物品 IO 必須放在牆面上，且整個結構的中心必須是中空的。最大能有 13x13x13 這麼大。建好後，對閥門右鍵，它會告訴你「已成型」或告訴你問題出在哪。

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.valve.original: The Valve is the Heart of your Tank. No Valve, no Tank. This is also where you'll pump, or pipe, Water ,or Fluids, into it.
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.valve.translation: 閥門是儲罐的心臟。沒有閥門，沒有儲罐。這也是你把水或其他流體導入的位置。

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.void.original: Fluid Void is a block that stops all water connected to it. Source block or flowing, Anything within 1 block is gone.
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.void.translation: 流體虛空是個能將所有接觸面碰觸到的水停止的方塊。無論是水源方塊或是流動的水，任何碰觸到 1 格位置的水都會消失。

atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.water.original: The Water Block acts as Water without the whole moving part. Cobble Gens can be made with them, farmland can be watered with it, just can't MLG clutch with it. (Fish will also try to get into it but will still die).
atm9.quest.xycraft.desc.water.translation: 水方塊就是水，而沒有流動的部分。可用來打造原版的鵝卵石製造機，農田也能被其濕潤，只是不能做到高空水這種大師級操作。（魚也會試著遊進去，但難免一死。）

atm9.quest.xycraft.extrator.original: Auto farm for rocks and more!
atm9.quest.xycraft.extrator.translation: 岩石以及更多資源的自動農場！

atm9.quest.xycraft.subt.blue.original: The B in Roy G. Biv

atm9.quest.xycraft.subt.red.original: The R in Roy G. Biv
